 * type's render infos made again: a car keeps a texture only another ride
 * holds (a car type shown twice), which goes with that ride, and draws with
 * it freed -- "memory access out of bounds" in its shadow or a part
 * (0x620AE0; overrides.c sub_00639f20 for the purge's lost references).  With
 * friends' cars that is no rare case: a few dozen in use, many of them loading
 * at once (the server's hub relinks a dozen as the player drives) where
 * pool_room checked room for one, and an hour of rides of all sizes coming and
 * going breaks the pool's free memory into pieces.  So in free roam, at a
 * load's memory check, a ride nobody uses goes first, as the game does, and
 * then the pool gets a block more (POOL_MORE, from the main pool, as a track
 * load adds its part: 0x610750), up to POOL_MORE_N of them; past that the
 * game's own purge.  The blocks stay in the pool.  roam.c: 1 = done here.
 * NFSU2_TEST_CARPOOL_FIXED=1 (test aid): the game's way. */
#define FN_BMALLOC      0x00440820u   /* cdecl (size, flags) -> memory */
#define FN_POOL_ADD     0x00440090u   /* cdecl (pool, memory, size) */
#define POOL_MORE       (16u << 20)
#define POOL_MORE_N     6
static int g_pool_more;
int roam_game_purge(CPU *c, uint32_t ret){
    static int fixed = -1;
    if (fixed < 0) fixed = rh_opt("NFSU2_TEST_CARPOOL_FIXED") ? 1 : 0;
    if (!g_inited || !O.on || fixed) return 0;
    switch (ret){                                  /* the load steps' memory checks (not Load's wait for a ride's place, 0x63AEBD) */
    case 0x0063a2bfu: case 0x0063a2ebu: case 0x0063a8d9u: case 0x0063a9cau: case 0x0063ab18u: case 0x0063ac8cu: case 0x0063ad9cu: break;
    default: return 0;
    }
    if (gcall1(c, FN_LOADER_PURGE, G_CARLOADER, 0) & 0xffu) return 1;
    if (g_pool_more >= POOL_MORE_N){
        static long said;
        if (!said || rh_frame() - said > 3600){ said = rh_frame();
            rlog("[roam] f=%ld car pool: no room for a load after %d blocks more: the game's purge\n", rh_frame(), g_pool_more); }
        return 0;
    }
    uint32_t a[2] = { POOL_MORE, 0x2000u }, mem = rh_call(c, FN_BMALLOC, 0, 0, 2, a);
    if (!mem) return 0;
    uint32_t b[3] = { 4u, mem, POOL_MORE };
    rh_call(c, FN_POOL_ADD, 0, 0, 3, b);
    g_pool_more++;
    rlog("[roam] f=%ld car pool: no room for a load (from 0x%08x): %u MB more (%d of %d)\n", rh_frame(), ret, POOL_MORE >> 20,
         g_pool_more, POOL_MORE_N);
    pool_log("more");
    return 1;
}
uint32_t roam_game_pool(uint32_t name, uint32_t count){
    for (unsigned i = 0; i < sizeof g_pools / sizeof g_pools[0]; i++){
        if (name != g_pools[i].name || count >= g_pools[i].count || !env_int("NFSU2_ROAM", 0, 0, 1)) continue;
        if (!g_pools[i].said++) rlog("[roam] %u %s, not %u (friends' cars)\n", g_pools[i].count, g_pools[i].what, count);
        return g_pools[i].count;
    }
    return count;
}
/* lifecycle.c, on the guest thread, when the app parks the game in the
 * background (Cmd-Tab, hidden: WM_ACTIVATEAPP(FALSE), then the game waits in
 * GetMessageA) and when it lets it run again (lifecycle_game_parked(): not
 * while a LAN session keeps the game running in the background).  No frame
 * runs while parked, but the network thread keeps answering friends with
 * the last status, so a player in free roam is announced as paused now
 * (friends see "paused" and the car standing where it stopped, for as long
 * as the pings keep coming); the next frame after the park sends the real status again.
 * int3a review: friends saw a frozen car marked "free roam". */
void roam_game_parked(int on){
    g_parked = on;
    if (!O.on || !g_net_ok) return;
    roam_plat_lock();
    int was_roam = g_s.status == RC_ST_ROAM;
    if (on && was_roam) rc_set_status(&g_s, RC_ST_PAUSED);
    roam_plat_unlock();
    if (on && was_roam) rlog("[roam] f=%ld the app is in the background: friends see you paused\n", rh_frame());
}
/* overrides.c (the rain at a place, on the guest thread): free roam's world
 * with free-roam multiplayer on, where the weather follows the clock everyone
 * shares; also while no friend is connected yet, so it doesn't change when one
 * comes.  Free roam's own track (not the Dyno Shop's), no career race, no LAN */
int roam_game_shared_weather(void){
    return O.on && rd32(G_FLOW) == 6u && rd32(G_TRACK) % 1000u == 0 && !rd32(G_CAREER_RACE) &&
           !(rd32(G_GAMEMODE) & 0x200u);
}
/* discord.c (the port's Discord presence): friends connected now, i.e.
 * established and not lost; 0 while free-roam multiplayer is off.  Takes the
 * session lock, so any thread may ask. */
int roam_game_friends(void){
    if (!O.on || !g_net_ok) return 0;
    int n = 0;
    roam_plat_lock();
    for (int i = 0; i < RC_TABLE; i++) if (g_s.peer[i].state == RC_PS_EST && !g_s.peer[i].lost) n++;
    roam_plat_unlock();
    return n;
}
/* status_web.c, on the guest thread: friends' cars the game holds now, being
 * made, loading, shown or parked (a parked one keeps its ride) */
int roam_game_cars(void){
    if (!O.on) return 0;
    int n = 0;
    for (int k = 0; k < NSLOT; k++) n += g_sl[k].st != SL_FREE;
    return n;
}
/* status_web.c, on the guest thread: Engage does something of ours now (engage_ours, this frame's) */
int roam_game_engage(void){ return O.on && g_engage; }
/* savegame.c, on the guest thread: in a race lobby (hosting it, asked into it, in it, its countdown, the trip): a
 * trip out of free roam (mprace.c) can start at any moment */
int roam_game_in_lobby(void){ return g_mp.st != MP_IDLE; }
/* status_web.c, on the guest thread: 1 while a countdown of the player's would not start here (say_frame: a car
 * meet, and the player has not stayed), so the page's picker dims it and says so (quickchat.ts) */
int roam_game_nocount(void){
#if SAYS
    return O.on && g_say.nocount;
#else
    return 0;
#endif
}
/* status_web.c, on the guest thread: friends' cars shown within a horn's reach (SAY_NEAR_M), so the touch controls'
 * Horn and Quick chat show; once there, until none is within 50 m more (no flicker at the edge) */
int roam_game_near(void){
    static int was;
    uint32_t me = O.on ? player_car() : 0u;
    if (!me || !ok(me, 0x70)) return was = 0;
    float x = MRF32(me + 0x60u), y = MRF32(me + 0x64u), r = SAY_NEAR_M, out = SAY_NEAR_M + 50.f;
    int n = 0, keep = 0;
    for (int k = 0; k < NSLOT; k++){
        uint32_t car = g_sl[k].car;
        if (g_sl[k].st != SL_ACTIVE || !ok(car, 0x70)) continue;
        float dx = MRF32(car + 0x60u) - x, dy = MRF32(car + 0x64u) - y, d2 = dx * dx + dy * dy;
        n += d2 <= r * r; keep += d2 <= out * out;
    }
    return was = n ? n : was ? keep : 0;
}
/* headlights.c, on the guest thread: is this a friend's car being shown? */
int roam_game_friend_car(uint32_t car){
    if (!O.on || !car) return 0;
    for (int k = 0; k < NSLOT; k++)
        if (g_sl[k].car == car && g_sl[k].st == SL_ACTIVE && !g_sl[k].hidden) return 1;
    return 0;
}

/* roam_host.h -- free-roam multiplayer: what roam_game.c needs from its host,
 * for the native port (the guest's memory is the 4 GB arena at g_mem, guest
 * code is the lifted C, called through dispatch_indirect).
 *
 * roam_game.c is shared with the Windows companion (win/roam_asi), which
 * builds it with -DROAM_HOST_WIN and win/roam_asi/roam_host_win.h instead:
 * there the guest's memory is the process's own (a guest address is a
 * pointer) and guest code is the original x86 code, called through a
 * pointer.  Both headers provide the same names:
 *
 *   MR8/MR16/MR32/MRF32(a)  guest memory as lvalues;  GPTR(a)  a host pointer
 *   rh_committed(a)         1 when guest address a is readable and writable
 *   rh_call(c, fn, ecx, edx, n, args)
 *                           call guest function fn with ecx/edx and n stack
 *                           arguments (any convention: the stack is restored
 *                           afterwards); returns eax.  Only from the main-loop
 *                           hook, on the game's thread
 *   rlog(fmt, ...)          one log line (printf format)
 *   rh_opt(name)            an option (NFSU2_ROAM_*), or NULL
 *   rh_frame()              the frame number (logs)
 *   rh_heap_mb()            guest heap in use (live blocks), MB (0 when not known)
 *   rh_ns()                 a monotonic clock in ns (frame cost)
 *   rh_file, rh_fopen/rh_fprintf/rh_fflush   the pose log (test aid)
 *   rh_hud_marker(&x, &y)   a HUD marker's position (640x480 units from the
 *                           view's pixels) as the screen shows the HUD
 *   rh_horn_held(stick)     1 while the horn key or button is held (horn.h's horn_held)
 *   rh_horn_mine()          the player's horn (horn.h's horn_mine), -1: none here
 *   rh_horn_name(kind)      a horn's name (horn.h's horn_name)
 *   rh_horn_begin/rh_horn_sound/rh_horn_end
 *                           a frame of horns (horn.h's horn_begin, ...)
 *   rh_carsfx_begin/rh_carsfx_car/rh_carsfx_end
 *                           a frame of friends' nitrous and hydraulics, heard
 *                           (carsfx.h's carsfx_begin, ...)
 *   rh_no_profile(name)     1 when a profile name is the game's "No Profile"
 *                           (language.c's language_no_profile: in the game's
 *                           language)
 *   rh_drift_tuning(out)    1 with the 41 bytes of the dyno setup the player's
 *                           ride had before drift mode put its Drift setup in
 *                           (drift.c's drift_kept_tuning), 0 when it has its own
 *   rh_showoff_mine()       the player's car's open parts (RC_OPEN_*: showoff.c's
 *                           showoff_mine), 0 where there is no show-off
 *   rh_showoff_car(c, k, car, open)   slot k's car (0: none) and the parts its
 *                           player has open, to open on it (showoff_car)
 *   rh_lights_mine()        the player's headlights: 0 as the game has them, 1 off, 2 high beam (lightkey.c's
 *                           lightkey_mine), 0 where there is no light key
 *   rh_lights_car(k, car, st)   slot k's car (0: none) and its player's headlights, to show (lightkey_car)
 *   rh_damage_on()          the crash damage is on (damage.c's damage_net_on): friends' damage is shown, and the
 *                           HELLO asks for it (RC_HF_DENTS); 0 where there is no crash damage
 *   rh_damage_rev()         the player's car's crash damage as published: +1 for every change friends should see
 *                           (damage.c's damage_net_rev), 0 where there is no crash damage
 *   rh_damage_mine(&epoch, &first, dents, max)   that damage's dents (RC_MSG_DENTS's, RC_DMG_BYTES each): how many
 *   rh_damage_car(c, k, car, peer, epoch, first, n, dents)   slot k's car (0: none), its player and the dents its
 *                           player's last DENTS had, to make on it (damage_net_car)
 *   rh_plate_mine()         our license plate's text ("" the game's own: plates.c's plates_mine), "" where
 *                           there are no plates
 *   rh_plate_car(k, car, text)  slot k's car (0: none) and its player's license plate, to show (plates_friend)
 *   rh_plates_forget()      the world is gone, every slot's car with it (plates_forget)
 *   rh_stance_mine(v)       1 with the player's car's stance (stance.c's stance_wire_mine: v[5] camber front, rear,
 *                           offset front, rear, tires' width), 0 none of its own (or no stance here)
 *   rh_stance_car(k, car, has, v)   slot k's car (0: none) and its stance (has 0: none), to draw (stance_wire_car)
 *   rh_stance_forget()      the world is gone, every slot's car with it (stance_forget)
 *   ROAM_HOST_SCRIPT        defined when the input-script commands exist
 *   RH_FE_NODES             the most objects FEng draws of one package (its
 *                           level sorter's nodes)

#define RH_FE_NODES      8192            /* objects FEng draws of one package: overrides.c's level sorter (the game: 512) */
#define GPTR(a)         (g_mem + (uint32_t)(a))

/* The pose log (a test aid) in the browser: every stdio flush is a
 * synchronous round trip to the I/O worker and an OPFS write.  With stdio's
 * 1 KB buffer that was a flush every ~3 frames and made roam_game_frame cost
 * 0.3 ms a frame on average (max 36 ms) against 20 us without the log.  The
 * buffer holds what the periodic rh_fflush (every 240 frames, roam_game.c)
 * writes, so that stays the only flush: per frame one L row (our car) and
 * one R row per friend's car shown (at most 32, roam_game.c NSLOT), each
 * about 145 bytes (147 at most in the measured runs), with room to 256.
 * 64 KB was 229 frames with one friend. */
#define RH_POSELOG_BUF (240u * (1u + 32u) * 256u)
static inline FILE *rh_fopen(const char *p){
    FILE *f = fopen(p, "w");
    /* musl ignores the size when setvbuf gets no buffer: give it one (one
     * pose log per process, kept open until exit) */
    char *b = f ? malloc(RH_POSELOG_BUF) : NULL;
    if (b) setvbuf(f, b, _IOFBF, RH_POSELOG_BUF);
    return f;
}
#else
#define rh_fopen(p)      fopen((p), "w")
#endif
#define rh_fprintf       fprintf
#define rh_fflush        fflush

static inline uint64_t rh_ns(void){
    static mach_timebase_info_data_t tb;
    if (!tb.denom) mach_timebase_info(&tb);
    return mach_absolute_time() * tb.numer / tb.denom;
}
/* call a guest function (any convention) from the main-loop hook; the CPU
 * state is restored afterwards */
static inline uint32_t rh_call(CPU *c, uint32_t fn, uint32_t ecx, uint32_t edx, int n, const uint32_t *arg){
    CPU save = *c;
    c->esp = (c->esp - 1024u) & ~15u;
    for (int i = n - 1; i >= 0; i--) PUSH32(arg[i]);
    c->ecx = ecx; c->edx = edx;
    PUSH32(ROAM_HOOK_RET);
    dispatch_indirect(c, fn);
    uint32_t r = c->eax;
    *c = save;
    return r;
}
#endif

/* savegame.c -- the pause menu's Save: in career free roam the career saved
 * where the car stands, without a trip to the garage.
 *
 * The game saves the career after races, on leaving a shop, after a cover
 * shoot and on leaving the crib (Return to Explore Mode, with the autosave on
 * and something changed); driving around in between saves nothing, and the
 * place a save keeps for the car is where it last left free roam.  Career free
 * roam's pause menu (not an outrun's) now has Save second, after Return to
 * Explore Mode: the car's place and heading go where leaving free roam keeps
 * them, and the game's own save screen runs over the pause menu, as the crib
 * and the tuning test run's pause menu start it, whatever the Save option
 * (Autosave, Prompt, Off) says: the player asked for it (with Prompt and Off
 * the save screen asks first, as it does for the game's own saves).  Back on
 * the pause menu after it; Resume Career and the crib's Return to Explore Mode later
 * put the car where it was saved.  Greyed out while the car moves (STILL_MPS
 * or faster when the menu comes up), with no profile loaded, in a new
 * career's prologue (no car of its own yet: a state the game never saves),
 * in a free-roam race lobby (its trip out of free roam could come in the
 * middle of the save) and while a save runs.
 *
 * The game (SPEED2.EXE v1.2 NA):
 *  - Career free roam's pause menu (0x4C2900) starts with Return to Explore
 *    Mode (MU_PAUSE_EXPLORE 0xC3E5BCDC, class vtable 0x7954D8), added through
 *    the menu's AddOption (0x50DAB0, patched by photo.c, which calls
 *    savegame_item after each add).  Save goes in after it: an item of
 *    Replay's kind (0x51F670, vtable 0x7954F0, +0x20 greyed out) with the
 *    game's own label MU_PAUSE_SAVE_GAME (0x37D13AE5, "Save" in every
 *    language, which the PC game never shows) and the crib menu's own Save
 *    icon: that is a front-end texture (0x8ADA6FD4) the world does not have,
 *    so texrep_web.c copies it into INGAME_ICON_VOIP_MUTE (0x12F47B2F), which
 *    nothing in the PC game draws, and the item names that.  Its action is Replay's
 *    (0x4C26B0, thiscall: package, message, 3 more; ret 0x14), whose patch in
 *    photo.c asks savegame_accept first.
 *  - The career keeps the car's place for the world's next load at Career
 *    (0x85AD40) +0x8750 (float[3]) and +0x8760 (u16, the heading), +0x8744 1
 *    to put it there, as 0x513B30 takes them from the car (+0x60, +0x40C)
 *    when the pause menu's Quit leaves free roam; the profile saves the three
 *    (0x514530).  Only the world's loads read the flag (0x5404A0, 0x540780):
 *    it goes back to what it was once the save is over.
 *  - The save: 0x4A3100 (cdecl: the package that asks, the package to tell,
 *    the job, 4 more) with the job 0x151, as the crib's Return to Explore
 *    Mode (0x4AF383) and the dyno menu's Quit Tuning (its "save your
 *    profile now?" Yes, 0x5648DB, runtime/dyno.c) call it:
 *    MC_Main.fng over that package; its end (0x4A31D0) tells the package
 *    0x251BF83E and takes MC_Main off, and the job's word ([0x836514]) is 0
 *    again (0x4A3272; not after a job with 0x2000, so here MC_Main up is
 *    what says a save runs).  The save (0x4E8D30, state 5) asks "Are you
 *    sure you want to save the profile named %s?" (0x4A3C10, the job's
 *    0x4000000) unless the autosave is on ([0x844AD9]); a game's first save
 *    asks "Do you want to overwrite previously saved game?": the memory-card
 *    library (the save screen's manager [0x836498] +0x5C) asks it (its state
 *    0xD) while its flag 0x100 (+0x6C) is off, and state 6 turns that off
 *    again (0x4E8F17) while the manager's +6 is 0.  Its answer becomes the
 *    autosave: 0x4C6500 writes it to [0x844AD9] and +6, so a No there turns
 *    Autosave off, and the profile is saved so at the next save.  With
 *    Autosave on, Save sets the two first as that Yes leaves them (+6 1, the
 *    flag on through the game's own 0x6FBFCC): the player asked for the
 *    save, and it is written at once with no question; the save screen then
 *    says "Save complete." (Continue, its only button).
 *    With Prompt or Off the save screen asks as for the game's own saves
 *    (are you sure, overwrite, "Save complete.").
 *  - mprace.c's trip out of free roam (the pause menu's Quit) waits while
 *    savegame_busy(), the player's input theirs.
 *
 * Log lines start "[save]"; tests/scripts/pause_save.txt checks it in the
 * game. */
#include "cpu.h"
#include "guest.h"
#include "game.h"
#include <math.h>
#include <stdio.h>
#include <strings.h>

long autotest_frame(void);
int career_fe_active(const char *name);
int mprace_car_ok(void);              /* mprace.c: the career has a car of its own (not a new one's prologue) */
int roam_game_in_lobby(void);         /* roam_game.c: in a free-roam race lobby (its trip can start any moment) */
int travel_city(float p[3], uint16_t *h);   /* travel.c: on a race track's map, the city's place the car left */

#define G_PLAYER1      SPLIT_PLAYERS_INDEX   /* Player*: +4 its car */
#define G_MC_JOB       0x00836514u   /* the save screen's job: 0 none */
#define G_MC_MANAGER   0x00836498u   /* the save screen's manager: +6 the overwrite question answered Yes this game, */
#define MGR_YES        6u
#define MGR_LIB        0x5cu         /* ... +0x5C the memory-card library ([it] the library: +0x6C its flags) */
#define FN_LIB_FLAGS   0x006fbfccu   /* thiscall (the +0x5C) (on, bits; ret 8): the library's flags on or off */
#define LIB_ASKED      0x100u        /* ... set: the overwrite question answered Yes (not asked again) */
#define G_AUTOSAVE     0x00844ad9u   /* byte: Save at Autosave */
#define CAR_PLACE      0x60u
#define CAR_VELOCITY   0x70u
#define CAR_HEADING    0x40cu
#define FN_ADD_ITEM    0x0050dab0u   /* thiscall (item; ret 4): a menu's AddOption */
#define FN_MC_JOB      0x004a3100u   /* cdecl (package, package to tell, job, 0, 0, 0, 0) */
#define VT_EXPLORE     0x007954d8u   /* Return to Explore Mode's class */
#define VT_REPLAY      0x007954f0u
#define LBL_EXPLORE    0xc3e5bcdcu   /* MU_PAUSE_EXPLORE "Return to Explore Mode" */
#define LBL_SAVE       0x37d13ae5u   /* MU_PAUSE_SAVE_GAME "Save" */
#define ICON_SAVE      0x12f47b2fu   /* INGAME_ICON_VOIP_MUTE, unused: texrep_web.c copies the crib menu's Save icon in */
#define ITEM_BYTES     0x48u
#define IT_GREY        0x20u
#define IT_LABEL       0x2cu
#define MSG_ACCEPT     0x0c407210u
#define MC_JOB_SAVE    0x151u        /* the crib's: save the profile */
#define STILL_MPS      1.0f          /* standing still: slower than this (3.6 km/h) */
#define PLACE_MAX      100000.f      /* farther out than this (m): no place on the map (carspot.c) */
#define WAIT_FRAMES    14400         /* a save not over by then (2 minutes at 120 fps): the flag back anyway */
#define MC_PACKAGE     "MC_Main.fng"

static struct {
    int pending, keep_was, writes_at;
    long at;
} S;
static int g_writes;                 /* profiles the game wrote (fileio.c) */

static uint32_t player_car(void){ uint32_t p = guest_rd32(G_PLAYER1), car = p ? guest_rd32(p + 4u) : 0; return guest_ok(car, CAR_HEADING + 2u) ? car : 0; }

/* why Save cannot run now (0: it can) */
static const char *not_now(void){
    if (MR32(G_GAMEMODE) != 1u || MR32(G_RACETYPE) != 0u) return "not career free roam";
    if (!MR8(G_PROFILE_NAME + 0x20u)) return "no profile loaded";
    if (!mprace_car_ok()) return "no car of the career's own yet";
    if (roam_game_in_lobby()) return "in a race lobby";
    if (S.pending || career_fe_active(MC_PACKAGE)) return "a save runs";
    uint32_t car = player_car();
    if (!car) return "no car";
    float v2 = 0.f;
    for (uint32_t i = 0; i < 3u; i++){
        float p = MRF32(car + CAR_PLACE + 4u * i), v = MRF32(car + CAR_VELOCITY + 4u * i);
        if (!isfinite(p) || fabsf(p) > PLACE_MAX || !isfinite(v)) return "no place on the map";
        v2 += v * v;
    }
    if (!(v2 < STILL_MPS * STILL_MPS)) return "moving";
    return 0;
}

/* photo.c's AddOption patch, after the game's add: after Return to Explore Mode, Save */
void savegame_item(CPU *c, uint32_t menu, uint32_t it){
    if (!guest_ok(it, IT_LABEL + 4u) || MR32(it) != VT_EXPLORE || MR32(it + IT_LABEL) != LBL_EXPLORE) return;
    if (MR32(G_GAMEMODE) != 1u || MR32(G_RACETYPE) != 0u) return;
    uint32_t n = ITEM_BYTES, sv = gcall_main(c, FN_NEW, 0, 1, &n);
    if (!guest_ok(sv, ITEM_BYTES)) return;
    uint32_t arg[3] = { ICON_SAVE, LBL_SAVE, 0 };
    gcall_main(c, FN_ITEM, sv, 3, arg);
    MR32(sv) = VT_REPLAY;
    const char *why = not_now();
    MR8(sv + IT_GREY) = why ? 1 : 0;
    gcall_main(c, FN_ADD_ITEM, menu, 1, &sv);
    fprintf(stderr, "[save] f=%ld the pause menu's Save%s%s%s\n", autotest_frame(), why ? " (greyed out: " : "", why ? why : "", why ? ")" : "");
}

/* photo.c's patch of Replay's action, first: Save's Accept saves; 1 when it was Save's (the call returned) */
int savegame_accept(CPU *c){
    uint32_t it = c->ecx, pkg = MR32(c->esp + 4u), msg = MR32(c->esp + 8u);
    if (!guest_ok(it, IT_LABEL + 4u) || MR32(it + IT_LABEL) != LBL_SAVE || MR32(it) != VT_REPLAY) return 0;
    if (msg == MSG_ACCEPT && !MR8(it + IT_GREY)){
        const char *why = not_now();
        if (why) fprintf(stderr, "[save] f=%ld Save: not now (%s)\n", autotest_frame(), why);
        else {
            uint32_t car = player_car(), k = G_CAREER;
            float city[3]; uint16_t city_h;
            S.keep_was = MR8(k + C_SPOT_SET);
            if (travel_city(city, &city_h)){              /* on a race track's map: the city's place it left (a save
                                                           * loads in the city, in the stock game too) */
                for (uint32_t i = 0; i < 3u; i++) MRF32(k + C_SPOT + 4u * i) = city[i];
                MR16(k + C_SPOT_HEADING) = city_h;
            } else {
                for (uint32_t i = 0; i < 3u; i++) MRF32(k + C_SPOT + 4u * i) = MRF32(car + CAR_PLACE + 4u * i);
                MR16(k + C_SPOT_HEADING) = MR16(car + CAR_HEADING);
            }
            MR8(k + C_SPOT_SET) = 1;
            uint32_t mgr = guest_rd32(G_MC_MANAGER), lib = guest_ok(mgr, MGR_LIB + 3u) ? guest_rd32(mgr + MGR_LIB) : 0;
            if (MR8(G_AUTOSAVE) && lib){                     /* no "overwrite?", whose No turns Autosave off */
                MR8(mgr + MGR_YES) = 1;
                uint32_t on[2] = { 1u, LIB_ASKED };
                gcall_main(c, FN_LIB_FLAGS, lib, 2, on);
            }
            uint32_t arg[7] = { pkg, pkg, MC_JOB_SAVE, 0, 0, 0, 0 };
            S.pending = 1; S.at = autotest_frame(); S.writes_at = g_writes;
            fprintf(stderr, "[save] f=%ld Save: the career at %.1f %.1f %.1f (heading %04x), the save screen\n", S.at,
                    (double)MRF32(k + C_SPOT), (double)MRF32(k + C_SPOT + 4u), (double)MRF32(k + C_SPOT + 8u), MR16(k + C_SPOT_HEADING));
            gcall_main(c, FN_MC_JOB, 0, 7, arg);
        }
    }
    POP32(c->eip);                   /* thiscall, 5 arguments */
    c->esp += 0x14u;
    return 1;
}

/* fileio.c: the game wrote a profile */
void savegame_profile_written(void){ g_writes++; }

/* 1 while Save's save runs, or any save screen is up (mprace.c waits) */
int savegame_busy(void){ return S.pending || career_fe_active(MC_PACKAGE); }

/* the main-loop hook: the save over (its job done, MC_Main off), the career's flag as it was */
void savegame_frame(void){
    if (!S.pending) return;
    long f = autotest_frame();
    int up = MR32(G_MC_JOB) || career_fe_active(MC_PACKAGE);   /* MC_Main comes up through the front end's queue */
    if ((up || f - S.at < 10) && f - S.at < WAIT_FRAMES) return;
    MR8(G_CAREER + C_SPOT_SET) = (uint8_t)S.keep_was;
    S.pending = 0;
    int w = g_writes - S.writes_at;
    fprintf(stderr, "[save] f=%ld Save: %s after %ld frames (%s)\n", f, up ? "the save screen still up" : "over", f - S.at,
            w ? "the profile written" : "nothing written");
}

/* setting.h -- settings from the environment: settings.ini's lines as the
 * page or the Mac app passes them (NFSU2_*), and test knobs.
 * No guest memory here (metal.m uses it too). */
#ifndef NFSU2_SETTING_H
#define NFSU2_SETTING_H
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <strings.h>

/* getenv, looked up once per call site and kept.  For hot paths: a getenv
 * per call measurably cost (getenv + __findenv_locked were 3 % of the guest
 * thread in a profile), and the environment does not change during a run. */
#define ENVC(nm_) ({ static const char *_ev_; static int _ei_; \
                     if (!_ei_){ _ei_ = 1; _ev_ = getenv(nm_); } _ev_; })

/* An on/off setting (the page writes 1 or 0; the Mac app passes the line's
 * own on/off): unset or empty, dflt; 0..., off, no or false (any case), 0;
 * anything else, 1.  Read each call: a caller that reads it often keeps it. */
static inline int setting_bool(const char *env, int dflt){
    const char *e = getenv(env);
    if (!e || !*e) return dflt;
    return *e != '0' && strcasecmp(e, "off") && strcasecmp(e, "no") && strcasecmp(e, "false");
}
#endif

/* shownames.c -- Show Player Names, the game's own row of its LAN and Online
 * options (UI_OLMAIN's Options, only a LAN lobby gets there), in Options >
 * Gameplay too, before Save, in the main menu's and the pause menu's: the
 * names over other players' cars on or off (free roam's, roam_game.c's tags;
 * a LAN race's, the game's own).  The game keeps it in 0x8500C9 (1: on, the
 * original's default, which the FEDatabase's constructor sets with its
 * online settings, 0x5030E0), saves it in the profile with them (0x515BF0;
 * a profile's load 0x515C90 sets it), and nothing else writes it but the
 * row (its method 1, 0x49AC20, flips it on a left or a right).
 *
 * The row is the game's own class (vtable 0x791B70, a toggle of 0x54 bytes
 * made by 0x51E230; its method 3, 0x49AC60, writes the name, 0x0B660729,
 * and On or Off, as each language has them), so nothing of ours runs in it.
 * The value goes to the registry (ShowPlayerNames: the device's, as
 * Power Units'), when a row changes it, the LAN lobby's too, and comes back
 * from there after the constructor and after each profile's load, whatever
 * the profile saved; none (until a row changes it): the game's, as in the
 * original.  The screens' lists place an entry's parts by name and number
 * as powerunits.c says: the row goes in only where the screen's package has
 * them for the list's last entry too, which ours makes one more. */
#include "cpu.h"
#include "guest.h"
#include "game.h"
#include "widescreen.h"           /* HOOK_SITE */
#include <stdio.h>
#include <string.h>

int  win32_reg_get_dword(const char *nm, uint32_t *out);
void win32_reg_put_dword(const char *nm, uint32_t v);

#define REG_NAME      "ShowPlayerNames"
#define A_NAMES       0x008500c9u   /* byte: Show Player Names, 1 = on */
#define FN_TOGGLE     0x0051e230u   /* thiscall (screen +0xFC, +0x10C, +0x114, +0x11C, 1): a toggle entry */
#define FN_ADD        0x0054ef30u   /* thiscall screen (entry, 1): Options > Gameplay's list takes a toggle */
#define FN_ADD_PAUSE  0x0054f170u   /* thiscall screen (entry, 1): the pause menu's */
#define VT_NAMES      0x00791b70u   /* Show Player Names' class (UI_OLMAIN's Options) */
#define MSG_LEFT      0x9120409eu
#define MSG_RIGHT     0xb5971bf1u
#define S_COUNT       0x12cu        /* the screen: its entries so far (the next one's number) */
#define S_PACKAGE     4u            /* its package's name */

static int g_loaded;
static int g_on = -1;                            /* 1: on, 0: off, -1: the game's (no registry value) */
static uint32_t g_scr;                           /* guest memory: scratch for a part's name */

static void load(void){
    if (g_loaded) return;
    g_loaded = 1;
    uint32_t v;
    if (win32_reg_get_dword(REG_NAME, &v)) g_on = v != 0;
}
/* the constructor's defaults or a profile's value set: the registry's instead */
static void apply(const char *after){
    load();
    if (g_on < 0 || MR8(A_NAMES) == (uint8_t)g_on) return;
    MR8(A_NAMES) = (uint8_t)g_on;
    fprintf(stderr, "[names] Show Player Names %s (registry %s), after %s\n", g_on ? "On" : "Off", REG_NAME, after);
}
/* a row's method 1 after its flip (every message comes here, eax the message):
 * a left or right's value to the registry */
static void changed(CPU *c){
    if (c->eax != MSG_LEFT && c->eax != MSG_RIGHT) return;
    load();
    g_on = MR8(A_NAMES) != 0;
    win32_reg_put_dword(REG_NAME, (uint32_t)g_on);
    fprintf(stderr, "[names] Show Player Names %s\n", g_on ? "On" : "Off");
}

/* ---- the row ------------------------------------------------------------- */
/* a part's object in the package by name and number, 0: none */
static uint32_t part(CPU *c, uint32_t pk, uint32_t base, uint32_t n, char *nm, size_t cap){
    int k = 0;
    for (; k < 32 && MR8(base + (uint32_t)k); k++) nm[k] = (char)MR8(base + (uint32_t)k);
    snprintf(nm + k, cap - (size_t)k, "%u", n);
    guest_write_str(g_scr, nm, 48);
    uint32_t h = gcall(c, FN_FE_HASH, 0, 1, &g_scr);
    return gcall(c, FN_PKG_FIND, pk, 1, &h);
}
/* Has the screen's package every part for entry n that it has for n - 1?
 * (powerunits.c's: +0xC4 OPTION_NAME_ .. +0xD8, but for +0xCC in the
 * menus' list, 0x54EF30) */
static int parts_there(CPU *c, uint32_t scr, uint32_t n, int pause){
    uint32_t pn = MR32(scr + S_PACKAGE), pk = pn ? gcall(c, FN_FE_PACKAGE, 0, 1, &pn) : 0;
    if (!pk || n < 2u) return 0;
    for (uint32_t o = 0xc4u; o <= 0xd8u; o += 4u){
        char nm[48], was[48];
        uint32_t b = o == 0xccu && !pause ? 0 : MR32(scr + o);
        if (b && !part(c, pk, b, n, nm, sizeof nm) && part(c, pk, b, n - 1u, was, sizeof was)){
            fprintf(stderr, "[names] the screen has %s but no %s: no Show Player Names row\n", was, nm);
            return 0;
        }
    }
    return 1;
}
/* the game's row, entry n, before `after` more of the game's */
static void add(CPU *c, uint32_t scr, uint32_t fn_add, uint32_t after){
    if (!g_scr){
        uint32_t sz = 64u;
        if (!(g_scr = gcall(c, FN_NEW, 0, 1, &sz))) return;
    }
    uint32_t n = MR32(scr + S_COUNT);
    if (!parts_there(c, scr, n + after, fn_add == FN_ADD_PAUSE)) return;
    uint32_t sz = 0x54u, w = gcall(c, FN_NEW, 0, 1, &sz);
    if (!w) return;
    uint32_t a[5] = { scr + 0xfcu, scr + 0x10cu, scr + 0x114u, scr + 0x11cu, 1u };
    gcall(c, FN_TOGGLE, w, 5, a);
    MR32(w) = VT_NAMES;
    uint32_t b[2] = { w, 1u };
    gcall(c, fn_add, scr, 2, b);
}

int shownames_hook(CPU *c, uint32_t ip){
    switch (ip){
    case HOOK_SITE(0x004b7544): add(c, c->esi, FN_ADD, 1u); return 1;         /* Options > Gameplay: after Race Map Mode, before Save */
    case HOOK_SITE(0x004c3bfb): add(c, c->esi, FN_ADD_PAUSE, 1u); return 1;   /* the pause menu's: after Race Map Mode, before Save */
    case HOOK_SITE(0x0049ac46): changed(c); return 1;                         /* the row's method 1, after its flip */
    case HOOK_SITE(0x0053ed7c): apply("the defaults"); return 1;              /* the FEDatabase's constructor: its online settings' defaults */
    case HOOK_SITE(0x0053465f): apply("a profile's load"); return 1;          /* a profile's load (0x5344D0): its online settings */
    }
    return 0;
}

/* showoff.c -- free roam's show-off: with the car standing, O (or the
 * controller's D-pad down held for a second) opens its parts one at a
 * time: the hood, then the trunk alone, then both doors alone, then all of
 * them, then closes them all (players wanted the hood or the doors alone,
 * 2026-11-03/04); they close by themselves as soon as the car drives off.  Other
 * players see them open: roam_game.c sends the open parts with the car's
 * state (RC_OPEN_*, roam_core.h) and hands each friend's car and its parts
 * here, where they open on that car.
 *
 * The parts are the game's: its magazine and DVD cover shoot opens them on
 * the player's car out in the world (the shoot's D-pad screen,
 * UI_Showcase_DPAD.fng, 0x4B5AD0: 0x61F820 with the car's render info, the
 * part, 0 hood, 1 trunk, 2 left door, 3 right door, open or not, 1.0f; the
 * shoot's start loads the animations, 0x4CE770 -> 0x633A00, its end closes

 * door's REG, SCISSOR, SUICIDE and WIDE1..4 (0x433AD0 picks one by the part
 * and its kind); all 31 player cars have them all, but for the three SUVs'
 * wide doors.  Drawing the car (0x620AE0) poses the parts by them: 0x433CD0

 * collisions are the same with them open.
 *
 * A part's state is a node (0x28 bytes, made by 0x433A80) on its bank's list
 * (bank +0xC: the list's head, next and previous): +8 the speed (1.0f), +0xC
 * the part, +0x10 the state (1 closed, 2 opening, 0 open, 3 closing; 0x433D50

 * opening or a closing), +0x14 its kind, +0x18/+0x1C when it began, +0x20 the

 *
 * The controller's D-pad down is the game's Legend (Career Status) as well:
 * in free roam with no screen over the HUD, a press goes to the game only
 * when it is let go within the second (as a short press then: showoff_pad,

/* the bank of a car type (0x433A30's walk; 0: its animations are not in) */
static uint32_t bank_of(uint32_t type){
    uint32_t e = guest_rd32(G_BANKS), b = e ? e - 4u : 0;
    for (int n = 0; b && b != G_BANKS - 4u && n < 256 && guest_ok(b, 0x28); n++){
        if (MR32(b + 0x24u) == type) return b;
        e = MR32(b + 4u); b = e ? e - 4u : 0;
    }
    return 0;
}

/* free roam's world: its own race, paused or not, not an outrun, a career race or an online one */

}

}

/* a cover shoot is on (its screens on top: UI_ShowCase_Preview.fng, UI_Showcase_DPAD.fng): it opens and closes the
 * player's car's parts itself, on the game's list */
static int shoot_on(void){
    uint32_t fe = guest_rd32(G_FENG), mg = fe ? guest_rd32(fe + 8u) : 0, top = mg ? coop_fe_top(mg) : 0;
    char a[40];
    guest_read_str(top ? guest_rd32(top + 0xcu) : 0, a, sizeof a);
    return !strncasecmp(a, "UI_Showcase", 11);
}

/* O presses since the last frame (a tap between frames counts): the player's key for it (O unless NFSU2_KEY_SHOWOFF:
 * dinput_kbd.c dikbd_site_key), none while the player has one of the game's controls on it (dikbd_ours; dinput_pad.c
 * leaves the D-pad's hold to the game the same way) */
int dikbd_ours(unsigned dik, const char *what);
unsigned dikbd_site_key(const char *env, unsigned dflt);
static int o_presses(void){
    static unsigned dik = 0x100u;
    if (dik == 0x100u) dik = dikbd_site_key("NFSU2_KEY_SHOWOFF", DIK_O);
    uint32_t head = kbd_ev_head();
    if (!S.kinit){ S.kinit = 1; S.kseq = head; return 0; }
    int n = 0;
    for (; S.kseq != head; S.kseq++){
        KbdEv e;
        int r = kbd_ev_get(S.kseq, &e);
        if (r == 0) break;
        if (r > 0 && dik && e.dik == dik){ if (e.down && !S.ostate && dikbd_ours(dik, "the show-off")) n++; S.ostate = e.down; }
    }
    return n;
}

/* the controller's buttons as the game reads them (dinput_pad.c fill_state): D-pad down (the D-pad direction D the
 * player has for it: NFSU2_BUTTON_HOLD) kept back in free roam, held a second a step (the car stood at the press) or
 * drift mode (it drove), the game's own press when let go before */
uint32_t showoff_pad(uint32_t b, uint32_t D){
    double t = now_s();
    int down = (b & D) != 0;
    if (down && !S.held && S.gate){ S.held = 1; S.fired = 0; S.t0 = t; S.hmove = S.moving; }
    if (S.held){
        if (!down){ S.held = 0; if (!S.fired) S.tap_until = t + TAP_S; }
        else if (!S.fired && t - S.t0 >= HOLD_S){ S.fired = 1; if (S.hmove) S.drifts++; else S.fires++; }
        b &= ~D;
    }
    if (t < S.tap_until) b |= D;
    return b;
}

/* our block of guest memory (the first time a part opens) */
static int mem_ok(CPU *c){
    if (S.mem) return 1;
    uint32_t sz = SO_CARS * 4u * NODE_SZ + SO_TYPES * 64u;
    S.mem = gcall_main(c, FN_NEW, 0, 1, &sz);
    if (!S.mem){ fprintf(stderr, "[showoff] guest malloc failed\n"); return 0; }
    for (uint32_t i = 0; i < sz; i += 4) MR32(S.mem + i) = 0;
    return 1;
}
/* a car type's animations in (1), or on the way (0, loading them; -1: they can't be had) */
static int bank_ready(CPU *c, uint32_t ti){
    uint32_t type = guest_ok(ti, 0xd4) ? MR32(ti + 0xd0u) : 0;
    if (!type) return -1;
    if (bank_of(type)) return 1;
    if (!roam_world()) return 0;                                       /* loads only out in free roam (sub_00438140) */
    Bank *k = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < S.nbank && !k; i++) if (S.bank[i].type == type) k = &S.bank[i];
    if (!k){
        if (S.nbank == SO_TYPES || !mem_ok(c)) return -1;
        k = &S.bank[S.nbank]; memset(k, 0, sizeof *k); k->type = type;
        k->name = S.mem + SO_CARS * 4u * NODE_SZ + 64u * (uint32_t)S.nbank++;
    }
    long f = autotest_frame();
    if (k->st == 1 && f - k->since < 600) return 0;                    /* on the way (10 s at most) */
    char nm[24], path[64];
    guest_read_str(ti, nm, sizeof nm);
    /* not in after 10 s, or its bank gone with the file still in: load it again.  The old file is left loaded, never
     * unloaded: the game's file unload (0x580E90 -> 0x439D70) takes the first bank of the file's car type off the list,
     * and with none there it calls through 0 (exit 134, 2026-11-02: ... car_apply); one that comes in late is a
     * second bank of the type, which 0x438140 (sub_00438140) deletes at the latest */
    if (k->st){
        if (k->file) fprintf(stderr, "[showoff] f=%ld %s: the part animations are not in: loading them again (the first file left loaded)\n", f, nm);
        k->file = 0; k->st = 0;
    }
    if (k->tries >= 3) return -1;
    snprintf(path, sizeof path, "CARS\\%s\\PARTS_ANIMATIONS.BIN", nm);
    for (int i = 0; i < 64; i++) MR8(k->name + (uint32_t)i) = (uint8_t)path[i < (int)sizeof path ? i : 63];
    MR8(k->name + 63u) = 0;
    uint32_t a[6] = { k->name, 0, 0, 1, FN_NOP, 0 };
    k->file = gcall_main(c, FN_LOAD, 0, 6, a);
    k->st = 1; k->since = f; k->tries++;
    fprintf(stderr, "[showoff] f=%ld %s: loading the car's part animations (%s)\n", f, nm, k->file ? "under way" : "FAILED");
    return 0;
}

/* a part's kind as 0x61F820 picks it: the hood by its hood part (split hoods: front, else left and right), the doors by
 * the door style part's attribute (scissor doors on a wide body: the wide body's), the trunk's the one; *mark: the
 * hood is the car's "style 22" hood */
static uint32_t so_kind(CPU *c, uint32_t ri, int part, uint32_t *mark){
    uint32_t ride = guest_rd32(ri + RI_RIDE), ti = guest_rd32(ri + RI_TYPE), type = guest_ok(ti, 0xd4) ? MR32(ti + 0xd0u) : 0, kind = 0;
    *mark = 0;
    if (!guest_ok(ride, 0x8f0)) return 0;
    if (part == 0){
        uint32_t h = guest_rd32(ride + RIDE_HOOD);
        if (!guest_ok(h, 0xe) || (MR8(h + 5u) & 0x1fu) != 5u) return 0;
        uint32_t s = S_ATTR_HOOD, ah = gcall_main(c, FN_HASH, 0, 1, &s), aa[2] = { ah, 0 }, at = gcall_main(c, FN_ATTR, h, 2, aa);
        kind = guest_ok(at, 8) && MR32(at + 4u) ? 4u : 2u;
        uint32_t key = (uint32_t)MR16(h + 2u) << 16 | MR16(h), s1[2] = { S_STYLE22, type }, s2[2] = { S_STYLE22CF, type };
        *mark = key == gcall_main(c, FN_HASH2, 0, 2, s1) || key == gcall_main(c, FN_HASH2, 0, 2, s2);
        return kind;
    }
    if (part == 1) return 0;
    uint32_t d = guest_rd32(ride + RIDE_DOORS);
    if (!guest_ok(d, 0xe)) return 0;
    uint32_t s = S_ATTR_DOOR, ah = gcall_main(c, FN_HASH, 0, 1, &s), aa[2] = { ah, 0 }, at = gcall_main(c, FN_ATTR, d, 2, aa);
    if (!guest_ok(at, 8)) return 0;
    kind = MR32(at + 4u);
    if (kind == 1u){
        uint32_t w = guest_rd32(ride + RIDE_WIDE);
        if (guest_ok(w, 6)){ uint8_t b = MR8(w + 5u); if ((b >> 5) && (b & 0x1fu)) kind = (b & 0x1fu) + 2u; }
    }
    return kind;
}
/* the player's car sounds as the shoot's does: the hood 3 / 2, the trunk 5 / 4, the doors (as one) 1 / 0 */
static void so_sound(CPU *c, int part, int open){
    if (part == 3) return;
    uint32_t snd = guest_rd32(G_SOUND), w = snd ? guest_rd32(snd + 0x78u) : 0;
    if (!w || guest_rd32(snd + 0x90u) == 1u) return;
    uint32_t which = part == 0 ? (open ? 3u : 2u) : part == 1 ? (open ? 5u : 4u) : (open ? 1u : 0u);
    gcall_main(c, FN_SOUND, w, 1, &which);
}

static int live_of(const Car *k){
    for (int p = 0; p < 4; p++) if (k->node[p] && MR32(k->node[p] + 0x10u) != 1u) return 1;
    return 0;
}
static void count_live(void){ int n = 0; for (int i = 0; i < SO_CARS; i++) n += S.car[i].live = (uint8_t)live_of(&S.car[i]); S.nlive = n; }
/* a car gone (or another one in its place): its nodes closed at once, kept for the next */
static void car_reset(Car *k){
    for (int p = 0; p < 4; p++) if (k->node[p]) MR32(k->node[p] + 0x10u) = 1u;
    k->car = k->ri = k->type = 0; k->want = k->has = 0; k->live = 0;
}
/* the car's parts to what it wants: open those it should and has not, close those it has and should not (closing a
 * part never opened would open it: 0x433A80 makes a node opening).
 * A node is kept for the next car in its slot (car_reset), and it holds the car type it was made for (+0x20).  A part
 * turned the other way while it opens or closes (0x433D50 from 2 to 3, or 3 to 2) is timed by its animation: 0x433D10
 * looks up that type's bank (0x433A30) and hands it to 0x433AD0, which reads the bank's animation list with no check.
 * With that type's animations thrown away since (a garage, shop or race lobby: 0x438140), the bank is 0, the list
 * reads 0 and the game calls through 0 for ever: free roam froze, or stopped with error 134, in a crowd (2026-11-02
 * 22:47 to 11-03, stack sub_00433ad0 < sub_00433d10 < car_apply).  The log of one: slot 30's trunk opened on a 350Z,
 * the game threw the banks away, a Skyline came into the slot and opened the hood (a new node) and the trunk (the
 * 350Z's node, which the drawing never finds on the Skyline's list, so it stayed opening), and its trunk closing was
 * the 350Z's bank looked up.  So a node of another type is made anew when its part opens, and one whose type has no
 * bank closes at once.  Test: tests/scripts/showoff_stale.txt (NFSU2_TEST_SHOWOFF_STALE=1, script runs only: the
 * player's car's trunk node first made for a type with no animations, as a slot's earlier car leaves it). */
static void car_apply(CPU *c, Car *k, int sound, const char *who){
    if (k->want == k->has || !guest_ok(k->ri, 0x2d48)) return;
    uint32_t ti = guest_rd32(k->ri + RI_TYPE);
    int r = bank_ready(c, ti);
    if (r <= 0){
        if (r < 0 && k->has){ for (int p = 0; p < 4; p++) if (k->node[p]) MR32(k->node[p] + 0x10u) = 1u; k->has = 0; }
        if (r < 0){ k->want = 0; if (k == &S.car[0]) S.failed = 1; }
        return;
    }
    if (!mem_ok(c)) return;
    int idx = (int)(k - S.car);
    static int stale = -1;                                             /* test aid, script runs only */
    if (stale < 0){ const char *s = getenv("NFSU2_INPUT_SCRIPT"), *e = getenv("NFSU2_TEST_SHOWOFF_STALE"); stale = s && *s && e && *e == '1'; }
    if (stale == 1 && idx == 0 && !k->node[1]){
        uint32_t n = k->node[1] = S.mem + NODE_SZ, a[5] = { k->type ^ 0x5a5a5a5au, 0x3f800000u, 1u, 0u, 0u };
        gcall_main(c, FN_NODE_INIT, n, 5, a);
        MR32(n + 0x10u) = 1u; stale = 2;
        fprintf(stderr, "[showoff] f=%ld test: my car's trunk node is one of another car type, closed\n", autotest_frame());
    }
    for (int p = 0; p < 4; p++){
        uint8_t bit = (uint8_t)(1u << p);
        int w = (k->want & bit) != 0, h = (k->has & bit) != 0;
        if (w == h) continue;
        uint32_t mark = 0, kind = w ? so_kind(c, k->ri, p, &mark) : 0, n = k->node[p];
        if (w && (!n || MR32(n + 0x20u) != k->type)){
            n = k->node[p] = S.mem + ((uint32_t)idx * 4u + (uint32_t)p) * NODE_SZ;
            uint32_t a[5] = { k->type, 0x3f800000u, (uint32_t)p, kind, mark };
            gcall_main(c, FN_NODE_INIT, n, 5, a);                          /* opening, from now */
        } else if (!w && !bank_of(MR32(n + 0x20u))){
            MR32(n + 0x10u) = 1u;                                     /* closed at once: no animation to close by */
        } else {
            if (w){ MR32(n + 8u) = 0x3f800000u; MR32(n + 0x14u) = kind; MR8(n + 0x24u) = (uint8_t)mark; }
            uint32_t a[2] = { n, w ? 2u : 3u };
            gcall_main(c, FN_NODE_GO, 0, 2, a);
        }
        if (sound) so_sound(c, p, w);
        k->has ^= bit;
        fprintf(stderr, "[showoff] f=%ld %s: %s %s (kind %u)\n", autotest_frame(), who, k_part[p], w ? "opens" : "closes", kind);
    }
}
/* a car of ours to show: its car (0: none), what should be open */
static void car_set(Car *k, uint32_t car, uint8_t want){
    uint32_t ri = guest_ok(car, 0x9e0) ? guest_rd32(car + CAR_RI) : 0, ti = guest_ok(ri, 0x2d48) ? guest_rd32(ri + RI_TYPE) : 0;
    uint32_t type = guest_ok(ti, 0xd4) ? MR32(ti + 0xd0u) : 0;
    if (!type){ if (k->car) car_reset(k); return; }
    if (k->car != car || k->ri != ri || k->type != type){ car_reset(k); k->car = car; k->ri = ri; k->type = type; }
    k->want = want & RC_OPEN_ALL;
}

/* roam_game.c: a friend's car shown in slot k (0: none) and the parts its player has open */
void showoff_car(CPU *c, int k, uint32_t car, uint8_t open){
    if (k < 0 || k >= SO_FRIENDS) return;
    Car *e = &S.car[1 + k];
    if (!car && !e->car) return;
    car_set(e, car, open);
    if (e->car){ char who[24]; snprintf(who, sizeof who, "slot %d", k); car_apply(c, e, 0, who); }
}
/* roam_game.c: the player's open parts, for friends (RC_OPEN_*) */
uint8_t showoff_mine(void){ return S.car[0].car ? S.car[0].want : 0; }

/* each frame, from the main-loop hook */
void showoff_frame(CPU *c){
    int world = roam_world(), top = world && hud_on_top() && !guest_rd32(G_FREEZE);
    uint32_t pl = guest_rd32(G_PLAYER1), car = pl ? guest_rd32(pl + 4u) : 0;
    float v = guest_ok(car, 0x9e0) ? fabsf(MRF32(car + CAR_FWD_SPEED)) : 0.f;
    if (!(v == v)) v = 0.f;
    int stands = top && v < OPEN_MPS;
    S.gate = top; S.moving = !stands;
    for (; S.drifts > 0; S.drifts--) drift_pad();
    int n = o_presses() * !typing(), fires = S.fires; S.fires = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < n + fires; i++){
        const char *how = i < n ? "O" : "D-pad down held";
        if (!stands){
            if (!S.note) fprintf(stderr, "[showoff] f=%ld %s: nothing (%s)\n", autotest_frame(), how,
                                 !world ? "not in free roam" : !top ? "a screen over the HUD" : "the car moves");
            S.note = 1;
            continue;
        }
        S.note = 0;
        S.step = (S.step + 1) % NSTEPS;
        fprintf(stderr, "[showoff] f=%ld %s: step %d (%s)\n", autotest_frame(), how, S.step, k_stepname[S.step]);
    }
    int shoot = world && shoot_on();
    if (S.step && (!world || shoot || v > SHUT_MPS)){
        fprintf(stderr, "[showoff] f=%ld %s: all closed\n", autotest_frame(),
                !world ? "out of free roam" : shoot ? "a cover shoot" : "the car drives off");
        S.step = 0;
    }
    Car *me = &S.car[0];
    if (!world || shoot){ if (me->car) car_reset(me); }
    else if (S.step || me->car){ car_set(me, car, k_step[S.step]); car_apply(c, me, 1, "my car"); }
    if (S.failed){
        if (S.step) fprintf(stderr, "[showoff] f=%ld my car's part animations can't be had: closed\n", autotest_frame());
        S.failed = 0; S.step = 0;
    }
    count_live();
}

/* ---- the drawing: each car with its own nodes -------------------------------------------------------------------------
 * The car's render info is this (ecx) in both; its nodes go on its type's bank's list (the list's own, the game's,
 * set aside) for the call, then the list is as it was. */
static Car *drawn(uint32_t ri, uint32_t *bank){
    if (!S.nlive) return 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < SO_CARS; i++){
        Car *k = &S.car[i];
        if (k->live && k->ri == ri){ uint32_t b = bank_of(k->type); if (!b) return 0; *bank = b; return k; }
    }
    return 0;
}
/* damage.c: the crash damage has lost the part (it lies on the road, or is gone): the show-off leaves it as it is (the
 * game's animation would move what is left of it); none where the damage is not built in */
__attribute__((weak)) int damage_part_lost(uint32_t ri, int part);
static void put_on(Car *k, uint32_t b, uint32_t *keep){
    uint32_t head = b + 0xcu, prev = head;
    keep[0] = MR32(head); keep[1] = MR32(head + 4u);
    for (int p = 0; p < 4; p++){
        uint32_t n = k->node[p];
        if (!n || (damage_part_lost && damage_part_lost(k->ri, p))) continue;
        MR32(prev) = n; MR32(n + 4u) = prev; prev = n;
    }
    MR32(prev) = head; MR32(head + 4u) = prev;
}
static void take_off(uint32_t b, const uint32_t *keep){ MR32(b + 0xcu) = keep[0]; MR32(b + 0x10u) = keep[1]; }

/* The trunk's audio (the layout, ride slot 0x22, and its 12 pieces, 0x23..0x2E, on the layout's places, render info
 * +0x2184): 0x620AE0 draws it only for a car whose racer record's driver is a human (car +0x14, +4 == 1: never a
 * friend's car, kind 2 or 4), and out in the world (not the front end, no cover shoot) each piece as an empty box of
 * its size (AUDIO_COMP_EMPTY_*, +0x2B74: what shows through a hatch's glass) instead of its own model (+0x2274).  The
 * cover shoot, which opens the trunk out in the world, has its flag (G_SHOWCASE, 0x499DB0) set: the pieces' own
 * models then, and the car at its first LOD (0x62118F).  So while a car's trunk is open (opening, open or closing)
 * near the camera, its drawing runs with that flag and a human's driver kind, both as they were again after.
 * Nothing else in 0x620AE0 or what it calls reads either (the flag's three reads are 0x62118F, 0x630883 and
 * 0x630C29; the kind's one 0x6306D4). */
#define G_SHOWCASE     0x00836352u   /* byte: a cover shoot is on (0x4CE770 sets it, 0x499FA0 clears it) */
#define G_VIEW1        0x00832e50u   /* eView 1: +0x40 its camera (+0x40 its position) */
#define CAR_REC        0x14u         /* car: its racer record (+4 the driver: 1 a human, 2 an AI racer, 3 traffic) */
#define CAR_POS        0x60u
#define TRUNK_NEAR_M   40.f          /* farther off the pieces are a few pixels: the game's boxes */
static uint32_t trunk_rec(const Car *k){
    static int game_way = -1;                                          /* test aid, script runs only: the game's drawing */
    if (game_way < 0){ const char *s = getenv("NFSU2_INPUT_SCRIPT"), *e = getenv("NFSU2_TEST_TRUNK_GAMEWAY"); game_way = s && *s && e && *e == '1'; }
    if (game_way) return 0;
    uint32_t n = k->node[1], car = k->car, rec = guest_ok(car, 0x9e0) ? guest_rd32(car + CAR_REC) : 0, cam = guest_rd32(G_VIEW1 + 0x40u);
    if (!n || MR32(n + 0x10u) == 1u || !guest_ok(rec, 8) || guest_rd32(k->ri) != car || !guest_ok(cam, 0x4c)) return 0;
    float dx = MRF32(car + CAR_POS) - MRF32(cam + 0x40u), dy = MRF32(car + CAR_POS + 4u) - MRF32(cam + 0x44u),
          dz = MRF32(car + CAR_POS + 8u) - MRF32(cam + 0x48u), d2 = dx * dx + dy * dy + dz * dz;
    return d2 == d2 && d2 < TRUNK_NEAR_M * TRUNK_NEAR_M ? rec : 0;
}

/* photo.c: a car photo mode does not draw (its Cars list); none where photo mode is not built in */
__attribute__((weak)) int photo_hides(uint32_t ri){ (void)ri; return 0; }
/* damage.c: the crash damage's work before a car is drawn; none where it is not built in */
__attribute__((weak)) void damage_render(CPU *c);
/* carpaint.c: the car's exhaust tips, calipers and rims with its own paint, not another car's; none where it is not
 * built in */
__attribute__((weak)) void carpaint_draw(uint32_t ri);
__attribute__((weak)) void carpaint_drawn(void);
/* stance.c: the car's stance (its wheels' camber and offset, its tires' width) for the call; none where it is not built
 * in */
__attribute__((weak)) void stance_draw_begin(CPU *c);
__attribute__((weak)) void stance_draw_end(void);
void sub_00620ae0_orig(CPU *c);
uint32_t plates_begin(uint32_t ri);               /* plates.c: the car's own license plate while it is drawn */
void plates_end(uint32_t before);
void sub_00620ae0(CPU *c){                       /* the car's drawing */
    if (photo_hides(c->ecx)){ POP32(c->eip); c->esp += 0x30u; return; }   /* (thiscall, ret 0x30) */
    if (damage_render) damage_render(c);
    if (carpaint_draw) carpaint_draw(c->ecx);
    uint32_t plate = plates_begin(c->ecx);
    if (stance_draw_begin) stance_draw_begin(c);
    uint32_t b = 0, keep[2]; Car *k = drawn(c->ecx, &b);
    if (!k){
        sub_00620ae0_orig(c);
        if (stance_draw_end) stance_draw_end();
        plates_end(plate); if (carpaint_drawn) carpaint_drawn(); return;
    }
    put_on(k, b, keep);
    uint32_t rec = trunk_rec(k), kind = 0; uint8_t shoot = 0;
    if (rec){ shoot = MR8(G_SHOWCASE); kind = MR32(rec + 4u); MR8(G_SHOWCASE) = 1; MR32(rec + 4u) = 1u; }
    sub_00620ae0_orig(c);
    if (rec){ MR8(G_SHOWCASE) = shoot; MR32(rec + 4u) = kind; }
    take_off(b, keep);
    if (stance_draw_end) stance_draw_end();
    plates_end(plate);
    if (carpaint_drawn) carpaint_drawn();
}
void sub_00615a10_orig(CPU *c);
void sub_00615a10(CPU *c){                       /* the car's lights (the hood's and the trunk's parts) */
    if (photo_hides(c->ecx)){ POP32(c->eip); c->esp += 0xcu; return; }    /* (its neon too; thiscall, ret 0xC) */
    uint32_t b = 0, keep[2]; Car *k = drawn(c->ecx, &b);
    if (!k){ sub_00615a10_orig(c); return; }
    put_on(k, b, keep);
    sub_00615a10_orig(c);
    take_off(b, keep);
}

/* ---- the game throws away the animation banks: ours first, and safely -------------------------------------------------
 * 0x438140 (cdecl, a car type's hash, 0: every bank) takes each bank of that type off the list (G_BANKS), lets go of its
 * animations (0x4380F0) and deletes it (its vtable's first, 1), then reads the next bank from the one it has just
 * deleted.  The game calls it with 0 only (from 0x61C63F, 0x61C5E2, 0x63B118, 0x637A05: the car loader's one record),
 * each time right after unloading that record's file, which takes its bank off: the list is empty and the walk never
 * runs.  Ours were still on it (a friend's open trunk is enough: any car lot, garage, cover shoot or race lobby
 * after it), so the walk deleted one and went on from freed memory: the heap keeps its free list there (heap.c, +0 and
 * +4 of a free block), the next "bank" was 0 and the game crashed calling through it (0x4380F0's null indirect call,
 * exit 134, from 18:05 UTC on 2026-11-02).  Here our files are unloaded first, the way the game unloads its own (so
 * their banks go as its do), and the walk reads the next bank before it deletes one.  Their cars' parts show closed
 * until their banks are in again (bank_ready, out in free roam only).  Test: tests/scripts/showoff_banks.txt;
 * NFSU2_TEST_BANKS_GAMEWAY=1 (script runs only) the game's way, for the A/B; NFSU2_TEST_BANKS_LOST=1 (script runs
 * only) the walk deletes ours with their files still in, as the live game's did when it got through
 * (tests/scripts/showoff_banks_lost.txt, bank_ready). */
#define FN_BANK_FREE   0x004380f0u   /* thiscall bank: lets go of its animations */
static void drop_ours(CPU *c){
    int n = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < S.nbank; i++){
        Bank *k = &S.bank[i];
        if (!k->file || !bank_of(k->type)) continue;                   /* (still loading: not on the list yet) */
        uint32_t a = k->file;
        gcall_main(c, FN_UNLOAD, 0, 1, &a);
        k->file = 0; k->st = 0; k->tries = 0; n++;
    }
    if (!n) return;
    for (int i = 0; i < SO_CARS; i++){                                 /* their parts open again once the banks are back */
        Car *k = &S.car[i];
        for (int p = 0; p < 4; p++) if (k->node[p]) MR32(k->node[p] + 0x10u) = 1u;
        k->has = 0;
    }
    count_live();
    fprintf(stderr, "[showoff] f=%ld the game throws the part animations away: %d of ours unloaded first\n", autotest_frame(), n);
}
void sub_00438140_orig(CPU *c);
void sub_00438140(CPU *c){
    static int game_way = -1, lost = -1;                               /* test aids, script runs only: the game's walk; */
    if (game_way < 0){                                                 /* ours deleted with their files still in */
        const char *s = getenv("NFSU2_INPUT_SCRIPT"), *e = getenv("NFSU2_TEST_BANKS_GAMEWAY"), *l = getenv("NFSU2_TEST_BANKS_LOST");
        game_way = s && *s && e && *e == '1'; lost = s && *s && l && *l == '1';
    }
    if (game_way){ sub_00438140_orig(c); return; }
    uint32_t type = MR32(c->esp + 4u);
    if (!lost) drop_ours(c);
    uint32_t e = guest_rd32(G_BANKS), b = e ? e - 4u : 0;
    for (int n = 0; b && b != G_BANKS - 4u && n < 4096 && guest_ok(b, 0x28); n++){
        uint32_t ne = MR32(b + 4u), next = ne ? ne - 4u : 0;           /* read before the bank is deleted */
        if (!type || MR32(b + 0x24u) == type){
            uint32_t pv = MR32(b + 8u), nx = MR32(b + 4u), one = 1;
            MR32(pv) = nx; MR32(nx + 4u) = pv;
            gcall_main(c, FN_BANK_FREE, b, 0, 0);
            gcall_main(c, MR32(MR32(b)), b, 1, &one);
            fprintf(stderr, "[showoff] f=%ld a bank was still on the list: deleted\n", autotest_frame());
        }
        b = next;
    }
    POP32(c->eip);                                                    /* (cdecl) */
}

/* ---- the animation library's heap ------------------------------------------
 * EAGL, the game's animation library, takes one block for its animation
 * objects at startup (0x431840 -> 0x6E1B30 -> its allocator's init 0x6E2310,
 * vtable 0x7C147C +4): 0x19000 bytes from the main pool (0x42FB40), base
 * [0x8AB28C], size [0x8AB288].  Objects come from free lists, by size (+0x14,
 * 0x6E2290: [0x8AAE80 + k * 4] with k = (n >> 4) & 0xFF, a block of k * 16 +
 * 0x14 bytes, k in its first dword, the object 4 in) or by kind (+0x1C,
 * 0x6E2240: [0x8AAE18 + kind * 4], word [0x811E00 + kind * 2] bytes), else
 * from the bump [0x8AAE10], which nothing checks against the block's end;
 * freeing (+0x18, +0x20) only puts a block back on its list.  The game loads
 * one car type's part animations at a time and never came near the end.
 * Show-off keeps those of every car type a friend's car opened a part with
 * (79 of the 100 KB with all 31; they do not grow when loaded again), and a
 * race's ending scene and the like took more on top: the bump ran past the
 * block into the next ones on the heap, the effect pool [0x870914] and the
 * first effect [0x86EB28] (error 134 at a race's results, or in free roam,
 * after an hour or more with friends: sub_005c2430 / sub_005d21f0 /
 * sub_005d1e20 < sub_005d2850, 2026-11-03 to 11-07).  So the block is
 * EAGL_HEAP bytes, and an object the bump has no room for comes from the
 * process heap instead (kept: EAGL only puts it on its list).
 * Test aids, script runs only: NFSU2_TEST_EAGL_LEFT=<n> keeps the game's
 * size and starts with only n KB of it left (as if the rest were in use);
 * NFSU2_TEST_EAGL_GAMEWAY=1 leaves the size and the unchecked end as the
 * game has them (tests/scripts/showoff_eagl_heap.txt). */
#define FN_EAGL_INIT   0x006e2310u   /* (size), ret 4 */
#define FN_EAGL_NEW    0x006e2290u   /* (size) -> object, ret 4 */
#define FN_EAGL_KIND   0x006e2240u   /* (word kind) -> object, ret 4 */
#define G_EAGL_BUMP    0x008aae10u
#define G_EAGL_SIZE    0x008ab288u
#define G_EAGL_BASE    0x008ab28cu
#define G_EAGL_BYKIND  0x008aae18u   /* 26 lists */
#define G_EAGL_BYSIZE  0x008aae80u   /* 256 lists */
#define T_EAGL_KIND    0x00811e00u   /* each kind's size (word) */
#define EAGL_GAME      0x19000u
#define EAGL_HEAP      0x80000u      /* 512 KB: the game's 100 and every car type's part animations, with room */
void sub_006e2310(CPU *c);
void sub_006e2290(CPU *c);
void sub_006e2240(CPU *c);
uint32_t gheap_alloc(int heap, uint32_t n, int zero);
static uint64_t g_eagl_more, g_eagl_more_bytes;

static long eagl_test(const char *name){
    const char *s = getenv("NFSU2_INPUT_SCRIPT"), *e = getenv(name);
    return s && *s && e && *e ? atol(e) : 0;
}
static void eagl_init(CPU *c){
    uint32_t n = MR32(c->esp + 4u), left = (uint32_t)eagl_test("NFSU2_TEST_EAGL_LEFT") << 10;
    if (n == EAGL_GAME && !left && eagl_test("NFSU2_TEST_EAGL_GAMEWAY") != 1) MR32(c->esp + 4u) = EAGL_HEAP;
    sub_006e2310(c);
    if (left && left < MR32(G_EAGL_SIZE)) MR32(G_EAGL_BUMP) = MR32(G_EAGL_BASE) + MR32(G_EAGL_SIZE) - left;
    fprintf(stderr, "[eagl] the animation heap: %u KB at 0x%08x (the game's %u KB)%s\n", MR32(G_EAGL_SIZE) >> 10,
            MR32(G_EAGL_BASE), n >> 10, left ? ", test: as if the rest of it were in use" : "");
}
/* the bump has room for need bytes before the block's end */
static int eagl_room(uint32_t need){
    uint32_t b = MR32(G_EAGL_BUMP), base = MR32(G_EAGL_BASE), end = base + MR32(G_EAGL_SIZE);
    return b >= base && b <= end && need <= end - b;
}
static uint32_t eagl_more(uint32_t need, const char *how){
    uint32_t p = gheap_alloc(1, need, 1);
    g_eagl_more++; g_eagl_more_bytes += need;
    if (g_eagl_more <= 4 || !(g_eagl_more & 255))
        fprintf(stderr, "[eagl] f=%ld the animation heap is full (%u of %u bytes): %u bytes %s from the process heap (%llu so far, "
                "%llu bytes)%s\n", autotest_frame(), MR32(G_EAGL_BUMP) - MR32(G_EAGL_BASE), MR32(G_EAGL_SIZE), need, how,
                (unsigned long long)g_eagl_more, (unsigned long long)g_eagl_more_bytes, p ? "" : ": NONE");
    return p;
}
static void eagl_new(CPU *c){
    uint32_t n = MR32(c->esp + 4u), k = (n >> 4) & 0xffu, need = k * 16u + 0x14u;
    if (MR32(G_EAGL_BYSIZE + k * 4u) || eagl_room(need)){ sub_006e2290(c); return; }
    uint32_t p = eagl_more(need, "by size");
    if (p) MR32(p) = k;
    POP32(c->eip); c->esp += 4u; c->eax = p ? p + 4u : 0u;
}
static void eagl_kind(CPU *c){
    uint32_t k = MR16(c->esp + 4u), need = MR16(T_EAGL_KIND + k * 2u);
    if (MR32(G_EAGL_BYKIND + k * 4u) || eagl_room(need)){ sub_006e2240(c); return; }
    uint32_t p = eagl_more(need, "by kind");
    POP32(c->eip); c->esp += 4u; c->eax = p;
}
void showoff_install(void){
    dispatch_patch(FN_EAGL_INIT, eagl_init);
    if (eagl_test("NFSU2_TEST_EAGL_GAMEWAY") == 1){ fprintf(stderr, "[eagl] test: the animation heap's end unchecked, as in the game\n"); return; }
    dispatch_patch(FN_EAGL_NEW, eagl_new);
    dispatch_patch(FN_EAGL_KIND, eagl_kind);
}

/* sms.c -- a text message of ours on the game's own phone: the SMS of career
 * free roam (an envelope on the HUD, the message in the mailbox).  The page
 * asks for one (input event IEV_SMS: web/src/app/playtime.ts, after two hours
 * of play, another after a hundred), or NFSU2_SMS=<id> does at the start
 * (tests).  It goes into the inbox once the player drives in career free roam, not before (the front
 * end, Online and LAN races have no phone), and the status "sms" then names
 * it, so the page asks no more.
 *
 * The inbox is the Career's (0x860A60): 256 messages of 20 bytes {entry,
 * flags +4..+7, body hash +8, %s hash +0xC, subject hash +0x10}, how many at
 * +0x1400.  An entry is one of the game's SMS table ([0x838454] x [0x838450],
 * 20 bytes: its name at [0x838428] + u16 +0, the kind of message, +4 = 1 "the
 * game opens it": its inbox update 0x529750 shows such a message by itself,
 * once the player is free in career free roam, 0x529700; +0x10 the sender's
 * name, by hash).  0x529670 (thiscall
 * inbox: entry, body, subject, %s) adds a message with texts other than its
 * entry's: the "unique parts" and magazine messages take one of several that
 * way (0x5338C0).  Ours has texts of our own (language.c) and a copy of
 * SMS_INSTRUCTION's entry (Rachel's first message: text only, nothing to do)
 * that the game opens and that is from us, not Rachel: the game lets an entry
 * in only while it is not in the inbox (0x514CB0, by address), and
 * SMS_INSTRUCTION always is.  A profile keeps a message by its entry's name
 * and its texts (0x514E80 loads them): ours comes back as SMS_INSTRUCTION's,
 * with our texts, which are in the language table by then, and gets our entry
 * back (opened already: the message's own flag +5 says so).  A message whose
 * body is ours is not added again (the profile has it from an earlier game). */

#define MSG_N 2                     /* the messages, by id 1.. (playtime.ts: 1 after 2 h, 2 after 100 h) */
static const struct { const char *name; const Text *t; unsigned n; } MSGS[MSG_N] = {
    { "SMS_PORT_HELLO", HELLO, sizeof HELLO / sizeof HELLO[0] },
    { "SMS_PORT_HUNDRED", HUNDRED, sizeof HUNDRED / sizeof HUNDRED[0] },
};

static int g_init;
static int g_ask;                   /* the message asked for (1..MSG_N), 0: none; set by the input thread */
static int g_sent;                  /* the message this game put in the inbox or found there */
static uint32_t g_subject[MSG_N], g_body[MSG_N], g_from;
static uint32_t g_entry;            /* our copy of SMS_INSTRUCTION's entry */
static double g_free_since = -1, g_next, g_scan;

/* the page asks (input_web.c, the input thread) */
void sms_request(int id){
    if (id < 1 || id > MSG_N) return;
    __atomic_store_n(&g_ask, id, __ATOMIC_RELAXED);
    fprintf(stderr, "[sms] message %d asked for\n", id);
}
/* the message the game has from us this game (status_web.c "sms"), 0: none */
int sms_delivered(void){ return __atomic_load_n(&g_sent, __ATOMIC_RELAXED); }

static double now_s(void){
    struct timespec ts; clock_gettime(CLOCK_MONOTONIC, &ts);
    return (double)ts.tv_sec + ts.tv_nsec * 1e-9;
}

/* our texts into the game's language table, in its language's letters */
static void init(void){
    g_init = 1;
    const char *l = language_name();
    for (int m = 0; m < MSG_N; m++){
        const Text *t = &MSGS[m].t[0];
        for (unsigned i = 0; i < MSGS[m].n; i++) if (!strcmp(MSGS[m].t[i].lang, l)) t = &MSGS[m].t[i];
        char name[64], s[1024];
        language_game_letters(t->subject, s, sizeof s);
        snprintf(name, sizeof name, "%s_SUBJECT", MSGS[m].name); g_subject[m] = language_add_text(name, s);
        language_game_letters(t->body, s, sizeof s);
        snprintf(name, sizeof name, "%s_BODY", MSGS[m].name); g_body[m] = language_add_text(name, s);
    }
    g_from = language_add_text("SMS_PORT_FROM", FROM);
    const char *e = getenv("NFSU2_SMS");
    if (e && *e) sms_request(atoi(e));
}

/* the player drives in career free roam, free to engage, the HUD on top */
static int free_roam(void){
    if (MR32(G_FLOW) != 6u || MR32(G_GAMEMODE) != 1u || MR32(G_CAREER_RACE) || mprace_owns_input()) return 0;
    uint32_t e = MR32(G_ENGAGE);
    if (!e || !mem_is_committed(e) || MR32(e) != 4u) return 0;
    const char *top = autotest_top_fng();
    return top && !strcasecmp(top, "HUD_SingleRace.fng");
}

/* SMS_INSTRUCTION's entry, copied, for the game to open, from us */
static uint32_t entry(CPU *c){
    if (g_entry) return g_entry;
    uint32_t tab = MR32(G_SMS_TAB), n = MR32(G_SMS_N), pool = MR32(G_POOL);
    if (!tab || !pool || n > 1024u || !mem_is_committed(tab) || !mem_is_committed(tab + 20u*n - 1u)) return 0;
    for (uint32_t i = 0; i < n; i++){
        uint32_t nm = pool + MR16(tab + 20u*i);
        if (!mem_is_committed(nm) || !mem_is_committed(nm + 15u) || memcmp(g_mem + nm, "SMS_INSTRUCTION", 16)) continue;
        uint32_t size = 20u, e = gcall_main(c, FN_NEW, 0, 1, &size);
        if (!e) return 0;
        memcpy(g_mem + e, g_mem + tab + 20u*i, 20);
        MR8(e + 4u) = 1;
        MR32(e + 0x10u) = g_from;
        return g_entry = e;
    }
    fprintf(stderr, "[sms] the game's SMS table has no SMS_INSTRUCTION: no message of ours\n");
    return 0;
}

/* our messages that a profile brought back (as SMS_INSTRUCTION's) get our entry again */
static void ours_back(CPU *c){
    uint32_t n = MR32(G_INBOX + IN_COUNT);
    for (uint32_t i = 0; i < n && i < 256u; i++){
        uint32_t m = G_INBOX + 20u*i, body = MR32(m + 8u);
        for (int k = 0; k < MSG_N; k++){
            if (body != g_body[k] || MR32(m) == g_entry) continue;
            uint32_t e = entry(c);
            if (!e) return;
            MR32(m) = e;
            fprintf(stderr, "[sms] message %d from the profile: ours again\n", k + 1);
        }
    }
}

void sms_frame(CPU *c){
    if (!g_init) init();
    double t = now_s();
    if (t >= g_scan){ g_scan = t + 1.0; ours_back(c); }
    int ask = __atomic_load_n(&g_ask, __ATOMIC_RELAXED);
    if (!ask || ask == g_sent) return;
    if (!free_roam()){ g_free_since = -1; return; }
    if (g_free_since < 0) g_free_since = t;
    if (t - g_free_since < FREE_S || t < g_next) return;
    int m = ask - 1;
    if (!language_text(g_body[m]) || !language_text(g_subject[m])) return;   /* the table again next frame */
    uint32_t n = MR32(G_INBOX + IN_COUNT);
    if (n > 256u) return;
    for (uint32_t i = 0; i < n; i++)
        if (MR32(G_INBOX + 20u*i + 8u) == g_body[m]){
            fprintf(stderr, "[sms] message %d is in the inbox already (an earlier game)\n", ask);
            __atomic_store_n(&g_sent, ask, __ATOMIC_RELAXED);
            return;
        }
    uint32_t e = entry(c);
    if (!e){ g_next = t + RETRY_S; return; }
    uint32_t a[4] = { e, g_body[m], g_subject[m], 0 };
    uint32_t msg = gcall_main(c, FN_SMS_ADD, G_INBOX, 4, a);
    if (!msg){
        fprintf(stderr, "[sms] message %d: the inbox is full (%u), again in %d s\n", ask, n, RETRY_S);
        g_next = t + RETRY_S;
        return;
    }
    fprintf(stderr, "[sms] message %d in the inbox (%u messages): the game shows it\n", ask, MR32(G_INBOX + IN_COUNT));
    __atomic_store_n(&g_sent, ask, __ATOMIC_RELAXED);
}

/* sndlead.c -- after a load the game's sound is back to its usual delay in a
 * few seconds, not half a minute.
 *
 * The game mixes all its sound into one looping DirectSound buffer, which
 * web/audio_web.c (audio.m on the Mac) plays.  A thread of its own (0x7263c7:
 * timeBeginPeriod(1), then a wake-up every 10 ms) writes the next part each
 * time (0x7260f7): up to the buffer's WRITE cursor (it asks for no play
 * cursor) plus 30 ms (float [0x8183dc]) plus a margin (float [0x8183ec]; int
 * copy word [0x8183e0]; 15 ms at the start, 10..200 ms: [0x784560],
 * [0x8183e8]).  Everything written ahead of the mixer is heard that much later:
 * a menu click, the engine, a crash.  (The write cursor is 50 ms past the play
 * cursor here; web/audio_web.c says why it stays there.)
 *
 * The margin is how late the thread has been: the longest it went between two
 * wake-ups (gaps over 300 ms not counted) raises it at once, and every 3000
 * wake-ups (word [0x8183e4] counts them down; 1000 the first time) it falls
 * to the longest gap of those (int [0x8183f4], 10 at the window's start).  On
 * Windows the thread runs beside the game's and the margin stays near
 * 10-15 ms.  Here it waits for the guest lock behind the game's thread, and a
 * load holds that for long stretches: in a quick race (2026-10-24) the boot's
 * 84 ms gap kept every sound 84 ms later for the first 40 s, the race's load
 * 35 ms for a minute.
 *
 * Here the window is 300 wake-ups (3 s).  A late wake-up still raises the
 * margin at once.  Original: 3000 (30 s). */
#include "cpu.h"
#include "widescreen.h"           /* HOOK_SITE */

#define WINDOW_TICKS 300

int sndlead_hook(CPU *c, uint32_t ip){
    (void)c;
    /* after mov word [0x8183e4], 0xbb8: the next window, shorter */
    if (ip != HOOK_SITE(0x00726336)) return 0;
    MR16(0x8183e4u) = WINDOW_TICKS;
    return 1;
}

/* specialties.c -- the Car Specialties shop (UI_ICEMAIN.fng): Stock gauges can be

 *  - the list now opens on the style fitted (FE ride 0x8392C0, slot 163

 * Trunk Audio is a second UI_ICEMAIN.fng screen (factory 0x560550, messages

static int pkg_is(uint32_t s, const char *name){
    size_t n = strlen(name);
    if (!guest_ok_bytes(s, (uint32_t)n + 1u)) return 0;
    for (size_t i = 0; i < n; i++) if ((MR8(s + i) | 0x20) != (name[i] | 0x20)) return 0;
    return MR8(s + n) == 0;
}

/* --- Custom Gauges ------------------------------------------------------------ */
/* the gauge screen's current item, when it is a style without colours (Stock) */
static uint32_t stock_item(CPU *c, uint32_t scr){
    uint32_t cat = MR32(scr + S_CATEGORY), item = MR32(scr + S_LIST + 0xcu);

static uint32_t reflection_com(CPU *c, uint32_t obj, unsigned slot, unsigned n, const uint32_t *args){

 * input port tables 0x8655A0.. moved (splitscreen_mem.h), and test scripts name the game's addresses
 * (autotest.c peek/poke/waitmem/expect, roam.c's expressions).  The same address natively. */
uint32_t split_guest_addr(uint32_t a){
    if (a - 0x8900acu < 8u) return SPLIT_PLAYERS_INDEX + (a - 0x8900acu);
    if (a - 0x8900b4u < 8u) return SPLIT_PLAYERS_ORDER + (a - 0x8900b4u);
    if (a - 0x8900bcu < 4u) return SPLIT_PLAYERS_COUNT + (a - 0x8900bcu);
    if (a - 0x8655a0u < 0x390u) return SPLIT_PORT_TABLES + (a - 0x8655a0u);
    return a;
}

/* The keyboard takes up to two local seats: Enter one, Space another.  A lone keyboard player drives on the
 * whole keyboard (arrows or WASD); with two, Enter's player has the arrows' side and Space's WASD's.  Controller
 * ownership remains in connection/Start order; a keyboard seat does not consume a pad. */

static int split_kb_of(unsigned seat){
    for (int k = 0; k < 2; ++k) if (split_kb_seat[k] >= 0 && seat == (unsigned)split_kb_seat[k]) return k;
    return -1;
}
/* the controller of a seat that is not the keyboard's: the keyboard's seats before it skipped */
static unsigned split_pad_of(unsigned seat){
    unsigned pad = seat;
    for (int k = 0; k < 2; ++k) if (split_kb_seat[k] >= 0 && seat > (unsigned)split_kb_seat[k]) --pad;
    return pad;
}
void split_keyboard_device(PadState *pad){
    /* the game's pad device converts every seat's input: it must exist (split screen: a keyboard seat; co-op: player
     * 2's device, whose controller the page keeps from driving this pad) */
    int need = MR32(G_GAMEMODE) == 4 ? split_kb_seat[0] >= 0 || split_kb_seat[1] >= 0 : coop_device() >= 0;
    if (!pad->connected && need){
        memset(pad, 0, sizeof *pad);
        pad->connected = 1; pad->family = PADF_XBOX;
        strcpy(pad->name, "Split Screen keyboard");
    }
}
