static int in_race(void){ return mem_is_committed(G_FLOW) && MR32(G_FLOW) == 6u; }

static unsigned long long phys_mem(void){
    uint64_t m = 0; size_t l = sizeof m;
    if (sysctlbyname("hw.memsize", &m, &l, NULL, 0) != 0) m = 8ull << 30;
    return m;
}

static void tr_init(void){
    if (g_init) return;
    g_init = 1;
    g_verbose = env_on("NFSU2_TEXLOG");
    const char *dv = getenv("NFSU2_TEXDUMP");
    if (dv && *dv && strcasecmp(dv, "off") && strcmp(dv, "0")){
        resolve_dir(dv, "dump", g_dumpdir, sizeof g_dumpdir);
        g_dumping = 1;
    }
    int want = texrep_wanted();
    if (want){
        resolve_dir(getenv("NFSU2_TEXPACK"), "default", g_packdir, sizeof g_packdir);
        const char *pv = getenv("NFSU2_TEXPARTS");
        if (!pv || !*pv) g_parts = PARTS_DEFAULT;
        else if (!strcasecmp(pv, "all")) g_parts = (1u << NCAT) - 1u;
        else {
            char tmp[256]; snprintf(tmp, sizeof tmp, "%s", pv); char *sv = 0;
            for (char *t = strtok_r(tmp, ", ", &sv); t; t = strtok_r(0, ", ", &sv)){
                int c = cat_by_name(t);
                if (c >= 0) g_parts |= 1u << c;
                else fprintf(stderr, "[texrep] texture_parts: unknown part \"%s\" ignored\n", t);
            }
        }
        const char *bv = getenv("NFSU2_TEXBUDGET");
        unsigned long long auto_b = phys_mem() / 6; if (auto_b > (4096ull << 20)) auto_b = 4096ull << 20;
        g_budget = (bv && atof(bv) > 0) ? (unsigned long long)(atof(bv) * 1048576.0) : auto_b;
        double t0 = now_ms();
        struct stat st;
        if (stat(g_packdir, &st) != 0 || !S_ISDIR(st.st_mode))
            fprintf(stderr, "[texrep] textures = upscaled, but there is no pack at %s: the game's own textures stay\n", g_packdir);
        else {
            idx_scan(g_packdir);
            fprintf(stderr, "[texrep] pack %s: %u replacement(s) indexed in %.1f ms (", g_packdir, g_idx_n, now_ms() - t0);
            for (int c = 0; c < NCAT; c++) if (g_idx_cat[c]) fprintf(stderr, " %s %u", k_cat[c], g_idx_cat[c]);
            fprintf(stderr, " ; %u in parts not enabled), GPU memory budget %.0f MB\n", g_idx_skipped, g_budget / 1048576.0);
            if (!g_idx_n) fprintf(stderr, "[texrep] nothing to replace: the game's own textures stay\n");
        }
        g_active = g_idx_n > 0;
        atomic_store(&g_pack_live, g_active);
    }
    if (g_active || g_dumping){
        g_tr = calloc(TEXREP_MAXTEX, sizeof *g_tr);
        dispatch_queue_attr_t at = dispatch_queue_attr_make_with_qos_class(DISPATCH_QUEUE_SERIAL, QOS_CLASS_UTILITY, 0);
        g_q = dispatch_queue_create("nfsu2.texrep.dump", at);
        for (int i = 0; i < NLQ; i++) g_lq[i] = dispatch_queue_create("nfsu2.texrep.load", at);
    }
    if (g_dumping){
        char p[1200];
        snprintf(p, sizeof p, "%s", g_dumpdir);
        for (char *q = p + 1; *q; q++) if (*q == '/'){ *q = 0; mkdir(p, 0755); *q = '/'; }
        mkdir(p, 0755);
        fprintf(stderr, "[texrep] dumping static textures to %s\n", g_dumpdir);
    }
    if (!g_active && !g_dumping) g_init = 2;        /* inert */
}

/* ---- formats ---------------------------------------------------------------- */
#define FMT_DXT1 0x31545844u
#define FMT_DXT3 0x33545844u
#define FMT_DXT5 0x35545844u
static MTLPixelFormat d3d_pf(uint32_t f){
    switch (f){
    case FMT_DXT1: return MTLPixelFormatBC1_RGBA;
    case FMT_DXT3: return MTLPixelFormatBC2_RGBA;
    case FMT_DXT5: return MTLPixelFormatBC3_RGBA;
    case 21: case 22: return MTLPixelFormatBGRA8Unorm;
    }
    return MTLPixelFormatInvalid;
}
static const char *fmt_name(uint32_t f){
    switch (f){ case FMT_DXT1: return "DXT1"; case FMT_DXT3: return "DXT3"; case FMT_DXT5: return "DXT5";
                case 21: return "A8R8G8B8"; case 22: return "X8R8G8B8"; }
    return "?";
}
/* bytes per row / rows of a level */
static void pf_level(MTLPixelFormat pf, unsigned w, unsigned h, size_t *row, size_t *rows){
    switch (pf){
    case MTLPixelFormatBC1_RGBA: *row = (size_t)((w + 3) / 4) * 8; *rows = (h + 3) / 4; return;
    case MTLPixelFormatBC2_RGBA: case MTLPixelFormatBC3_RGBA: case MTLPixelFormatBC7_RGBAUnorm:
        *row = (size_t)((w + 3) / 4) * 16; *rows = (h + 3) / 4; return;
    default: *row = (size_t)w * 4; *rows = h; return;
    }
}
static unsigned full_levels(unsigned w, unsigned h){
    unsigned n = 1; for (unsigned q = w > h ? w : h; q > 1; q >>= 1) n++;
    return n;
}

/* ---- DDS -------------------------------------------------------------------- */
typedef struct { unsigned w, h, levels; MTLPixelFormat pf; size_t off; } Dds;
static uint32_t rd32(const uint8_t *p){ uint32_t v; memcpy(&v, p, 4); return v; }
static int dds_parse(const uint8_t *b, size_t n, Dds *d){
    if (n < 128 || memcmp(b, "DDS ", 4) || rd32(b + 4) != 124) return 0;
    d->h = rd32(b + 12); d->w = rd32(b + 16);
    d->levels = rd32(b + 28); if (!d->levels) d->levels = 1;
    if (rd32(b + 112) & 0x200u) return 0;                    /* cube map */
    uint32_t pff = rd32(b + 80), four = rd32(b + 84), bits = rd32(b + 88), rm = rd32(b + 92), am = rd32(b + 104);
    d->off = 128; d->pf = MTLPixelFormatInvalid;
    if (pff & 4u){
        if (four == FMT_DXT1) d->pf = MTLPixelFormatBC1_RGBA;
        else if (four == FMT_DXT3 || four == 0x32545844u) d->pf = MTLPixelFormatBC2_RGBA;
        else if (four == FMT_DXT5 || four == 0x34545844u) d->pf = MTLPixelFormatBC3_RGBA;
        else if (four == 0x30315844u && n >= 148){            /* "DX10" */
            uint32_t dx = rd32(b + 128); d->off = 148;
            if (rd32(b + 132) != 3u) return 0;                /* TEXTURE2D only */
            switch (dx){                                      /* the game is not sRGB-aware: _SRGB = UNORM */
            case 71: case 72: d->pf = MTLPixelFormatBC1_RGBA; break;
            case 74: case 75: d->pf = MTLPixelFormatBC2_RGBA; break;
            case 77: case 78: d->pf = MTLPixelFormatBC3_RGBA; break;
            case 98: case 99: d->pf = MTLPixelFormatBC7_RGBAUnorm; break;
            case 87: case 91: d->pf = MTLPixelFormatBGRA8Unorm; break;
            case 28: case 29: d->pf = MTLPixelFormatRGBA8Unorm; break;
            }
        }
    } else if ((pff & 0x40u) && bits == 32){
        d->pf = rm == 0x00ff0000u ? MTLPixelFormatBGRA8Unorm : rm == 0x000000ffu ? MTLPixelFormatRGBA8Unorm
              : MTLPixelFormatInvalid;
        (void)am;
    }
    if (d->pf == MTLPixelFormatInvalid || !d->w || !d->h || d->w > 16384 || d->h > 16384) return 0;
    unsigned fl = full_levels(d->w, d->h);
    if (d->levels > fl) d->levels = fl;
    size_t need = 0;
    for (unsigned l = 0; l < d->levels; l++){
        unsigned lw = d->w >> l, lh = d->h >> l; if (!lw) lw = 1; if (!lh) lh = 1;
        size_t row, rows; pf_level(d->pf, lw, lh, &row, &rows); need += row * rows;
    }
    return d->off + need <= n;
}

/* ---- loader (GCD queue) ----------------------------------------------------- */
static void ready_post(Ready r){
    pthread_mutex_lock(&g_rmx);
    if (g_ready_n == g_ready_cap){ g_ready_cap = g_ready_cap ? 2 * g_ready_cap : 256;
                                   g_ready = realloc(g_ready, g_ready_cap * sizeof *g_ready); }
    g_ready[g_ready_n++] = r;
    pthread_mutex_unlock(&g_rmx);
}
static uint8_t *read_file(const char *path, size_t *n){
    int fd = open(path, O_RDONLY); if (fd < 0) return 0;
    struct stat st; if (fstat(fd, &st) != 0 || st.st_size < 128 || st.st_size > (1ll << 31)){ close(fd); return 0; }
    uint8_t *b = malloc((size_t)st.st_size);
    size_t got = 0;
    while (b && got < (size_t)st.st_size){
        ssize_t k = read(fd, b + got, (size_t)st.st_size - got);
        if (k <= 0) break;
        got += (size_t)k;
    }
    close(fd);
    if (!b || got != (size_t)st.st_size){ free(b); return 0; }
    *n = got; return b;
}
/* Ready.fail: 0 = loaded, 1: shape / format, 2: read / parse, 3: over the
 * budget (bytes = what it needed).  The bytes of a loaded texture stay
 * counted in g_bytes until its Ent is freed (texrep_frame). */
static void load_job(int32_t ei, const char *path, unsigned w, unsigned h, unsigned olev, uint32_t fmt){
    double t0 = now_ms();
    Ready r = { ei, 0, 0, 2, NULL, 0, 0 };
    size_t n = 0; uint8_t *b = read_file(path, &n);
    Dds d;
    if (!b || !dds_parse(b, n, &d)){ free(b); r.ms = now_ms() - t0; ready_post(r); return; }
    r.fail = 1;
    /* same aspect ratio, not smaller, at most 16x (the sampler's LOD clamp has 3 bits) */
    if (d.w < w || d.h < h || (unsigned long long)d.w * h != (unsigned long long)d.h * w || d.w > (w << 4)){
        free(b); r.ms = now_ms() - t0; ready_post(r); return; }
    unsigned k = 0; while ((w << k) < d.w && k < 4) k++;
    int pow2 = (w << k) == d.w && (h << k) == d.h;
    int stacked = pow2 && k >= 1 && d.levels == k && d.pf == d3d_pf(fmt);
    unsigned tot = stacked ? k + olev : d.levels;
    unsigned fl = full_levels(d.w, d.h); if (tot > fl) tot = fl;
    /* sampler clamp (texrep_skey_slow) needs log2(scale) of a power-of-two scale */
    unsigned kk = pow2 ? k : 0;
    MTLTextureDescriptor *td = [MTLTextureDescriptor texture2DDescriptorWithPixelFormat:d.pf
                                   width:d.w height:d.h mipmapped:(tot > 1)];
    td.mipmapLevelCount = tot;
    td.usage = MTLTextureUsageShaderRead;
    td.storageMode = MTLStorageModeShared;
    id<MTLDevice> dev = metal_device();
    MTLSizeAndAlign sa = dev ? [dev heapTextureSizeAndAlignWithDescriptor:td] : (MTLSizeAndAlign){0, 0};
    unsigned long long want = sa.size;
    /* reserve first: three loaders at once can never pass the budget together */
    if (atomic_fetch_add(&g_bytes, want) + want > g_budget){
        atomic_fetch_sub(&g_bytes, want);
        free(b); r.fail = 3; r.bytes = want; r.ms = now_ms() - t0; ready_post(r); return; }
    id<MTLTexture> t = dev ? [dev newTextureWithDescriptor:td] : nil;
    if (!t){ atomic_fetch_sub(&g_bytes, want); free(b); r.fail = 2; r.ms = now_ms() - t0; ready_post(r); return; }
    unsigned long long got = t.allocatedSize;      /* the reservation becomes the real size */
    if (got > want) atomic_fetch_add(&g_bytes, got - want); else atomic_fetch_sub(&g_bytes, want - got);
    size_t off = d.off;
    for (unsigned l = 0; l < d.levels && l < tot; l++){
        unsigned lw = d.w >> l, lh = d.h >> l; if (!lw) lw = 1; if (!lh) lh = 1;
        size_t row, rows; pf_level(d.pf, lw, lh, &row, &rows);
        [t replaceRegion:MTLRegionMake2D(0, 0, lw, lh) mipmapLevel:l withBytes:b + off bytesPerRow:row];
        off += row * rows;
    }
    free(b);
    r.fail = 0; r.k = kk; r.stacked = (unsigned)stacked; r.bytes = got;
    r.tex = (__bridge_retained void *)t;
    r.ms = now_ms() - t0;
    ready_post(r);
}

/* ---- dump (GCD queue) ---------------------------------------------------------- */
static int cat_of_src(const char *s){
    if (!s) return CAT_OTHER;
    const char *p = s;
    if (strcasestr(p, "DYNTEX")) return CAT_SKY;              /* LOC4DYNTEX.BIN: clouds */
    if (!strncasecmp(p, "CARS/", 5)) return CAT_CARS;
    if (!strncasecmp(p, "TRACKS/", 7) || !strncasecmp(p, "NIS/", 4)) return CAT_WORLD;
    if (!strncasecmp(p, "FRONTEND/PLATFORMS/", 19)) return CAT_GARAGE;
    if (!strncasecmp(p, "FRONTEND/", 9) || !strncasecmp(p, "LANGUAGES/", 10)) return CAT_FRONTEND;
    if (!strncasecmp(p, "GLOBAL/InGame", 13) || !strncasecmp(p, "GLOBAL/HUD", 10)) return CAT_HUD;
    if (!strncasecmp(p, "GLOBAL/", 7)) return CAT_FRONTEND;
    return CAT_OTHER;
}
/* the file the guest read last, relative to the game folder */
static void src_rel(char *out, size_t n){
    const char *lr = fileio_last_read();
    out[0] = 0; if (!lr) return;
    static const char *const tops[] = { "/CARS/", "/TRACKS/", "/NIS/", "/FRONTEND/", "/GLOBAL/", "/LANGUAGES/", "/MOVIES/" };
    const char *best = 0;
    for (unsigned i = 0; i < sizeof tops / sizeof tops[0]; i++){
        const char *p = strcasestr(lr, tops[i]); if (p && (!best || p < best)) best = p; }
    snprintf(out, n, "%s", best ? best + 1 : lr);
    for (char *q = out; *q; q++) if (*q == '\\') *q = '/';
}
static void dump_write(TR *t, unsigned mid, const uint8_t *data, size_t len, unsigned pitch){
    (void)mid;
    uint8_t *copy = malloc(len); if (!copy) return;
    memcpy(copy, data, len);
    unsigned w = t->w, h = t->h, lev = t->lev; uint32_t fmt = t->fmt; uint64_t hh = t->hash; int cat = t->cat;
    char src[256]; src_rel(src, sizeof src);
    char *srcd = strdup(src);
    g_n_dumped++;
    dispatch_async(g_q, ^{
        char dir[1200], p[1400];
        snprintf(dir, sizeof dir, "%s/%s", g_dumpdir, k_cat[cat]); mkdir(dir, 0755);
        snprintf(p, sizeof p, "%s/%ux%u_%s_%016llx.dds", dir, w, h, fmt_name(fmt), (unsigned long long)hh);
        struct stat st;
        if (stat(p, &st) != 0){
            uint8_t hd[128]; memset(hd, 0, sizeof hd);
            memcpy(hd, "DDS ", 4);
            uint32_t v[32]; memset(v, 0, sizeof v);
            int bc = fmt == FMT_DXT1 || fmt == FMT_DXT3 || fmt == FMT_DXT5;
            v[1] = 124; v[2] = 0x1 | 0x2 | 0x4 | 0x1000 | (bc ? 0x80000u : 0x8u);
            v[3] = h; v[4] = w; v[5] = bc ? (uint32_t)len : pitch; v[7] = 1;
            v[19] = 32;
            if (bc){ v[20] = 0x4; v[21] = fmt; }
            else { v[20] = fmt == 21 ? 0x41u : 0x40u; v[22] = 32; v[23] = 0x00ff0000u; v[24] = 0x0000ff00u;
                   v[25] = 0x000000ffu; v[26] = fmt == 21 ? 0xff000000u : 0u; }
            v[27] = 0x1000;
            memcpy(hd + 4, v + 1, 124);
            char tmp[1500]; snprintf(tmp, sizeof tmp, "%s.tmp", p);
            FILE *f = fopen(tmp, "wb");
            if (f){ fwrite(hd, 1, 128, f); fwrite(copy, 1, len, f);
                    if (fclose(f) == 0) rename(tmp, p); else unlink(tmp); }
            snprintf(p, sizeof p, "%s/index.csv", g_dumpdir);
            int fresh = stat(p, &st) != 0;
            FILE *ix = fopen(p, "a");
            if (ix){ if (fresh) fprintf(ix, "hash,w,h,fmt,levels,category,source\n");
                     fprintf(ix, "%016llx,%u,%u,%s,%u,%s,%s\n", (unsigned long long)hh, w, h, fmt_name(fmt), lev,
                             k_cat[cat], srcd); fclose(ix); }
        }
        free(copy); free(srcd);
    });
}
/* a dumped texture turned out to be dynamic: take the file back */
static void dump_unlink(TR *t, uint64_t hh){
    unsigned w = t->w, h = t->h; uint32_t fmt = t->fmt; int cat = t->cat;
    g_n_unlinked++;
    dispatch_async(g_q, ^{
        char p[1400];
        snprintf(p, sizeof p, "%s/%s/%ux%u_%s_%016llx.dds", g_dumpdir, k_cat[cat], w, h, fmt_name(fmt), (unsigned long long)hh);
        unlink(p);
    });
}

/* ---- replacements: Ent bookkeeping (guest thread) ------------------------------ */
static int32_t ent_new(int32_t idx, uint32_t path){
    int32_t ei;
    if (g_ent_free >= 0){ ei = g_ent_free; g_ent_free = g_ent[ei].idx; }
    else {
        if (g_ent_n == g_ent_cap){ g_ent_cap = g_ent_cap ? 2 * g_ent_cap : 1024;
                                   g_ent = realloc(g_ent, g_ent_cap * sizeof *g_ent); }
        ei = (int32_t)g_ent_n++;
    }
    memset(&g_ent[ei], 0, sizeof g_ent[ei]);
    g_ent[ei].idx = idx; g_ent[ei].path = path; g_ent[ei].st = E_LOADING;
    if (idx >= 0) g_idx[idx].ent = ei;
    return ei;
}
static void ent_free(int32_t ei){
    Ent *en = &g_ent[ei];
    if (en->tex){ CFBridgingRelease(en->tex); en->tex = NULL; atomic_fetch_sub(&g_bytes, en->bytes); g_n_tex_live--; }
    if (en->idx >= 0 && g_idx[en->idx].ent == ei) g_idx[en->idx].ent = -1;
    en->idx = g_ent_free; g_ent_free = ei; en->st = E_FAILED; en->refs = en->waiters = 0;
}
/* free an Ent nobody shows or waits for (a loading one when its load ends).
 * A failed load stays linked as a marker so its file is not read again; a
 * budget failure is retried once enough memory is free (texrep_uploaded). */
static void ent_unref(int32_t ei){
    Ent *en = &g_ent[ei];
    if (en->refs || en->waiters || en->st == E_LOADING) return;
    if ((en->st == E_FAILED || en->st == E_BUDGET) && en->idx >= 0) return;
    ent_free(ei);
}
static void load_start(int32_t ei, const TR *t){
    unsigned w = t->w, h = t->h, olev = t->lev; uint32_t fmt = t->fmt;
    const char *path = g_paths + g_ent[ei].path;
    g_n_loaded++;
    dispatch_async(g_lq[g_lq_next++ % NLQ], ^{ load_job(ei, path, w, h, olev, fmt); });
}
static void pend_add(unsigned mid, unsigned gen){
    if (g_pend_n == g_pend_cap){ g_pend_cap = g_pend_cap ? 2 * g_pend_cap : 256;
                                 g_pend = realloc(g_pend, g_pend_cap * sizeof *g_pend); }
    g_pend[g_pend_n++] = (Pend){ mid, gen };
}
/* this id stops showing / waiting for its replacement: the game's own texture shows */
static void tr_drop(TR *t, unsigned mid){
    if (t->state == S_ACTIVE){
        op_post((Op){ OP_CLEAR, mid, 0, 0, 0, NULL });
        g_ent[t->ent].refs--; ent_unref(t->ent);
    } else if (t->state == S_PENDING){
        g_ent[t->ent].waiters--; ent_unref(t->ent);
    }
    t->state = S_NONE; t->gen++; t->ent = -1;
}

/* ---- guest hooks -------------------------------------------------------------- */
void texrep_created(unsigned mid, unsigned w, unsigned h, unsigned levels,
                    unsigned d3dfmt, unsigned usage, unsigned pool){
    if (g_init == 2) return;
    tr_init(); if (g_init == 2 || !mid || mid >= TEXREP_MAXTEX) return;
    TR *t = &g_tr[mid];
    if (t->state != S_NONE || t->hash) texrep_released(mid);     /* id reused */
    uint32_t gen = t->gen + 1;
    memset(t, 0, sizeof *t);
    t->gen = gen; t->ent = -1;
    g_n_created++;
    t->w = (uint16_t)(w > 65535 ? 65535 : w); t->h = (uint16_t)(h > 65535 ? 65535 : h);
    t->lev = (uint8_t)(levels > 15 ? 15 : levels); t->fmt = d3dfmt;
    char src[256]; src_rel(src, sizeof src);
    t->cat = (uint8_t)cat_of_src(src);
    /* static game textures only: managed pool, no usage flags (render
     * target, dynamic, autogen mips), a block or 32-bit format, more than
     * 32x32 texels (ramps and lookup tables), no movie frames */
    t->ok = pool == 1u && usage == 0u && d3d_pf(d3dfmt) != MTLPixelFormatInvalid
         && w >= 16 && h >= 16 && w * h > 1024u && w <= 4096 && h <= 4096
         && strncasecmp(src, "MOVIES/", 7) != 0;
    if (t->ok) g_n_eligible++;
}
static void tr_dynamic(TR *t, unsigned mid){
    t->dyn = 1; g_n_dyn++;
    if (t->dumped){ dump_unlink(t, t->hash); t->dumped = 0; }
    if (t->state != S_NONE){ g_n_drop++; tr_drop(t, mid); }
}
void texrep_surface_written(unsigned mid){
    if (g_init != 1 || !mid || mid >= TEXREP_MAXTEX) return;
    TR *t = &g_tr[mid];
    if (!t->ok || t->dyn) return;
    tr_dynamic(t, mid);
}
void texrep_released(unsigned mid){
    if (g_init != 1 || !mid || mid >= TEXREP_MAXTEX) return;
    TR *t = &g_tr[mid];
    tr_drop(t, mid);
    t->ok = 0;
}
void texrep_uploaded(unsigned mid, unsigned level, const uint8_t *data, unsigned pitch, unsigned rows){
    if (g_init != 1 || !mid || mid >= TEXREP_MAXTEX || !data) return;
    TR *t = &g_tr[mid];
    if (!t->ok || t->dyn) return;
    t->last_up = g_frame;
    if (level){
        if (level >= 16) return;
        double t0 = now_ms();
        size_t len = (size_t)pitch * rows;
        int again = (t->lvmask >> level) & 1u;
        if (!again){ t->lvmask |= 1u << level; t->lvh += XXH3_64bits_withSeed(data, len, level); }
        else g_n_relevel++;
        g_hash_ms += now_ms() - t0; g_hash_bytes += len;
        if (t->state == S_ACTIVE && t->k){
            Ent *en = &g_ent[t->ent];
            if (en->refs > 1){
                /* the Ent's lower levels are another id's: this one goes back
                 * to its own texture rather than change what the others show */
                g_n_unshare++; tr_drop(t, mid);
            } else {
                /* a stacked replacement keeps the game's level up to date */
                op_post((Op){ OP_COPY, mid, t->k, level, 1, NULL });
                if (again) en->solo = 1;               /* content may differ now: nobody shares it */
                else { en->lvmask = t->lvmask; en->lvh = t->lvh; }
            }
        }
        return;
    }
    double t0 = now_ms();
    size_t len = (size_t)pitch * rows;
    uint64_t seed = (uint64_t)t->w | (uint64_t)t->h << 16 | (uint64_t)t->fmt << 32;
    uint64_t hh = XXH3_64bits_withSeed(data, len, seed);
    g_n_hashed++; g_hash_bytes += len;
    if (t->hash && t->hash != hh){
        /* new content under the same texture: it is dynamic, the game's own
         * texture shows from now on (and a dump of the old content goes) */
        tr_dynamic(t, mid);
        g_hash_ms += now_ms() - t0;
        return;
    }
    int first = !t->hash;
    t->hash = hh; t->lvmask |= 1u;
    if (first && g_dumping){ dump_write(t, mid, data, len, pitch); t->dumped = 1; }
    if (first && g_active && t->state == S_NONE){
        IdxEnt *e = idx_get(hh);
        if (e){
            int32_t ei = e->ent;
            if (ei >= 0 && g_ent[ei].st == E_FAILED){ if (g_ent[ei].bytes == 1) g_n_shape++; else g_n_fail++; ei = -2; }
            else if (ei >= 0 && g_ent[ei].st == E_BUDGET){
                if (atomic_load(&g_bytes) + g_ent[ei].bytes > g_budget){ g_n_budget++; ei = -2; }
                else { ent_free(ei); ei = -1; }            /* memory was freed: try again */
            }
            if (ei != -2){
                g_n_hit++;
                if (ei < 0 || g_ent[ei].solo){                /* nothing to share: load it */
                    ei = ent_new(ei < 0 ? (int32_t)(e - g_idx) : -1, e->path);
                    if (g_ent[ei].idx < 0) g_n_private++;
                    load_start(ei, t);
                }
                t->state = S_PENDING; t->gen++; t->req_frame = g_frame; t->ent = ei;
                g_ent[ei].waiters++;
                pend_add(mid, t->gen);
                if (in_race()) g_load_race++;
            }
        }
    }
    g_hash_ms += now_ms() - t0;
}
static void lat_note(long d){
    int b = d <= 0 ? 0 : d == 1 ? 1 : d == 2 ? 2 : d <= 4 ? 3 : d <= 8 ? 4 : d <= 16 ? 5 : d <= 64 ? 6 : 7;
    g_lat_hist[b]++; if (d > g_lat_max) g_lat_max = d;
}
void texrep_frame(void){
    if (g_init != 1) return;
    double t0 = now_ms();
    g_frame++;
    /* finished loads */
    pthread_mutex_lock(&g_rmx);
    Ready *rs = g_ready; unsigned n = g_ready_n;
    g_ready = NULL; g_ready_n = g_ready_cap = 0;
    pthread_mutex_unlock(&g_rmx);
    for (unsigned i = 0; i < n; i++){
        Ready r = rs[i];
        Ent *en = &g_ent[r.ei];
        g_load_ms_sum += r.ms; if (r.ms > g_load_ms_max) g_load_ms_max = r.ms;
        if (r.fail){
            if (g_verbose) fprintf(stderr, "[texrep] %s: %s\n", en->idx >= 0 ? g_paths + g_idx[en->idx].path : "(private)",
                                   r.fail == 1 ? "size or format does not fit, skipped"
                                   : r.fail == 3 ? "over the memory budget, skipped" : "cannot read the file");
            en->st = r.fail == 3 ? E_BUDGET : E_FAILED;
            en->bytes = r.fail == 3 ? r.bytes : r.fail;   /* E_FAILED: 1 = shape, 2 = read */
            unsigned wt = en->waiters;
            if (r.fail == 1) g_n_shape += wt; else if (r.fail == 3) g_n_budget += wt; else g_n_fail += wt;
        } else {
            en->st = E_READY; en->tex = r.tex; en->k = (uint8_t)r.k; en->stacked = (uint8_t)r.stacked;
            en->bytes = r.bytes;
            if (++g_n_tex_live > g_n_tex_peak) g_n_tex_peak = g_n_tex_live;
            unsigned long long b = atomic_load(&g_bytes); if (b > g_bytes_peak) g_bytes_peak = b;
        }
        if (!en->waiters){ if (!r.fail) g_n_stale++; ent_unref(r.ei); }   /* nobody waits any more */
    }
    free(rs);
    /* ids waiting for an Ent */
    unsigned keep = 0;
    for (unsigned i = 0; i < g_pend_n; i++){
        Pend p = g_pend[i];
        TR *t = &g_tr[p.mid];
        if (t->gen != p.gen || t->state != S_PENDING) continue;          /* dropped meanwhile */
        Ent *en = &g_ent[t->ent];
        if (en->st == E_LOADING){ g_pend[keep++] = p; continue; }
        if (en->st != E_READY){                                          /* failed: stays original */
            int32_t ei = t->ent; t->state = S_NONE; t->ent = -1; en->waiters--; ent_unref(ei);
            continue;
        }
        /* stacked: publish once the game's levels are in (they are copied
         * under the pack's), once it stopped uploading (some textures never
         * get all their levels), or after 60 frames; a level that comes
         * later is copied then (OP_COPY) */
        unsigned want = t->lev >= 16 ? 0xFFFFu : (1u << t->lev) - 1u;
        int why = (t->lvmask & want) == want ? 0 : g_frame - t->last_up >= 2 ? 1 : g_frame - t->req_frame >= 60 ? 2 : -1;
        if (en->stacked && why < 0){ g_pend[keep++] = p; continue; }
        if (!en->stacked) why = 0;
        int own = en->refs == 0;
        if (!own && (en->solo || en->lev != t->lev || en->lvmask != t->lvmask || en->lvh != t->lvh)){
            /* the same pack file, other lower levels: this id gets its own copy */
            int32_t old = t->ent;
            en->waiters--;
            int32_t ei = ent_new(-1, en->path); g_n_private++;     /* (en may move: realloc) */
            t->ent = ei; g_ent[ei].waiters++;
            load_start(ei, t);
            ent_unref(old);
            g_pend[keep++] = p;
            continue;
        }
        if (own){ en->lev = t->lev; en->lvmask = t->lvmask; en->lvh = t->lvh; }
        else g_n_shared++;
        en->waiters--; en->refs++;
        t->state = S_ACTIVE; t->k = en->k;
        op_post((Op){ OP_SET, p.mid, en->k, 0, own && en->stacked, (void *)CFRetain(en->tex) });
        g_n_pub++; g_why[why]++; lat_note(g_frame - t->req_frame);
        if (in_race()) g_pub_race++;
        if (g_verbose) fprintf(stderr, "[texrep] f=%ld %ux%u %s %016llx -> x%u%s%s\n", g_frame, t->w, t->h,
                               fmt_name(t->fmt), (unsigned long long)t->hash, 1u << en->k,
                               en->stacked ? " (stacked)" : "", own ? "" : " (shared)");
    }
    g_pend_n = keep;
    double ms = now_ms() - t0 + g_hash_ms - g_hash_ms_mark;   /* this frame's drain + hashing since the last frame */
    g_hash_ms_mark = g_hash_ms;
    if (ms > g_frame_ms_max) g_frame_ms_max = ms;
    if (ms > 1.0) g_frames_over1++;
}

/* ---- main thread ---------------------------------------------------------------- */
void texrep_main_frame(id<MTLCommandQueue> q){
    Op *ops = NULL; unsigned n = 0;
    if (g_ops_n){                                        /* racy peek; the lock decides */
        pthread_mutex_lock(&g_omx);
        ops = g_ops; n = g_ops_n; g_ops = NULL; g_ops_n = g_ops_cap = 0;
        pthread_mutex_unlock(&g_omx);
    }
    id<MTLCommandBuffer> cb = nil; id<MTLBlitCommandEncoder> bl = nil;
    for (unsigned i = 0; i < n; i++){
        Op o = ops[i];
        if (o.mid >= TEXREP_MAXTEX){ if (o.tex) CFBridgingRelease(o.tex); continue; }
        if (o.op == OP_SET){
            id<MTLTexture> t = (__bridge_transfer id<MTLTexture>)o.tex;
            id<MTLTexture> orig = metal_tex_object(o.mid);
            if (!orig) continue;
            if (o.stacked && orig.pixelFormat == t.pixelFormat){
                NSUInteger nl = orig.mipmapLevelCount;
                if (o.k + nl > t.mipmapLevelCount) nl = t.mipmapLevelCount - o.k;
                if (!cb){ cb = [q commandBuffer]; cb.label = @"texrep"; bl = [cb blitCommandEncoder]; }
                if (nl) [bl copyFromTexture:orig sourceSlice:0 sourceLevel:0 toTexture:t
                           destinationSlice:0 destinationLevel:o.k sliceCount:1 levelCount:nl];
            }
            if (!g_texrep_tex[o.mid]) g_main_live++;
            g_texrep_tex[o.mid] = t; g_texrep_k[o.mid] = (uint8_t)o.k;
        } else if (o.op == OP_CLEAR){
            if (g_texrep_tex[o.mid]){ g_texrep_tex[o.mid] = nil; g_main_live--; }
        } else if (o.op == OP_COPY){
            id<MTLTexture> t = g_texrep_tex[o.mid], orig = metal_tex_object(o.mid);
            if (t && orig && orig.pixelFormat == t.pixelFormat && o.level < orig.mipmapLevelCount
                && o.k + o.level < t.mipmapLevelCount){
                if (!cb){ cb = [q commandBuffer]; cb.label = @"texrep"; bl = [cb blitCommandEncoder]; }
                [bl copyFromTexture:orig sourceSlice:0 sourceLevel:o.level toTexture:t
                   destinationSlice:0 destinationLevel:o.k + o.level sliceCount:1 levelCount:1];
            }
        }
    }
    free(ops);
    if (cb){ [bl endEncoding]; [cb commit]; }       /* before this frame's command buffer */
    g_texrep_frame_on = g_main_live && atomic_load(&g_shown);
    if (g_menu_item && atomic_load(&g_pack_live)){
        [g_menu_item setHidden:NO]; g_menu_item = nil;
        fprintf(stderr, "[texrep] app menu: \"Upscaled Textures\" (Cmd-T) shown\n");
    }
}
/* sampler key for a replaced texture (metal.m samp_for decodes bits 15-17):
 * where the game's sampler has no mip filter it read only the original's
 * level 0; the replacement gets linear mip filtering with the LOD clamped
 * at level k (= the original's level 0), so magnified it blends the pack's
 * levels and minified it still reads the game's own texels, as before. */
unsigned texrep_skey_slow(unsigned sk, unsigned k){
    unsigned mp = (sk >> 4) & 3u;
    g_mipstat[mp]++;
    if (mp == 0 && k) sk = (sk & ~0x30u) | 0x20u | ((k & 7u) << 15);
    return sk;
}

/* ---- toggle ---------------------------------------------------------------------- */
void texrep_set_shown(int on){
    int v = on < 0 ? !atomic_load(&g_shown) : !!on;
    atomic_store(&g_shown, v);
    fprintf(stderr, "[texrep] upscaled textures %s\n", v ? "shown" : "hidden (the game's own)");
}
int texrep_shown(void){ return atomic_load(&g_shown); }
@interface TexrepMenuTarget : NSObject
- (void)toggle:(NSMenuItem *)it;
@end
@implementation TexrepMenuTarget
- (void)toggle:(NSMenuItem *)it {
    texrep_set_shown(-1);
    [it setState:texrep_shown() ? NSControlStateValueOn : NSControlStateValueOff];
}
@end
static TexrepMenuTarget *g_menu_target;
/* the item (and its shortcut) stays hidden until a pack with something to
 * replace is indexed (texrep_main_frame): no pack, an empty one or parts
 * that match nothing = no menu item */
void texrep_add_menu(NSMenu *m){
    if (!texrep_wanted()) return;
    if (!g_menu_target) g_menu_target = [TexrepMenuTarget new];
    /* Cmd-T alone: Shift, Control and Option are game keys (gear up, gear
     * down, nitrous), and a modifier pressed before Command reaches the game
     * (keyboard_mac.m); Shift-Cmd-T sent a Shift press to the game whenever
     * Shift went down first.  A key pressed with Command never reaches it. */
    NSMenuItem *it = [m addItemWithTitle:@"Upscaled Textures" action:@selector(toggle:) keyEquivalent:@"t"];
    [it setKeyEquivalentModifierMask:NSEventModifierFlagCommand];
    [it setTarget:g_menu_target];
    [it setState:texrep_shown() ? NSControlStateValueOn : NSControlStateValueOff];
    if (atomic_load(&g_pack_live)){ fprintf(stderr, "[texrep] app menu: \"Upscaled Textures\" (Cmd-T) shown\n"); return; }
    [it setHidden:YES];                       /* hidden items get no key equivalent */
    g_menu_item = it;
}

/* [status] line fragment (autotest.c) while a pack is in use: replacement
 * memory now / its peak and the loaded replacements; nothing otherwise */
int texrep_status(char *buf, size_t n){
    if (g_init != 1 || !g_active || !n) return 0;
    int k = snprintf(buf, n, " trep=%.0f/%.0fMB/%lu", atomic_load(&g_bytes) / 1048576.0, g_bytes_peak / 1048576.0,
                     g_n_tex_live);
    return k < 0 ? 0 : k;
}

/* ---- report ------------------------------------------------------------------------ */
void texrep_report(void){
    if (g_init != 1) return;
    if (g_active){
        fprintf(stderr, "[texrep] textures %lu created, %lu eligible, %lu hashed (%.1f MB, %.1f ms); "
                "pack hits %lu: %lu shown (%lu sharing a texture already loaded), %lu dropped (content changed), "
                "%lu went back to their own levels; %lu skipped (size/format), %lu over budget, %lu unreadable; dynamic %lu\n",
                g_n_created, g_n_eligible, g_n_hashed, g_hash_bytes / 1048576.0, g_hash_ms,
                g_n_hit, g_n_pub, g_n_shared, g_n_drop, g_n_unshare, g_n_shape, g_n_budget, g_n_fail, g_n_dyn);
        fprintf(stderr, "[texrep] replacement GPU memory %.1f MB (peak %.1f MB, budget %.0f MB) in %lu loaded texture(s) "
                "(peak %lu; %lu loads, %lu of them a private copy, %lu not needed any more); loader %.1f ms in total, "
                "slowest %.2f ms; lower levels uploaded again %lu\n",
                atomic_load(&g_bytes) / 1048576.0, g_bytes_peak / 1048576.0, g_budget / 1048576.0, g_n_tex_live,
                g_n_tex_peak, g_n_loaded, g_n_private, g_n_stale, g_load_ms_sum, g_load_ms_max, g_n_relevel);
        fprintf(stderr, "[texrep] publish latency (frames) 0:%lu 1:%lu 2:%lu 3-4:%lu 5-8:%lu 9-16:%lu 17-64:%lu >64:%lu, "
                "max %ld (all levels in %lu, uploads stopped %lu, 60 frames %lu); in race/free roam: %lu requested, %lu shown\n",
                g_lat_hist[0], g_lat_hist[1], g_lat_hist[2], g_lat_hist[3], g_lat_hist[4], g_lat_hist[5],
                g_lat_hist[6], g_lat_hist[7], g_lat_max, g_why[0], g_why[1], g_why[2], g_load_race, g_pub_race);
        fprintf(stderr, "[texrep] guest thread time in texrep per frame: max %.3f ms, %lu frame(s) over 1 ms of %ld; "
                "replaced binds by mip filter none/point/linear %lu/%lu/%lu\n",
                g_frame_ms_max, g_frames_over1, g_frame, g_mipstat[0], g_mipstat[1], g_mipstat[2]);
    }
    if (g_dumping)
        fprintf(stderr, "[texrep] dump: %lu texture(s) written to %s (%lu taken back: dynamic)\n",
                g_n_dumped, g_dumpdir, g_n_unlinked);
    if (g_q) dispatch_sync(g_q, ^{});                /* finish pending dump writes */
}

/* tonemenu.c -- Exposure and White Level: two sliders on the game's Display
 * options, after Level Of Detail (the menus' Options > Display, 0x4B7180,
 * and the pause menu's, 0x4C36C0), for eyes the picture's brightness tires,
 * as qUINT Lightroom's sliders through ReShade on the PC game.  The page's last pass applies them to the whole picture, menus and
 * HUD included (gpu_web.c gw_tone, every frame's GwTone; web/src/gpu):
 *   Exposure     the colour times 2^exposure, -1 .. +1 in steps of 0.1 (as
 *                qUINT's: half to twice as bright); 0: as the game draws it
 *   White Level  the brightest the picture gets, 40 % .. 100 % in steps of
 *                5 %: the top fifth below it bends down to it (a soft
 *                shoulder from KNEE of it); 100 %: as the game draws it
 * A step shows at once (the page draws every frame with them); a frame dump
 * and a screenshot keep the colours as drawn.  Both are the registry's
 * (registry.txt: the device's, as the game's own video options; cloud saves
 * leave it out), read at startup: Exposure in hundredths of a stop, signed
 * (stored as the game stores FSAA's -1), WhiteLevel in percent; none: 0 and
 * 100.  The sliders themselves: optslider.c.  Web only: the Mac renderer
 * has no such pass. */

static uint32_t g_white = 100;                   /* White Level, percent */

static void apply(void){ gw_tone(exp2f((float)g_exp / 100.f), (float)g_white / 100.f, KNEE); }

/* the labels in the game's language, as hornmenu.c's (Latin-1 where the
 * language's own texts have those letters: German's ß, Swedish's å, Spanish's
 * ó, the Portuguese pack's ç, ã, í, the Hungarian pack's í, ó, é, the Czech
 * pack's Ú, í, é (and its ň written n), the Slovak pack's in Windows-1250);
 * English for the others */
static const char *label_of(int white){
    static const struct { const char *lang, *exposure, *white; } T[] = {
        { "french", "Exposition", "Niveau de blanc" }, { "german", "Belichtung", "Wei\xdfpegel" },
        { "italian", "Esposizione", "Livello del bianco" }, { "spanish", "Exposici\xf3n", "Nivel de blanco" },
        { "dutch", "Belichting", "Witniveau" }, { "swedish", "Exponering", "Vitniv\xe5" },
        { "danish", "Eksponering", "Hvidniveau" }, { "portuguese", "Exposi\xe7\xe3o", "N\xedvel de Branco" },
        { "polish", "Ekspozycja", "Poziom bieli" }, { "turkish", "Pozlama", "Beyaz Seviyesi" },
        { "hungarian", "Expoz\xed" "ci\xf3", "Feh\xe9rszint" },
        { "czech", "Expozice", "\xdaroven b\xedl\xe9" }, { "slovak", "Expoz\xed" "cia", "\xdarove\xf2 bielej" },
    };
    const char *l = language_name();
    for (unsigned i = 0; i < sizeof T / sizeof T[0]; i++) if (!strcmp(l, T[i].lang)) return white ? T[i].white : T[i].exposure;
    return white ? "White Level" : "Exposure";
}
static const char *exp_label(void){ return label_of(0); }
static const char *white_label(void){ return label_of(1); }
static float exp_value(void){ return (float)g_exp / 100.f; }
static float white_value(void){ return (float)g_white / 100.f; }
static void exp_moved(float v){
    int32_t h = (int32_t)lrintf(v * 100.f);
    if (h < -100) h = -100;
    if (h > 100) h = 100;
    if (h == g_exp) return;
    g_exp = h;
    win32_reg_put_dword(REG_EXPOSURE, (uint32_t)h);
    fprintf(stderr, "[tone] exposure %+.1f\n", h / 100.0);
    apply();
}
static void white_moved(float v){
    uint32_t pct = (uint32_t)lrintf(v * 100.f);
    if (pct < 40u) pct = 40u;
    if (pct > 100u) pct = 100u;
    if (pct == g_white) return;
    g_white = pct;
    win32_reg_put_dword(REG_WHITE, pct);
    fprintf(stderr, "[tone] white level %u %%\n", pct);
    apply();
}
static OptSlider g_exposure = { "Exposure", -1.f, 1.f, 0.1f, exp_value, exp_moved, exp_label, 0 };
static OptSlider g_whitelv  = { "White Level", 0.4f, 1.f, 0.05f, white_value, white_moved, white_label, 0 };

/* the registry's Exposure and White Level to the renderer (once) */
void tonemenu_install(void){
    if (g_installed) return;
    g_installed = 1;
    uint32_t v;
    if (win32_reg_get_dword(REG_EXPOSURE, &v)){
        int32_t h = (int32_t)v;
        g_exp = h < -100 ? -100 : h > 100 ? 100 : h;
    }
    if (win32_reg_get_dword(REG_WHITE, &v)) g_white = v < 40u ? 40u : v > 100u ? 100u : v;
    if (g_exp || g_white != 100u) fprintf(stderr, "[tone] exposure %+.1f, white level %u %% (registry)\n", g_exp / 100.0, g_white);
    apply();
}

int tonemenu_hook(CPU *c, uint32_t ip){
    switch (ip){
    case HOOK_SITE(0x004b725a): break;           /* Options > Display: after Level Of Detail, before Customize Display Settings */
    case HOOK_SITE(0x004c3835): break;           /* the pause menu's */
    default: return 0;
    }
    tonemenu_install();
    optslider_add(c, c->esi, FN_ADD, &g_exposure);
    optslider_add(c, c->esi, FN_ADD, &g_whitelv);
    return 1;
}

/* trafficcars.c -- a traffic vehicle as the player's own car (a save edited to drive the fire truck, the bus, a
 * van ...): its body on the player's own screen, not only its lights and its shadow.  Friends always saw it.
 *
 * The game (SPEED2.EXE):
 *  - CarTypeInfo ([0x8A1CCC], 0x890 bytes each) +0x844 the type's use: 0 for the 31 player cars, 2 for the 15
 *    traffic vehicles (TAXI .. HATCHBACK02, types 31 .. 45).
 *  - The race's cars (GRaceParameters 0x89E7A0: [+0x70] 0x940 bytes each, [0x89E814] of them; 0x5ED900 the i-th):
 *    +1 the racer's index, +4 its kind (1 a player of this game, 2 another racer, 3 traffic: free roam's 16 at racers
 *    50 .. 65), +0x10 its RideInfo (+0 the type), +0x8F8 its CarLoader handle, +0x908 the traffic model it shares.
 *  - The world's load streams each one's ride (0x57F680 .., CarLoader::Load 0x63BC70) but a traffic type's
 *    (0x57F6A2); the traffic manager takes those instead (0x4201A2 -> 0x413440, 0x412C7C: +0x908), and draws the
 *    models it streams only on its own traffic.  The player's car of a traffic type is made all the same, with its
 *    lights and its shadow, but no model of its own is ever loaded: nothing of its body is drawn.
 *  - A friend's game loads the car as any friend's (roam_game.c: CarLoader::Load on its ride), and the loader and
 *    the car's render info take a traffic type as they should (the whole GEOMETRY.BIN at once, no vinyls).
 * Here a racer's entry (kind 1 or 2) is a car of its own at those three checks: the type's use is read as type 0's.
 * Traffic (kind 3) stays the traffic manager's, and every player car is as before.
 *
 * The camera behind such a vehicle: CarTypeInfo +0x720 the count of its camera spots, +0x724 split screen's, +0x730
 * and +0x790 the spots (0x10 bytes: s16 the camera kind, u16 its pitch, float forward, height, sideways); 0x5ECCA0
 * (the car's spot of a kind, 0x441140) is how the cameras find them.  Kinds 0 and 1 are the chase views (C's views
 * 3 and 2), 5 the drift camera (view 4); bumper and hood (2, 4) have a camera of their own.  Every traffic type has
 * a small car's spots (5.8 m behind, 1.7 m up), so the camera is inside the bus and right behind the fire truck,
 * below its roof.  The game's own SUVs have spots of their own (the Hummer 6.7 m and 2.3 m).  Here the big traffic

 * the player's 31 cars keep theirs.

static void type_name(uint32_t type, char *out, int len){
    uint32_t t = MR32(G_CARTYPES) + type * CT_SIZE;
    int k = 0;
    if (type < N_TYPES) for (; k < len - 1 && MR8(t + (uint32_t)k); k++) out[k] = (char)MR8(t + (uint32_t)k);

static int traffic_type(uint32_t type){ return type < N_TYPES && MR32(MR32(G_CARTYPES) + type * CT_SIZE + CT_USE) == USE_TRAFFIC; }

/* the big traffic types' chase and drift spots moved back and up, once (a spot still the small car's: -5.8 m) */
static void big_cameras(void){
    uint32_t types = MR32(G_CARTYPES);
    static uint32_t done;
    if (!types || done == types) return;
    done = types;
    for (uint32_t t = 0; t < N_TYPES; t++){
        if (!traffic_type(t)) continue;
        char nm[24]; type_name(t, nm, sizeof nm);
        float s = 1.f;
        for (unsigned k = 0; k < sizeof BIG / sizeof BIG[0]; k++) if (!strcmp(nm, BIG[k].type)) s = BIG[k].s;
        uint32_t ti = types + t * CT_SIZE;
        if (s == 1.f || MR32(ti + CT_SPOTS) == 0 || MRF32(ti + CT_SPOTS + 0x10u + 4u) != -5.8f) continue;
        for (uint32_t l = 0; l < 2u; l++){
            uint32_t n = MR32(ti + CT_SPOTS + 4u * l), e = ti + CT_SPOTS + (l ? 0x70u : 0x10u);
            for (uint32_t k = 0; k < n && k < SPOTS_MAX; k++, e += SPOT_SIZE){
                int16_t kind = (int16_t)MR16(e);
                if (kind != 0 && kind != 1 && kind != 5) continue;
                MRF32(e + 4u) *= s; MRF32(e + 8u) *= s;
            }
        }
        fprintf(stderr, "[traffic] the %s's chase cameras %.2f times as far back and up (%.1f m, %.1f m)\n", nm, (double)s,
                (double)-MRF32(ti + CT_SPOTS + 0x10u + 4u), (double)MRF32(ti + CT_SPOTS + 0x10u + 8u));
    }
}

/* (test) the player's ride made the named type, stock parts, its own skin slot */
static void test_ride(CPU *c, uint32_t e){
    const char *want = getenv("NFSU2_TEST_TRAFFIC_CAR");
    if (!test_on("NFSU2_TEST_TRAFFIC_CAR")) return;
    { char nm[24]; type_name(MR32(e + RC_RIDE), nm, sizeof nm);
      fprintf(stderr, "[traffic] (test) race car 0x%08x: racer %u, kind %u, %s\n", e, MR8(e + 1u), MR32(e + RC_KIND), nm); }
    if (MR32(e + RC_KIND) != KIND_PLAYER) return;
    for (uint32_t t = 0; t < N_TYPES; t++){
        char nm[24]; type_name(t, nm, sizeof nm);
        if (strcasecmp(nm, want)) continue;
        uint32_t ride = e + RC_RIDE, a4[4] = { t, 1u, 0u, 0u }, z = 0, slot = (uint32_t)MR8(e + 1u) + 1u;
        if (MR32(ride) == t) return;
        gcall_main(c, FN_RIDE_INIT, ride, 4, a4);
        gcall_main(c, FN_RIDE_STOCK, ride, 1, &z);
        gcall_main(c, FN_RIDE_SKINS, ride, 1, &slot);
        fprintf(stderr, "[traffic] (test) the player's car made a %s (type %u)\n", nm, t);
        return;
    }
    fprintf(stderr, "[traffic] (test) no car type %s\n", want);
}

/* the race's car e at a check of its type's use: a racer's of a traffic type is read as type 0's (a player car) */
static uint32_t as_player(uint32_t e, uint32_t off, const char *where){
    uint32_t type = MR32(e + RC_RIDE), kind = MR32(e + RC_KIND);
    if ((kind != KIND_PLAYER && kind != KIND_RACER) || !traffic_type(type)) return off;
    static uint32_t said[3]; static const char *at[3] = { "load", "traffic models", "traffic manager" };
    int k = !strcmp(where, at[0]) ? 0 : !strcmp(where, at[1]) ? 1 : 2;
    char nm[24]; type_name(type, nm, sizeof nm);
    if (test_on("NFSU2_TEST_TRAFFIC_GAME")){
        if (said[k] != e){ said[k] = e; fprintf(stderr, "[traffic] racer %u's %s: the game's way at the %s\n", MR8(e + 1u), nm, where); }
        return off;
    }
    if (said[k] != e){ said[k] = e; fprintf(stderr, "[traffic] racer %u's %s: a car of its own at the %s\n", MR8(e + 1u), nm, where); }
    return 0;
}

int trafficcars_hook(CPU *c, uint32_t ip){
    switch (ip){
    case HOOK_SITE(0x0057f6a2):              /* the world's load, cmp [ecx+eax+0x844], 2: esi the race's car, ecx its type x 0x890 */
        big_cameras();
        test_ride(c, c->esi);
        c->ecx = as_player(c->esi, MR32(c->esi + RC_RIDE) * CT_SIZE, "load");
        return 1;
    case HOOK_SITE(0x004201a2):              /* cmp [eax+ecx+0x844], 2: edi the race's car, eax its type x 0x890 */
        test_ride(c, c->edi);
        c->eax = as_player(c->edi, MR32(c->edi + RC_RIDE) * CT_SIZE, "traffic models");
        return 1;
    case HOOK_SITE(0x00412c7c):              /* cmp [eax+edx+0x844], 2: ebx the race's car, eax its type x 0x890 */
        test_ride(c, c->ebx);
        c->eax = as_player(c->ebx, MR32(c->ebx + RC_RIDE) * CT_SIZE, "traffic manager");
        return 1;
    }
    return 0;
}

/* the spot of the loaded track's map the car is nearest to */
static int spot_on(uint32_t track, uint32_t car){
    int best = 0; float bd = 1e30f;
    for (int i = 0; i < NSPOTS; i++){
        if (SPOTS[i].track != track) continue;
        float dx = MRF32(car + 0x60u) - SPOTS[i].x, dy = MRF32(car + 0x64u) - SPOTS[i].y, d = dx * dx + dy * dy;
        if (d < bd){ bd = d; best = i + 1; }
    }
    return best;
}

/* why a trip to spot k (0 the city) cannot go now, WHY_OK it can */
static int why_not(int k){
    if (T.going) return WHY_GOING;
    uint32_t race = MR32(G_RACE), pl = MR32(G_PLAYER1), car = player_car(), track = MR32(G_RACEPARAMS);
    if (MR32(G_FLOW) != 6u || MR32(G_GAMEMODE) != 1u || MR32(G_RACETYPE) || MR32(G_CAREER_RACE) || !pl || !car ||
        !race || MR32(race) != 4u || (track != CITY && !track_map(track))) return WHY_NOT_HERE;
    const char *top = autotest_top_fng();
    if (!top || strcasecmp(top, "HUD_SingleRace.fng")) return WHY_NOT_HERE;   /* a menu or the map over the world */
    if (MR32(race + 0x24u) != 1u || !roam_game_alone()) return WHY_BUSY;      /* (two racers: an outrun) */
    if (!mprace_car_ok()) return WHY_NO_CAR;
    if (coop_wanted() && k) return WHY_COOP;          /* (back to the city goes: player 2 comes in there, coop.c) */
    if (MR32(G_CAREER + C_TIMED)) return WHY_TIMED;
    if (MR32(pl + PL_MARKER)) return WHY_MARKER;
    return WHY_OK;
}

/* the trip to spot k (0 the city): free roam loaded again, its start there (written by travel_presetup, just before
 * free roam's setup reads it: a trip that never starts changes nothing) */
static void go(CPU *c, int k, long f){
    const char *to = k ? SPOTS[k - 1].name : "the city";
    int why = why_not(k);
    if (why){ fprintf(stderr, "[travel] f=%ld a trip to %s asked: not now, %s\n", f, to, WHY[why]); return; }
    if (k == T.spot){ fprintf(stderr, "[travel] f=%ld a trip to %s asked: there already\n", f, to); return; }
    uint32_t car = player_car(), track = MR32(G_RACEPARAMS);
    if (track == CITY){                               /* leaving the city: where to come back */
        for (uint32_t i = 0; i < 3u; i++) T.city[i] = MRF32(car + 0x60u + 4u * i);
        T.city_h = MR16(car + 0x40cu); T.city_ok = 1;
    }
    if (!T.city_ok){ fprintf(stderr, "[travel] f=%ld a trip to %s asked: no city place kept\n", f, to); return; }
    T.going = k + 1; T.going_at = f; T.loaded = 0; T.place = 0;
    T.full = k && SPOTS[k - 1].track == track;        /* (the map loaded now: coop.c's flow step loads it in full) */
    uint32_t a[2] = { 10u, 0u };
    if (!g_test_noevent) gcall_main(c, FN_POSTEVENT, MR32(G_RACESTATUS), 2, a);
    fprintf(stderr, "[travel] f=%ld to %s (track %u)%s: free roam loads there\n", f, to, k ? SPOTS[k - 1].track : CITY,
            T.full ? ", the map loaded again" : "");
}

/* the career's kept spot: the city's place */
static void keep_city(void){
    for (uint32_t i = 0; i < 3u; i++) MRF32(G_CAREER + C_SPOT + 4u * i) = T.city[i];
    MR16(G_CAREER + C_SPOT_HEADING) = T.city_h;
}
/* savegame.c (the pause menu's Save): on a race track's map, the city's place the car left (what a save keeps), 1;
 * else 0 */
int travel_city(float p[3], uint16_t *h){
    if (!T.city_ok || !on_track()) return 0;
    memcpy(p, T.city, sizeof T.city); *h = T.city_h;
    return 1;
}
/* coop.c's free-roam setup (0x540780), before the game's, which reads the place: a trip's start, or for free roam
 * loaded again by the game's own way while on a track's map (0x513B30 keeping the car's place first) the city's */
void travel_presetup(void){
    long f = autotest_frame();
    if (T.going){
        int k = T.going - 1;
        float p[3]; uint16_t h;
        if (T.place){ memcpy(p, T.pp, sizeof p); h = T.ph; }
        else if (k){ p[0] = SPOTS[k - 1].x; p[1] = SPOTS[k - 1].y; p[2] = SPOTS[k - 1].z; h = SPOTS[k - 1].heading; }
        else { memcpy(p, T.city, sizeof p); p[2] += 0.5f; h = T.city_h; }
        for (uint32_t i = 0; i < 3u; i++) MRF32(G_START_POS + 4u * i) = p[i];
        MR16(G_START_HEAD) = h; MR8(G_START_KEEP) = 1;
        fprintf(stderr, "[travel] f=%ld the start at %.1f %.1f %.1f heading 0x%04x\n", f, (double)p[0], (double)p[1], (double)p[2], h);
        return;
    }
    if (!T.city_ok || !on_track()) return;
    keep_city();
    MR8(G_START_KEEP) = 1;
    fprintf(stderr, "[travel] f=%ld free roam loads again from a track's map by the game's own way: the city's place\n", f);
}
/* coop.c's free-roam setup (0x540780), after the game's (it wrote track 4000): the trip's track */
void travel_setup(void){
    if (!T.going) return;
    T.loaded = 1;
    if (T.going >= 2) MR32(G_RACEPARAMS) = SPOTS[T.going - 2].track;
}
/* coop.c's flow step (0x581820), before the game's: a trip to the map loaded now loads it in full, as co-op's reload
 * (the step's short way for the same region leaves the car where it is, and the race status took no SwitchTrack after
 * it: 2026-11-08), 1 once */
int travel_full(void){
    if (!T.going || !T.full) return 0;
    T.full = 0;
    return 1;
}

/* a trip to place p, heading h, on the map loaded now (spot T.spot's, or the city's): free roam loaded again there */
static void go_place(CPU *c, const float p[3], uint16_t h, long f){
    int k = T.spot;
    T.going = k + 1; T.going_at = f; T.loaded = 0; T.full = 1;
    T.place = 1; memcpy(T.pp, p, sizeof T.pp); T.pp[2] += 1.f; T.ph = h;
    uint32_t a[2] = { 10u, 0u };
    if (!g_test_noevent) gcall_main(c, FN_POSTEVENT, MR32(G_RACESTATUS), 2, a);
    fprintf(stderr, "[travel] f=%ld to %.1f %.1f %.1f on %s: free roam loads there\n", f, (double)p[0], (double)p[1], (double)p[2],
            k ? SPOTS[k - 1].name : "the city");
}
/* on a race track's map: the road point nearest `at` (its height within 6 m of at's, if one is), 1; 0 none within
 * ROAD_NEAR_M (the road table as near_roads reads it) */
static int road_near(const float at[3], float out[3]){
    float bd = ROAD_NEAR_M * ROAD_NEAR_M; int found = 0, level = 0;
    for (uint32_t i = 0; i < 2048u; i++){
        uint32_t r = guest_rd32(0x0088a334u + 4u * i);
        if (!guest_ok(r, 0x8cu) || (int16_t)MR16(r + 0xau) != (int)i) continue;
        int n = (int16_t)MR16(r + 0x34u);
        for (int j = 0; j < n && j < 4096 && guest_ok(r + 0x8cu + 0x38u * (uint32_t)j, 0x38u); j++){
            uint32_t nd = r + 0x8cu + 0x38u * (uint32_t)j;
            float dx = MRF32(nd) - at[0], dy = MRF32(nd + 4u) - at[1], d = dx * dx + dy * dy, z = (float)(int16_t)MR16(nd + 0x12u) / 8.f;
            int lv = fabsf(z - at[2]) < 6.f;
            if (lv < level || (lv == level && d >= bd)) continue;
            bd = d; level = lv; found = 1; out[0] = MRF32(nd); out[1] = MRF32(nd + 4u); out[2] = z;
        }
    }
    return found;
}
/* the trip's word to the page */
static void said(int what, int why, long f){
    static const char *const W[] = { "", "there", "a part of the city this career has not opened", "not found", "not now" };
    S.n++; S.what = what; S.why = why;
    fprintf(stderr, "[travel] f=%ld to a friend: %s%s%s\n", f, W[what], why ? ", " : "", why ? WHY[why] : "");
    double v = (double)S.n * 256 + why * 16 + what;
    if (S.slot == -2) S.slot = host_status_slot("travel_said");
    if (S.slot >= 0) host_status_set_n(&S.slot, &v, 1);
}
/* a trip to a friend, every frame in the world with no trip on its way: to its map, then behind it */
static void friend_step(CPU *c, uint32_t car, long f){
    if (T.spot != F.spot){
        if (F.went){ said(SAID_NOT_FOUND, 0, f); F.name = 0; return; }   /* (its map's trip went elsewhere) */
        int why = why_not(F.spot);
        if (why){ said(SAID_NOT_NOW, why, f); F.name = 0; return; }
        go(c, F.spot, f); F.went = 1; F.since = 0;
        return;
    }
    if (!F.since) F.since = f;
    float p[3]; uint16_t h;
    if (!roam_game_friend_at(F.name, p, &h)){
        if (f - F.since > FRIEND_WAIT){ said(SAID_NOT_FOUND, 0, f); F.name = 0; }
        return;
    }
    float dx = MRF32(car + 0x60u) - p[0], dy = MRF32(car + 0x64u) - p[1];
    if (dx * dx + dy * dy < FRIEND_NEAR_M * FRIEND_NEAR_M){ said(SAID_THERE, 0, f); F.name = 0; return; }
    if (F.went == 2){ said(SAID_THERE, 0, f); F.name = 0; return; }   /* (behind it once: it drove on since) */
    float a = (float)h * (6.28318531f / 65536.f), back[3] = { p[0] - FRIEND_BACK_M * cosf(a), p[1] - FRIEND_BACK_M * sinf(a), p[2] };
    float out[3]; uint16_t oh = h;
    int ok = T.spot ? road_near(back, out) : walls_open_near(p, back, p[0], p[1], out, &oh);
    if (!ok){ said(T.spot ? SAID_NOT_FOUND : SAID_LOCKED, 0, f); F.name = 0; return; }
    int why = why_not(1);                             /* (as a trip to a race track: none with player 2 in) */
    if (why){ said(SAID_NOT_NOW, why, f); F.name = 0; return; }
    go_place(c, out, T.spot ? h : oh, f);
    F.went = 2;
}

/* the status's "travel" (the page's Tracks): in a career's world, or on the way; else 0 (no Tracks row) */
static void publish(int why){
    double v = why < 0 ? 0. : TRAVEL_HAS + why * 256 + T.spot;
    if (v == T.shown) return;
    if (T.slot == -2) T.slot = host_status_slot("travel");
    if (T.slot >= 0){ host_status_set_n(&T.slot, &v, 1); T.shown = v; }
}

void travel_frame(CPU *c){
    long f = autotest_frame();
    static int test_read;
    if (!test_read){ test_read = 1; g_test_noevent = getenv("NFSU2_INPUT_SCRIPT") && getenv("NFSU2_TRAVEL_TEST_NOEVENT"); }
    uint32_t flow = MR32(G_FLOW), track = MR32(G_RACEPARAMS), car = player_car();
    int career = MR32(G_GAMEMODE) == 1u, world = flow == 6u && career && !MR32(G_RACETYPE) && car;
    /* the front end (the pause menu's Quit, a load): the career leaves free roam for good, with the city's place (another
     * profile may load next: nothing of this one carries over) */
    if (flow == 3u && (T.spot || T.going || T.city_ok)){
        if (T.city_ok && (T.spot || T.going || track_map(track))){
            keep_city();
            fprintf(stderr, "[travel] f=%ld the menus: the career keeps the city's place %.1f %.1f %.1f\n", f,
                    (double)T.city[0], (double)T.city[1], (double)T.city[2]);
        }
        T.spot = T.going = T.loaded = T.full = 0; T.city_ok = 0;
    }
    if (T.going && !world) T.going_at = f;            /* (loading: the wait counts in the world only) */
    if (world && T.going && T.loaded){
        uint32_t want = T.going == 1 ? CITY : SPOTS[T.going - 2].track;
        if (track == want){
            T.spot = T.going - 1; T.going = 0;
            roam_game_jumped();                       /* (others who came to the same start line stand there too) */
            fprintf(stderr, "[travel] f=%ld at %s (track %u, %.8s), the car at %.1f %.1f %.1f\n", f,
                    T.spot ? SPOTS[T.spot - 1].name : "the city", track, MR32(G_TRACKINFO) ? (const char *)(g_mem + MR32(G_TRACKINFO) + 0x40u) : "?",
                    (double)MRF32(car + 0x60u), (double)MRF32(car + 0x64u), (double)MRF32(car + 0x68u));
        }
    }
    if (T.going && world && f - T.going_at > GOING_FRAMES){
        fprintf(stderr, "[travel] f=%ld the trip to %s never started: given up\n", f, T.going > 1 ? SPOTS[T.going - 2].name : "the city");
        T.going = T.loaded = T.full = 0;
    }
    if (world && !T.going){
        int k = track_map(track) ? spot_on(track, car) : 0;
        if (T.spot != k && !(k && T.spot && SPOTS[T.spot - 1].track == track)){
            fprintf(stderr, "[travel] f=%ld %s\n", f, k ? "on a track's map: at its spot nearest the car" : "back in the city (the game's own way)");
            T.spot = k;
        }
    }
    if (world && on_track() && T.city_ok && !T.going) keep_city();   /* (a trip's start goes in the same fields) */
    if (F.name && world && !T.going) friend_step(c, car, f);
    int k = __atomic_exchange_n(&g_ask, 0, __ATOMIC_ACQUIRE);
    if (k == ASK_FRIEND){
        int why = why_not(1);
        F.name = __atomic_load_n(&g_ask_name, __ATOMIC_RELAXED); F.spot = __atomic_load_n(&g_ask_spot, __ATOMIC_RELAXED);
        F.since = 0; F.went = 0;
        fprintf(stderr, "[travel] f=%ld to a friend (%08x) at %s\n", f, F.name, F.spot ? SPOTS[F.spot - 1].name : "the city");
        if (why && why != WHY_COOP){ said(SAID_NOT_NOW, why, f); F.name = 0; }
    } else if (k) go(c, k - 1, f);
    publish(career && (flow == 6u || T.going) ? why_not(1) : -1);
}

/* The World Map's key (Player's input 0x602BD0, its event 0xC0) asks the career whether there is a map (0x500B60: none
 * in Quick Race's Free Run, where M does nothing) before it stops the world for the map's screen (race status event
 * 0x12, then 0x606730 shows it, and its close starts the world again); on a track's map the answer is none.  (Later
 * than that, the world stays stopped: the screen that would start it again never comes) */
int travel_hook(CPU *c, uint32_t ip){
    switch (ip){
    case HOOK_SITE(0x00602eef):
        if (on_track()) c->eax &= ~0xffu;
        return 1;
    }
    return 0;
}

/* The outrun challengers' manager (race coordinator +0xC40, Update 0x42EDF0; roam_game.c em_update) asks at its state 1
 * whether an outrun is due (0x41ACE0, thiscall, no arguments: the career's 0x500CB0, then its three tuners' rides set
 * up) and sends the tuners out when so (state 3).  On a track's map the answer is no: the tuners stay in the city, and
 * the manager waits at 1 until the car is back there */
void sub_0041ace0_orig(CPU *c);
void sub_0041ace0(CPU *c){
    if (on_track()){ c->eax &= ~0xffu; POP32(c->eip); return; }
    sub_0041ace0_orig(c);
}

/* "travel near X Y":the loaded map's three road points nearest X Y with their heights (the road table 0x88A334, 2048:
 * a road's nodes from +0x8C, 0x38 bytes, x y and the height at +0x12 in 1/8 m, as walls.c reads them), for a spot's
 * height; roads over roads show as points at the same place with other heights */
static void near_roads(long f, float x, float y){
    float bd[3] = { 1e30f, 1e30f, 1e30f }, bp[3][3] = {{0}};
    for (uint32_t i = 0; i < 2048u; i++){
        uint32_t r = guest_rd32(0x0088a334u + 4u * i);
        if (!guest_ok(r, 0x8cu) || (int16_t)MR16(r + 0xau) != (int)i) continue;
        int n = (int16_t)MR16(r + 0x34u);
        for (int j = 0; j < n && j < 4096 && guest_ok(r + 0x8cu + 0x38u * (uint32_t)j, 0x38u); j++){
            uint32_t nd = r + 0x8cu + 0x38u * (uint32_t)j;
            float dx = MRF32(nd) - x, dy = MRF32(nd + 4u) - y, d = dx * dx + dy * dy;
            for (int s = 0; s < 3; s++) if (d < bd[s]){
                for (int t = 2; t > s; t--){ bd[t] = bd[t - 1]; memcpy(bp[t], bp[t - 1], sizeof bp[t]); }
                bd[s] = d; bp[s][0] = MRF32(nd); bp[s][1] = MRF32(nd + 4u); bp[s][2] = (float)(int16_t)MR16(nd + 0x12u) / 8.f;
                break;
            }
        }
    }
    fprintf(stderr, "[travel] f=%ld near %.1f %.1f (track %u):", f, (double)x, (double)y, MR32(G_RACEPARAMS));
    for (int s = 0; s < 3; s++) if (bd[s] < 1e29f)
        fprintf(stderr, " %.1f %.1f height %.1f (%.1f m)", (double)bp[s][0], (double)bp[s][1], (double)bp[s][2], (double)sqrtf(bd[s]));
    fputc('\n', stderr);
}

/* script command (tests): "travel N" a trip to spot N (1..), "travel city" back, "travel where" where the car is,
 * "travel near X Y" the road points there (near_roads), "travel friend NAME [SPOT]" to that player (at that spot) */
int travel_cmd(const char *args){
    long f = autotest_frame();
    char a[32] = {0};
    sscanf(args, "%31s", a);
    if (!strcasecmp(a, "where")){
        uint32_t car = player_car(), ti = MR32(G_TRACKINFO);
        fprintf(stderr, "[travel] f=%ld where: %s, track %u (%.8s), why not %s; the car at %.1f %.1f %.1f heading 0x%04x "
                        "velocity %.1f %.1f %.1f; the kept spot %.1f %.1f %.1f\n", f,
                T.spot ? SPOTS[T.spot - 1].name : "the city", MR32(G_RACEPARAMS), ti ? (const char *)(g_mem + ti + 0x40u) : "?",
                WHY[why_not(1)], car ? (double)MRF32(car + 0x60u) : 0., car ? (double)MRF32(car + 0x64u) : 0.,
                car ? (double)MRF32(car + 0x68u) : 0., car ? MR16(car + 0x40cu) : 0u, car ? (double)MRF32(car + 0x70u) : 0.,
                car ? (double)MRF32(car + 0x74u) : 0., car ? (double)MRF32(car + 0x78u) : 0.,
                (double)MRF32(G_CAREER + C_SPOT), (double)MRF32(G_CAREER + C_SPOT + 4u), (double)MRF32(G_CAREER + C_SPOT + 8u));
        return 1;
    }
    if (!strcasecmp(a, "near")){ float x = 0, y = 0; sscanf(args, "%*s %f %f", &x, &y); near_roads(f, x, y); return 1; }
    if (!strcasecmp(a, "friend")){                    /* "travel friend NAME [SPOT]": as the page's Friends, Join */
        char nm[40] = {0}; int k = 0;
        if (sscanf(args, "%*s %39s %d", nm, &k) < 1){ fprintf(stderr, "[travel] f=%ld travel friend: NAME [SPOT]\n", f); return 1; }
        travel_ask_friend(rc_room_hash(nm), k);
        return 1;
    }
    int k = !strcasecmp(a, "city") ? 0 : atoi(a);
    if (k < 0 || k > NSPOTS){ fprintf(stderr, "[travel] f=%ld travel: N (1..%d), city, where or near X Y\n", f, NSPOTS); return 1; }
    travel_ask(k);
    return 1;
}

/* tunegraph.c -- the ECU and turbo tuning graphs take a drag.
 *
 * The performance tuning screen UI_PerformanceTuning_Graph.fng (TuningGraphMenu,
 * vtable 0x79d374, message handler 0x5654d0) holds a graph at +0x50.  For ECU
 * and turbo it is the torque graph (vtable 0x79beb8): a column per 1000 rpm
 * (a ring at +0x20, the selected one at +0x28), each a slider (+8: value +0xc,
 * range +0x10 .. +0x14, a tenth of it a step) drawn as a bar with a dot on top
 * (the scale +0x18 .. +0x1c over +0x44 units up from +0x3c; left +0x38, width
 * +0x40, in 640x480 units around the centre).  Left and Right pick a column (method
 * 7, 0x522eb0), Up and Down move its dot a step (PAD_UP 0x72619778, PAD_DOWN
 * 0x911c0a4b: method 8, 0x522f10, then the screen's 0xe15f62f8).  The mouse
 * (message 0x9803f6e2, every frame: method 9, 0x522f90) picks the column
 * under the pointer and moves its dot with the wheel; a click does nothing.
 * A phone has neither wheel nor keys there, so a tap picked a column and
 * nothing moved its dot (a player's report from Android, 2026-10-24: "cannot
 * be regulated").  Nitrous's graph (vtable 0x79b7f4) has arrows to tap.
 *
 * Here: a press on the torque graph keeps the column it picked until the
 * button goes up, and every 8 units the pointer goes up or down from there
 * is an Up or a Down for the screen, as a key would be (a step moves the dot
 * some 7 units).  The press need not be on the dot, and the finger need not
 * hide it.  At the dot's end the pointer's place counts as the start again,
 * so turning back moves it after 8 units.  Original: the pointer only picks
 * the column. */
#include "cpu.h"
#include "guest.h"
#include <stdio.h>

void dispatch_patch(uint32_t a, void (*f)(CPU *));
void sub_005654d0(CPU *c);

#define FN_TUNE_MSG  0x005654d0u   /* thiscall (msg, obj, a3, a4), ret 0x10 */
#define VT_TORQUE    0x0079beb8u
#define MSG_MOUSE    0x9803f6e2u
#define MSG_UP       0x72619778u
#define MSG_DOWN     0x911c0a4bu
#define SC_GRAPH     0x50u
#define G_RING       0x20u         /* the columns: a ring, this its head */
#define G_SEL        0x28u
#define P_VALUE      0x0cu
#define P_X          0x38u
#define P_Y          0x3cu         /* the foot */
#define P_W          0x40u
#define P_H          0x44u
#define P_NUM        0x48u
#define MOUSE        0x008763d0u   /* +4 x, +8 y (640x480); +0x20 buttons swapped; +0x21 left down, +0x22 went down; right +3 */
#define STEP_UNITS   8

static uint32_t g_drag;            /* the screen whose graph the button holds, 0: none */
static int g_inner;                /* the game's own handling of the mouse runs */
static int g_ref, g_steps;         /* the pointer's y the next step counts from; steps so far */

static int pointer_y(void){ return (int32_t)MR32(MOUSE + 8u); }

/* the pointer is on one of the graph's columns, between its foot and its top */
static int on_graph(uint32_t g){
    float x = (float)(int32_t)MR32(MOUSE + 4u) - 320.f, y = (float)pointer_y() - 240.f;
    uint32_t head = g + G_RING;
    for (uint32_t p = MR32(head); p && p != head; p = MR32(p))
        if (x >= MRF32(p + P_X) && x <= MRF32(p + P_X) + MRF32(p + P_W) &&
            y <= MRF32(p + P_Y) && y >= MRF32(p + P_Y) - MRF32(p + P_H)) return 1;
    return 0;
}

/* a step for every 8 units the pointer has gone up or down, as Up and Down to the screen */
static void follow(CPU *c, uint32_t self, uint32_t p){
    int y = pointer_y();
    while (g_ref - y >= STEP_UNITS || y - g_ref >= STEP_UNITS){
        int up = g_ref > y;
        uint32_t a[4] = { up ? MSG_UP : MSG_DOWN, 0, 0, 0 };
        float v = MRF32(p + P_VALUE);
        gcall(c, FN_TUNE_MSG, self, 4, a);
        if (MRF32(p + P_VALUE) == v){ g_ref = y; break; }   /* at its end */
        g_ref += up ? -STEP_UNITS : STEP_UNITS;
        g_steps += up ? 1 : -1;
    }
}

static void tune_msg(CPU *c){
    uint32_t self = c->ecx, g = MR32(self + SC_GRAPH);
    if (g_inner || MR32(c->esp + 4u) != MSG_MOUSE || !g || MR32(g) != VT_TORQUE){ sub_005654d0(c); return; }
    uint32_t b = MOUSE + (MR8(MOUSE + 0x20u) ? 0x24u : 0x21u);   /* the main button, as 0x52d100 takes it */
    uint32_t p = MR32(g + G_SEL);
    if (g_drag && (g_drag != self || !MR8(b) || !p)){
        if (g_steps && p) fprintf(stderr, "[tune] column %u: %+d steps by a drag\n", MR32(p + P_NUM), g_steps);
        g_drag = 0;
    }
    if (g_drag) follow(c, self, p);
    else {
        uint32_t a[4] = { MR32(c->esp + 4u), MR32(c->esp + 8u), MR32(c->esp + 12u), MR32(c->esp + 16u) };
        g_inner = 1; gcall(c, FN_TUNE_MSG, self, 4, a); g_inner = 0;
        if (MR8(b + 1u) && MR32(g + G_SEL) && on_graph(g)){ g_drag = self; g_ref = pointer_y(); g_steps = 0; }
    }
    POP32(c->eip); c->esp += 16u;
}

void tunegraph_install(void){ dispatch_patch(FN_TUNE_MSG, tune_msg); }

/* uniques.c -- once Caleb is beaten, the unique visual parts (the wide body
 * kits and the other visual rewards of the stages' outruns) are in every
 * career car's shops.
 *
 * The game gives each unique visual part only to the one car driven to its
 * star (STAGE_2_VISUAL_1 .. STAGE_5_VISUAL_5, the last one the wide body kit),
 * and the stage-5 star is gone once the last URL race is won.  Its own ending
 * opens all of them after Caleb, but only in Customize mode, whose cars free
 * roam never drives: there the career car is the one everybody sees.  So
 * after Caleb the career shops sell them for every car too, the rule the game
 * already has for Customize.  The stars and the outrun rewards stay as they
 * are, and the unique performance parts (a separate system: UI_ChooseUniquePart,
 * RideInfo +0x318) stay one per stage.
 *
 * The game's checks (v1.2 NA):
 *   0x52A010 IsUnlocked(filter, slot, part, car): the shops' and the garage's
 *     test of a car part (slot = CARSLOTID, WIDE_BODY 6; part = 14-byte record,
 *     byte +5's top 3 bits its unlock level, 4 = unique).  The filter comes from
 *     0x50F0D0: in career ([0x850078] 1) 6 in the shops and 2 in the garage
 *     ([0x83898C] 1), in Customize ([0x850078] 8) 0x08..0x1F8.
 *   0x515500(filter, slot, part): the career's half.  Bit 2: the car owns the
 *     part (the car's record +0x434, set by a buy, 0x5289F0).  Bit 4: the stage
 *     has opened its level (0x515360), and level 4 never.  Also called with 4
 *     alone from 0x530004 (a shop's category).
 *   0x529D60: Customize's half; unlocks level 4 once the final event of stage 5
 *     is won: Career 0x500B80([[0x86262C] + 0x28]), [0x86262C] being stage 5's
 *     stage info (its record +0x100) and +0x28 its final event, S5_CIRCUIT_36.
 * Here 0x515500 also says yes to a level-4 part with bit 4 asked once that same
 * event is won.  Nothing else changes: such a part is bought like any other and
 * is then the car's, in the profile too. */
#include "cpu.h"
#include "guest.h"
#include "game.h"
#include <stdio.h>

#define C_NEVENTS      0x7afcu        /* career: events with a record */
#define C_EVENTS       0x7b00u        /* career: those records, 8 bytes {hash, ..., +6 state (1 won)} */
#define C_MAXEVENTS    0x181u         /* room up to +0x8708 */
#define G_S5_INFO      0x0086262cu    /* stage 5's stage info (its stage record +0x100) */
#define SI_FINAL       0x28u          /* stage info: the final event's hash */
#define P_LEVEL        5u             /* part: top 3 bits its unlock level */
#define LEVEL_UNIQUE   4u
#define F_STAGE        4u             /* 0x515500's filter: the stage's unlocks (the shops) */

/* Career 0x500B80 with stage 5's final event: Caleb's race won */
int uniques_caleb_beaten(void){
    uint32_t si = MR32(G_S5_INFO);
    if (!guest_ok_bytes(si, SI_FINAL + 4u)) return 0;
    uint32_t h = MR32(si + SI_FINAL), n = MR32(G_CAREER + C_NEVENTS);
    if (!h || n > C_MAXEVENTS) return 0;
    for (uint32_t i = 0; i < n; i++){
        uint32_t r = G_CAREER + C_EVENTS + 8u * i;
        if (MR32(r) == h) return MR8(r + 6u) == 1u;
    }
    return 0;
}

static int g_said;

void sub_00515500_orig(CPU *c);
void sub_00515500(CPU *c){
    uint32_t filter = MR32(c->esp + 4u), slot = MR32(c->esp + 8u), part = MR32(c->esp + 12u);
    sub_00515500_orig(c);
    if ((c->eax & 0xffu) || !(filter & F_STAGE) || !guest_ok_bytes(part, P_LEVEL + 1u)) return;
    if ((MR8(part + P_LEVEL) >> 5) != LEVEL_UNIQUE || !uniques_caleb_beaten()) return;
    c->eax = (c->eax & ~0xffu) | 1u;
    if (!g_said){
        g_said = 1;
        fprintf(stderr, "[career] Caleb beaten: the unique visual parts are in every car's shops (first asked: slot %u)\n", slot);
    }
}
