/* walls.c -- a car past the career's walls goes back to the roads it can reach.
 *
 * Career free roam closes the later stages' areas with red walls: the scenery
 * and collision group BARRIERS_CAREER<stage> (0x578060, 0x5F54A0), and lines
 * of the same group among the track's barriers (track 0x88F298 +0x498 count,
 * +0x49C 0x24 each: x0 y0 x1 y1, +0x10 enabled), which the GPS's road search
 * does not cross (0x5D2E60).  In a stage 2 career five such lines are on:
 * where the roads leave its area.  A car thrown past a wall (a hard hit with
 * another player's car in free roam, Discord 2026-11-04: Coal Harbor's bridge;
 * the walls stop a car thrown at them even 40 m up, so round a wall's end or
 * through it) could not come back: R (Player::ResetCar 0x6009A0, also the game's own reset
 * of a car that fell out of the world: 0x6012B0) puts it in a reset zone, on
 * the road it is on (the car's road, +0x2C) or where it was a moment ago; its
 * only look at the walls is the line from the car to that road.  Leaving free
 * roam the game keeps where the car is (Career +0x8750, 0x513B30; an outrun's
 * end 0x513950) and the profile saves that, so every load, garage and race put
 * the car behind the wall again.
 *
 * The traffic's roads (road table 0x88A334, 2048: a road's own index at +0xA,
 * its node count at +0x34, its nodes from +0x8C, 0x38 bytes: x, y, the height
 * at +0x12 (s16, 1/8 m), the road's index in +0xC's low 11 bits; joints
 * 0x883DB0 (count 0x883DB4), 0x20 bytes: the two roads at +8/+0xA, their
 * nodes at +4/+6) make one network over the whole city.  Cut where an enabled
 * barrier line crosses it, the part the new career's start still reaches
 * (the airport's car park, in every career's area) is the career's roads;
 * what else is on the network is past its walls (tests/scripts/walls_*.txt).
 * A car whose nearest road (a height difference past HEIGHT_SLACK counts
 * twice, for roads over roads) is past the walls, and no near one of the
 * career's roads at its height is on its side of them, goes to the nearest
 * place on the career's roads at least WALL_GAP from a barrier line, facing
 * away from where it was, through the hot-position jump (as roam_game.c's
 * car_rescue):
 *  - when career free roam starts with the car there (a profile saved so: the

 *  - after a reset (R, or the game's own: the reset's blink start, car +0x974,

static uint32_t player_car(void){ uint32_t p = guest_rd32(G_PLAYER1), car = p ? guest_rd32(p + 4u) : 0; return guest_ok(car, CAR_RESET_T + 4u) ? car : 0; }
static uint32_t road(uint32_t i){
    uint32_t r = guest_rd32(G_ROADS + 4u * i);
    if (!guest_ok(r, RD_NODE0) || (int16_t)MR16(r + RD_ID) != (int)i) return 0;   /* the table's other slots name roads again */
    int n = (int16_t)MR16(r + RD_NODES);
    return n > 0 && n < 4096 && guest_ok(r + RD_NODE0, (uint32_t)n * NODE_SZ) ? r : 0;
}
static uint32_t mix(uint32_t h, uint32_t v){ return (h ^ v) * 16777619u; }

/* the roads and the enabled barriers as they are now, in a word */
static uint32_t signature(void){
    uint32_t h = 2166136261u, nb = guest_rd32(G_TRACK + TK_NBAR), bars = guest_rd32(G_TRACK + TK_BARS);
    for (uint32_t i = 0; i < NROADS; i++) h = mix(h, guest_rd32(G_ROADS + 4u * i));
    h = mix(h, guest_rd32(G_JOINTS)); h = mix(h, guest_rd32(G_NJOINTS)); h = mix(h, nb);
    for (uint32_t i = 0; i < nb && i < 8192u && guest_ok(bars + i * BAR_SZ, BAR_SZ); i++) if (MR8(bars + i * BAR_SZ + BAR_ON)) h = mix(h, i + 1u);
    return h;
}

/* 2D: the segments a-b and c-d cross */
static int crosses(float ax, float ay, float bx, float by, const float *c){
    float d1 = (c[2] - c[0]) * (ay - c[1]) - (c[3] - c[1]) * (ax - c[0]);
    float d2 = (c[2] - c[0]) * (by - c[1]) - (c[3] - c[1]) * (bx - c[0]);
    float d3 = (bx - ax) * (c[1] - ay) - (by - ay) * (c[0] - ax);
    float d4 = (bx - ax) * (c[3] - ay) - (by - ay) * (c[2] - ax);
    return (d1 > 0.f) != (d2 > 0.f) && (d3 > 0.f) != (d4 > 0.f);
}
static int crosses_any(float ax, float ay, float bx, float by){
    for (int i = 0; i < W.nbar; i++) if (crosses(ax, ay, bx, by, W.bar[i])) return i + 1;
    return 0;
}
/* 2D distance from (px, py) to the segment a-b, and where along it (0..1) */
static float seg_dist(float px, float py, float ax, float ay, float bx, float by, float *t){
    float dx = bx - ax, dy = by - ay, l2 = dx * dx + dy * dy, u = l2 > 1e-6f ? ((px - ax) * dx + (py - ay) * dy) / l2 : 0.f;
    if (u < 0.f) u = 0.f; else if (u > 1.f) u = 1.f;
    if (t) *t = u;
    float ex = ax + u * dx - px, ey = ay + u * dy - py;
    return sqrtf(ex * ex + ey * ey);
}
static float bar_dist(float x, float y){
    float m = 1e30f;
    for (int i = 0; i < W.nbar; i++){ float d = seg_dist(x, y, W.bar[i][0], W.bar[i][1], W.bar[i][2], W.bar[i][3], 0); if (d < m) m = d; }
    return m;
}
/* how far a place is from a point of the roads: the height difference past HEIGHT_SLACK twice */
static float metric(float d2d, float dz){
    float h = fabsf(dz) - HEIGHT_SLACK;
    if (h < 0.f) h = 0.f;
    return sqrtf(d2d * d2d + 4.f * h * h);
}

static void drop(void){
    free(W.x); free(W.y); free(W.z); free(W.reach); free(W.sa); free(W.sb); free(W.scut);
    W.x = W.y = W.z = 0; W.reach = 0; W.sa = W.sb = 0; W.scut = 0;
    W.built = W.ok = W.n = W.nseg = W.nbar = W.nreach = W.npast = 0;
}

/* the network, its cuts and what the start reaches; W.ok when it is usable */
static void build(long f){
    drop();
    W.built = 1; W.sig = signature();
    uint32_t nb = guest_rd32(G_TRACK + TK_NBAR), bars = guest_rd32(G_TRACK + TK_BARS);
    for (uint32_t i = 0; i < nb && i < 8192u && guest_ok(bars + i * BAR_SZ, BAR_SZ); i++){
        uint32_t b = bars + i * BAR_SZ;
        if (!MR8(b + BAR_ON)) continue;
        if (W.nbar == MAX_BARS){ fprintf(stderr, "[walls] f=%ld more than %d barrier lines on: left as the game has it\n", f, MAX_BARS); return; }
        for (int k = 0; k < 4; k++) W.bar[W.nbar][k] = MRF32(b + 4u * (uint32_t)k);
        if (!isfinite(W.bar[W.nbar][0] + W.bar[W.nbar][1] + W.bar[W.nbar][2] + W.bar[W.nbar][3])) continue;
        W.nbar++;
    }
    static int base[NROADS];
    int n = 0;
    for (uint32_t i = 0; i < NROADS; i++){ uint32_t r = road(i); base[i] = r ? n : -1; if (r) n += (int16_t)MR16(r + RD_NODES); }
    uint32_t nj = guest_rd32(G_NJOINTS), jt = guest_rd32(G_JOINTS);
    if (nj > 65536u || !guest_ok(jt, nj * JOINT_SZ)) nj = 0;
    if (n < 100){ fprintf(stderr, "[walls] f=%ld no roads (%d nodes): left as the game has it\n", f, n); return; }
    int maxseg = n + (int)nj;
    W.x = malloc(sizeof(float) * (size_t)n); W.y = malloc(sizeof(float) * (size_t)n); W.z = malloc(sizeof(float) * (size_t)n);
    W.reach = calloc((size_t)n, 1); W.sa = malloc(sizeof(int) * (size_t)maxseg); W.sb = malloc(sizeof(int) * (size_t)maxseg);
    W.scut = calloc((size_t)maxseg, 1);
    int *deg = calloc((size_t)n + 1, sizeof(int)), *adj = malloc(sizeof(int) * 2u * (size_t)maxseg), *queue = malloc(sizeof(int) * (size_t)n);
    uint8_t *seen = calloc((size_t)n, 1);
    if (!W.x || !W.y || !W.z || !W.reach || !W.sa || !W.sb || !W.scut || !deg || !adj || !queue || !seen){
        fprintf(stderr, "[walls] f=%ld out of memory\n", f); free(deg); free(adj); free(queue); free(seen); drop(); W.built = 1; return;
    }
    W.n = n;
    for (uint32_t i = 0; i < NROADS; i++){
        if (base[i] < 0) continue;
        uint32_t r = road(i); int m = (int16_t)MR16(r + RD_NODES);
        for (int k = 0; k < m; k++){
            uint32_t nd = r + RD_NODE0 + NODE_SZ * (uint32_t)k; int g = base[i] + k;
            W.x[g] = MRF32(nd); W.y[g] = MRF32(nd + 4u); W.z[g] = (float)(int16_t)MR16(nd + ND_Z) * 0.125f;
            if (k + 1 < m){ W.sa[W.nseg] = g; W.sb[W.nseg] = g + 1; W.nseg++; }
        }
    }
    int njoint = 0;
    for (uint32_t j = 0; j < nj; j++){
        uint32_t e = jt + JOINT_SZ * j;
        int n4 = (int16_t)MR16(e + 4u), n6 = (int16_t)MR16(e + 6u), r8 = (int16_t)MR16(e + 8u), ra = (int16_t)MR16(e + 0xau);
        if (r8 < 0 || ra < 0 || r8 >= (int)NROADS || ra >= (int)NROADS || base[r8] < 0 || base[ra] < 0 || n4 < 0 || n6 < 0) continue;
        if (n4 >= (int16_t)MR16(road((uint32_t)r8) + RD_NODES) || n6 >= (int16_t)MR16(road((uint32_t)ra) + RD_NODES)) continue;
        W.sa[W.nseg] = base[r8] + n4; W.sb[W.nseg] = base[ra] + n6; W.nseg++; njoint++;
    }
    int ncut = 0;
    for (int s = 0; s < W.nseg; s++){
        int a = W.sa[s], b = W.sb[s];
        if (isfinite(W.x[a] + W.y[a] + W.x[b] + W.y[b]) && crosses_any(W.x[a], W.y[a], W.x[b], W.y[b])){ W.scut[s] = 1; ncut++; }
    }
    /* the start's node, then everything joined to it (seen), and what of that joins it without a cut (reach) */
    int seed = -1; float best = 1e30f;
    for (int g = 0; g < n; g++){ float d = hypotf(W.x[g] - START_X, W.y[g] - START_Y); if (d < best){ best = d; seed = g; } }
    for (int pass = 0; pass < 2; pass++){
        memset(deg, 0, sizeof(int) * ((size_t)n + 1));
        for (int s = 0; s < W.nseg; s++) if (pass == 0 || !W.scut[s]){ deg[W.sa[s] + 1]++; deg[W.sb[s] + 1]++; }
        for (int g = 0; g < n; g++) deg[g + 1] += deg[g];
        int *fill = malloc(sizeof(int) * (size_t)n);
        if (!fill){ fprintf(stderr, "[walls] f=%ld out of memory\n", f); break; }
        memcpy(fill, deg, sizeof(int) * (size_t)n);
        for (int s = 0; s < W.nseg; s++) if (pass == 0 || !W.scut[s]){ adj[fill[W.sa[s]]++] = W.sb[s]; adj[fill[W.sb[s]]++] = W.sa[s]; }
        free(fill);
        uint8_t mark = pass == 0 ? 1 : 2;
        int qh = 0, qt = 0, cnt = 0;
        if (seed >= 0 && (pass == 0 || seen[seed] == 1)){ seen[seed] = mark; queue[qt++] = seed; }
        while (qh < qt){
            int u = queue[qh++]; cnt++;
            for (int i = deg[u]; i < deg[u + 1]; i++){
                int v = adj[i];
                if (pass == 0 ? !seen[v] : seen[v] == 1){ seen[v] = mark; queue[qt++] = v; }
            }
        }
        if (pass == 0) W.npast = cnt; else W.nreach = cnt;
    }
    for (int g = 0; g < n; g++) W.reach[g] = seen[g] == 2 ? W_OPEN : seen[g] == 1 ? W_PAST : W_UNKNOWN;
    int joined = W.npast; W.npast = joined - W.nreach;
    free(deg); free(adj); free(queue); free(seen);
    /* the start's roads reach most of what joins them, or something is not as this expects: left alone */
    W.ok = seed >= 0 && best < 200.f && joined > n / 2 && W.nreach * 5 > joined;
    fprintf(stderr, "[walls] f=%ld roads: %d nodes, %d segments (%d joints), %d barrier lines on, %d segments cut; the start reaches %d "
            "nodes, %d past the career's walls, %d off its network%s\n", f, n, W.nseg, njoint, W.nbar, ncut, W.nreach, W.npast,
            n - joined, W.ok ? "" : ": not as expected, left as the game has it");
}

/* the network as the roads and the barriers are now (a new world, a new stage: built again) */
static void ensure(long f){
    if (!W.built || signature() != W.sig) build(f);
}

typedef struct {
    int state;            /* W_*: the place's */
    int seg; float d;     /* its nearest road segment, how far (metric) */
    int found; float qx, qy, qz, qd, hx, hy;   /* the nearest place on the career's roads WALL_GAP from a barrier, how far, the road's way */
} Where;

/* the nearest place on the career's roads to (x, y, z), at least WALL_GAP from a barrier line */
static void career_place(float x, float y, float z, Where *w){
    w->found = 0; w->qd = 1e30f;
    static const float TS[5] = { 0.f, .25f, .5f, .75f, 1.f };
    for (int s = 0; s < W.nseg; s++){
        int a = W.sa[s], b = W.sb[s];
        if (W.scut[s] || W.reach[a] != W_OPEN || W.reach[b] != W_OPEN) continue;
        float t0; float d = seg_dist(x, y, W.x[a], W.y[a], W.x[b], W.y[b], &t0);
        if (d >= w->qd) continue;                        /* (no point of it is nearer) */
        for (int k = -1; k < 5; k++){
            float t = k < 0 ? t0 : TS[k];
            float px = W.x[a] + t * (W.x[b] - W.x[a]), py = W.y[a] + t * (W.y[b] - W.y[a]), pz = W.z[a] + t * (W.z[b] - W.z[a]);
            float m = metric(hypotf(px - x, py - y), pz - z);
            if (m >= w->qd || bar_dist(px, py) < WALL_GAP) continue;
            float hx = W.x[b] - W.x[a], hy = W.y[b] - W.y[a], hl = hypotf(hx, hy);
            if (hl < 1e-3f) continue;
            w->found = 1; w->qd = m; w->qx = px; w->qy = py; w->qz = pz; w->hx = hx / hl; w->hy = hy / hl;
        }
    }
}

static void where(float x, float y, float z, Where *w){
    memset(w, 0, sizeof *w); w->seg = -1; w->d = 1e30f; w->state = W_UNKNOWN;
    for (int s = 0; s < W.nseg; s++){
        int a = W.sa[s], b = W.sb[s]; float t;
        float d2 = seg_dist(x, y, W.x[a], W.y[a], W.x[b], W.y[b], &t);
        if (d2 > w->d) continue;
        float m = metric(d2, W.z[a] + t * (W.z[b] - W.z[a]) - z);
        if (m < w->d){ w->d = m; w->seg = s; }
    }
    if (w->seg < 0) return;
    int s = w->seg, a = W.sa[s], b = W.sb[s];
    if (W.reach[a] == W_UNKNOWN && W.reach[b] == W_UNKNOWN) return;
    if (!W.scut[s] && W.reach[a] == W_OPEN && W.reach[b] == W_OPEN){ w->state = W_OPEN; return; }
    if (W.scut[s] && (W.reach[a] == W_OPEN || W.reach[b] == W_OPEN)){
        /* the segment a barrier line cuts: on its career end's side of that line, the place is on the career's roads */
        int e = W.reach[a] == W_OPEN ? a : b, i = crosses_any(x, y, W.x[e], W.y[e]);
        if (!i){ w->state = W_OPEN; return; }
    }
    /* past the walls, unless one of the career's roads is about as near, at its height, and on its side of them
     * (a road of the career's beside it, or over it with the car on that) */
    career_place(x, y, z, w);
    if (!w->found){ w->state = W_OPEN; return; }       /* (nowhere to go: left as it is) */
    w->state = w->qd > w->d + NEAR_MORE || fabsf(w->qz - z) > HEIGHT_SLACK + 2.f || crosses_any(x, y, w->qx, w->qy) ? W_PAST : W_OPEN;
}

static uint16_t heading_of(float hx, float hy){
    float a = atan2f(hy, hx);
    if (a < 0.f) a += 6.28318531f;
    return (uint16_t)(int)(a * (65536.f / 6.28318531f));
}

static const char *const WHY[] = { "", "free roam began there", "after a reset" };
enum { WHY_ENTRY = 1, WHY_RESET };

/* the car past the walls: to the nearest place on the career's roads (1: it goes) */
static int check(long f, uint32_t car, int why){
    ensure(f);
    if (!W.ok) return 0;
    float x = MRF32(car + CAR_PLACE), y = MRF32(car + CAR_PLACE + 4u), z = MRF32(car + CAR_PLACE + 8u);
    if (!isfinite(x + y + z) || fabsf(x) > PLACE_MAX || fabsf(y) > PLACE_MAX) return 0;   /* (car_rescue's) */
    Where w; where(x, y, z, &w);
    if (w.state != W_PAST) return 0;
    /* facing along the road, away from where the car was (the wall is that way) */
    float hx = w.hx, hy = w.hy;
    if ((w.qx - x) * hx + (w.qy - y) * hy < 0.f){ hx = -hx; hy = -hy; }
    uint16_t h = heading_of(hx, hy);
    MRF32(G_HOTPOS) = w.qx; MRF32(G_HOTPOS + 4u) = w.qy; MRF32(G_HOTPOS + 8u) = w.qz + 1.f;
    MR16(G_HOTPOS_ANGLE) = h; MR8(G_HOTPOS_VALID) = 1; MR8(G_HOTPOS_JUMP) = 1;
    roam_game_jumped();
    S.jumped_at = f;
    if (++S.jumps <= 20)
        fprintf(stderr, "[walls] f=%ld my car is past the career's walls (at %.1f %.1f %.1f, %s): back to %.1f %.1f %.1f, heading %04x, "
                "%.0f m away\n", f, (double)x, (double)y, (double)z, WHY[why], (double)w.qx, (double)w.qy, (double)w.qz, h, (double)w.qd);
    return 1;
}

/* travel.c (a trip to a friend in the city): whether `at` is on this career's side of its walls, and if so where its
 * car may go near `near`: the nearest place on its roads at least WALL_GAP from a barrier line (out, heading *h along
 * the road, toward (tx, ty)), 1; 0 when `at` is past its walls (a part of the city its career has not opened), or
 * the roads are not as expected (then nowhere is known to be open) */
int walls_open_near(const float at[3], const float near[3], float tx, float ty, float out[3], uint16_t *h){
    ensure(autotest_frame());
    if (!W.ok) return 0;
    Where w; where(at[0], at[1], at[2], &w);
    if (w.state == W_PAST) return 0;
    career_place(near[0], near[1], near[2], &w);
    if (!w.found) return 0;
    float hx = w.hx, hy = w.hy;
    if ((tx - w.qx) * hx + (ty - w.qy) * hy < 0.f){ hx = -hx; hy = -hy; }
    out[0] = w.qx; out[1] = w.qy; out[2] = w.qz;
    *h = heading_of(hx, hy);
    return 1;
}

/* the main-loop hook (roam.c), every frame */
void walls_frame(void){
    long f = autotest_frame();
    uint32_t car = 0;
    if (MR32(G_GAMEMODE) == 1u && MR32(G_RACETYPE) == 0u && MR32(G_FLOW) == 6u && MR32(G_RACEPARAMS) == 4000u) car = player_car();   /* the city (a race track's map, travel.c, has no career walls) */
    if (!car){ S.in = 0; return; }
    if (!S.in){
        memset(&S, 0, sizeof S); S.in = mprace_car_ok() ? 1 : 2; S.since = f; S.jumped_at = -100000; S.stamp = MR32(car + CAR_RESET_T);
    }
    if (S.in != 1) return;
    if (MR8(G_HOTPOS_JUMP)){ S.stamp = MR32(car + CAR_RESET_T); return; }   /* a jump on its way (ours, a rescue, a script) */
    float wdt = MRF32(G_WORLDDT);
    int running = isfinite(wdt) && wdt > 0.f, why = 0;
    if (!S.entry_done && running && f - S.since >= ENTRY_FRAMES){ S.entry_done = 1; why = WHY_ENTRY; }
    uint32_t st = MR32(car + CAR_RESET_T);
    if (st && st != S.stamp) why = WHY_RESET;
    S.stamp = st;
    if (why && f - S.jumped_at >= JUMP_PAUSE) check(f, car, why);
}

/* script command (tests): "walls" the car's place, "walls at X Y Z" a place's, "walls bars" the barrier lines on,
 * "walls sweep" places on and beside the roads, "walls fling VX VY VZ" the car's velocity (as a hit could leave it:
 * its rigid body's momentum) */
int walls_cmd(const char *args){
    long f = autotest_frame();
    char sub[32] = {0}; float a = 0, b = 0, c = 0;
    sscanf(args, "%31s %f %f %f", sub, &a, &b, &c);
    ensure(f);
    uint32_t car = player_car();
    if (!strcasecmp(sub, "bars")){
        for (int i = 0; i < W.nbar; i++)
            fprintf(stderr, "[walls] f=%ld barrier line %d: %.1f %.1f -> %.1f %.1f\n", f, i, (double)W.bar[i][0], (double)W.bar[i][1],
                    (double)W.bar[i][2], (double)W.bar[i][3]);
        return 1;
    }
    if (!strcasecmp(sub, "sweep") && W.ok){
        /* places on and beside the roads (every third node, on it and 6 m to each side): how many of the career's
         * roads' places would go, and how many past the walls would stay */
        static const float OFF[5][2] = { { 0, 0 }, { 6, 0 }, { -6, 0 }, { 0, 6 }, { 0, -6 } };
        int n[3][3] = { { 0 } }, said = 0;
        for (int g = 0; g < W.n; g += 3){
            if (W.reach[g] == W_UNKNOWN) continue;
            for (int k = 0; k < 5; k++){
                Where w; where(W.x[g] + OFF[k][0], W.y[g] + OFF[k][1], W.z[g] + 0.5f, &w);
                n[W.reach[g]][w.state]++;
                if (W.reach[g] == W_OPEN && w.state == W_PAST && said++ < 10)
                    fprintf(stderr, "[walls] f=%ld sweep: %.1f %.1f %.1f beside the career's roads would go (%.1f m from a barrier line)\n", f,
                            (double)(W.x[g] + OFF[k][0]), (double)(W.y[g] + OFF[k][1]), (double)W.z[g], (double)bar_dist(W.x[g], W.y[g]));
            }
        }
        fprintf(stderr, "[walls] f=%ld sweep: beside the career's roads %d stay, %d would go; beside the roads past its walls %d would go, "
                "%d stay\n", f, n[W_OPEN][W_OPEN] + n[W_OPEN][W_UNKNOWN], n[W_OPEN][W_PAST], n[W_PAST][W_PAST], n[W_PAST][W_OPEN] + n[W_PAST][W_UNKNOWN]);
        return 1;
    }
    if (!strcasecmp(sub, "fling")){
        uint32_t mb = car ? guest_rd32(car + CAR_RB) : 0, rb = guest_ok(mb, 0x6c) && MR32(mb + 0x5cu) ? guest_rd32(mb + 0x68u) : 0;
        if (!guest_ok(rb, 0x168)){ fprintf(stderr, "[walls] f=%ld fling: no rigid body\n", f); return 1; }
        float m = MRF32(rb + 0x164u), v[3] = { a, b, c };
        for (uint32_t i = 0; i < 3u; i++){ MRF32(rb + 0x70u + 4u * i) = v[i] * m; MRF32(rb + 0xa0u + 4u * i) = v[i]; MRF32(car + 0x70u + 4u * i) = v[i]; }
        fprintf(stderr, "[walls] f=%ld fling: velocity %.1f %.1f %.1f (mass %.3f)\n", f, (double)a, (double)b, (double)c, (double)m);
        return 1;
    }
    float x = a, y = b, z = c;
    if (strcasecmp(sub, "at")){
        if (!car){ fprintf(stderr, "[walls] f=%ld no car\n", f); return 1; }
        x = MRF32(car + CAR_PLACE); y = MRF32(car + CAR_PLACE + 4u); z = MRF32(car + CAR_PLACE + 8u);
        fprintf(stderr, "[walls] f=%ld my car: heading %04x, forward %.3f %.3f (heading of it %04x), %d jumps of ours\n", f,
                MR16(car + CAR_HEADING), (double)MRF32(car + CAR_FWD), (double)MRF32(car + CAR_FWD + 4u),
                heading_of(MRF32(car + CAR_FWD), MRF32(car + CAR_FWD + 4u)), S.jumps);
    }
    if (!W.ok){ fprintf(stderr, "[walls] f=%ld %.1f %.1f %.1f: no usable roads\n", f, (double)x, (double)y, (double)z); return 1; }
    Where w; where(x, y, z, &w);
    float rz = w.seg >= 0 ? W.z[W.sa[w.seg]] : 0.f;
    career_place(x, y, z, &w);
    fprintf(stderr, "[walls] f=%ld %.1f %.1f %.1f: %s (the nearest road %.1f m, its height %.1f%s); the nearest place on the career's "
            "roads %.1f %.1f %.1f, %.1f m\n", f, (double)x, (double)y, (double)z, STATE[w.state], (double)w.d, (double)rz,
            w.seg >= 0 && W.scut[w.seg] ? ", a barrier line across it" : "", (double)w.qx, (double)w.qy, (double)w.qz, (double)w.qd);
    return 1;
}

/* watchdog.c -- stall watchdog (v1.2 NA port, long-session track).
 *
 * After codepdbh/nfsu2-recompiled's idea: if the guest has not presented a
 * frame for a while, log once what every guest thread is doing, so a hang
 * in a long career run can be diagnosed from the log alone.
 *
 *   NFSU2_WATCHDOG=<s>   seconds without a Present before the report
 *                        (default 15; 0 turns the watchdog off).  While the
 *                        game is loading (GameFlow [0x8654a4] other than
 *                        3 = front end and 6 = in game) the limit is at
 *                        least 20 s.  It used to be 60 s, and players stuck
 *                        on a loading screen reloaded before the report
 *                        came; a first load that waits on the network for
 *                        its data may now get a report it did not need
 *                        (only log lines).
 *
 * The report gives, per guest thread: its state (running, waiting for the
 * GIL, waiting on a kernel object, in a contended critical section,
 * sleeping) and since when, the guest call chain read from its stack, the
 * GIL holder, and the critical sections held with owner and recursion.  It
 * is printed once per stall; the next Present re-arms it.  The watchdog
 * only reads; it never changes what the game does.
 *
 * The web page's Download log asks too (watchdog_log_download): players
 * download a frozen game's log before the limit (2026-10-24: 13 s after the
 * last frame, no report), so the log gets how long ago the last frame was
 * and, after 3 s or more, the report then. */
#include "cpu.h"
#include "game.h"
#include <pthread.h>
#include <stdatomic.h>
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <time.h>
#include <unistd.h>

#define MAXCPUS 32                               /* win32_ext.c */
enum { TS_RUN = 0, TS_GIL, TS_WAIT, TS_WAITM, TS_CS, TS_SLEEP, TS_IDLE };
typedef struct { volatile int what; volatile uint32_t obj; volatile uint64_t since_us; } TState;
extern TState   g_tstate[MAXCPUS];
extern CPU     *g_all_cpus[MAXCPUS];
extern uint32_t g_all_tids[MAXCPUS];
extern int      g_all_n;
extern CPU     *g_cur_cpu;
void guest_backtrace(CPU *, int);
int  win32_cs_held(uint32_t *key, uint32_t *owner, int *depth, int max);
int  win32_obj_describe(uint32_t h, char *buf, size_t n);

static _Atomic uint64_t g_wd_present_us = 0;
static _Atomic long     g_wd_frames = 0;
static uint64_t g_wd_reports = 0;

static uint64_t wd_now_us(void){
    struct timespec ts; clock_gettime(CLOCK_MONOTONIC, &ts);
    return (uint64_t)ts.tv_sec * 1000000ull + (uint64_t)ts.tv_nsec / 1000ull;
}
/* Seconds from a stamp another thread took to now.  In the browser every
 * thread is a worker with its own performance.timeOrigin + now() (and the
 * guest threads' since_us come from nfsu2_now_ms, rounded another way): a
 * stamp taken a moment ago can read a few microseconds ahead of this
 * thread's now.  Unsigned, that was 2^64 us ("no Present for
 * 18446744073709.6 s" once in ~60 runs); a stamp ahead counts as no time. */
static double wd_since_s(uint64_t now, uint64_t then){
    return now > then ? (double)(now - then) / 1e6 : 0.0;
}
/* com.c Present (guest thread). */
void watchdog_on_present(void){
    atomic_store(&g_wd_present_us, wd_now_us());
    atomic_fetch_add(&g_wd_frames, 1);
}

static pthread_mutex_t g_wd_mx = PTHREAD_MUTEX_INITIALIZER;   /* the watchdog's thread and the page's input thread */
static void wd_report(double stalled, uint32_t flow){
    pthread_mutex_lock(&g_wd_mx);
    g_wd_reports++;
    uint64_t now = wd_now_us();
    fprintf(stderr, "\n[watchdog] no Present for %.1f s (game flow %u, %ld frames so far); guest threads:\n",
            stalled, flow, atomic_load(&g_wd_frames));
    static const char *const what[] = { "running", "waiting for the GIL", "waiting on", "waiting on (multiple) first",
                                        "in contended critical section", "sleeping", "outside guest code (host side)" };
    for (int i = 0; i < g_all_n && i < MAXCPUS; i++){
        CPU *c = g_all_cpus[i];
        if (!c) continue;
        int w = g_tstate[i].what; uint32_t o = g_tstate[i].obj;
        double for_s = g_tstate[i].since_us ? wd_since_s(now, g_tstate[i].since_us) : 0.0;
        char desc[96] = "";
        if (w == TS_WAIT || w == TS_WAITM) win32_obj_describe(o, desc, sizeof desc);
        else if (w == TS_CS) snprintf(desc, sizeof desc, "0x%08x", o);
        else if (w == TS_SLEEP) snprintf(desc, sizeof desc, "%u ms", o);
        fprintf(stderr, "  thread %d tid=%u%s: %s %s for %.1f s, esp=0x%08x eip=0x%08x\n",
                i, g_all_tids[i], c == g_cur_cpu ? " (holds the GIL)" : "",
                (w >= 0 && w <= TS_IDLE) ? what[w] : "?", desc, for_s, c->esp, c->eip);
        guest_backtrace(c, 12);
    }
    uint32_t key[32], owner[32]; int depth[32];
    int n = win32_cs_held(key, owner, depth, 32);
    if (!n) fprintf(stderr, "  critical sections held: none\n");
    for (int k = 0; k < n; k++)
        fprintf(stderr, "  critical section 0x%08x held by tid %u (depth %d)\n", key[k], owner[k], depth[k]);
    fprintf(stderr, "[watchdog] end of report\n\n");
    pthread_mutex_unlock(&g_wd_mx);
}

/* lifecycle.c (app track) defines the real one: true while the game has been
 * told it is inactive and parks in GetMessageA (no Present, on purpose, as
 * after an alt-tab on Windows).  During a LAN session an inactive game is
 * not parked (lifecycle_may_park): it keeps presenting, so the limit applies
 * as in the foreground.  Without lifecycle.c the game is never parked. */
__attribute__((weak)) int lifecycle_game_parked(void){ return 0; }

/* the page's Download log (runtime/web/input_web.c, on its input thread,
 * which runs while the game's threads are stuck): how long ago the last
 * frame was, the report after 3 s or more, then the line the page waits for
 * before it makes the file.  Also with NFSU2_WATCHDOG=0. */
void watchdog_log_download(void){
    uint64_t last = atomic_load(&g_wd_present_us);
    uint32_t flow = mem_is_committed(G_FLOW) ? MR32(G_FLOW) : 0u;
    if (!last) fprintf(stderr, "[watchdog] log downloaded before the first frame (game flow %u)\n", flow);
    else {
        double ago = wd_since_s(wd_now_us(), last);
        int parked = lifecycle_game_parked();
        fprintf(stderr, "[watchdog] log downloaded: the last frame %.1f s ago (game flow %u, %ld frames so far%s)\n",
                ago, flow, atomic_load(&g_wd_frames), parked ? ", parked in the background" : "");
        if (ago >= 3.0 && !parked) wd_report(ago, flow);
    }
    fprintf(stderr, "[watchdog] log download ready\n");
}

static void *wd_main(void *arg){
    double lim = *(double *)arg;
    pthread_setname_np("watchdog");
    int reported = 0;
    for (;;){
        sleep(1);
        uint64_t last = atomic_load(&g_wd_present_us);
        if (!last) continue;                     /* not armed before the first frame */
        if (lifecycle_game_parked()){            /* parked in the background: not a stall; */
            atomic_store(&g_wd_present_us, wd_now_us());   /* the limit restarts on return */
            reported = 0; continue; }
        double stalled = wd_since_s(wd_now_us(), last);
        uint32_t flow = mem_is_committed(G_FLOW) ? MR32(G_FLOW) : 0u;
        double l = (flow == 3u || flow == 6u) ? lim : (lim > 20.0 ? lim : 20.0);
        if (stalled < l){ reported = 0; continue; }
        if (!reported){ reported = 1; wd_report(stalled, flow); }
    }
    return 0;
}

void watchdog_start(void){
    const char *e = getenv("NFSU2_WATCHDOG");
    static double lim;
    lim = (e && *e) ? atof(e) : 15.0;
    if (lim <= 0.0) return;
    pthread_t th;
    if (pthread_create(&th, 0, wd_main, &lim) == 0) pthread_detach(th);
}
uint64_t watchdog_reports(void){ return g_wd_reports; }

/* The audio ring between the mixer's pump thread (runtime/web/audio_web.c)
 * and the page's AudioWorklet (web/src/audio/worklet.ts), registered with
 * nfsu2_register(HOST_KIND_AUDIO, ring, sizeof *ring).
 *
 * One producer (the pump) and one consumer (the worklet): the pump writes
 * float32 stereo frames at w and advances it, the worklet reads at r and
 * advances it.  Both counters only grow (mod 2^32); fill = w - r.  The page
 * (main thread) owns the context-state word.  The header is a plain array
 * of 32-bit words so the TypeScript side mirrors it by index:
 * web/src/audio/proto.ts carries the same numbers and web/tools/check-proto.mjs
 * compares the two files. */
#ifndef NFSU2_AUDIO_PROTO_H
#define NFSU2_AUDIO_PROTO_H
#include <stdint.h>
#include <stddef.h>

#define AUDIO_MAGIC        0x4E415544u  /* 'NAUD' */
#define AUDIO_VERSION      1u
#define AUDIO_RING_FRAMES  16384u       /* power of two: 372 ms at 44.1 kHz (a phone's 175 ms bursts, smoothly) */
#define AUDIO_RATE         44100u       /* the mixer's output rate */

/* header words */
enum {
    AR_MAGIC = 0,
    AR_VERSION = 1,
    AR_FRAMES = 2,       /* ring size in frames */
    AR_RATE = 3,         /* sample rate of the ring */
    AR_W = 4,            /* pump: frames written */
    AR_R = 5,            /* worklet: frames read (the pump waits on this word) */
    AR_UNDERRUNS = 6,    /* worklet: render quanta that found fewer frames than they needed */
    AR_CTX = 7,          /* page: AudioContext state (AR_CTX_*) */
    AR_QUANTA = 8,       /* worklet: process() calls */
    AR_TARGET = 9,       /* pump: ring fill it keeps, in frames */
    AR_MODE = 10,        /* pump: AR_MODE_* */
    AR_NOSOUND = 11,     /* pump: 1 = sound off (NOSOUND), the page plays nothing */
    AR_MUTED = 12,       /* pump: 1 = the game is parked, the output is silence */
    AR_PEAK = 13,        /* pump: peak of the last full second of output, 0..65536 */
    AR_RMS = 14,         /* pump: RMS of the last full second of output, 0..65536 */
    AR_LOUD = 15,        /* worklet: quanta whose output was not silent */
    AR_RESET = 16,       /* pump: bumped by audio_device_changed (autotest audioreset): the page rebuilds its context */
    AR_WALL_MS = 17,     /* pump: milliseconds mixed on the wall clock (no consumer) */
    AR_MIXED = 18,       /* pump: frames mixed (low 32 bits) */
    AR_PAGE_RATE = 19,   /* page: the context's real sample rate */
    AR_HDR_WORDS = 32
};
enum { AR_CTX_NONE = 0, AR_CTX_RUNNING = 1, AR_CTX_SUSPENDED = 2, AR_CTX_CLOSED = 3 };
enum { AR_MODE_IDLE = 0, AR_MODE_RING = 1, AR_MODE_WALL = 2 };

typedef struct {
    _Atomic uint32_t h[AR_HDR_WORDS];
    float pcm[AUDIO_RING_FRAMES * 2];     /* interleaved L, R */
} AudioRing;

#define AR_OFF_PCM 128   /* byte offset of pcm */
_Static_assert(offsetof(AudioRing, pcm) == AR_OFF_PCM, "audio ring layout");
_Static_assert((AUDIO_RING_FRAMES & (AUDIO_RING_FRAMES - 1)) == 0, "ring size: power of two");
#endif

/* The DirectSound mixer for the browser: runtime/audio.m without CoreAudio.
 *
 * The game mixes everything itself into one looping DirectSound buffer (EA's
 * SND library); com.c's
 * DirectSound HLE registers that buffer here and the mixer below plays it:
 * the same slot table, the same mix_into (nearest-neighbour resampling), only
 * the output differs, and the playback rate: constant here, where audio.m's
 * write-position servo and SNDSYNC rate ratio made the music's pitch wander
 * (both stay behind SNDSERVO=1 / SNDSYNC=1, see mix_into).
 *
 * On the Mac a CoreAudio render callback pulled 512-frame slices.  Here a
 * dedicated "audio pump" pthread mixes 512-frame slices into a float32 ring
 * in shared memory (audio_proto.h) that the page's AudioWorklet drains, so
 * the mixer keeps its pthread mutex (a worklet may not block) and its
 * callback-sized steps (the servo's constants are per callback).  The pump
 * paces itself by the ring: it tops it up to the target fill and sleeps on
 * the worklet's read counter, which the worklet notifies every render
 * quantum.  That locks the play cursors to the output device clock, as the
 * AudioUnit callback did.
 *
 * The DirectSound play cursor must move in real time, always: if it stands
 * still the EA library tears its buffer down and recreates it (after ~100
 * polls; seen on the Mac: 120 buffers in 4 s, then a crash at 0x727030), and
 * the movie player takes its clock from it.  In a browser the output can be
 * missing or stop at any time: no page attached yet, an AudioContext that is
 * suspended until the first user gesture or later interrupted, a stalled
 * device, NOSOUND (settings: sound = off).  So whenever the worklet has not
 * consumed anything for STALL_MS (or two of its gaps, below), or the page
 * reports a context that is not running, the pump falls back to the wall
 * clock: it keeps mixing slices at 44.1 kHz real time and drops them.  Cursors
 * keep moving; nothing is heard.
 *
 * Chrome runs the worklet once per render quantum, but in bursts: two output
 * callbacks' worth back to back (measured headless), so 8 quanta every 23 ms
 * at a base latency of 11.6 ms, and on a phone with a base latency of ~90 ms
 * (2026-10-25 reports) ~60 quanta every ~180 ms.  With a 60 ms stall test and a
 * 23 ms ring that phone's sound was dropped more than it was played
 * (reproduced with audio_latency 45 and 90).  So the pump learns the worklet's
 * rhythm: a stall is two of its longest gaps without a read (RHYTHM_*), and
 * when its bursts are big (over twice the start target) the ring holds one
 * and a slice (BURST_*; why the ring is 16384 frames now) and the pump mixes
 * at a steady pace (PACE) instead of refilling a burst at once.  That keeps
 * the DirectSound play cursor moving in real time: a cursor that stood still
 * and then jumped by a burst left the game's writer, which follows it, behind
 * (a skip every burst).  A desktop's bursts keep the old refill.
 *
 *   NOSOUND=1                 no output; the pump still runs (wall clock)
 *   SNDSYNC=1                 audio.m's rate ratio between game and real time
 *   SNDSERVO=1                audio.m's write-position servo (+-3 % trim)
 *   NFSU2_AUDIO_TARGET=<n>    ring fill in frames (default 1024 = 23 ms); worklet
 *                             underruns raise it a slice each, SHRINK_QUIET_S
 *                             without one lower it a slice, down to this (or
 *                             to a burst and a slice, if more)
 *   NFSU2_AUDIO_STATUS=<s>    an "[audio]" status line every s seconds
 *                             (default 5 when NFSU2_STATUS_EVERY is set)
 *   SNDDUMP, SNDCSV, SNDSTAT, SNDGAP   the Mac's diagnostics, unchanged */
#include "cpu.h"                 /* g_mem: guest memory is linear memory from 0 */
#include "host_abi.h"
#include "audio_proto.h"
#include "horn.h"
#include "carsfx.h"
#include "whine.h"
#include <stdint.h>
#include <string.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <stdio.h>
#include <pthread.h>
#include <math.h>
#include <time.h>
#include <stdatomic.h>

uint64_t host_us(void);          /* the game's virtual clock (win32.c) */

static double mono_s(void){
    struct timespec ts; clock_gettime(CLOCK_MONOTONIC, &ts);
    return (double)ts.tv_sec + (double)ts.tv_nsec * 1e-9;
}
static int env_on(const char *n){ const char *e = getenv(n); return e && *e && *e != '0'; }

/* ---- rate ratio (SNDSYNC), as audio.m; off by default here ----------------
 * audio.m made consumption follow the game's virtual clock (never faster than
 * real time, cap 1.0) for a game that ran below 60 fps on a fixed 16.7 ms
 * clock.  With the real-time clock (win32.c VCLOCK) the ratio only moves when
 * a frame runs past the 50 ms clock cap, and then it bends the pitch: every
 * loading hitch slowed the music to ~0.65 for a second.  The game's writer
 * follows the play cursor (below), so nothing needs the ratio: SNDSYNC=1
 * brings it back. */
static double g_rate_ratio = 1.0;
static int    g_sync_mode = -1;
/* the status line's window: the playback rate's extremes since the last line */
static double g_win_rmin = 9.0, g_win_rmax = 0.0, g_win_tmin = 9.0, g_win_tmax = 0.0;
static double g_win_fmin = 9.0, g_win_fmax = 0.0; static uint64_t g_win_over = 0;
/* how far ahead of the mixer the game has written (ms, the game's share of the
 * sound's delay), and the slices mixed before the game wrote them (each one a
 * glitch): the status line's window and the whole run */
static double g_win_lmin = 1e9, g_win_lmax = 0.0, g_lead_sum = 0.0, g_lead_max = 0.0;
static uint64_t g_lead_n = 0, g_starved = 0, g_win_starved = 0, g_skips = 0;
static _Atomic int g_reported = 0;   /* the game is ending (audio_report): its writer stops, no skip */
static int g_servo = 0;          /* SNDSERVO=1: audio.m's write-position trim */
static void update_rate_ratio(void){
    if (g_sync_mode < 0){
        const char *e = getenv("SNDSYNC");
        g_sync_mode = (e && *e) ? (*e != '0') : 0;
    }
    if (!g_sync_mode){ g_rate_ratio = 1.0; return; }
    static uint64_t lv = 0, lr = 0;
    struct timespec ts; clock_gettime(CLOCK_MONOTONIC, &ts);
    uint64_t rus = (uint64_t)ts.tv_sec*1000000ull + (uint64_t)ts.tv_nsec/1000ull;
    uint64_t vus = host_us();
    if (lv && rus > lr){
        double dv = (double)(vus - lv), dr = (double)(rus - lr);
        if (dr > 1000.0){
            double k = dv / dr;
            if (k < 0.25) k = 0.25;
            if (k > 1.00) k = 1.00;      /* never faster than real time */
            g_rate_ratio += (k - g_rate_ratio) * 0.10;
        }
    }
    lv = vus; lr = rus;
}

#define OUT_RATE   AUDIO_RATE
#define OUT_CH     2
#define FRAMES     2048          /* largest slice mix_into takes */
#define SLICE      512           /* frames per mix_into call: the Mac's AudioUnit slice */
#define STALL_MS   60.0          /* no consumption for this long (or 2 rhythms): wall-clock pacing */
#define START_GRACE_S 0.5        /* ... except right after the consumer appeared (two ~180 ms gaps to learn) */
#define SHRINK_QUIET_S 20.0      /* no worklet underrun for this long: the ring target a slice lower */
#define RHYTHM_WIN_S 1.0         /* the worklet's rhythm: the longest gap between its reads in each second, */
#define RHYTHM_N   5             /* ... the median of the last RHYTHM_N seconds (a hitch is one second's) */
#define RHYTHM_WAKE_MS 20.0      /* a gap the pump slept through longer than this says nothing */
#define BURST_SPLIT_MS 3.0       /* reads further apart than this begin a new burst */
#define BURST_N    9             /* the time between bursts: the median of the last BURST_N */
#define PACE       1.05          /* ring mode: slices at most this much faster than real time (the target caps it) */
#define CATCHUP_S  0.03          /* ... and at most this much made up at once after the pump was late */

#define MAXSND 128
#define SETTLE_SLICES 90          /* ~1 s: a stream's start (a cleared buffer) is no glitch */
typedef struct {
    uint32_t data, bytes, rate, chans, bits;
    int      used, playing, loop;
    double   cursor;          /* source frames */
    float    vol;             /* 0..1 */
    uint32_t wpos;            /* end of the last region the game wrote (Unlock) */
    int      wseen;
    double   trim;            /* servo rate correction */
    double   target;          /* fill fraction the servo locks to (adapts) */
    double   freq;            /* SetFrequency ratio */
    uint64_t plays, stops, wr_bytes, wr_calls, wr_nonzero;
    uint64_t over;            /* slices in which the cursor overtook the writer */
    unsigned settled;         /* slices mixed since it played from the top (to SETTLE_SLICES) */
    int      starving;        /* the last slice was mixed before the game wrote it */
    double   wtime;           /* when the game last wrote it (mono_s) */
} SndBuf;

static SndBuf g_snd[MAXSND];
static int    g_sndn = 1;                    /* 0 = no slot */
static int    g_sndfree[MAXSND], g_nsndfree = 0;
static int snd_new_id(void){                  /* g_slock held */
    if (g_nsndfree) return g_sndfree[--g_nsndfree];
    return g_sndn < MAXSND ? g_sndn++ : 0;
}
static pthread_mutex_t g_slock = PTHREAD_MUTEX_INITIALIZER;
static int g_audio_on = 0;                   /* the output is wanted (not NOSOUND) */
