/* ---- the DirectSound side (com.c), unchanged from audio.m ---------------- */
int audio_register(uint32_t data, uint32_t bytes, uint32_t rate,
                   uint32_t chans, uint32_t bits){
    if (!data || !bytes) return 0;
    if (rate < 4000u || rate > 192000u) rate = 44100u;
    if (chans < 1u || chans > 2u) chans = 1u;
    if (bits != 8u && bits != 16u) bits = 16u;
    pthread_mutex_lock(&g_slock);
    int id = snd_new_id();
    if (id){
        SndBuf *b = &g_snd[id];
        b->data = data; b->bytes = bytes; b->rate = rate;
        b->chans = chans; b->bits = bits;
        b->used = 1; b->playing = 0; b->loop = 0; b->cursor = 0.0; b->vol = 1.f;
        b->wpos = 0; b->wseen = 0; b->trim = 1.0; b->target = 0.0; b->over = 0;
        b->freq = 1.0; b->plays = b->stops = 0;
        b->wr_bytes = b->wr_calls = b->wr_nonzero = 0;
        fprintf(stderr, "  [sound] buffer #%d: %u Hz, %u channels, %u bit, %u bytes (%.2f s)\n",
                id, rate, chans, bits, bytes,
                (double)bytes / (double)(rate * chans * (bits/8u)));
    }
    pthread_mutex_unlock(&g_slock);
    return id;
}
void audio_play(int id, int loop){
    if (id <= 0 || id >= MAXSND) return;
    pthread_mutex_lock(&g_slock);
    if (g_snd[id].used){
        /* a buffer that already plays keeps its cursor: the game re-issues
         * Play on its stream all the time */
        if (!g_snd[id].playing){ g_snd[id].cursor = 0.0; g_snd[id].settled = 0; g_replay++; }
        else g_reissue++;
        g_snd[id].playing = 1;
        g_snd[id].loop = loop;
        g_snd[id].plays++;
    }
    pthread_mutex_unlock(&g_slock);
}
void audio_note_write(int id, uint32_t end_off){
    if (id <= 0 || id >= MAXSND) return;
    pthread_mutex_lock(&g_slock);
    if (g_snd[id].used && g_snd[id].bytes){
        g_snd[id].wpos = end_off % g_snd[id].bytes;
        g_snd[id].wtime = mono_s();
        g_snd[id].wseen = 1;
    }
    pthread_mutex_unlock(&g_slock);
}
void audio_note_write_stat(int id, uint32_t n, int nonzero){
    if (id <= 0 || id >= MAXSND) return;
    pthread_mutex_lock(&g_slock);
    if (g_snd[id].used){ g_snd[id].wr_calls++; g_snd[id].wr_bytes += n;
                         if (nonzero) g_snd[id].wr_nonzero++; }
    pthread_mutex_unlock(&g_slock);
}
void audio_set_freq(int id, uint32_t hz){
    if (id <= 0 || id >= MAXSND) return;
    pthread_mutex_lock(&g_slock);
    if (g_snd[id].used && g_snd[id].rate){
        if (!hz) g_snd[id].freq = 1.0;                      /* DSBFREQUENCY_ORIGINAL */
        else {
            double f = (double)hz / (double)g_snd[id].rate;
            if (f < 0.05) f = 0.05;
            if (f > 8.00) f = 8.00;
            g_snd[id].freq = f;
        }
    }
    pthread_mutex_unlock(&g_slock);
}
int audio_duplicate(int src){
    if (src <= 0 || src >= MAXSND) return 0;
    int id = 0;
    pthread_mutex_lock(&g_slock);
    if (g_snd[src].used && (id = snd_new_id()) != 0){
        g_snd[id] = g_snd[src];
        g_snd[id].playing = 0; g_snd[id].cursor = 0.0; g_snd[id].trim = 1.0;
        g_snd[id].target = 0.0; g_snd[id].over = 0;
        g_snd[id].plays = g_snd[id].stops = 0;
        g_snd[id].wr_bytes = g_snd[id].wr_calls = g_snd[id].wr_nonzero = 0;
    }
    pthread_mutex_unlock(&g_slock);
    return id;
}
/* com.c, last Release: the mixer holds g_slock while it reads guest PCM, so
 * once this returns the data can be freed. */
void audio_unregister(int id){
    if (id <= 0 || id >= MAXSND) return;
    pthread_mutex_lock(&g_slock);
    if (g_snd[id].used){
        g_snd[id].used = 0; g_snd[id].playing = 0; g_snd[id].data = 0;
        if (g_nsndfree < MAXSND) g_sndfree[g_nsndfree++] = id;
    }
    pthread_mutex_unlock(&g_slock);
}
void audio_stop(int id){
    if (id <= 0 || id >= MAXSND) return;
    pthread_mutex_lock(&g_slock);
    if (g_snd[id].used){ g_snd[id].playing = 0; g_snd[id].stops++; }
    pthread_mutex_unlock(&g_slock);
}
/* GetCurrentPosition: the play cursor and a write cursor 50 ms ahead of it
 * (equal cursors made the game write where we play).  The game's writer adds
 * its own 30 ms and margin to the write cursor (sndlead.c), so this is heard
 * as delay on every sound; it is also what covers the game's sound thread
 * waiting for the guest lock, ~70 ms at a race's start.  Measured with four
 * career races at once (2026-10-24): 30 ms made 1-4 skips a run there, 12 ms
 * 4-5, 50 ms none. */
#define WRITE_LEAD_MS 50u
void audio_cursors(int id, uint32_t *play, uint32_t *write){
    uint32_t p = 0, w = 0;
    if (id > 0 && id < MAXSND){
        pthread_mutex_lock(&g_slock);
        if (g_snd[id].used && g_snd[id].bytes){
            uint32_t bpf = g_snd[id].chans * (g_snd[id].bits/8u);
            uint32_t sz  = g_snd[id].bytes;
            p = (uint32_t)(g_snd[id].cursor * (double)bpf) % sz;
            uint32_t lead = (g_snd[id].rate * WRITE_LEAD_MS / 1000u) * bpf;
            if (lead >= sz) lead = sz / 4u;
            w = (p + lead) % sz;
        }
        pthread_mutex_unlock(&g_slock);
    }
    if (play)  *play  = p;
    if (write) *write = w;
}
double audio_time(void){ return (double)g_mixed_frames / (double)OUT_RATE; }
uint32_t audio_cursor(int id){ uint32_t p; audio_cursors(id, &p, 0); return p; }
void audio_set_volume(int id, long millibel){
    if (id <= 0 || id >= MAXSND) return;
    float v = (millibel <= -10000L) ? 0.f : powf(10.f, (float)millibel / 2000.f);
    if (v > 1.f) v = 1.f;
    pthread_mutex_lock(&g_slock);
    if (g_snd[id].used) g_snd[id].vol = v;
    pthread_mutex_unlock(&g_slock);
}
/* win32_ext.c GetMessageA: while the game is parked its clock stands still
 * and nothing refills the stream, so the output is muted; the cursors keep
 * moving (see audio.m). */
static _Atomic int g_out_muted = 0;
void audio_set_muted(int on){
    if (atomic_exchange(&g_out_muted, on ? 1 : 0) != (on ? 1 : 0)){
        atomic_store(&RH(AR_MUTED), on ? 1u : 0u);
        fprintf(stderr, "sound: output %s\n", on ? "muted (game inactive)" : "unmuted");
    }
}

/* ---- the mixer: audio.m's mix_into, float output ------------------------ */
static void mix_into(float *out, unsigned frames){
    static float acc[FRAMES * OUT_CH];
    if (frames > FRAMES) frames = FRAMES;
    memset(acc, 0, sizeof(float) * frames * OUT_CH);
    uint64_t active = 0;
    update_rate_ratio();
    if (g_rate_ratio < g_win_rmin) g_win_rmin = g_rate_ratio;
    if (g_rate_ratio > g_win_rmax) g_win_rmax = g_rate_ratio;

    pthread_mutex_lock(&g_slock);
    for (int i = 1; i < g_sndn; i++){
        SndBuf *b = &g_snd[i];
        if (!b->used || !b->playing || !b->bytes) continue;
        uint32_t bps  = b->bits / 8u;
        uint32_t bpf  = b->chans * bps;
        if (!bpf) continue;
        uint32_t nsrc = b->bytes / bpf;
        if (!nsrc) continue;
        /* audio.m locks the play cursor to the game's write position (a
         * PLL, +-3 %) against a free-running cursor drifting through the
         * unwritten region.  The game's writer follows the play cursor
         * instead: a quick race at a constant 1.03 kept the same fill (0.31
         * to 0.38 of the buffer) as one at 1.00, no overruns either way.  The
         * trim had nothing to correct; its target lagged each change of the
         * game's fill level by ~15 s, so it sat at 1.03 or 0.97 for half a
         * minute at a time: the music's tempo and pitch wandered by a
         * semitone.  Off by default (SNDSERVO=1 turns it on); the fill and
         * the overrun count are still measured for the status line. */
        if (b->wseen){
            uint32_t pbyte = ((uint32_t)(b->cursor * (double)bpf)) % b->bytes;
            uint32_t avail = (b->wpos + b->bytes - pbyte) % b->bytes;
            double frac = (double)avail / (double)b->bytes;
            double want;
            if (frac < g_win_fmin) g_win_fmin = frac;
            if (frac > g_win_fmax) g_win_fmax = frac;
            if (frac > 0.85) g_win_over++;
            if (frac > 0.85){
                b->over++;                         /* the cursor overtook the writer */
                want = 0.94;
            } else {
                if (b->target <= 0.0) b->target = frac;
                else b->target += (frac - b->target) * 0.0008;
                if (b->target < 0.12) b->target = 0.12;
                if (b->target > 0.60) b->target = 0.60;
                want = 1.0 + (frac - b->target) * 1.5;
                if (want < 0.97) want = 0.97;
                if (want > 1.03) want = 1.03;
            }
            b->trim += (want - b->trim) * 0.05;
            if (!g_servo) b->trim = 1.0;
        } else b->trim += (1.0 - b->trim) * 0.08;
        if (b->trim < 0.5 || b->trim > 2.0) b->trim = 1.0;
        if (b->wseen){
            if (b->trim < g_win_tmin) g_win_tmin = b->trim;
            if (b->trim > g_win_tmax) g_win_tmax = b->trim;
        }
        if (g_csv){
            uint32_t pb = ((uint32_t)(b->cursor * (double)bpf)) % b->bytes;
            uint32_t av = b->wseen ? ((b->wpos + b->bytes - pb) % b->bytes) : 0u;
            fprintf(g_csv, "%llu,%.4f,%d,%u,%u,%u,%u,%u,%.4f,%.4f,%.4f,%.4f,",
                    (unsigned long long)g_cb_no,
                    (double)g_mixed_frames/(double)OUT_RATE, i, b->rate, b->bytes,
                    pb, b->wpos, av, (double)av/(double)b->bytes,
                    b->target, b->trim, g_rate_ratio);
        }
        double step = (double)b->rate / (double)OUT_RATE * g_rate_ratio * b->trim * b->freq;
        active++;
        if (b->settled < SETTLE_SLICES) b->settled++;
        else if (b->wseen && !atomic_load(&g_out_muted) && !atomic_load(&g_reported)){
            /* has the game written the part this slice plays?  (it writes at
             * most 50 + 30 + 200 ms ahead: more is the cursor past the writer) */
            uint32_t pbyte = ((uint32_t)(b->cursor * (double)bpf)) % b->bytes;
            uint32_t avail = (b->wpos + b->bytes - pbyte) % b->bytes;
            if ((double)avail > 0.3 * (double)b->rate * (double)bpf || (double)avail < step * (double)frames * (double)bpf){
                g_starved++; g_win_starved++;
                /* the first slice of a skip says how late the game's writer is */
                if (!b->starving && ++g_skips <= 20)
                    fprintf(stderr, "sound: a skip at %.1f s: the game last wrote its sound %.0f ms ago\n",
                            (double)g_mixed_frames / OUT_RATE, (mono_s() - b->wtime) * 1000.0);
                b->starving = 1;
            } else {
                b->starving = 0;
                double ms = (double)avail * 1000.0 / ((double)b->rate * (double)bpf);
                g_lead_sum += ms; g_lead_n++;
                if (ms > g_lead_max) g_lead_max = ms;
                if (ms < g_win_lmin) g_win_lmin = ms;
                if (ms > g_win_lmax) g_win_lmax = ms;
            }
        }
        for (unsigned f = 0; f < frames; f++){
            double sp = b->cursor + step * (double)f;
            if (sp >= (double)nsrc){
                if (b->loop) sp = fmod(sp, (double)nsrc);
                else { b->playing = 0; break; }
            }
            uint32_t si = (uint32_t)sp;
            for (int c = 0; c < OUT_CH; c++){
                uint32_t sc = (b->chans == 2u) ? (uint32_t)c : 0u;
                uint32_t off = b->data + si*bpf + sc*bps;
                float s;
                if (b->bits == 16u){
                    int16_t v; memcpy(&v, g_mem + off, 2);
                    s = (float)v / 32768.f;
                } else {
                    s = ((float)g_mem[off] - 128.f) / 128.f;
                }
                acc[f*OUT_CH + c] += s * b->vol;
            }
        }
        if (g_csv){
            uint32_t p0 = ((uint32_t)(b->cursor * (double)bpf)) % b->bytes;
            uint32_t nby = (uint32_t)(step * (double)frames * (double)bpf);
            if (nby > b->bytes) nby = b->bytes;
            uint32_t z = 0;
            for (uint32_t q = 0; q < nby; q++)
                if (!g_mem[b->data + ((p0 + q) % b->bytes)]) z++;
            fprintf(g_csv, "%.4f\n", nby ? (double)z/(double)nby : 0.0);
        }
        b->cursor += step * (double)frames;
        if (b->cursor >= (double)nsrc){
            if (b->loop) b->cursor = fmod(b->cursor, (double)nsrc);
            else { b->cursor = 0.0; b->playing = 0; }
        }
    }
    pthread_mutex_unlock(&g_slock);
    if (active > g_active_peak) g_active_peak = active;
    g_mixed_frames += frames;
    if (g_sndstat){
        static uint64_t next = 0;
        if (g_mixed_frames >= next){
            next = g_mixed_frames + (uint64_t)OUT_RATE * 2ull;
            pthread_mutex_lock(&g_slock);
            fprintf(stderr, "  [state] ");
            for (int i2 = 1; i2 < g_sndn; i2++){
                if (!g_snd[i2].used) continue;
                uint32_t nz = 0, lim = g_snd[i2].bytes < 8192u ? g_snd[i2].bytes : 8192u;
                for (uint32_t q = 0; q < lim; q++) if (g_mem[g_snd[i2].data + q]) nz++;
                fprintf(stderr, "#%d[%s%s %uHz data=%u%%] ", i2,
                        g_snd[i2].playing ? "play" : "stop",
                        g_snd[i2].loop ? "+loop" : "",
                        g_snd[i2].rate, lim ? (unsigned)(100u*nz/lim) : 0u);
            }
            fprintf(stderr, "\n");
            pthread_mutex_unlock(&g_slock);
        }
    }
    /* silent data while something plays = a region the game has not written */
    if (active){
        unsigned zero = 0;
        for (unsigned k = 0; k < frames * OUT_CH; k++) if (acc[k] == 0.f) zero++;
        g_out_frames += frames * OUT_CH;
        g_out_zero   += zero;
        if (zero > (frames * OUT_CH) * 3u / 4u){
            g_gap_cb++;
            static int shown = 0;
            if (g_sndgap && shown < 40 && g_mixed_frames > (uint64_t)OUT_RATE * 5ull){ shown++;
                fprintf(stderr, "  [gap] t=%.2f s\n", (double)g_mixed_frames / (double)OUT_RATE); }
        }
    }
    horn_mix(acc, frames, OUT_RATE);              /* free-roam horns over the game's sound */
    carsfx_mix(acc, frames, OUT_RATE);            /* ...and friends' nitrous and hydraulics */
    whine_mix(acc, frames, OUT_RATE);             /* ...and the gearbox whine (gearbox_whine) */
    int muted = atomic_load(&g_out_muted);
    for (unsigned k = 0; k < frames * OUT_CH; k++){
        float v = muted ? 0.f : acc[k];
        if (v >  1.f) v =  1.f;
        if (v < -1.f) v = -1.f;
        out[k] = v;
    }
    g_cb_no++;
    if (g_dump){
        int16_t s16[FRAMES * OUT_CH];
        for (unsigned k = 0; k < frames * OUT_CH; k++) s16[k] = (int16_t)(out[k] * 32767.f);
        fwrite(s16, sizeof(int16_t), (size_t)frames * OUT_CH, g_dump);
    }
}

/* ---- output statistics: what goes to the ring --------------------------- */
static struct {
    double sumsq; float peak; uint64_t n;            /* the current one-second window */
    float last_peak, last_rms;                       /* the last complete window */
    uint64_t slices, loud_slices;                    /* slices with any sample above 1 LSB */
    float max_peak;                                  /* over the whole run */
} g_st;
static void stats_add(const float *o, unsigned frames){
    float pk = 0.f; double ss = 0.0;
    for (unsigned k = 0; k < frames * OUT_CH; k++){ float a = fabsf(o[k]); if (a > pk) pk = a; ss += (double)o[k] * o[k]; }
    g_st.slices++;
    if (pk > 1.f / 32768.f) g_st.loud_slices++;
    if (pk > g_st.peak) g_st.peak = pk;
    if (pk > g_st.max_peak) g_st.max_peak = pk;
    g_st.sumsq += ss; g_st.n += frames * OUT_CH;
    if (g_st.n >= (uint64_t)OUT_RATE * OUT_CH){
        g_st.last_peak = g_st.peak;
        g_st.last_rms = (float)sqrt(g_st.sumsq / (double)g_st.n);
        atomic_store(&RH(AR_PEAK), (uint32_t)(g_st.last_peak * 65536.f));
        atomic_store(&RH(AR_RMS), (uint32_t)(g_st.last_rms * 65536.f));
        g_st.peak = 0.f; g_st.sumsq = 0.0; g_st.n = 0;
    }
}
static double dbfs(float v){ return v > 1e-7f ? 20.0 * log10((double)v) : -140.0; }

/* ---- the pump -------------------------------------------------------------- */
static uint64_t g_ring_frames = 0, g_wall_frames = 0;
static double   g_mix_s = 0.0, g_mix_max_s = 0.0;   /* time inside mix_into: total, longest slice */
static void mix_timed(float *out, unsigned frames){
    double t = mono_s();
    mix_into(out, frames);
    t = mono_s() - t;
    g_mix_s += t; if (t > g_mix_max_s) g_mix_max_s = t;
}
static uint64_t g_to_wall = 0, g_to_ring = 0, g_target_raised = 0, g_target_lowered = 0;
static double   g_wall_s = 0.0, g_pump_t0 = 0.0, g_ring_s0 = 0.0;
static unsigned g_target = 1024;
/* the least the target comes back down to: the start (NFSU2_AUDIO_TARGET), or
 * the size above one a lowering left that then underran */
static unsigned g_target_floor = 1024;
static unsigned g_target_start = 1024;
static double   g_status_every = 0.0;
static unsigned target_max(void){ return AUDIO_RING_FRAMES - SLICE; }

/* the worklet's rhythm (RHYTHM_*): the longest gap between two of its reads in
 * each of the last seconds, and g_rhythm_ms, their median with the current
 * second's (0 until a gap was seen) */
static double g_gapwin[RHYTHM_N];
static int    g_ngapwin = 0;
static double g_rhythm_ms = 0.0;
static double median(double *v, int n){
    for (int i = 1; i < n; i++){ double x = v[i]; int j = i; for (; j > 0 && v[j-1] > x; j--) v[j] = v[j-1]; v[j] = x; }
    return v[n / 2];
}
static void rhythm_update(double cur){              /* cur < 0: the current second has none yet */
    double v[RHYTHM_N + 1]; int n = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < g_ngapwin; i++) v[n++] = g_gapwin[i];
    if (cur >= 0.0) v[n++] = cur;
    if (n) g_rhythm_ms = median(v, n);
}
static void rhythm_window(double max){              /* a second ended: its longest gap joins the last ones */
    if (g_ngapwin == RHYTHM_N){ memmove(g_gapwin, g_gapwin + 1, sizeof g_gapwin[0] * (RHYTHM_N - 1)); g_ngapwin--; }
    g_gapwin[g_ngapwin++] = max;
    rhythm_update(-1.0);
}
static double stall_ms(void){ return 2.0 * g_rhythm_ms > STALL_MS ? 2.0 * g_rhythm_ms : STALL_MS; }

/* the worklet's bursts (BURST_*): g_burst_ms, the median time from the start
 * of one to the start of the next; a late burst does not make the next one
 * bigger, so this, not the longest gap, says how much one takes */
static double g_bper[BURST_N];
static int    g_nbper = 0, g_ibper = 0;
static double g_burst_ms = 0.0;
static void burst_add(double ms){
    g_bper[g_ibper] = ms; g_ibper = (g_ibper + 1) % BURST_N;
    if (g_nbper < BURST_N) g_nbper++;
    double v[BURST_N];
    memcpy(v, g_bper, sizeof v[0] * (size_t)g_nbper);
    double m = median(v, g_nbper);                  /* sorts v */
    /* the first two (the start, ~0.3 s): the shorter, as a load's hitch is no burst */
    g_burst_ms = g_nbper < 3 ? v[0] : m;
}
/* the ring target that holds one burst and a slice: only for a worklet whose
 * bursts are more than twice the start target.  A desktop's (two callbacks of
 * 10-12 ms) are about the start target, and the pump tops the ring up between
 * the two; the underruns below cover what that misses, as before. */
static unsigned burst_need(void){
    if (!g_nbper) return 0;
    double f = g_burst_ms * OUT_RATE / 1000.0;
    if (f <= 2.0 * g_target_start) return 0;
    unsigned need = (((unsigned)f + 127u) & ~127u) + SLICE;     /* whole quanta: less churn */
    return need < target_max() ? need : target_max();
}
/* autotest "audiostall MS" (test-only): the pump mixes nothing for MS ms, so
 * the worklet underruns as on a starved device */
static _Atomic int g_test_stall_ms = 0;
void audio_test_stall(int ms){ atomic_store(&g_test_stall_ms, ms > 0 ? ms : 1); }

static void status_line(double now, int mode){
    uint32_t w = atomic_load(&RH(AR_W)), r = atomic_load(&RH(AR_R));
    char cur[160] = ""; int cl = 0;
    pthread_mutex_lock(&g_slock);
    for (int i = 1; i < g_sndn && cl < (int)sizeof cur - 32; i++)
        if (g_snd[i].used && g_snd[i].playing){
            uint32_t bpf = g_snd[i].chans * (g_snd[i].bits / 8u);
            cl += snprintf(cur + cl, sizeof cur - (size_t)cl, " #%d@%u", i,
                           (uint32_t)(g_snd[i].cursor * (double)bpf) % (g_snd[i].bytes ? g_snd[i].bytes : 1u));
        }
    pthread_mutex_unlock(&g_slock);
    static const char *const ctxn[] = { "none", "running", "suspended", "closed" };
    uint32_t ctx = atomic_load(&RH(AR_CTX));
    static double last_t = 0, last_mix = 0;
    double el = now - (last_t ? last_t : g_pump_t0), cpu = el > 0 ? (g_mix_s - last_mix) / el * 100.0 : 0.0;
    last_t = now; last_mix = g_mix_s;
    fprintf(stderr, "[audio] t=%.1fs mode=%s ctx=%s fill=%u target=%u rhythm=%.0fms burst=%.0fms mixed=%.1fs wall=%.1fs mixcpu=%.2f%%"
            " peak=%.1fdBFS rms=%.1fdBFS loud=%.0f%% underruns=%u worklet_loud=%u muted=%d ratio=%.3f..%.3f trim=%.3f..%.3f"
            " frac=%.2f..%.2f over=%llu lead=%.0f..%.0fms starved=%llu play:%s\n",
            now - g_pump_t0, mode == AR_MODE_RING ? "ring" : mode == AR_MODE_WALL ? "wall" : "idle",
            ctx < 4 ? ctxn[ctx] : "?", w - r, g_target, g_rhythm_ms, g_burst_ms, (double)g_mixed_frames / OUT_RATE, g_wall_s, cpu,
            dbfs(g_st.last_peak), dbfs(g_st.last_rms),
            g_st.slices ? 100.0 * (double)g_st.loud_slices / (double)g_st.slices : 0.0,
            atomic_load(&RH(AR_UNDERRUNS)), atomic_load(&RH(AR_LOUD)), atomic_load(&g_out_muted),
            g_win_rmin > g_win_rmax ? 1.0 : g_win_rmin, g_win_rmin > g_win_rmax ? 1.0 : g_win_rmax,
            g_win_tmin > g_win_tmax ? 1.0 : g_win_tmin, g_win_tmin > g_win_tmax ? 1.0 : g_win_tmax,
            g_win_fmin > g_win_fmax ? 0.0 : g_win_fmin, g_win_fmin > g_win_fmax ? 0.0 : g_win_fmax,
            (unsigned long long)g_win_over, g_win_lmin > g_win_lmax ? 0.0 : g_win_lmin, g_win_lmax,
            (unsigned long long)g_win_starved, cl ? cur : " -");
    g_win_rmin = g_win_tmin = g_win_fmin = 9.0; g_win_rmax = g_win_tmax = g_win_fmax = 0.0; g_win_over = 0;
    g_win_lmin = 1e9; g_win_lmax = 0.0; g_win_starved = 0;
}

/* wait until *addr != expect or the timeout: the worklet notifies AR_R */
static void wait_word(_Atomic uint32_t *addr, uint32_t expect, double max_s){
    if (max_s <= 0) return;
    __builtin_wasm_memory_atomic_wait32((int32_t *)addr, (int32_t)expect, (int64_t)(max_s * 1e9));
}

static void *pump_main(void *unused){
    (void)unused;
    static float scratch[SLICE * OUT_CH];
    int mode = AR_MODE_IDLE;
    double now = mono_s();
    g_pump_t0 = now;
    double t_r = now, wall_t0 = now, next_status = now + g_status_every;
    uint64_t wall_done = 0;
    uint32_t r_seen = atomic_load(&RH(AR_R)), under_seen = 0;
    double t_quiet = now, t_lowered = 0;        /* the last underrun or lowering; the last lowering */
    int lowered = 0;                            /* the target is one a lowering left */
    double grace_end = 0, t_loop = now;         /* no stall before grace_end; the last time round the loop */
    double t_win = now, win_max = -1.0;         /* this second of the rhythm, its longest gap (-1: none) */
    double t_burst = -1.0;                      /* the start of the worklet's last burst (-1: not known) */
    double t_due = 0;                           /* ring mode: when the next slice is due at the pace */
    uint32_t fill_seen = 0;                     /* the fill the last time round */
    int need_lines = 0;
    /* NFSU2_FAST (framerate.c, tests): no output; the "wall" pacing below
     * follows the game's clock, so the DirectSound cursors move in game time */
    int hfr_fast(void); uint64_t vclock_peek_us(void);
    const int ff = hfr_fast();
    for (;;){
        now = mono_s();
        double slept = (now - t_loop) * 1000.0; t_loop = now;
        if (g_status_every > 0 && now >= next_status){ status_line(now, mode); next_status = now + g_status_every; }
        int stall = atomic_exchange(&g_test_stall_ms, 0);
        if (stall){
            static _Atomic uint32_t never = 0;
            fprintf(stderr, "sound: audiostall: the pump mixes nothing for %d ms (test-only)\n", stall);
            wait_word(&never, 0, stall / 1000.0);
            continue;
        }
        uint32_t r = atomic_load(&RH(AR_R)), w = atomic_load(&RH(AR_W));
        uint32_t fill = w - r;
        if (fill > AUDIO_RING_FRAMES) fill = AUDIO_RING_FRAMES;      /* never: one producer, one consumer */
        if (r != r_seen){
            /* what the time since its last read says about the worklet, unless
             * that read was before this ring session, the ring had too little
             * for a quantum (the pump's fault), or the pump slept through it */
            int valid = mode == AR_MODE_RING && t_r >= g_ring_s0 && fill_seen >= 128u && slept < RHYTHM_WAKE_MS;
            double gap = (now - t_r) * 1000.0;
            if (valid && gap > win_max){ win_max = gap; rhythm_update(win_max); }
            if (gap >= BURST_SPLIT_MS){                         /* a burst begins */
                if (valid && t_burst >= g_ring_s0) burst_add((now - t_burst) * 1000.0);
                t_burst = valid ? now : -1.0;
            }
            r_seen = r; t_r = now;
        }
        fill_seen = fill;
        if (now - t_win >= RHYTHM_WIN_S){
            if (win_max >= 0.0) rhythm_window(win_max);
            t_win = now; win_max = -1.0;
        }
        int running = atomic_load(&RH(AR_CTX)) == AR_CTX_RUNNING;
        /* the worklet is consuming: it moved r recently (within two of its
         * longest gaps), or the ring has room it has not been asked to drain yet */
        int consumer = !ff && g_audio_on && running &&
                       (now < grace_end || (now - t_r) * 1000.0 < stall_ms() || fill + SLICE <= g_target);
        if (consumer){
            if (mode != AR_MODE_RING){
                if (mode == AR_MODE_WALL) g_to_ring++;
                if (g_target > target_max()) g_target = target_max();
                if (g_target_floor > g_target) g_target_floor = g_target;
                fprintf(stderr, "sound: output paced by the AudioWorklet (ring %u frames, target %u = %.1f ms)\n",
                        AUDIO_RING_FRAMES, g_target, g_target * 1000.0 / OUT_RATE);
                mode = AR_MODE_RING; atomic_store(&RH(AR_MODE), AR_MODE_RING);
                g_ring_s0 = now; under_seen = atomic_load(&RH(AR_UNDERRUNS)); t_quiet = now;
                /* a worklet that was just connected takes a moment to run
                 * its first quantum, and one that reads in bursts its first
                 * gaps to learn: do not call that a stall */
                grace_end = now + START_GRACE_S;
                t_burst = -1.0; t_due = now;
            }
            /* a burst must fit in the ring: no underrun every burst while the
             * slice-at-a-time raise below catches up */
            unsigned need = burst_need();
            if (g_target < need){
                g_target = need;
                atomic_store(&RH(AR_TARGET), g_target);
                if (++need_lines <= 10)
                    fprintf(stderr, "sound: the worklet reads in bursts %.0f ms apart: the ring holds one, target %u frames (%.1f ms)\n",
                            g_burst_ms, g_target, g_target * 1000.0 / OUT_RATE);
            }
            /* underruns once the output has settled: keep more in the ring.
             * SHRINK_QUIET_S without one: a slice less again, down to the
             * floor.  An underrun at a size a lowering left, however much
             * later, makes the size before it the floor: a device that needs
             * the room (a hitch every minute, say) gets one click more than
             * before, not one after every lowering. */
            uint32_t un = atomic_load(&RH(AR_UNDERRUNS));
            /* ...and not below a burst and a quantum: one whose length jitters
             * across a rounding step does not move it every SHRINK_QUIET_S */
            unsigned keep = need ? need + 128u : 0u;
            unsigned lowest = g_target_floor > keep ? g_target_floor : keep;
            if (un != under_seen){
                if (now - g_ring_s0 > 1.0 && g_target + SLICE <= target_max()){
                    if (lowered){
                        g_target_floor = g_target + SLICE;
                        fprintf(stderr, "sound: worklet underrun %.0f s after the ring target was lowered: it stays at %u frames (%.1f ms) or more\n",
                                now - t_lowered, g_target_floor, g_target_floor * 1000.0 / OUT_RATE);
                    }
                    lowered = 0;
                    g_target += SLICE; g_target_raised++;
                    atomic_store(&RH(AR_TARGET), g_target);
                    fprintf(stderr, "sound: worklet underrun (%u so far): ring target raised to %u frames (%.1f ms)\n",
                            un, g_target, g_target * 1000.0 / OUT_RATE);
                }
                under_seen = un; t_quiet = now;
            } else if (g_target > lowest && now - t_quiet >= SHRINK_QUIET_S){
                g_target = g_target - SLICE > lowest ? g_target - SLICE : lowest;
                g_target_lowered++; t_quiet = t_lowered = now; lowered = 1;
                atomic_store(&RH(AR_TARGET), g_target);
                fprintf(stderr, "sound: no worklet underrun for %.0f s: ring target lowered to %u frames (%.1f ms)\n",
                        SHRINK_QUIET_S, g_target, g_target * 1000.0 / OUT_RATE);
            }
            if (fill + SLICE > g_target){              /* full: no time is banked while it waits */
                if (t_due < now) t_due = now;
                wait_word(&RH(AR_R), r, 0.004);
                continue;
            }
            /* room: with big bursts, a slice when it is due at the pace, or at
             * once when the ring runs low (a burst came early, the pump was
             * late); with a desktop's, at once, as ever (the cursor's steps
             * are small next to the game's write-ahead) */
            if (need && fill >= SLICE && now < t_due){
                double s = t_due - now;
                wait_word(&RH(AR_R), r, s < 0.004 ? s : 0.004);
                continue;
            }
            float *dst = &g_ring.pcm[(w & (AUDIO_RING_FRAMES - 1u)) * OUT_CH];
            /* SLICE divides the ring size: a slice never wraps */
            mix_timed(dst, SLICE);
            stats_add(dst, SLICE);
            atomic_store(&RH(AR_W), w + SLICE);
            atomic_store(&RH(AR_MIXED), (uint32_t)g_mixed_frames);
            g_ring_frames += SLICE;
            if (t_due < now - CATCHUP_S) t_due = now - CATCHUP_S;
            t_due += (double)SLICE / (OUT_RATE * PACE);
            continue;
        }
        /* no consumer: keep the cursors moving on the wall clock (the game's
         * clock when fast-forwarding) */
        double clk = ff ? (double)vclock_peek_us() * 1e-6 : now;
        if (mode != AR_MODE_WALL){
            if (mode == AR_MODE_RING) g_to_wall++;
            fprintf(stderr, "sound: %s: the mixer runs on the %s clock (DirectSound cursors keep moving, output dropped)\n",
                    ff ? "fast-forward (NFSU2_FAST)" : !g_audio_on ? "sound is off (NOSOUND)" : !running ? "no running AudioContext" : "the AudioWorklet stopped consuming",
                    ff ? "game's" : "wall");
            mode = AR_MODE_WALL; atomic_store(&RH(AR_MODE), AR_MODE_WALL);
            wall_t0 = clk; wall_done = 0;
        }
        double due = (clk - wall_t0) * OUT_RATE - (double)wall_done;
        if (due > OUT_RATE * 0.1){             /* the pump was starved: do not burst-mix the backlog */
            wall_done = (uint64_t)((clk - wall_t0) * OUT_RATE) - SLICE;
            due = SLICE;
        }
        if (due >= SLICE){
            mix_timed(scratch, SLICE);
            stats_add(scratch, SLICE);
            wall_done += SLICE; g_wall_frames += SLICE;
            g_wall_s = (double)g_wall_frames / OUT_RATE;
            atomic_store(&RH(AR_WALL_MS), (uint32_t)(g_wall_s * 1000.0));
            atomic_store(&RH(AR_MIXED), (uint32_t)g_mixed_frames);
            continue;
        }
        double sleep_s = (SLICE - due) / OUT_RATE;
        if (sleep_s > 0.005) sleep_s = 0.005;     /* notice a consumer coming back */
        if (ff && sleep_s > 0.001) sleep_s = 0.001;   /* game time may run several times the wall clock */
        wait_word(&RH(AR_R), r, sleep_s);
    }
    return 0;
}

void audio_init(void){
    if (atomic_exchange(&g_pump_started, 1)) return;
    g_audio_on = !env_on("NOSOUND");
    g_sndstat = getenv("SNDSTAT") != NULL;
    g_sndgap = getenv("SNDGAP") != NULL;
    g_servo = env_on("SNDSERVO");
    { const char *e = getenv("NFSU2_AUDIO_TARGET"); int t = e && *e ? atoi(e) : 0;
      if (t >= SLICE && t <= (int)(AUDIO_RING_FRAMES - SLICE)) g_target = g_target_floor = g_target_start = (unsigned)t; }   /* any size: a slice is mixed when fill + SLICE <= target */
    { const char *e = getenv("NFSU2_AUDIO_STATUS");
      if (e && *e) g_status_every = atof(e);
      else if (getenv("NFSU2_STATUS_EVERY")) g_status_every = 5.0; }
    { const char *d = getenv("SNDDUMP");
      if (d && *d){ g_dump = fopen(d, "wb");
          fprintf(stderr, "sound: output dump -> %s (%d Hz s16le %d channels)\n", d, OUT_RATE, OUT_CH); } }
    { const char *d = getenv("SNDCSV");
      if (d && *d){ g_csv = fopen(d, "w");
          if (g_csv) fprintf(g_csv, "cb,t,id,rate,bytes,pbyte,wpos,avail,frac,target,trim,ratio,zero\n"); } }
    RH(AR_MAGIC) = AUDIO_MAGIC; RH(AR_VERSION) = AUDIO_VERSION;
    RH(AR_FRAMES) = AUDIO_RING_FRAMES; RH(AR_RATE) = OUT_RATE;
    RH(AR_TARGET) = g_target; RH(AR_NOSOUND) = g_audio_on ? 0u : 1u;
    nfsu2_register(HOST_KIND_AUDIO, &g_ring, (uint32_t)sizeof g_ring);
    pthread_attr_t at; pthread_attr_init(&at);
    pthread_attr_setstacksize(&at, 256u * 1024u);
    pthread_t th;
    if (pthread_create(&th, &at, pump_main, 0) != 0){
        fprintf(stderr, "sound: the audio pump thread could not start: the DirectSound cursors stand still\n");
        return;
    }
    pthread_detach(th);
    fprintf(stderr, "sound: %s (audio pump thread, %d Hz float stereo ring at 0x%08x, %u frames)\n",
            g_audio_on ? "Web Audio output open" : "sound OFF (NOSOUND), the mixer still runs",
            OUT_RATE, (unsigned)(uintptr_t)&g_ring, AUDIO_RING_FRAMES);
}

/* autotest "audioreset" (on the Mac: the CoreAudio device-change path).  The
 * browser follows the default output device by itself; here the page is
 * asked to rebuild its AudioContext, which exercises the stall fallback. */
static uint64_t g_dev_changes = 0;
void audio_device_changed(const char *why){
    g_dev_changes++;
    atomic_fetch_add(&RH(AR_RESET), 1u);
    fprintf(stderr, "sound: output reset requested (%s): the page rebuilds its AudioContext\n", why);
}

void audio_report(void){
    atomic_store(&g_reported, 1);
    if (g_dump){ fflush(g_dump); fclose(g_dump); g_dump = NULL; }
    if (g_csv){  fflush(g_csv);  fclose(g_csv);  g_csv  = NULL; }
    fprintf(stderr, "  sound output      : %s, %llu frames mixed, "
            "at most %llu buffers at once, %d registered\n",
            g_audio_on ? "on" : "OFF",
            (unsigned long long)g_mixed_frames,
            (unsigned long long)g_active_peak, g_sndn - 1);
    fprintf(stderr, "  sound Play calls  : %llu started from the top, %llu were already playing\n",
            (unsigned long long)g_replay, (unsigned long long)g_reissue);
    fprintf(stderr, "  sound rate ratio : %.3f (game virtual time / real time)%s\n",
            g_rate_ratio, g_sync_mode ? "" : "  [off; SNDSYNC=1 turns it on]");
    fprintf(stderr, "  sound data gaps   : %.1f%% of samples silent, %llu callbacks mostly empty\n",
            g_out_frames ? 100.0*(double)g_out_zero/(double)g_out_frames : 0.0,
            (unsigned long long)g_gap_cb);
    fprintf(stderr, "  --- per sound buffer ---\n");
    for (int i = 1; i < g_sndn; i++){
        SndBuf *b = &g_snd[i];
        if (!b->used) continue;
        fprintf(stderr, "   #%-3d %6u Hz %uch %5.2f s   Play=%-4llu Stop=%-4llu  "
                "writes=%llu (%llu non-empty, %.1f KB)  %s\n",
                i, b->rate, b->chans,
                (double)b->bytes/(double)(b->rate*b->chans*(b->bits/8u)),
                (unsigned long long)b->plays, (unsigned long long)b->stops,
                (unsigned long long)b->wr_calls, (unsigned long long)b->wr_nonzero,
                b->wr_bytes/1024.0, b->playing ? "PLAYING" : "stopped");
    }
    { uint64_t ov = 0; for (int i = 1; i < g_sndn; i++) ov += g_snd[i].over;
      fprintf(stderr, "  sound cursor overrun: in %llu callbacks the play cursor passed the writer\n",
              (unsigned long long)ov); }
    fprintf(stderr, "  sound write-ahead : the game wrote %.1f ms ahead of the mixer on average, at most %.1f ms; "
            "%llu slices mixed before the game wrote them, in %llu skips\n",
            g_lead_n ? g_lead_sum / (double)g_lead_n : 0.0, g_lead_max, (unsigned long long)g_starved,
            (unsigned long long)g_skips);
    fprintf(stderr, "  sound output path : AudioWorklet ring, %u-frame slices, target %u frames (%.1f ms), "
            "%u underruns, target grew %llu times and came down %llu times (to %u frames at least); "
            "the worklet's reads up to %.0f ms apart, its bursts %.0f ms apart, a ring of %u frames\n",
            SLICE, g_target, g_target * 1000.0 / OUT_RATE, atomic_load(&RH(AR_UNDERRUNS)),
            (unsigned long long)g_target_raised, (unsigned long long)g_target_lowered, g_target_floor,
            g_rhythm_ms, g_burst_ms, AUDIO_RING_FRAMES);
    fprintf(stderr, "  sound clock backup: %.1f s on the ring, %.1f s on the wall clock (no output), %llu times ring->wall, %llu times wall->ring\n",
            (double)g_ring_frames / OUT_RATE, g_wall_s, (unsigned long long)g_to_wall, (unsigned long long)g_to_ring);
    fprintf(stderr, "  sound mixer       : %.3f s in total (%.2f%% of the mixed time), longest slice %.3f ms\n",
            g_mix_s, g_mixed_frames ? 100.0 * g_mix_s / ((double)g_mixed_frames / OUT_RATE) : 0.0, g_mix_max_s * 1000.0);
    fprintf(stderr, "  sound output level: peak %.1f dBFS, %.1f%% of slices not silent, worklet %u non-silent quanta\n",
            dbfs(g_st.max_peak), g_st.slices ? 100.0 * (double)g_st.loud_slices / (double)g_st.slices : 0.0,
            atomic_load(&RH(AR_LOUD)));
    fprintf(stderr, "  sound output device: %llu reset requests (the browser follows the default device)\n",
            (unsigned long long)g_dev_changes);
}

/* wasm: os_unfair_lock as a tiny spin-then-wait lock on wasm atomics */
#pragma once
#include <stdatomic.h>
#include <sched.h>
typedef struct { _Atomic int v; } os_unfair_lock;
#define OS_UNFAIR_LOCK_INIT { 0 }
static inline void os_unfair_lock_lock(os_unfair_lock *l){
    for (int spins = 0;; spins++){
        int z = 0;
        if (atomic_compare_exchange_weak_explicit(&l->v, &z, 1, memory_order_acquire, memory_order_relaxed)) return;
        if (spins > 64){
            /* contended: park on the word (memory.atomic.wait32), woken by unlock */
            __builtin_wasm_memory_atomic_wait32((int *)&l->v, 1, 1000000 /* 1 ms cap */);
        }
    }
}
static inline int os_unfair_lock_trylock(os_unfair_lock *l){
    int z = 0; return atomic_compare_exchange_strong_explicit(&l->v, &z, 1, memory_order_acquire, memory_order_relaxed);
}
static inline void os_unfair_lock_unlock(os_unfair_lock *l){
    atomic_store_explicit(&l->v, 0, memory_order_release);
    __builtin_wasm_memory_atomic_notify((int *)&l->v, 1);
}
static inline void os_unfair_lock_assert_owner(const os_unfair_lock *l){ (void)l; }

 * trampoline that sets a jump point; pthread_exit longjmps back to it (wasm
 * exception handling unwinds the lifted frames).  runtime/web/thread_exit.c */
int nfsu2_pthread_create(pthread_t *th, const pthread_attr_t *attr, void *(*fn)(void *), void *arg);

{"id": "AT000633", "source": "archive:A028!/nfsu2-web-public/runtime/web/gcpu.c", "originalBytes": 5728, "originalSha256": "ab1ffeff74499a5b91ab1e53141bb9c96f4d7f47f0a3c80f261af0071158ce98", "originalEncoding": "utf-8", "utf8RangeStart": 0, "utf8RangeEnd": 5728, "utf8TotalBytes": 5728}

/* wasm: guest CPU time per frame, the key number for 120 fps.
 *
 * The Mac reads the guest main thread's CPU clock at every Present
 * ([status] gcpu, PERFLOG guest.csv).  The browser has no thread CPU clock,
 * so the busy time comes from the guest lock (win32_ext.c
 * win32_thread_busy_ms: time holding the lock minus host waits; pacer
 * sleeps, Sleep/Wait* and the present wait all release the lock).
 *
 * Per Present (autotest_on_present, the guest main thread) the frame's busy
 * time goes into a histogram per game flow ([0x8654a4]: 3 = front end,
 * 6 = racing, ...) and into a window for the next [status] line, which then
 * shows its distribution: gp=p50/p95/p99/max ms.  The exit report prints the
 * distribution per flow.
 *
 * NFSU2_GCPU_FRAMES=1 (the perf track's benchmark, web/tools/bench.mjs) also
 * keeps every racing frame's busy time and Present time and prints them at
 * exit as "[gcpuf]" lines ("busy_us@present_ms_since_first;...", after a
 * "[gcpuf0] <first Present, epoch ms>" line), so the
 * benchmark can split the race into tier-up and warm parts and count late
 * frames itself. */
#include "cpu.h"
#include "game.h"
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>
#include <math.h>
#include <time.h>

double win32_thread_busy_ms(void);

/* Buckets: 0.025 ms wide up to 50 ms, then 5 % wide (geometric) up to
 * 50 * 1.05^NL = 123 s; a percentile is its bucket's midpoint (at most
 * 0.0125 ms or 2.5 % off), never more than the maximum.  A frame above
 * the last bucket (it would be a hang) reads as the maximum. */
#define BW   0.025                      /* linear bucket width, ms */
#define NB   2000                       /* linear: [0, 50) ms */
#define LO   (NB * BW)                  /* 50 ms */
#define GR   1.05                       /* geometric step above that */
#define NL   160                        /* geometric: [50 ms, 123 s) */
typedef struct { uint64_t n; double sum, max; uint32_t h[NB + NL + 1]; } Dist;
static Dist  g_flow[8];
static float g_win[16384]; static int g_nwin;
static double g_last = -1;
static int g_fr_on = -1;                /* NFSU2_GCPU_FRAMES */
static struct { float busy; double t; } *g_fr; static int g_nfr, g_cfr;
static double now_ms(void){ struct timespec t; clock_gettime(CLOCK_MONOTONIC, &t); return t.tv_sec * 1e3 + t.tv_nsec * 1e-6; }

static void dist_add(Dist *d, double ms){
    d->n++; d->sum += ms; if (ms > d->max) d->max = ms;
    int k;
    if (!(ms >= 0)) k = 0;
    else if (ms < LO) k = (int)(ms / BW);
    else { k = NB + (int)(log(ms / LO) / log(GR)); if (k > NB + NL) k = NB + NL; }
    d->h[k]++;
}
static double bucket_mid(int k){
    if (k < NB) return (k + 0.5) * BW;
    return LO * pow(GR, (double)(k - NB) + 0.5);
}
static double dist_pct(const Dist *d, double p){
    uint64_t want = (uint64_t)(p * (double)d->n + 0.5), acc = 0;
    if (!want) want = 1;
    for (int k = 0; k <= NB + NL; k++){
        acc += d->h[k];
        if (acc >= want){ double v = k < NB + NL ? bucket_mid(k) : d->max; return v < d->max ? v : d->max; }
    }
    return d->max;
}

static double g_frame_ms = -1;
/* the last frame's busy time (ms), -1 before the second Present: roam_game.c's Players' cars shown, Auto */
double gcpu_frame_ms(void){ return g_frame_ms; }

void gcpu_frame(void){
    double b = win32_thread_busy_ms();
    if (g_last >= 0){
        double ms = b - g_last;
        g_frame_ms = ms;
        uint32_t flow = mem_is_committed(G_FLOW) ? MR32(G_FLOW) : 0u;
        dist_add(&g_flow[flow & 7], ms);
        if (g_nwin < (int)(sizeof g_win / sizeof g_win[0])) g_win[g_nwin++] = (float)ms;
        if (g_fr_on < 0){ const char *e = getenv("NFSU2_GCPU_FRAMES"); g_fr_on = e && *e == '1'; }
        if (g_fr_on && (flow & 7) == 6){
            if (g_nfr == g_cfr){ int nc = g_cfr ? 2 * g_cfr : 16384; void *p = realloc(g_fr, (size_t)nc * sizeof *g_fr);
                if (p){ g_fr = p; g_cfr = nc; } }
            if (g_nfr < g_cfr){ g_fr[g_nfr].busy = (float)ms; g_fr[g_nfr].t = now_ms(); g_nfr++; }
        }
    }
    g_last = b;
}

static int fcmp(const void *a, const void *b){ float x = *(const float *)a, y = *(const float *)b; return (x > y) - (x < y); }
/* " gp=p50/p95/p99/max" over the frames since the last call */
int gcpu_status(char *buf, size_t n){
    if (!g_nwin) return snprintf(buf, n, " gp=-");
    qsort(g_win, (size_t)g_nwin, sizeof g_win[0], fcmp);
    #define Q(p) g_win[(int)((p) * (g_nwin - 1) + 0.5)]
    int k = snprintf(buf, n, " gp=%.2f/%.2f/%.2f/%.2fms", Q(0.5), Q(0.95), Q(0.99), g_win[g_nwin - 1]);
    #undef Q
    g_nwin = 0;
    return k;
}

void gcpu_report(void){
    fprintf(stderr, "\n  guest main thread busy time per frame (ms; the guest lock held minus host waits):\n");
    static const char *const nm[8] = { "flow 0", "flow 1", "flow 2", "flow 3 (front end)", "flow 4", "flow 5", "flow 6 (racing)", "flow 7" };
    for (int f = 0; f < 8; f++){
        const Dist *d = &g_flow[f];
        if (!d->n) continue;
        fprintf(stderr, "    %-18s %7llu frames: mean %.2f  p50 %.2f  p95 %.2f  p99 %.2f  max %.2f\n", nm[f],
                (unsigned long long)d->n, d->sum / (double)d->n, dist_pct(d, 0.5), dist_pct(d, 0.95), dist_pct(d, 0.99), d->max);
    }
    if (g_nfr){
        char line[4096]; int k = 0;
        fprintf(stderr, "[gcpuf0] %.3f\n", g_fr[0].t);      /* the first racing frame's Present, epoch ms */
        for (int i = 0; i < g_nfr; i++){
            k += snprintf(line + k, sizeof line - (size_t)k, "%s%d@%.2f", k ? ";" : "", (int)(g_fr[i].busy * 1000.0f + 0.5f),
                          g_fr[i].t - g_fr[0].t);
            if (k > (int)sizeof line - 64 || i == g_nfr - 1){ fprintf(stderr, "[gcpuf] %s\n", line); k = 0; }
        }
    }
}

/* The renderer contract between the C recorder (runtime/web/gpu_web.c, on the
 * game thread) and the WebGPU encoder (web/src/gpu, on the page).  Everything
 * here lives in the wasm memory; the page reads it zero-copy.  The page-side
 * mirror is web/src/gpu/proto.ts (same offsets; web/tools/check-gpu-proto.mjs
 * compares the two, and the page refuses a block whose layout word differs).
 *
 * Only fixed-width fields: wasm32 and the TypeScript views must agree byte for
 * byte, and `long` is 32 bits on wasm32.
 *
 *   GwCtl     one per process, registered as HOST_KIND_GPU
 *   GwFrame   per record buffer (2): what the frame's records are and where
 *   GwDraw    one per draw / clear / StretchRect, in submission order
 *   GwCmd     resource queue record (texture create/upload/free, mirror pool,
 *             shaders), ordered against frames by GwFrame.rq_end
 *   GwVsync   the page's display clock, registered as HOST_KIND_VSYNC
 */
#ifndef NFSU2_GPU_PROTO_H
#define NFSU2_GPU_PROTO_H
#include <stdint.h>
#include <stddef.h>

#define GW_MAGIC   0x55504757u          /* "WGPU" */
#define GW_VERSION 7u                   /* 7: immutable per-draw headlights */
#define GW_NBUF    2                    /* record buffers: one being written, one handed off */

/* GwDraw.kind */
enum { GW_DRAW = 0, GW_CLEAR = 1, GW_BLIT = 2 };

/* One record.  Fields as in metal.m's MDraw, minus the HD-only ones (c0, gh). */
typedef struct {
    uint32_t first;       /* TVert path: first vertex in the TVert arena; GW_BLIT: source rectangle left | top << 16 */
    uint32_t count;       /* vertices (TVert/raw) or indices (indexed); a multiple of 3;
                           * GW_BLIT: source rectangle right | bottom << 16 (pixels), 0 = the whole source */
    uint32_t tex;         /* stage-0 texture id (0 = white) */
    uint32_t target;      /* render target: texid | (cube face + 1) << 16; 0 = back buffer */
    uint32_t kind;        /* GW_DRAW, GW_CLEAR, GW_BLIT */
    uint32_t blend;       /* bit0 enable, 1-5 SRCBLEND, 6-10 DESTBLEND, 11-13 BLENDOP, 14-17 write mask */
    float    aref;        /* alpha test reference (0 = no test) */
    uint32_t depth;       /* bit0 Z test, bit1 Z write, bits 2-4 D3DCMPFUNC, bits 8+ Z surface id */
    uint32_t tex1, tex2, tex3;
    int32_t  ps;          /* pixel shader id (0 = fixed function), +256 = stage-0 cube variant */
    uint32_t psci;        /* index of the PS constant block in the frame's pool */
    int32_t  vsid;        /* GPU vertex shader id (0 = TVert path) */
    uint32_t rawoff;      /* raw arena byte offset (raw draw) or pool offset of vertex 0 (indexed) */
    uint32_t koff;        /* VS constant block offset in the K arena (16-byte aligned) */
    float    proj[4];     /* per stage: TEXCOORDINDEX + 16 * projection mode */
    uint32_t smp[4];      /* packed sampler keys (com.c smp_push) */
    uint32_t blit_src;    /* GW_BLIT: source texture id; GW_DRAW: headlight block byte offset */
    uint32_t bcol;        /* D3DRS_BLENDFACTOR (ARGB) */
    uint32_t cull;        /* D3DCULL: 1 none, 2 CW, 3 CCW */
    float    fogv[4];     /* fog colour rgb + enable */
    uint32_t clr_argb;    /* GW_CLEAR: colour; GW_DRAW: normalized effect clip left|top<<16 */
    uint32_t clr_flags;   /* GW_CLEAR: D3DCLEAR_*; GW_DRAW: normalized right|bottom<<16 (0 = no clip) */
    float    clr_z;       /* GW_CLEAR: Z value */
    uint32_t ksz;         /* VS constant block size in bytes (16 + 16 * nk) */
    uint32_t ix_isz;      /* indexed draw: index size 2 or 4; 0 = not indexed */
    uint32_t ix_ib;       /* indexed draw: pool offset of the first index */
    int32_t  ix_base;     /* indexed draw: BaseVertexIndex */
    uint32_t clip;        /* the 2D UI on a screen narrower than 4:3: rows y0 | y1 << 16 of the back buffer
                           * (its 4:3 band), the draw kept between them; 0 = the whole target (com.c) */
    float viewport[6];   /* x,y,width,height,minZ,maxZ; width=0: full target */
} GwDraw;

typedef struct {
    uint32_t seq;         /* guest frame number at handoff */
    uint32_t dn;          /* records */
    uint32_t vn;          /* TVerts (112 bytes each, gfx.h) */
    uint32_t rvn;         /* raw vertex arena bytes */
    uint32_t kn;          /* VS constant arena bytes */
    uint32_t pscn;        /* PS constant blocks (32 x vec4 = 512 bytes each) */
    uint32_t draws, tv, raw, k, psc;   /* wasm addresses of this buffer's arenas */
    uint32_t rq_end;      /* resource queue position at handoff: apply the queue up to here first */
    uint32_t bb_w, bb_h;  /* back buffer (device) size */
    uint32_t clear_argb;  /* clear colour in effect when the frame began */
    uint32_t pool_size;   /* mirror pool size at handoff */
    uint32_t dump;        /* nonzero: read this frame back (autotest "dump") */
    int32_t  dump_frame;  /* guest frame number for the file name */
    char     dump_label[64];
    /* rb_id nonzero: after this frame, texture rb_tex's level 0 goes to the
     * game, rb_rows rows of rb_pitch bytes at wasm address rb_dst (BGRA, as
     * D3DFMT_A8R8G8B8 is in memory).  The game waits in LockRect for it
     * (GwCtl.rb_want / rb_done); gpu_web.c metal_read_texture. */
    uint32_t rb_id, rb_tex, rb_dst, rb_pitch, rb_rows;
} GwFrame;

/* GwCtl.state: the handoff word.  bits 0-1 ready buffer + 1 (0 = none),
 * bits 2-3 buffer the page is encoding + 1 (0 = none).  The game publishes
 * ready (or, in mailbox mode, replaces a ready frame the page has not taken);
 * the page takes it by CAS {r,0} -> {r,r}, encodes, then stores 0. */
/* GwCtl.attached: 0 until a renderer attaches (the first present waits for
 * it), GW_ATTACHED while one drains the block, GW_DETACHED once it detached
 * or once the game stopped waiting for one (NFSU2_RENDERER_WAIT_MS, 30 s; the
 * game's CAS 0 -> GW_DETACHED).  A detached block never takes a renderer again
 * (a new one would lack every texture and shader queued before it): the game
 * drops back to the null renderer at once, and the page attaches only with a
 * CAS from 0, so a renderer that comes too late is refused, not shown black. */
#define GW_ATTACHED 1
#define GW_DETACHED 2
#define GW_ST_READY(s) ((s) & 3)
#define GW_ST_ENC(s)   (((s) >> 2) & 3)

typedef struct {
    uint32_t magic, version, layout, size;
    int32_t  state;       /* handoff word (above) */
    int32_t  bell;        /* doorbell: bumped and notified on every publish and queue flush */
    int32_t  attached;    /* page: GW_ATTACHED while a renderer drains this block, GW_DETACHED after it let go */
    int32_t  rq_head;     /* resource queue: bytes written (game), wraps mod 2^32 */
    int32_t  rq_tail;     /* resource queue: bytes consumed (page); notified */
    uint32_t rq_ptr;      /* ring address */
    uint32_t rq_cap;      /* ring size, a power of two */
    uint32_t frames_done; /* page: frames encoded and submitted */
    uint32_t view_w, view_h;   /* page: canvas size in device pixels */
    uint32_t dpr1000;     /* page: devicePixelRatio x 1000 */
    uint32_t features;    /* page: GW_FEAT_* */
    uint32_t st_draws;    /* page: draws encoded (total) */
    uint32_t st_passes;   /* page: render passes (total) */
    uint32_t st_enc_us;   /* page: encode time (total, microseconds) */
    uint32_t st_errors;   /* page: WebGPU validation errors seen */
    uint32_t dumps_done;  /* page: frame dumps written */
    uint32_t st_pipelines;/* page: pipelines created */
    /* a texture read back (GwFrame.rb_*): rb_want is the request the game
     * waits for; the page claims it with a CAS to rb_id | GW_RB_FLAG before it
     * writes rb_dst (the game cancels with a CAS to 0 when it stops waiting:
     * the lock buffer is not the page's to write then), then stores rb_done =
     * rb_id once the bytes are there, rb_id | GW_RB_FLAG when it could not
     * read the texture, and notifies */
    int32_t  rb_want, rb_done;
    GwFrame  frame[GW_NBUF];
} GwCtl;

#define GW_RB_FLAG 0x80000000u

#define GW_FEAT_BC       1u   /* texture-compression-bc */
#define GW_FEAT_SWIZZLE  2u   /* texture-component-swizzle */
#define GW_FEAT_HQSKIN   4u   /* the page paints car skins again at 1024 (GW_SKIN_HQ): HQ vinyls, a PC with BC */

/* The page's display clock, filled from requestAnimationFrame. */
typedef struct {
    int32_t  tick;        /* bumped (and notified) at every rAF */
    int32_t  seq;         /* seqlock: odd while the page writes ts/period */
    double   ts_ms;       /* the latest rAF time, ms on the shared clock (performance.timeOrigin + rAF timestamp) */
    double   period_ms;   /* median rAF interval */
    int32_t  hz;          /* refresh rate from the median interval (0 = not measured yet) */
    int32_t  visible;     /* document visible */
} GwVsync;

/* Resource queue records: a 32-byte header, then the payload.  Records are
 * 16-byte aligned and never wrap (a GW_PAD record fills the end of the ring). */
enum {
    GW_PAD         = 0,
    GW_TEX_CREATE  = 1,   /* a: id, w, h, levels, d3dfmt, flags (GW_TF_*) */
    GW_TEX_UPLOAD  = 2,   /* a: id, level | face << 16, level w, level h, pitch, rows; payload pitch*rows */
    GW_TEX_FREE    = 3,   /* a: id */
    GW_POOL_GROW   = 4,   /* a: new size */
    GW_POOL_WRITE  = 5,   /* a: offset, bytes; payload */
    GW_SHADER_VS   = 6,   /* a: id, text bytes; payload WGSL (NUL-terminated) */
    GW_SHADER_PS   = 7,   /* a: id, text bytes; payload WGSL (NUL-terminated) */
    GW_Z_FORGET    = 8,   /* a: zid */
    GW_BB_SAMPLES  = 9,   /* a: the back buffer's samples from the next frame on, 1 or 4 (com.c MULTISAMPLING; a page
                           * without it skips the record and draws with 1) */
    GW_SKIN_HQ     = 10,  /* a: id, recipe bytes; payload GwSkinHq, then its layers' alpha planes (runtime/hqvinyls.c) */
};
#define GW_TF_RT   1u
#define GW_TF_CUBE 2u
#define GW_TF_MS   8u     /* with GW_TF_RT: a render target drawn at 4 samples, resolved into the texture at the end of
                           * every pass (CreateRenderTarget with multisampling, com.c MULTISAMPLING; a page without it
                           * draws the target with 1) */
typedef struct { uint32_t op, len; uint32_t a[6]; } GwCmd;
#define GW_CMD_HDR 32u

/* A car skin the game just painted at 512 (DUMMY_SKIN<n>, texture id a[0]), to be painted again at 1024 from the HQ
 * vinyls' pictures (HQVINYLS/CARS/<car>.hqv, tools/hqvinyls.py) and shown in its place (web/src/gpu/hqskin.ts):
 * the game's compositor's recipe (0x611F10's argument), its colours as it holds them: R, G, B, A bytes (A = gloss).
 * A layer drawn as it is (no REMAP: a doorline, some vinyls) gives the skin its alpha, which the HQ pictures do not
 * have: alpha = GW_SKIN_HQ_PLANE then means a 512x512 plane of the game's own (one byte a pixel) follows the
 * recipe, the layers' planes in their order; else alpha is the layer's one alpha (or unused, with REMAP). */
#define GW_SKIN_HQ_MAGIC  0x4B535148u     /* "HQSK" */
#define GW_SKIN_HQ_LAYERS 8
#define GW_SKIN_HQ_PLANE  0x100u
#define GW_SKIN_HQ_SIDE   512u            /* the game's skins and layers */
typedef struct {
    uint32_t hash;        /* the layer picture's name hash (<car>_<TEXTURE>, <car>_DOORLINE...) */
    uint32_t mask;        /* its mask's (... + "_MASK") */
    uint32_t remap;       /* nonzero: coloured by col[0..2] by the picture's R, G, B */
    uint32_t alpha;       /* without REMAP: the layer's alpha 0..255, or GW_SKIN_HQ_PLANE */
    uint32_t col[4];      /* R, G, B, A bytes */
} GwSkinHqLayer;
typedef struct {
    uint32_t magic;       /* GW_SKIN_HQ_MAGIC */
    uint32_t serial;      /* the runtime's count of skins sent (a newer one for the same id wins) */
    char     car[16];     /* the car's folder (CARS/<car>), NUL-padded */
    uint32_t base;        /* the base paint, R, G, B, A bytes */
    uint32_t n;           /* layers */
    GwSkinHqLayer layer[GW_SKIN_HQ_LAYERS];
} GwSkinHq;

/* The other cars' headlights (runtime/headlights.c): every frame's VS
 * constant arena holds this block at GW_K_HL, bound as group 0 binding 3 (H)
 * for the lit pixel shaders, which add car k's light at q * t (q: their
 * coordinate in the player's light, uv1; t: columns) with the falloff
 * coordinate s * q'.w + o.  n = 0: none this frame. */
#define GW_HL_MAX   8
typedef struct { float t[16]; float col[4]; } GwHLight;
typedef struct { uint32_t n; float s, o, pad; GwHLight l[GW_HL_MAX]; } GwHL;
#define GW_K_HL     256u
#define GW_HL_BYTES 656u

/* Quick chat's places over the cars (roam_game.c say_marks): every frame's VS
 * constant arena holds this block at GW_K_MARKS, which the page reads with
 * the frame it encodes, so a line said moves with its car in that very
 * picture.  magic: GW_MARKS_MAGIC (where a module without the block has the
 * draws' constants); n marks: the player's id, where the name over their car
 * is (x, y: parts of the back buffer from its top left corner, 0 .. 1) and
 * its scale (the game's, 0.5 .. 1 with the distance).  n = 0: none this
 * frame.  The page binds none of it. */
#define GW_MARKS_MAX   32

#define GW_K_MARKS     1024u
#define GW_MARKS_BYTES 528u

/* Exposure and White Level (tonemenu.c): every frame's VS constant arena
 * holds this block at GW_K_TONE, which the page reads with the frame it
 * encodes.  Its last pass takes each colour channel c (0 .. 1, as drawn) to
 * y = min(1, c * mult), and a y above knee * white bends down so that 1
 * lands on white (web/src/gpu/wgsl.ts TONE).  mult 1 and white 1: the
 * picture as drawn, without that pass.  magic: GW_TONE_MAGIC (where a module
 * without the block has zeros).  The page binds none of it. */
#define GW_TONE_MAGIC  0x454E4F54u        /* "TONE" */
typedef struct { uint32_t magic; float mult, white, knee; } GwTone;
#define GW_K_TONE      1552u
#define GW_TONE_BYTES  16u

/* Input age (framerate.c): every frame's VS constant arena holds this block
 * at GW_K_LAT: when the game read the input this frame simulates with, and
 * when it handed the frame off, in ms of the shared clock
 * (performance.timeOrigin + performance.now()).  The page logs how old that
 * input is when the frame is submitted, done on the GPU and next shown.
 * magic: GW_LAT_MAGIC (where a module without the block has zeros).  The page
 * binds none of it. */
#define GW_LAT_MAGIC   0x4E54414Cu        /* "LATN" */
typedef struct { uint32_t magic, pad; double input_ms, handoff_ms; } GwLat;
#define GW_K_LAT       1568u
#define GW_LAT_BYTES   24u

/* Photo mode's picture (photo.c): every frame's VS constant arena holds this
 * block at GW_K_PHOTO, which the page reads with the frame it encodes.  state
 * GW_PHOTO_LIVE: the frame as it is (the camera moves); GW_PHOTO_ADD: frame n
 * of the target frames of still picture gen, each drawn from a slightly
 * different spot (smooth edges, the lens's blur), which the page averages
 * (the first replaces what it had); GW_PHOTO_DONE: the picture has its
 * frames, this one adds nothing; GW_PHOTO_NOW: the frame as it is is the
 * picture (time runs on: nothing to add up).  magic: GW_PHOTO_MAGIC; none, or
 * GW_PHOTO_OFF: photo mode is off.  The page binds none of it.
 * ack is the page's, in both buffers' blocks (the game hands over only the
 * words before it): gen << 16 | the frames of that picture it has.  The game
 * draws frame n + 1 next, so a frame the page never encodes (a newer one
 * took its place, the GPU behind) is drawn again, and none counts twice.
 * want is the page's too: a picture asked for (Take photo), as a number
 * 1 .. 0xFFFF in its low half and the most tiles a side the page can put
 * together (1 .. 4) at 16.  tile is the game's answer, for that frame: the
 * tile drawn (its index, left to right then top to bottom) in its low byte,
 * the tiles a side at 8, what the game is taking at 12 (GW_CAP_*: nothing
 * but the still picture, a bigger picture in tiles, a shutter's time) and
 * the last picture asked for that it saw at 16.  fov: the field of view the
 * frame is drawn with (degrees across), and lens what the page makes of it
 * (GW_LENS_*: as drawn, a fisheye). */
#define GW_PHOTO_MAGIC 0x544F4850u        /* "PHOT" */
enum { GW_PHOTO_OFF = 0, GW_PHOTO_LIVE = 1, GW_PHOTO_ADD = 2, GW_PHOTO_DONE = 3, GW_PHOTO_NOW = 4 };
enum { GW_CAP_NONE = 0, GW_CAP_TILES = 1, GW_CAP_SHUTTER = 2 };
enum { GW_LENS_PLAIN = 0, GW_LENS_FISHEYE = 1 };
typedef struct { uint32_t magic, state, n, target, gen, ack, tile, want; float fov; uint32_t lens, pad[2]; } GwPhoto;
#define GW_K_PHOTO     1600u
#define GW_PHOTO_BYTES 48u

/* The page binds the VS constant arena (K) in windows of GW_KWIN_ROWS rows of
 * 16 bytes: 64 KB, the default maxUniformBufferBindingSize.  A draw's block
 * (16-byte header + c[0..255]) starts at row firstInstance of its window, so
 * consecutive draws share one bind group. */
#define GW_KWIN_ROWS 4096u

/* Layout word: changes whenever a struct above changes shape. */
#define GW_LAYOUT ((uint32_t)(sizeof(GwDraw) | sizeof(GwFrame) << 8 | (sizeof(GwCtl) & 0xFFF) << 16) ^ (GW_VERSION << 28))

_Static_assert(sizeof(GwDraw) == 180, "GwDraw");
_Static_assert(offsetof(GwDraw, kind) == 16 && offsetof(GwDraw, aref) == 24 && offsetof(GwDraw, depth) == 28, "GwDraw a");

/* wasm: the renderer's game side.  Implements the metal_* API that com.c
 * records through (on the Mac: runtime/metal.m), as strong symbols over the
 * weak stand-ins in null_platform.c.
 *
 * The game thread cannot touch WebGPU (its objects belong to the page), so
 * everything goes into shared memory and the page's encoder
 * (web/src/gpu) turns it into WebGPU work:
 *   - frame records: GwDraw per draw/clear/StretchRect plus the TVert, raw
 *     vertex, VS constant and PS constant arenas, double-buffered as on the
 *     Mac (one buffer being written, one handed off);
 *   - an ordered resource queue: texture create/upload/free, the persistent
 *     vertex/index mirror pool, shader text.  Frames carry the queue position
 *     at handoff, so a frame never sees uploads recorded after it (the Mac's
 *     replaceRegion was immediate);
 *   - the present handshake (GwCtl.state, Atomics notify) and the display
 *     clock the page fills from requestAnimationFrame (GwVsync), which feeds
 *     framerate.c's vsync lock and NFSU2_FPS=auto.
 * Contract: gpu_proto.h / web/src/gpu/proto.ts.
 *
 * NFSU2_RENDERER=webgpu (set by a page that attaches a renderer) turns the
 * recording on.  Without it this file behaves like the null renderer: ids
 * and sizes for com.c, every draw dropped. */
#include "cpu.h"
#include "gfx.h"
#include "host_abi.h"
#include "gpu_proto.h"
#include "wgsl.h"
#include "texrep.h"
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>
#include <math.h>
#include <time.h>
#include <stdatomic.h>
#include "setting.h"      /* ENVC */

void guest_wait_begin(void);     /* win32_ext.c: release the guest lock around a host wait */
void guest_wait_end(void);
int  hfr_mailbox(void);          /* framerate.c */
int  hfr_display_live(void);
double hfr_frame_input_ms(void);
void hfr_note_vsync(double ts, double dur);

/* ---- shared-memory waits (wasm atomics on the shared linear memory) ---- */
static inline int32_t ald(int32_t *p){ return __atomic_load_n(p, __ATOMIC_SEQ_CST); }
static inline void ast(int32_t *p, int32_t v){ __atomic_store_n(p, v, __ATOMIC_SEQ_CST); }
static inline void wake(int32_t *p){ __builtin_wasm_memory_atomic_notify((int *)p, 0xFFFFFFFFu); }
/* wait while *p == v, at most ms milliseconds; 0 woken, 1 not equal, 2 timed out */
static inline int wait32(int32_t *p, int32_t v, double ms){
    return __builtin_wasm_memory_atomic_wait32((int *)p, v, ms < 0 ? -1 : (int64_t)(ms * 1e6));
}
static double now_ms(void){ struct timespec t; clock_gettime(CLOCK_MONOTONIC, &t); return t.tv_sec * 1e3 + t.tv_nsec * 1e-6; }

/* ---- state ------------------------------------------------------------- */
static GwCtl   *g_ctl;
static GwVsync *g_vs;
static int      g_on;            /* recording for a page renderer */
static int      g_inited;
static int      g_detached;      /* the page never attached: dropped back to null behaviour */

#define PSC_N  32
#define MAXV   (256u * 1024u)               /* TVerts per buffer (CPU vertex path) */
#define MAXD   (16u * 1024u)                /* records per buffer */
#define MAXRV  (16u * 1024u * 1024u)        /* raw vertex arena (bytes) */
#define MAXKB  ( 4u * 1024u * 1024u)        /* VS constant arena (bytes) */
#define RQ_CAP (64u * 1024u * 1024u)        /* resource queue ring (bytes, power of two) */
#define KZERO  256u                         /* K arena bytes [0, 256): an all-zero block for TVert draws (base 0) */
#define KFIRST 2048u                        /* [GW_K_HL, + GW_HL_BYTES): the frame's headlights; [GW_K_MARKS, + GW_MARKS_BYTES):
                                               quick chat's places; [GW_K_TONE, + GW_TONE_BYTES): Exposure and
                                               White Level; [GW_K_LAT, + GW_LAT_BYTES): input age;
                                               [GW_K_PHOTO, + GW_PHOTO_BYTES): photo mode's picture; the draws'
                                               blocks from here */
_Static_assert(GW_K_HL >= KZERO && GW_K_HL + GW_HL_BYTES <= KFIRST && GW_K_MARKS + GW_MARKS_BYTES <= KFIRST
               && GW_K_TONE + GW_TONE_BYTES <= KFIRST && GW_K_LAT + GW_LAT_BYTES <= KFIRST
               && GW_K_PHOTO + GW_PHOTO_BYTES <= KFIRST, "K arena");

typedef struct {
    GwDraw  *d;  unsigned dn;
    TVert   *v;  unsigned vn;
    uint8_t *rv; unsigned rvn;
    uint8_t *kb; unsigned kn;
    float  (*psc)[PSC_N][4]; unsigned pscn, psc_last, psc_lastver;

static Buf g_b[GW_NBUF];
static int g_cur = 0;
