/* roam_web.c -- free-roam multiplayer: the browser's platform layer (wasm),
 * in place of roam_bsd.c.  See roam_plat.h.
 *
 * A page cannot open sockets.  The page's main thread holds one WebSocket to
 * the local server's virtual-LAN switch (web/server-rs/crates/lan, /lan), which gives
 * every browser a virtual IPv4 address (10.77.x.x) and routes frames by virtual
 * destination address.  This file is one virtual UDP endpoint on that LAN:
 *
 *   game thread / network thread --TX ring--> page (web/src/net) --WebSocket--> switch
 *   network thread <--RX ring-- page <--WebSocket-- switch
 *
 * The rings live in the net mailbox (net_proto.h) in shared wasm memory,
 * registered with nfsu2_register(HOST_KIND_NET).  The page writes our virtual
 * address into it once the switch has assigned one.  The network thread
 * (a pthread, i.e. a worker of the page's pool) blocks on the RX ring's bell
 * with memory.atomic.wait32 and a timeout, feeds every datagram to the session
 * and runs rc_tick every 10 ms, all under roam_plat_lock(), as roam_bsd.c's
 * thread does with poll() and recvfrom().  Sending (from either thread, with
 * the lock held) queues a datagram on the TX ring and rings the page.
 *
 * Addresses (what the core sees):
 *   player   our own virtual address and port; peers are virtual addresses
 *            (roam_peers takes 10.77.x.x literals, the page shows them).  Who
 *            our peers are comes from the server's free-roam hub
 *            (NET_ROAM_HUB, web/server-rs/crates/roam: the players nearest to
 *            us, rc_config.hub_ip), so a server takes far more players than
 *            one group; NFSU2_ROAM_HUB=0 does without it.  Without a hub
 *            answering, discovery (roam_discovery = on) is one datagram to
 *            the switch's broadcast address, i.e. every other browser on the
 *            server.  A destination outside the virtual subnet cannot be
 *            reached: a send error, logged.
 *   test     (roam_plat_test_mode(): an automated run, the same rule as the
 *            Mac) the Mac's guard is kept word for word: only 127/8
 *            destinations, no broadcast, peers only 127/8, every refusal
 *            logged as "[roam] BLOCKED".  What 127.0.0.1 means is adapted: the
 *            switch stands for the Mac's loopback interface.  A datagram to
 *            127.x.x.x:P goes out as a NET_KIND_UDP_LOOP frame to the switch's
 *            broadcast address; only instances in test mode bound to port P
 *            take it, and they see it come from 127.0.0.1:<sender's port>.  So
 *            the Mac's test setup works unchanged (every instance its own
 *            roam_port, peers 127.0.0.1:<port>), and test traffic and players'
 *            traffic never meet, even on one switch: a player's endpoint drops
 *            loopback frames, a test endpoint drops player frames.  As on the
 *            Mac, two test instances must not share a port (there is no bind
 *            to fail here: both would take the datagrams).
 *   NFSU2_ROAM_WEBTEST=vlan
 *            (web only, a test aid) an automated run that uses the virtual LAN
 *            as a player does (virtual addresses, discovery): the two-browser
 *            test of the players' path.  Allowed because nothing here reaches
 *            a real network: the switch forwards only to browsers attached to
 *            the same server.
 *
 * A SNAP carries one state here, not three (rc_config.snap_states): the
 * WebSocket loses nothing, so the older two only doubled the traffic.
 *
 * Co-op free roam (coop.c): player 2 is a second endpoint of this browser on
 * the same switch connection, a session of its own on a port of its own
 * (roam_plat_start2: player 1's port + 1), with the same virtual address.  The
 * network thread feeds each datagram to the session of its destination port
 * and ticks both; each sends from its own port.  The two never talk to each
 * other: a datagram from our own address (another endpoint of this browser:
 * an older hub links them, a restart's old endpoint lingers) is dropped, so
 * neither ever takes the other as a peer, and the notices are player 1's.
 *
 * The clock is CLOCK_MONOTONIC, which the host takes from
 * performance.timeOrigin + performance.now(): one clock in every worker of
 * the page (and comparable between pages of one browser).  Random numbers come
 * from crypto.getRandomValues (WASI random_get).  The impairment knob
 * (NFSU2_ROAM_IMPAIR) works on received datagrams as on the Mac. */
#include "roam_plat.h"
#include "host_abi.h"
#include "net_proto.h"
#include "gpu_proto.h"
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>
#include <strings.h>
#include <pthread.h>
#include <time.h>
#include <stdatomic.h>

static pthread_t       g_thr;
static int             g_thr_on;
static atomic_int      g_stop;
static pthread_mutex_t g_mu = PTHREAD_MUTEX_INITIALIZER;
static rc_session     *g_s;

/* each session's own port, for its sends (rc_io.user); player 2's session (co-op), its port (0: none) */

static io_ep           g_ep1, g_ep2;
static rc_session     *g_s2;
static uint16_t        g_port2, g_port2_was;    /* (was: player 2's port in this game, 0: never; its datagrams stay ours) */
static roam_plat_stats g_st;          /* written under g_mu */
static net_mailbox    *MB;            /* allocated once, registered once */
/* the browser's own numbers (under g_mu) */
static struct {
    uint64_t offline, unreachable, ring_full, filtered, own;     /* own: from another endpoint of this browser, dropped */
    uint32_t offline_noted;                         /* generation + 1 of the outage last noted */
    double   rxw_sum, rxw_max; uint64_t rxw_n;     /* page queued -> network thread took it, ms */
} W;

void roam_plat_lock(void){ pthread_mutex_lock(&g_mu); }
void roam_plat_unlock(void){ pthread_mutex_unlock(&g_mu); }
int64_t roam_plat_now_us(void){
    struct timespec ts; clock_gettime(CLOCK_MONOTONIC, &ts);
    return (int64_t)ts.tv_sec * 1000000 + ts.tv_nsec / 1000;
}
static double now_ms(void){ return (double)roam_plat_now_us() / 1000.0; }
uint32_t roam_plat_random(void){ uint32_t r; do arc4random_buf(&r, sizeof r); while (!r); return r; }

    snprintf(b, 16, "%u.%u.%u.%u", ip >> 24, (ip >> 16) & 255u, (ip >> 8) & 255u, ip & 255u); return b; }

/* ---- the mailbox ------------------------------------------------------------- */
static inline uint32_t ld(const uint32_t *p){ return __atomic_load_n(p, __ATOMIC_SEQ_CST); }
static inline void st(uint32_t *p, uint32_t v){ __atomic_store_n(p, v, __ATOMIC_SEQ_CST); }
static inline net_slot *tx_slot(uint32_t i){ return (net_slot *)((uint8_t *)MB + MB->tx_off + (i % NET_TX_SLOTS) * NET_SLOT_BYTES); }
static inline net_slot *rx_slot(uint32_t i){ return (net_slot *)((uint8_t *)MB + MB->rx_off + (i % NET_RX_SLOTS) * NET_SLOT_BYTES); }

static int mailbox_once(void){
    if (MB) return 0;
    net_mailbox *m = aligned_alloc(64, NET_MAILBOX_BYTES);
    if (!m){ fprintf(stderr, "[roam] no memory for the net mailbox\n"); return -1; }
    memset(m, 0, NET_MAILBOX_BYTES);
    m->magic = NET_MAGIC; m->version = NET_VERSION; m->hdr_bytes = NET_HDR_BYTES; m->slot_bytes = NET_SLOT_BYTES;
    m->tx_slots = NET_TX_SLOTS; m->rx_slots = NET_RX_SLOTS;
    m->tx_off = NET_HDR_BYTES; m->rx_off = NET_HDR_BYTES + NET_TX_SLOTS * NET_SLOT_BYTES;
    MB = m;
    nfsu2_register(HOST_KIND_NET, m, NET_MAILBOX_BYTES);
    return 0;
}

/* want (net_proto.h): free roam needs the switch while it runs; the page lets it go when nothing wants it */
static void set_want(uint32_t on){
    st(&MB->want, on);
    __atomic_add_fetch(&MB->tx_bell, 1, __ATOMIC_SEQ_CST);
    __builtin_wasm_memory_atomic_notify((int *)&MB->tx_bell, 1);
}

/* queue one datagram for the page (with the lock held), from our port sport */
static int tx_push_from(uint16_t sport, uint32_t kind, uint32_t dst, uint16_t dport, const uint8_t *buf, int len){
    uint32_t h = MB->tx_head, t = ld(&MB->tx_tail);
    if (h - t >= NET_TX_SLOTS){ W.ring_full++; return 0; }
    net_slot *s = tx_slot(h);
    s->len = (uint32_t)len; s->kind = kind; s->src_ip = ld(&MB->vip); s->dst_ip = dst;
    s->src_port = sport; s->dst_port = dport; s->t_ms = now_ms();
    memcpy(s->data, buf, (size_t)len);
    st(&MB->tx_head, h + 1);
    __atomic_add_fetch(&MB->tx_bell, 1, __ATOMIC_SEQ_CST);
    __builtin_wasm_memory_atomic_notify((int *)&MB->tx_bell, 1);
    return 1;
}
static int tx_push(uint32_t kind, uint32_t dst, uint16_t dport, const uint8_t *buf, int len){
    return tx_push_from(g_cfg.port, kind, dst, dport, buf, len);
}

/* ---- the guard (as roam_bsd.c) ------------------------------------------------ */
static void blocked(const char *what, uint32_t ip){
    char b[16];
    g_st.blocked++;
    if (g_st.blocked <= 20 || g_st.blocked % 1000 == 0)
        fprintf(stderr, "[roam] BLOCKED %s %s (test harness: loopback only; %llu refused so far)\n",
                what, roam_ip_str(ip, b), (unsigned long long)g_st.blocked);
}
int roam_plat_guard(int test_mode, uint32_t ip, int is_bcast){
    if (!test_mode) return 1;
    if (is_bcast){ blocked("broadcast to", ip); return 0; }
    if ((ip >> 24) != 127){ blocked("sendto", ip); return 0; }
    return 1;
}

/* ---- sending (called with the lock held, from either thread) ------------------ */
static void send_err(const char *why, uint32_t ip, uint16_t port){
    g_st.send_err++;
    if (g_st.send_err <= 5 || g_st.send_err % 1000 == 0){
        char b[16];
        fprintf(stderr, "[roam] sendto %s:%u failed: %s (%llu send errors)\n", roam_ip_str(ip, b), port, why,
                (unsigned long long)g_st.send_err);
    }
}
static void do_send(uint16_t sport, uint32_t ip, uint16_t port, const uint8_t *buf, int len, int is_bcast){
    if (!roam_plat_guard(g_cfg.test_mode, ip, is_bcast) || !MB || !ld(&MB->mode)) return;
    if (len <= 0 || len > (int)NET_MAX_PAYLOAD){ send_err("datagram too long", ip, port); return; }
    if (ld(&MB->page_state) != NET_PAGE_ONLINE){
        /* not a send error: the page has not connected yet, or lost the
         * switch and reconnects; noted once per outage */
        W.offline++;
        uint32_t gen = ld(&MB->generation);
        if (W.offline_noted != gen + 1){
            W.offline_noted = gen + 1;
            fprintf(stderr, "[roam] the virtual LAN is not connected%s: datagrams are dropped until the page's switch "
                            "connection is up\n", gen ? " (reconnecting)" : " yet");
        }
        return;
    }
    uint32_t kind = NET_KIND_UDP, dst = ip;
    if (g_cfg.test_mode){ kind = NET_KIND_UDP_LOOP; dst = NET_BROADCAST; }     /* the switch as the loopback */
    else if (!is_bcast){
        uint32_t vip = ld(&MB->vip), mask = ld(&MB->netmask);
        if ((ip & mask) != (vip & mask)){
            W.unreachable++;
            char b[16], n[16];
            g_st.send_err++;
            if (g_st.send_err <= 5 || g_st.send_err % 1000 == 0)
                fprintf(stderr, "[roam] sendto %s:%u failed: not an address on the virtual LAN (%s/%d); in the browser "
                                "roam_peers takes the virtual addresses the page shows\n", roam_ip_str(ip, b), port,
                        roam_ip_str(vip & mask, n), __builtin_popcount(mask));
            return;
        }
        if (ip == ((vip & mask) | ~mask)) dst = NET_BROADCAST;               /* the subnet's broadcast */
    }
    if (!tx_push_from(sport, kind, dst, port, buf, len)){ send_err("the page's send queue is full", ip, port); return; }
    g_st.sent++; g_st.sent_bytes += (uint64_t)len;
}
static void io_send(void *u, uint32_t ip, uint16_t port, const uint8_t *buf, int len){
    do_send(u ? ((const io_ep *)u)->port : g_cfg.port, ip, port, buf, len, 0);
}

/* the unit tests' piece (no interfaces in a browser: discovery is the switch's
 * broadcast); kept with roam_bsd.c's rules for tests/roam_unit.c */
static int if_skip(const char *n){
    return !strncmp(n, "lo", 2) || !strncmp(n, "utun", 4) || !strncmp(n, "awdl", 4) || !strncmp(n, "llw", 3) ||
           !strncmp(n, "ipsec", 5) || !strncmp(n, "gif", 3) || !strncmp(n, "stf", 3) || !strncmp(n, "anpi", 4) ||
           !strncmp(n, "ap", 2);
}
int roam_bcast_targets(const roam_if *ifs, int n, uint32_t *out, int max){
    int k = 0;
    if (k < max) out[k++] = 0xFFFFFFFFu;
    for (int i = 0; i < n && k < max; i++){
        const roam_if *f = &ifs[i];
        if (!f->up || f->loopback || !f->can_broadcast || if_skip(f->name) || !f->mask || f->mask == 0xFFFFFFFFu) continue;
        if (!rc_addr_private(f->addr)) continue;
        uint32_t b = (f->addr & f->mask) | ~f->mask;
        int dup = 0; for (int j = 0; j < k; j++) if (out[j] == b) dup = 1;
        if (!dup) out[k++] = b;
    }
    return k;
}
static void io_broadcast(void *u, uint16_t port, const uint8_t *buf, int len){
    (void)u;
    if (g_cfg.test_mode || !g_cfg.discovery){ roam_plat_guard(1, 0xFFFFFFFFu, 1); return; }
    do_send(g_cfg.port, NET_BROADCAST, port, buf, len, 1);     /* every other browser on the switch */
}
/* player 2's session broadcasts nothing (it takes the hub's links, or none) */
static void io_broadcast2(void *u, uint16_t port, const uint8_t *buf, int len){ (void)u; (void)port; (void)buf; (void)len; }
void roam_game_event(int ev, int peer, const char *text);    /* roam_game.c provides the log */
void roam_game_event2(int ev, int peer, const char *text);   /* ...and player 2's */
int roam_game_racing(void);                                  /* roam_game.c: the player races (no notices) */

/* ---- notices: what the page shows over the game ----------------------------------
 * A friend joining free roam, going into a race, back in free roam after it, and
 * leaving, as NET_KIND_NOTICE lines on the TX ring; the page never sends them
 * on.  Joining free roam is told when the friend's car gets there: from the
 * menus (starting the game, or back from the main menu), or already in free
 * roam when we first hear them.  Pausing is free roam here (a window in the
 * background pauses; the name over the car says "paused"); the menus are not
 * told, and a shop and loading are in between: a friend who goes into a shop
 * and comes back is not announced.  A place is told once it has held for
 * 1.5 s, so a friend passing through a loading screen is not announced
 * either.  Going from free roam into a race, and quitting, are told only of
 * a friend whose car was near ours (NEAR_M): one far away is not missed.
 * While the player races (a race, or an outrun with a friend) nothing is
 * shown; the places are still followed, so no pile of old notices comes
 * when it ends.  All with the lock held. */
#define NOTICE_HOLD_US 1500000
#define NEAR_M 150.f
static struct { uint32_t id; uint8_t told, cand, roam; int64_t since; } g_where[RC_TABLE];   /* roam: "joined free roam" told since the menus */
/* the players whose joining was told: once each (with the hub, a player
 * near us now and then, or passing by, comes and goes as a peer) */
#define TOLD_IDS 256
static uint32_t g_told[TOLD_IDS]; static int g_ntold;
static int told_once(uint32_t id){
    for (int i = 0; i < g_ntold && i < TOLD_IDS; i++) if (g_told[i] == id) return 0;
    g_told[g_ntold++ % TOLD_IDS] = id;
    return 1;
}
/* (name 0: what alone, no friend's name first: the page shows it as its own lines are) */
static void notice(const char *name, const char *what){
    if (roam_game_racing()) return;
    char t[192];
    int n = name ? snprintf(t, sizeof t, "%s\x1f%s", *name ? name : "A player", what) : snprintf(t, sizeof t, "%s", what);
    if (n > (int)sizeof t - 1) n = (int)sizeof t - 1;
    if (MB && n > 0) tx_push(NET_KIND_NOTICE, 0, 0, (const uint8_t *)t, n);
}
void roam_plat_notice(const char *name, const char *what){ notice(name, what); }
/* a hint by its id, the page's words for it: a NET_KIND_NOTICE line starting with 0x1E */
int roam_plat_hint(const char *id){
    char t[32];
    int n = snprintf(t, sizeof t, "\x1e%s", id);
    return MB && n > 1 && n < (int)sizeof t && tx_push(NET_KIND_NOTICE, 0, 0, (const uint8_t *)t, n) ? 1 : 0;
}
/* the race lobby's panel: its state to the page (NET_KIND_LOBBY), in a race too; -1: the ring is full, again later */
int roam_plat_lobby(const char *json){
    int n = (int)strlen(json);
    if (!MB) return -1;
    if (n <= 0 || n > (int)NET_MAX_PAYLOAD) return 1;
    return tx_push(NET_KIND_LOBBY, 0, 0, (const uint8_t *)json, n) ? 1 : -1;
}
/* the race lobby's actions from the page (input_web.c IEV_LOBBY, on the input thread): a few kept for the game thread
 * (roam_plat_lobby_act), the oldest dropped when they come faster than it takes them */
#define LB_RING 8
static struct { int act; uint32_t host, lobby, race; } g_lb[LB_RING];
static unsigned g_lb_w, g_lb_r;
static pthread_mutex_t g_lb_mu = PTHREAD_MUTEX_INITIALIZER;
void roam_plat_lobby_input(int act, uint32_t host, uint32_t lobby, uint32_t race){
    if (act <= ROAM_LB_NONE || act > ROAM_LB_NEW) return;
    pthread_mutex_lock(&g_lb_mu);
    if (g_lb_w - g_lb_r >= LB_RING) g_lb_r++;
    g_lb[g_lb_w % LB_RING].act = act; g_lb[g_lb_w % LB_RING].host = host; g_lb[g_lb_w % LB_RING].lobby = lobby; g_lb[g_lb_w % LB_RING].race = race;
    g_lb_w++;
    pthread_mutex_unlock(&g_lb_mu);
}
int roam_plat_lobby_act(uint32_t *host, uint32_t *lobby, uint32_t *race){
    int act = ROAM_LB_NONE;
    pthread_mutex_lock(&g_lb_mu);
    if (g_lb_r != g_lb_w){
        act = g_lb[g_lb_r % LB_RING].act; *host = g_lb[g_lb_r % LB_RING].host; *lobby = g_lb[g_lb_r % LB_RING].lobby; *race = g_lb[g_lb_r % LB_RING].race;
        g_lb_r++;
    }
    pthread_mutex_unlock(&g_lb_mu);
    return act;
}
/* solid cars as the page's menu switched them (net_proto.h solid) */
int roam_plat_solid(void){
    uint32_t v = MB ? ld(&MB->solid) : 0;
    return v == 1 ? 0 : v == 2 ? 1 : v == 3 ? 2 : -1;
}
/* quick chat: the page picks (net_proto.h say: the phrase, under a count that changes with each pick), the game
 * tells it what was said (NET_KIND_SAY) and, every frame, where the names of those who spoke are (the renderer's
 * frame, gpu_web.c gw_marks) */
void gw_marks(const GwMark *m, int n);
static uint32_t g_say_seen;
int roam_plat_quickchat(void){ return 1; }
int roam_plat_say_pick(void){
    uint32_t v = MB ? ld(&MB->say) : 0;
    if (v == g_say_seen) return -1;
    g_say_seen = v;
    return (int)(v & 0xffu);
}
int roam_plat_said(const char *json){
    int n = (int)strlen(json);
    if (!MB) return -1;
    if (n <= 0 || n > (int)NET_MAX_PAYLOAD) return 1;
    return tx_push(NET_KIND_SAY, 0, 0, (const uint8_t *)json, n) ? 1 : -1;
}
/* front bumpers: the page's "Add friend" (NET_KIND_FRIEND) */
int roam_plat_friend(const char *json){
    int n = (int)strlen(json);
    if (!MB) return -1;
    if (n <= 0 || n > (int)NET_MAX_PAYLOAD) return 1;
    return tx_push(NET_KIND_FRIEND, 0, 0, (const uint8_t *)json, n) ? 1 : -1;
}
/* a drift battle's scoreboard (NET_KIND_BATTLE): the page's, under the drift panel */
int roam_plat_battle(const char *json){
    int n = (int)strlen(json);
    if (!MB) return -1;
    if (n <= 0 || n > (int)NET_MAX_PAYLOAD) return 1;
    return tx_push(NET_KIND_BATTLE, 0, 0, (const uint8_t *)json, n) ? 1 : -1;
}
/* a car that flew for minutes: the page leaves the switch (NET_KIND_FLYING), only while it is on it */
int roam_plat_flying(const char *json){
    int n = (int)strlen(json);
    if (!MB || ld(&MB->page_state) != NET_PAGE_ONLINE || n <= 0 || n > (int)NET_MAX_PAYLOAD) return 0;
    return tx_push(NET_KIND_FLYING, 0, 0, (const uint8_t *)json, n) ? 1 : -1;
}
void roam_plat_say_marks(const uint32_t *ids, const float *xys, int n){
    GwMark m[GW_MARKS_MAX];
    if (n > GW_MARKS_MAX) n = GW_MARKS_MAX;
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++){ m[i].id = ids[i]; m[i].x = xys[3 * i]; m[i].y = xys[3 * i + 1]; m[i].s = xys[3 * i + 2]; }
    gw_marks(m, n);
}
/* the crews as the page's menu changed them (net_proto.h crews): read again
 * while the page writes them (the crews and colours first, then the number) */
uint32_t roam_plat_crews(uint32_t crews[RC_CREW_MAX], uint32_t rgb[RC_CREW_MAX]){
    for (int tries = 0; MB && tries < 4; tries++){
        uint32_t g = ld(&MB->crews_gen);
        if (!g) return 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < RC_CREW_MAX; i++){ crews[i] = i < 4 ? ld(&MB->crews[i]) : 0; rgb[i] = i < 4 ? ld(&MB->crews_rgb[i]) & 0xffffffu : 0; }
        if (ld(&MB->crews_gen) == g) return g;
    }
    return 0;
}
/* the room as the page changed it (net_proto.h room_name): read again while the page writes it (the name first, then
 * the number) */
uint32_t roam_plat_room(char name[64]){
    for (int tries = 0; MB && tries < 4; tries++){
        uint32_t g = ld(&MB->room_gen);
        if (!g) return 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < 16; i++){
            uint32_t w = ld(&MB->room_name[i]);
            for (int k = 0; k < 4; k++) name[4 * i + k] = (char)(w >> 8 * k);
        }
        name[63] = 0;
        if (ld(&MB->room_gen) == g) return g;
    }
    return 0;
}
/* A new name from the page (input event IEV_NAME, input_web.c): the operator took the old one away and the player
 * picked another (web/src/app/shell.ts netRename).  Its pieces come on the input thread; the whole one is kept here,
 * for free roam (roam_game.c name_follow) and Online mode's next login (online.c player_name). */
static pthread_mutex_t g_name_mx = PTHREAD_MUTEX_INITIALIZER;
static char g_name_in[33], g_name[33];
static atomic_uint g_name_gen;
void roam_plat_name_piece(int off, int total, const char *b, int n){
    if (total < 1 || total > 32 || off < 0 || off >= total) return;
    for (int i = 0; i < n && off + i < total; i++) g_name_in[off + i] = b[i] ? b[i] : ' ';
    if (off + n < total) return;                                     /* more pieces to come */
    g_name_in[total] = 0;
    pthread_mutex_lock(&g_name_mx);
    memcpy(g_name, g_name_in, sizeof g_name);
    atomic_fetch_add(&g_name_gen, 1);
    pthread_mutex_unlock(&g_name_mx);
    fprintf(stderr, "[roam] a new name from the page (%d characters)\n", total);
}
/* the page's newest name, and how many it sent (0: none: out is left as it is) */
uint32_t roam_plat_name(char out[33]){
    if (!atomic_load(&g_name_gen)) return 0;
    pthread_mutex_lock(&g_name_mx);
    uint32_t g = atomic_load(&g_name_gen);
    memcpy(out, g_name, 33);
    pthread_mutex_unlock(&g_name_mx);
    return g;
}
/* Co-op: player 2's name from the page (IEV_NAME with INAME_SEAT2), the same way: the page checked the one the game
 * made (NET_KIND_COOP) and another player holds it, or the operator took it away and the player picked another */
static char g_name2_in[33], g_name2[33];
static atomic_uint g_name2_gen;
void roam_plat_name2_piece(int off, int total, const char *b, int n){
    if (total < 1 || total > 32 || off < 0 || off >= total) return;
    for (int i = 0; i < n && off + i < total; i++) g_name2_in[off + i] = b[i] ? b[i] : ' ';
    if (off + n < total) return;
    g_name2_in[total] = 0;
    pthread_mutex_lock(&g_name_mx);
    memcpy(g_name2, g_name2_in, sizeof g_name2);
    atomic_fetch_add(&g_name2_gen, 1);
    pthread_mutex_unlock(&g_name_mx);
    fprintf(stderr, "[roam] a new name for player 2 from the page (%d characters)\n", total);
}
uint32_t roam_plat_name2(char out[33]){
    if (!atomic_load(&g_name2_gen)) return 0;
    pthread_mutex_lock(&g_name_mx);
    uint32_t g = atomic_load(&g_name2_gen);
    memcpy(out, g_name2, 33);
    pthread_mutex_unlock(&g_name_mx);
    return g;
}
/* player 2's endpoint for the page (NET_KIND_COOP): {"name"} or "{}"; -1: the ring is full, again later */
int roam_plat_coop(const char *json){
    int n = (int)strlen(json);
    if (!MB) return -1;
    if (n <= 0 || n > (int)NET_MAX_PAYLOAD) return 1;
    return tx_push(NET_KIND_COOP, 0, 0, (const uint8_t *)json, n) ? 1 : -1;
}
static uint8_t place(const rc_peer *p){ return p->status == RC_ST_PAUSED ? RC_ST_ROAM : p->status; }
/* we are in free roam and the friend's car was within NEAR_M of ours (on the
 * ground) when last seen: SNAPs come only from free roam, so its newest state
 * is where it was before a race or a quit */
static int nearby(const rc_peer *p){
    if ((g_s->status != RC_ST_ROAM && g_s->status != RC_ST_PAUSED) || !g_s->nlast || !p->mo.n) return 0;
    const float *a = g_s->last[0].p, *b = p->mo.s[p->mo.n - 1].p;
    float dx = a[0] - b[0], dy = a[1] - b[1];
    return dx * dx + dy * dy <= NEAR_M * NEAR_M;
}
static void where_watch(int64_t now){
    for (int i = 0; i < RC_TABLE; i++){
        const rc_peer *p = &g_s->peer[i];
        if (p->state != RC_PS_EST || p->lost){ if (p->state != RC_PS_EST) g_where[i].id = 0; continue; }
        uint8_t st = place(p);
        if (st == RC_ST_LOADING || st == RC_ST_SHOP) continue;
        if (g_where[i].id != p->id){
            g_where[i].id = p->id; g_where[i].told = g_where[i].cand = st; g_where[i].roam = st == RC_ST_ROAM; g_where[i].since = now;
            continue;
        }
        if (st != g_where[i].cand){ g_where[i].cand = st; g_where[i].since = now; }
        if (g_where[i].cand == g_where[i].told || now - g_where[i].since < NOTICE_HOLD_US) continue;
        uint8_t was = g_where[i].told;
        g_where[i].told = g_where[i].cand;
        if (st == RC_ST_EVENT){ if (was == RC_ST_ROAM && nearby(p)) notice(p->name, " is in a race"); }
        else if (st == RC_ST_MENUS) g_where[i].roam = 0;                   /* out of free roam: not told */
        else if (!g_where[i].roam){ g_where[i].roam = 1; told_once(p->id); notice(p->name, " joined free roam"); }
        else if (was == RC_ST_EVENT) notice(p->name, " is in free roam");
    }
}
static void io_event(void *u, int ev, int peer, const char *text){
    (void)u; roam_game_event(ev, peer, text);
    if (peer < 0 || peer >= RC_TABLE) return;
    const rc_peer *p = &g_s->peer[peer];
    if (ev == RC_EV_JOIN){
        /* in the menus, a race (or a shop, or loading): told when the car gets to free roam */
        uint8_t st = place(p);
        g_where[peer].id = p->id; g_where[peer].told = g_where[peer].cand = st; g_where[peer].roam = st == RC_ST_ROAM;
        g_where[peer].since = roam_plat_now_us();
        if (st == RC_ST_ROAM && told_once(p->id)) notice(p->name, " joined free roam");
    } else if (ev == RC_EV_LEAVE){
        /* roam_core.c drop_peer: "<name> left: <why>"; a restart joins again at once, another room was never ours,
         * one out of range (the hub's list) is still playing.  Quitting: the place held last (the
         * game's last frames may be another), and only from free roam near us */
        const char *why = strstr(text, " left: ");
        why = why ? why + 7 : "";
        if (!strcmp(why, "quit")){ if (g_where[peer].id == p->id && g_where[peer].told == RC_ST_ROAM && nearby(p)) notice(p->name, " left"); }
        else if (!strcmp(why, "switched off")) notice(p->name, " turned free roam off");
        else if (!strcmp(why, "timeout") || !strcmp(why, "no longer hears us")) notice(p->name, " lost the connection");
        g_where[peer].id = 0;
    }
}
/* player 2's session: its log only (the notices over the game are player 1's) */
static void io_event2(void *u, int ev, int peer, const char *text){ (void)u; roam_game_event2(ev, peer, text); }

/* ---- impairment (test aid, as roam_bsd.c) ------------------------------------------ */
static struct { int on, loss, delay, jitter, dup; uint32_t rng; } IMP;
#define IMPQ 512
static struct { int used; int64_t at; uint32_t ip; uint16_t port; int len; uint8_t b[RC_MAX_DGRAM]; } g_q[IMPQ];
static uint32_t imp_rand(void){ uint32_t x = IMP.rng; x ^= x << 13; x ^= x >> 17; x ^= x << 5; IMP.rng = x ? x : 1u; return IMP.rng; }
static void imp_parse(const char *s){
    memset(&IMP, 0, sizeof IMP);
    if (!s || !*s) return;
    IMP.rng = 0x9E3779B9u;
    const char *p = s;
    while (*p){
        char k[16] = {0}; int v = 0, nk = 0;
        while (*p && *p != '=' && *p != ',' && nk < 15) k[nk++] = *p++;
        if (*p == '='){ p++; v = atoi(p); while (*p && *p != ',') p++; }
        if (*p == ',') p++;
        if (!strcmp(k, "loss")) IMP.loss = v;
        else if (!strcmp(k, "delay")) IMP.delay = v;
        else if (!strcmp(k, "jitter")) IMP.jitter = v;
        else if (!strcmp(k, "dup")) IMP.dup = v;
        else if (!strcmp(k, "seed")) IMP.rng = (uint32_t)v ? (uint32_t)v : 1u;
    }
    IMP.on = 1;
    fprintf(stderr, "[roam] impairment (test aid) on received datagrams: loss %d%%, delay %d ms, jitter +-%d ms, duplicates %d%%\n",
            IMP.loss, IMP.delay, IMP.jitter, IMP.dup);
}
static void imp_queue(int64_t now, uint32_t ip, uint16_t port, const uint8_t *b, int len){
    for (int copy = 0; copy < 2; copy++){
        if (copy == 1 && (int)(imp_rand() % 100u) >= IMP.dup) break;
        if (copy == 1) g_st.impair_dup++;
        int64_t d = (int64_t)IMP.delay * 1000;
        if (IMP.jitter) d += (int64_t)((int)(imp_rand() % (uint32_t)(2 * IMP.jitter * 1000 + 1)) - IMP.jitter * 1000);
        if (d < 0) d = 0;
        int i = 0; while (i < IMPQ && g_q[i].used) i++;
        if (i == IMPQ){ g_st.impair_drop++; return; }
        g_q[i].used = 1; g_q[i].at = now + d; g_q[i].ip = ip; g_q[i].port = port; g_q[i].len = len; memcpy(g_q[i].b, b, (size_t)len);
    }
}
static void imp_release(int64_t now){
    for (;;){
        int best = -1;
        for (int i = 0; i < IMPQ; i++) if (g_q[i].used && g_q[i].at <= now && (best < 0 || g_q[i].at < g_q[best].at)) best = i;
        if (best < 0) return;
        rc_receive(g_s, g_q[best].ip, g_q[best].port, g_q[best].b, g_q[best].len, now);
        g_q[best].used = 0;
    }
}

/* ---- network thread ---------------------------------------------------------------- */
/* the page's side of the link, logged when it changes: up (with the
 * address), down once per outage, a reminder after 10 s without it */
typedef struct { int up, nagged; uint32_t vip, gen; int64_t t_down; } link_seen;
static void link_watch(link_seen *k, int64_t now){
    uint32_t ps = ld(&MB->page_state), vip = ld(&MB->vip), gen = ld(&MB->generation);
    int up = ps == NET_PAGE_ONLINE;
    char b[16];
    if (up && (!k->up || vip != k->vip || gen != k->gen)){
        fprintf(stderr, "[roam] virtual LAN up: this browser is %s/%d on the switch (connection %u, %u on the switch)%s\n",
                roam_ip_str(vip, b), __builtin_popcount(ld(&MB->netmask)), gen, ld(&MB->switch_peers),
                k->vip && vip != k->vip ? "; a new address: friends see a new player once the old one timed out" :
                k->vip ? "; the same address again" : "");
        k->vip = vip; k->gen = gen; k->nagged = 0;
    }
    if (!up && k->up){
        fprintf(stderr, "[roam] virtual LAN down (was %s): the page is reconnecting, datagrams are dropped meanwhile\n",
                roam_ip_str(k->vip, b));
        k->t_down = now; k->nagged = 0;
    }
    k->up = up;
    if (!up && !k->nagged && now - k->t_down > 10000000){
        k->nagged = 1;
        fprintf(stderr, "[roam] the virtual LAN has not been connected for 10 s (%s): friends cannot be reached until it is\n",
                ps == NET_PAGE_NONE ? "the page has not attached the network (web/src/net attachNet)" :
                k->vip ? "the page lost the server's switch and keeps reconnecting" : "the page is still connecting to the server's switch");
    }
}
static void web_stats_log(const char *when){
    double tws = MB->tx_wait_ms_sum, twm = MB->tx_wait_ms_max; uint32_t twn = MB->tx_wait_n;
    fprintf(stderr, "[roam] virtual LAN %s: sent %llu, received %llu, dropped while offline %llu, send errors %llu (not on the LAN %llu, queue full %llu), "
                    "filtered %llu (from this browser's own endpoints %llu); page: switch rtt %.2f ms, peers on the switch %u, RX ring full %u, oversize %u; "
                    "C->page wait mean %.3f ms max %.2f ms, page->C wait mean %.3f ms max %.2f ms\n",
            when, (unsigned long long)g_st.sent, (unsigned long long)g_st.recv, (unsigned long long)W.offline,
            (unsigned long long)g_st.send_err, (unsigned long long)W.unreachable, (unsigned long long)W.ring_full,
            (unsigned long long)W.filtered, (unsigned long long)W.own, MB->switch_rtt_ms, ld(&MB->switch_peers), ld(&MB->rx_full_drop), ld(&MB->rx_oversize),
            twn ? tws / twn : 0.0, twm, W.rxw_n ? W.rxw_sum / (double)W.rxw_n : 0.0, W.rxw_max);
}
static void *net_main(void *u){
    (void)u;
    int64_t next_tick = 0, t_start = roam_plat_now_us(), next_stats = t_start + 30000000;
    link_seen ls = { 0, 0, 0, 0, t_start };
    while (!atomic_load(&g_stop)){
        int64_t now = roam_plat_now_us();
        uint32_t bell = ld(&MB->rx_bell);
        if (ld(&MB->rx_head) == MB->rx_tail){
            int64_t wait = next_tick - now;
            if (wait > 10000) wait = 10000;
            if (wait > 0) __builtin_wasm_memory_atomic_wait32((int *)&MB->rx_bell, (int)bell, wait * 1000);
        }
        __atomic_add_fetch(&MB->c_alive, 1, __ATOMIC_RELAXED);
        now = roam_plat_now_us();
        link_watch(&ls, now);
        uint32_t mode = ld(&MB->mode), port = ld(&MB->port), vip = ld(&MB->vip);
        double tms = (double)now / 1000.0;
        uint32_t tail = MB->rx_tail;
        for (int k = 0; k < 256 && tail != ld(&MB->rx_head); k++, tail++){
            const net_slot *s = rx_slot(tail);
            uint32_t ip = s->src_ip; uint16_t sport = s->src_port; int n = (int)s->len; int take = 0;
            roam_plat_lock();
            /* (player 2's session, co-op: the datagrams to its port) */
            rc_session *to = s->dst_port == port ? g_s : g_s2 && s->dst_port == g_port2 ? g_s2 : 0;
            if (n >= 0 && n <= (int)NET_MAX_PAYLOAD && to){
                if (mode == NET_MODE_VLAN) take = s->kind == NET_KIND_UDP && (s->dst_ip == vip || s->dst_ip == NET_BROADCAST);
                else if (mode == NET_MODE_LOOP){ take = s->kind == NET_KIND_UDP_LOOP; ip = 0x7F000001u; }
                /* once this game had a player 2: another endpoint of this browser (player 1's or player 2's, or a
                 * restart's old one) is never a peer (a solo game takes what it took before) */
                if (take && g_port2_was && (mode == NET_MODE_VLAN ? ip == vip : sport == port || sport == g_port2_was)){ take = 0; W.own++; }
            }
            double w = tms - s->t_ms;
            if (w >= 0 && w < 60000){ W.rxw_sum += w; W.rxw_n++; if (w > W.rxw_max) W.rxw_max = w; }
            if (!take) W.filtered++;
            else {
                g_st.recv++; g_st.recv_bytes += (uint64_t)n;
                if (n > RC_MAX_DGRAM){ to->rx++; to->rx_bad++; }
                else if (IMP.on && to == g_s){
                    if ((int)(imp_rand() % 100u) < IMP.loss) g_st.impair_drop++;
                    else imp_queue(now, ip, sport, s->data, n);
                } else rc_receive(to, ip, sport, s->data, n, now);
            }
            roam_plat_unlock();
            st(&MB->rx_tail, tail + 1);
        }
        if (IMP.on){ roam_plat_lock(); imp_release(now); roam_plat_unlock(); }
        if (now >= next_tick){
            roam_plat_lock(); rc_tick(g_s, now); if (g_s2) rc_tick(g_s2, now); where_watch(now); roam_plat_unlock();
            next_tick = now + 10000;
        }
        if (now >= next_stats){ roam_plat_lock(); web_stats_log("stats"); roam_plat_unlock(); next_stats = now + 30000000; }
    }
    return 0;
}

int roam_plat_start(const roam_plat_cfg *cfg, rc_session *s){
    g_cfg = *cfg; g_s = s; g_ep1.port = cfg->port;
    memset(&g_st, 0, sizeof g_st); memset(&W, 0, sizeof W);
    if (g_cfg.test_mode && g_cfg.discovery){
        fprintf(stderr, "[roam] LAN discovery DISABLED: automated run (test harness), no broadcast will be sent; "
                        "only loopback peers from NFSU2_ROAM_PEERS\n");
        g_cfg.discovery = 0;
    }
    if (mailbox_once() != 0) return -1;
    /* drop what an earlier endpoint left; the page may still be sending its TX ring */
    st(&MB->rx_tail, ld(&MB->rx_head));
    st(&MB->port, g_cfg.port);
    st(&MB->mode, g_cfg.test_mode ? NET_MODE_LOOP : NET_MODE_VLAN);
    imp_parse(g_cfg.impair);
    memset(g_q, 0, sizeof g_q); memset(g_where, 0, sizeof g_where); g_ntold = 0;
    rc_io io = { &g_ep1, io_send, io_broadcast, io_event };
    const char *hub = getenv("NFSU2_ROAM_HUB");
    int use_hub = !g_cfg.test_mode && !(hub && !strcmp(hub, "0"));
    roam_plat_lock();
    s->io = io;
    if (use_hub){ s->conf.hub_ip = NET_ROAM_HUB; s->conf.hub_port = g_cfg.port; }
    /* the WebSocket loses no datagram, so a SNAP carries only the newest
     * state: half the bytes (a receiver the switch sheds for, see nfsu2-lan's
     * roam_queue, interpolates over the gap).  The impairment knob stands for
     * a lossy link: all three there, as on a LAN */
    s->conf.snap_states = IMP.on ? RC_SNAP_STATES : 1;
    roam_plat_unlock();
    atomic_store(&g_stop, 0);
    if (pthread_create(&g_thr, 0, net_main, 0) != 0){ st(&MB->mode, NET_MODE_CLOSED); return -1; }
    g_thr_on = 1;
    set_want(1);
    if (webtest_vlan())
        fprintf(stderr, "[roam] automated run on the virtual LAN (NFSU2_ROAM_WEBTEST=vlan): virtual addresses and discovery as "
                        "for players; the switch reaches only browsers on this server\n");
    fprintf(stderr, "[roam] virtual LAN UDP port %u open%s%s\n", g_cfg.port,
            g_cfg.test_mode ? " (test harness: loopback only; the switch stands for the loopback, 127.0.0.1:<port> "
                              "reaches the test instance on that port)" :
            use_hub ? ", the players near us from the server's free-roam hub (10.77.0.253)" : "",
            g_cfg.test_mode ? "" : g_cfg.discovery ? (use_hub ? "; LAN discovery if it does not answer" :
                                                      ", LAN discovery on (broadcast to every browser on the switch)") : "");
    return 0;
}
void roam_plat_stop(uint8_t reason){
    if (!g_thr_on) return;
    roam_plat_lock();
    if (g_s2){ rc_shutdown(g_s2, reason); g_s2 = 0; g_port2 = 0; }   /* player 2's too (co-op) */
    rc_shutdown(g_s, reason);                                         /* BYE x3: the page sends what is queued */
    roam_plat_unlock();
    atomic_store(&g_stop, 1);
    __atomic_add_fetch(&MB->rx_bell, 1, __ATOMIC_SEQ_CST);
    __builtin_wasm_memory_atomic_notify((int *)&MB->rx_bell, 1);
    pthread_join(g_thr, 0); g_thr_on = 0;
    roam_plat_lock(); web_stats_log("closed"); roam_plat_unlock();
    st(&MB->mode, NET_MODE_CLOSED);
    set_want(0);
}

/* Co-op: player 2's session on the same connection, from port (player 1's + 1): its datagrams go out from that port,
 * the ones to it come to it, it ticks with player 1's.  The hub (when player 1's has one) is its too.  With the lock
 * free; 0: started */
int roam_plat_start2(rc_session *s, uint16_t port){
    if (!g_thr_on || !MB || !port || port == g_cfg.port) return -1;
    rc_io io = { &g_ep2, io_send, io_broadcast2, io_event2 };
    roam_plat_lock();
    if (g_s2){ roam_plat_unlock(); return -1; }
    s->io = io;
    s->conf.hub_ip = g_s->conf.hub_ip; s->conf.hub_port = g_s->conf.hub_ip ? port : 0;
    s->conf.snap_states = g_s->conf.snap_states;
    s->conf.discovery = 0;
    g_ep2.port = port; g_port2 = port; g_port2_was = port; g_s2 = s;
    roam_plat_unlock();
    fprintf(stderr, "[roam] player 2's virtual LAN UDP port %u open (a second endpoint of this browser)%s\n", port,
            s->conf.hub_ip ? ", the players near player 2 from the server's hub" : "");
    return 0;
}
/* player 2's session ends: BYE to its peers and the hub (queued for the page at once), then nothing more to it */
void roam_plat_stop2(uint8_t reason){
    roam_plat_lock();
    if (g_s2){
        rc_shutdown(g_s2, reason);
        fprintf(stderr, "[roam] player 2's virtual LAN UDP port %u closed\n", g_port2);
        g_s2 = 0; g_port2 = 0;
    }
    roam_plat_unlock();
}
/* ip:port is an endpoint of this browser (player 1's or player 2's port at our address; the loopback's in a test
 * run).  With the lock held */
int roam_plat_own(uint32_t ip, uint16_t port){
    if (!MB) return 0;
    if (ld(&MB->mode) == NET_MODE_LOOP) return ip == 0x7F000001u && (port == g_cfg.port || (g_port2 && port == g_port2));
    uint32_t vip = ld(&MB->vip);
    return vip && ip == vip;
}

int roam_plat_parse_peers(const char *list, int test_mode, uint16_t defport, uint32_t *ip, uint16_t *port, int max){
    int n = 0;
    if (!list) return 0;
    const char *p = list;
    while (*p && n < max){
        /* blanks, tabs, commas and ';' separate entries (as settings.ini and
         * the Windows plugin take them) */
        while (*p == ' ' || *p == '\t' || *p == ',' || *p == ';') p++;
        if (!*p) break;
        char tok[64]; int k = 0;
        while (*p && *p != ',' && *p != ';' && *p != ' ' && *p != '\t' && k < 63) tok[k++] = *p++;
        tok[k] = 0;
        unsigned a, b, c, d, pt = defport; char extra;
        int got = sscanf(tok, "%u.%u.%u.%u:%u%c", &a, &b, &c, &d, &pt, &extra);
        if ((got != 4 && got != 5) || a > 255 || b > 255 || c > 255 || d > 255 || pt == 0 || pt > 65535){
            fprintf(stderr, "[roam] peer \"%s\" ignored: write a.b.c.d or a.b.c.d:port (IPv4 numbers, no names)\n", tok);
            continue;
        }
        uint32_t v = a << 24 | b << 16 | c << 8 | d;
        if (test_mode && a != 127){
            fprintf(stderr, "[roam] peer %s REFUSED: test harness, only 127.x.x.x peers\n", tok); continue; }
        ip[n] = v; port[n] = (uint16_t)pt; n++;
    }
    return n;
}

{"id": "AT000650", "source": "archive:A028!/nfsu2-web-public/runtime/web/sbrk.c", "originalBytes": 4337, "originalSha256": "ab71052cb003c93fdd5803cf8f83679ff1ae43149f3097e0340af1d1b7c05d88", "originalEncoding": "utf-8", "utf8RangeStart": 0, "utf8RangeEnd": 4337, "utf8TotalBytes": 4337}

/* The runtime heap's break (wasi-libc's dlmalloc takes its memory from sbrk).
 *
 * The module declares a small minimum memory (web/build.sh MIN_MB: just past
 * the runtime's data and main stack), so that every byte the heap takes comes
 * through here and its break says what the game has used of its memory (the
 * [status] line's brk=; the page gives 1 GB, host/memory.ts).
 * dlmalloc begins with [__heap_base, __heap_end), where wasm-ld puts
 * __heap_end at that declared minimum, and asks sbrk for the rest.  wasi-libc's
 * own sbrk grows the memory from its current end, so with the page's usual
 * 1 GB everything between the minimum and 1 GB would never be used and the
 * memory would grow past 1 GB at once.  This one hands out the memory from
 * __heap_end on, in order, and grows the memory only past what the page gave:
 * the heap stays one contiguous run, as large before any growth as it always
 * was.  dlmalloc calls it with its global lock held; nothing else moves the
 * break.  sbrk(0) is the break: the top of everything the heap ever took.
 *
 * With the guest heap's window above the runtime (guest_span.h, a computer's
 * browser) the heap goes on past the window's end (and GWIN_GUARD more: at
 * 2 GB, where the page reads its pointers as unsigned, host/game-worker.ts
 * u32args) instead of into it: the
 * piece below the window is left unused and dlmalloc takes the memory after
 * the window as a segment of its own (its sys_alloc adds a segment for a
 * break that does not continue the last).  The runtime kept below ~1020 MB in
 * every measured game, so that is room it should never need. */
#include <errno.h>
#include <stdint.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <unistd.h>
#include "../guest_span.h"

extern char __heap_end;
static uintptr_t g_brk;

static uint64_t g_stepped;                            /* bytes left below the window by the step over it */
/* (mem.c, test runs only: NFSU2_TEST_HIGH_RUNTIME) the next growth steps over the window whatever its size, so the
 * runtime's heap is at 2 GB or more from then on, as after a long session, and the page's handling of such pointers
 * is tried */
int g_sbrk_high = 0;

void *sbrk(intptr_t increment){
    if (!g_brk) g_brk = (uintptr_t)&__heap_end;
    if (increment < 0){
        /* dlmalloc never trims here (the memory never shrinks); it gives back only the piece a growth got when it
         * could not get the rest (its sys_alloc's partial failure), which may follow a step over the window: the
         * break goes back over that piece, never back into the window */
        uint32_t whi = __atomic_load_n(&g_gwin_hi, __ATOMIC_ACQUIRE);
        uint64_t back = (uint64_t)-(int64_t)increment, top = whi ? (uint64_t)whi + GWIN_GUARD : 0;
        uint64_t floor = top && g_brk >= top ? top : (uintptr_t)&__heap_end;
        if (g_brk - floor < back){ errno = EINVAL; return (void *)-1; }
        uint64_t was = g_brk; g_brk = (uintptr_t)(g_brk - back);
        return (void *)(uintptr_t)was;
    }
    /* in 64 bits: a 4 GB memory's size does not fit a wasm32 size_t */
    uint64_t old = g_brk, end = old + (uint64_t)increment;
    /* (the top first: mem.c sets the bottom before it) */
    uint32_t whi = __atomic_load_n(&g_gwin_hi, __ATOMIC_ACQUIRE), wlo = __atomic_load_n(&g_gwin_lo, __ATOMIC_ACQUIRE);
    if (increment && whi && old < (uint64_t)whi + GWIN_GUARD && (end > wlo || g_sbrk_high)){
        old = (uint64_t)whi + GWIN_GUARD; end = old + (uint64_t)increment; }
    uint64_t have = (uint64_t)__builtin_wasm_memory_size(0) * 65536u;
    if (end > 0xFFFF0000u){ errno = ENOMEM; return (void *)-1; }
    if (end > have && __builtin_wasm_memory_grow(0, (size_t)((end - have + 65535u) / 65536u)) == SIZE_MAX){
        errno = ENOMEM; return (void *)-1;
    }
    if (old != g_brk) g_stepped += old - g_brk;
    g_brk = (uintptr_t)end;
    return (void *)(uintptr_t)old;
}

/* the break (the top of all the heap ever took) and the memory's size, in bytes, for the status line (autotest.c) */
uint64_t heap_break(void){ return g_brk ? g_brk : (uintptr_t)&__heap_end; }
/* what the runtime's heap has taken: the break less what the step over the guest heap's window left out */
uint64_t heap_taken(void){ return heap_break() - g_stepped; }
uint64_t memory_bytes(void){ return (uint64_t)__builtin_wasm_memory_size(0) * 65536u; }

/* sha256.c -- SHA-256 (FIPS 180-4) for the wasm build, where CommonCrypto
 * does not exist.  module.c pins the lifted server.dll to the file it was
 * lifted from with this hash (the Mac uses CC_SHA256 for the same check).
 * Plain portable C; checked against the FIPS 180-4 vectors by
 * web/test/lan_unit.c (node --test web/test/lan-wasm.test.mjs) and against
 * gen/server/modinfo.c's hash of the game's own server.dll at every load
 * ("sha256 ok" in the log). */
#include <stdint.h>
#include <stddef.h>
#include <string.h>

static const uint32_t K[64] = {
    0x428a2f98u, 0x71374491u, 0xb5c0fbcfu, 0xe9b5dba5u, 0x3956c25bu, 0x59f111f1u, 0x923f82a4u, 0xab1c5ed5u,

    0x983e5152u, 0xa831c66du, 0xb00327c8u, 0xbf597fc7u, 0xc6e00bf3u, 0xd5a79147u, 0x06ca6351u, 0x14292967u,

    0xa2bfe8a1u, 0xa81a664bu, 0xc24b8b70u, 0xc76c51a3u, 0xd192e819u, 0xd6990624u, 0xf40e3585u, 0x106aa070u,
    0x19a4c116u, 0x1e376c08u, 0x2748774cu, 0x34b0bcb5u, 0x391c0cb3u, 0x4ed8aa4au, 0x5b9cca4fu, 0x682e6ff3u,
    0x748f82eeu, 0x78a5636fu, 0x84c87814u, 0x8cc70208u, 0x90befffau, 0xa4506cebu, 0xbef9a3f7u, 0xc67178f2u,
};
#define ROR(x, n) ((x) >> (n) | (x) << (32 - (n)))

static void block(uint32_t h[8], const uint8_t *p){
    uint32_t w[64];
    for (int i = 0; i < 16; i++)
        w[i] = (uint32_t)p[4*i] << 24 | (uint32_t)p[4*i+1] << 16 | (uint32_t)p[4*i+2] << 8 | p[4*i+3];
    for (int i = 16; i < 64; i++){
        uint32_t s0 = ROR(w[i-15], 7) ^ ROR(w[i-15], 18) ^ (w[i-15] >> 3);
        uint32_t s1 = ROR(w[i-2], 17) ^ ROR(w[i-2], 19) ^ (w[i-2] >> 10);
        w[i] = w[i-16] + s0 + w[i-7] + s1;
    }
    uint32_t a = h[0], b = h[1], c = h[2], d = h[3], e = h[4], f = h[5], g = h[6], k = h[7];
    for (int i = 0; i < 64; i++){
        uint32_t t1 = k + (ROR(e, 6) ^ ROR(e, 11) ^ ROR(e, 25)) + ((e & f) ^ (~e & g)) + K[i] + w[i];
        uint32_t t2 = (ROR(a, 2) ^ ROR(a, 13) ^ ROR(a, 22)) + ((a & b) ^ (a & c) ^ (b & c));
        k = g; g = f; f = e; e = d + t1; d = c; c = b; b = a; a = t1 + t2;
    }
    h[0] += a; h[1] += b; h[2] += c; h[3] += d; h[4] += e; h[5] += f; h[6] += g; h[7] += k;
}

void nfsu2_sha256(const void *data, size_t n, uint8_t out[32]){
    uint32_t h[8] = { 0x6a09e667u, 0xbb67ae85u, 0x3c6ef372u, 0xa54ff53au,
                      0x510e527fu, 0x9b05688cu, 0x1f83d9abu, 0x5be0cd19u };
    const uint8_t *p = data;
    size_t left = n;
    for (; left >= 64; left -= 64, p += 64) block(h, p);
    uint8_t tail[128]; memset(tail, 0, sizeof tail);
    memcpy(tail, p, left);
    tail[left] = 0x80;
    size_t tl = left < 56 ? 64 : 128;
    uint64_t bits = (uint64_t)n * 8u;
    for (int i = 0; i < 8; i++) tail[tl - 1 - i] = (uint8_t)(bits >> (8 * i));
    block(h, tail);
    if (tl == 128) block(h, tail + 64);
    for (int i = 0; i < 8; i++){
        out[4*i] = (uint8_t)(h[i] >> 24); out[4*i+1] = (uint8_t)(h[i] >> 16);
        out[4*i+2] = (uint8_t)(h[i] >> 8); out[4*i+3] = (uint8_t)h[i];
    }
}

/* NFSU2_SHADER_DUMP=<dir> (e.g. /save/shaders): write every shader the game
 * creates and every WGSL module the translator hands the renderer, so the
 * whole set can be validated in Chrome (web/tools/shader-check.mjs).
 *
 *   vsobj_<n>.bin/.asm   CreateVertexShader bytecode + disassembly (n = com.c index)
 *   psobj_<id>.bin/.asm  CreatePixelShader bytecode + disassembly
 *   vs_<gid>.wgsl        one module per (vertex shader, declaration) pair
 *   ps_<id>.wgsl         pixel shader module; ps_<id+256>.wgsl = stage-0 cube twin
 *   decl_<obj>.bin      CreateVertexDeclaration elements (obj = COM address, hex)
 *   vs_0, ps_0, ps_256   built-in TVert / fixed-function modules
 *   pulltest.wgsl        vertex-pulling compute test
 *   index.txt            one line per object / module, with the declarations
 *
 * Game-derived data: the dump goes to OPFS or out/, never into the repo. */
#include "wgsl.h"
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>
#include <sys/stat.h>
#include <errno.h>

static int g_on = -1;
static char g_dir[512];
static FILE *g_ix;

static void put(const char *name, const void *data, size_t n){
    char path[640]; snprintf(path, sizeof path, "%s/%s", g_dir, name);
    FILE *f = fopen(path, "wb");
    if (!f){ fprintf(stderr, "[shaderdump] %s: %s\n", path, strerror(errno)); return; }
    fwrite(data, 1, n, f); fclose(f);
}

int wgsl_dump_on(void){
    if (g_on >= 0) return g_on;
    const char *d = getenv("NFSU2_SHADER_DUMP");
    g_on = (d && *d) ? 1 : 0;
    if (!g_on) return 0;
    snprintf(g_dir, sizeof g_dir, "%s", d);
    if (mkdir(g_dir, 0755) != 0 && errno != EEXIST){
        fprintf(stderr, "[shaderdump] cannot create %s: %s\n", g_dir, strerror(errno));
        g_on = 0; return 0;
    }
    char path[640]; snprintf(path, sizeof path, "%s/index.txt", g_dir);
    g_ix = fopen(path, "w");
    static char buf[64 * 1024];
    int n;
    if ((n = wgsl_tvert_module(buf, sizeof buf)) > 0) put("vs_0.wgsl", buf, (size_t)n);
    if ((n = wgsl_ff_module(0, buf, sizeof buf, 0u)) > 0) put("ps_0.wgsl", buf, (size_t)n);
    if ((n = wgsl_ff_module(256, buf, sizeof buf, 1u)) > 0) put("ps_256.wgsl", buf, (size_t)n);
    if ((n = wgsl_pull_test_module(buf, sizeof buf)) > 0) put("pulltest.wgsl", buf, (size_t)n);
    if (g_ix){ fprintf(g_ix, "builtin vs_0 ps_0 ps_256 pulltest\n"); fflush(g_ix); }
    fprintf(stderr, "[shaderdump] writing shaders to %s\n", g_dir);
    return 1;
}

void wgsl_dump_obj(const char *kind, int idx, const void *tok, size_t bytes, const VSProg *p){
    if (!wgsl_dump_on()) return;
    char name[64];
    snprintf(name, sizeof name, "%sobj_%d.bin", kind, idx);
    put(name, tok, bytes);
    snprintf(name, sizeof name, "%sobj_%d.asm", kind, idx);
    char path[640]; snprintf(path, sizeof path, "%s/%s", g_dir, name);
    FILE *f = fopen(path, "w");
    if (f){ vs_disasm(p, f); fclose(f); }
    if (g_ix){
        unsigned v = vs_version(p);
        fprintf(g_ix, "obj %s %d %s_%u_%u bytes=%zu instr=%u unknown=%u\n", kind, idx, kind,
                v >> 8, v & 0xFF, bytes, vs_ninstr(p), vs_unknown(p));
        fflush(g_ix);
    }
}

static const char *const DECLTYPE[] = { "FLOAT1", "FLOAT2", "FLOAT3", "FLOAT4", "D3DCOLOR", "UBYTE4",

void wgsl_dump_vs(int gid, int vsobj, uint32_t decl, const int dcl[16][2], const char *wgsl, int len){

    if (g_ix){

        int first = 1;

            if (dcl[i][0] < 0) continue;

        }
        fprintf(g_ix, " %s\n", len > 0 ? "ok" : "REJECTED");
        fflush(g_ix);
    }
}

void wgsl_dump_ps(int id, int psobj, const char *wgsl, int len){

void wgsl_dump_decl(uint32_t obj, const void *elems, size_t bytes){

}

/* wasm: stack high-water probe (NFSU2_STACKPROBE=1).
 *
 * Every lifted guest call is a wasm call, so a deep guest call chain uses the
 * engine's native stack, which the page cannot size (about 1 MB in a Chrome
 * worker) and whose overflow is a RangeError that kills the thread.  This
 * records how deep the game goes, per guest thread: at a Win32/COM call
 * (dispatch.c) whose guest stack is deeper than any before on that thread
 * (in 4 KB steps), and otherwise at most every 2 s,
 *   - the guest stack in use: from where the thread started (every guest
 *     thread starts 4 KB below its StackBase: win32_ext.c, main_web.c) down
 *     to esp, and
 *   - the engine call depth: frames on the thread's stack, wasm and JS, from
 *     a stack trace (web/src/host/game-worker.ts, nfsu2.stack_frames).
 * Both are samples at Win32/COM calls only, so the true maxima can be higher
 * (guest code that recurses without calling out is never seen): read them as
 * lower bounds.  Byte usage of the engine stack cannot be read from the page:
 * a recursion probe is not stable in Chrome (4536 to 7352 frames of the same
 * interpreted function in the same place), so frames are the measure, and how
 * far that is from a RangeError is not measured here.  New maxima are logged
 * as [stack] lines; the exit report lists each thread's maxima, with the
 * return address of the call that reached them. */
#include "cpu.h"
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include "web/host_abi.h"

__attribute__((import_module("nfsu2"), import_name("stack_frames"))) int nfsu2_stack_frames(void);

int g_stackprobe = -1;                  /* -1: not read yet */
#define START_GAP 0x1000u             /* a thread's first esp is StackBase - 4 KB */
typedef struct { uint32_t tid, guest_b, guest_at, frames, frames_at, logged, probes; } Probe;
static Probe g_pr[64]; static int g_npr;  /* each entry written by its own thread, under the guest lock */
static _Thread_local Probe *tl_pr;
static _Thread_local uint32_t tl_low = ~0u;
static _Thread_local double tl_next_ms;

int stackprobe_on(void){
    if (g_stackprobe < 0){ const char *e = getenv("NFSU2_STACKPROBE"); g_stackprobe = e && *e && *e != '0'; }
    return g_stackprobe;
}

void stackprobe_check(CPU *c){
    double now = nfsu2_now_ms();
    int deeper = c->esp + 0x1000u < tl_low;
    if (!deeper && now < tl_next_ms) return;
    tl_next_ms = now + 2000.0;
    if (deeper) tl_low = c->esp;
    if (!tl_pr){
        uint32_t tid = c->fs_base ? MR32(c->fs_base + 0x24u) : 0u;
        for (int i = 0; i < g_npr; i++) if (g_pr[i].tid == tid){ tl_pr = &g_pr[i]; break; }
        if (!tl_pr && g_npr < 64){ tl_pr = &g_pr[g_npr++]; tl_pr->tid = tid; }
        if (!tl_pr) return;
    }
    Probe *p = tl_pr;
    uint32_t top = c->fs_base ? MR32(c->fs_base + 0x04u) : 0u;
    uint32_t start = top > START_GAP ? top - START_GAP : 0u;
    uint32_t gb = start > c->esp ? start - c->esp : 0u;
    /* the guest's call pushed its return address: the call site */
    uint32_t at = mem_is_committed(c->esp) ? MR32(c->esp) : 0u;
    int fr = nfsu2_stack_frames();
    p->probes++;
    if (gb > p->guest_b){ p->guest_b = gb; p->guest_at = at; }
    if (fr > 0 && (uint32_t)fr > p->frames){ p->frames = (uint32_t)fr; p->frames_at = at; }
    if (p->frames >= p->logged + p->logged / 4 + 8){     /* log when the maximum grew by a quarter */
        fprintf(stderr, "[stack] tid %u: engine call depth %u frames, guest stack %.1f KB in use (call returning to 0x%08x)\n",
                p->tid, p->frames, gb / 1024.0, at);
        p->logged = p->frames;
    }
}

void stackprobe_report(void){
    if (!stackprobe_on() || !g_npr) return;
    fprintf(stderr, "\n  stack high-water (NFSU2_STACKPROBE), sampled at Win32/COM calls (lower bounds): engine call depth"
                    " (wasm + JS frames) and guest stack in use, each with the call's return address\n");
    for (int i = 0; i < g_npr; i++)
        fprintf(stderr, "    tid %-4u engine >= %5u frames (0x%08x)  guest >= %6.1f KB (0x%08x)  %u probes\n", g_pr[i].tid,
                g_pr[i].frames, g_pr[i].frames_at, g_pr[i].guest_b / 1024.0, g_pr[i].guest_at, g_pr[i].probes);
}

/* HOST_KIND_STATUS: counters for the page's frame-rate overlay
 * (web/src/app/status.ts reads them).
 *
 * Self-describing on purpose: a table of named doubles, so any part of the
 * web runtime (renderer, audio, pacing) can publish a counter with
 * host_status_slot()/host_status_set() without a layout change on the page.
 * The page shows the change in "frames" over the change in "frames_t" (the
 * C clock when frames was read, ms) as the game's frame rate, and lists the
 * rest in the detailed overlay.
 *
 * Consistency: a sequence lock.  The writer makes seq odd, writes, makes it
 * even; the page copies the table and keeps the copy only if seq was even
 * and unchanged around it.  Names are NUL-padded ASCII. */
#ifndef NFSU2_STATUS_PROTO_H
#define NFSU2_STATUS_PROTO_H
#include <stdint.h>

#define HOST_STATUS_MAGIC 0x31545453u      /* "STT1" */
#define HOST_STATUS_MAX   48         /* 32 until 2026-11-04: by then 35 names, so photo mode's last ones never showed */
#define HOST_STATUS_NAME  16

typedef struct { char name[HOST_STATUS_NAME]; double value; } HostStatusItem;   /* 24 bytes */
#include "radio_proto.h"

typedef struct {
    uint32_t magic;        /* HOST_STATUS_MAGIC */
    uint32_t seq;          /* sequence lock, even = stable */
    uint32_t count;        /* items in use */
    uint32_t period_ms;    /* how often the publisher refreshes the table */
    HostStatusItem item[HOST_STATUS_MAX];
    HostStatusRadio radio;
} HostStatus;

_Static_assert(sizeof(HostStatusItem) == 24, "page layout (status.ts)");
/* the radio's words right after the table (radio-link.ts); the block may end in padding, the doubles' alignment */
_Static_assert(__builtin_offsetof(HostStatus, radio) == 16 + 24 * HOST_STATUS_MAX, "page layout (status.ts)");

/* status_web.c */
int  host_status_slot(const char *name);          /* index of a named counter (created on first use), -1 if full */
void host_status_set(int slot, double value);
void host_status_set_n(const int *slot, const double *value, int n);   /* in one consistent section */
HostStatusRadio *host_status_radio(void);         /* the radio's words, shared with the page */
#endif

{"id": "AT000655", "source": "archive:A028!/nfsu2-web-public/runtime/web/status_web.c", "originalBytes": 13543, "originalSha256": "3c03e052f42496f13e2fb0fb275d35ece0fbcf7ae54150d7fe4f3aa96ff46297", "originalEncoding": "utf-8", "utf8RangeStart": 0, "utf8RangeEnd": 13543, "utf8TotalBytes": 13543}

/* The page's frame-rate overlay reads the game's own counters from here
 * (HOST_KIND_STATUS, layout in status_proto.h).  A small thread refreshes
 * the renderer's counters four times a second; other parts of the web
 * runtime may set their own with host_status_set().  With the null renderer
 * "frames" still counts the game's presents, so the overlay shows the game's
 * frame rate rather than the page's display rate. */
#include "cpu.h"
#include "game.h"
#include "status_proto.h"
#include "host_abi.h"
#include <pthread.h>
#include <string.h>
#include <strings.h>
#include <stdio.h>
#include <time.h>
#include <unistd.h>

long metal_frames(void); long metal_tris(void); long metal_tex_created(void);
unsigned long metal_tex_released(void); long metal_frames_dropped(void);

static HostStatus g_st;
static pthread_mutex_t g_mu = PTHREAD_MUTEX_INITIALIZER;

int host_status_slot(const char *name){
    pthread_mutex_lock(&g_mu);
    int i = 0;
    for (; i < (int)g_st.count; i++) if (!strncmp(g_st.item[i].name, name, HOST_STATUS_NAME)) break;
    if (i == (int)g_st.count){
        if (i >= HOST_STATUS_MAX){
            pthread_mutex_unlock(&g_mu);
            fprintf(stderr, "[status] no room for \"%s\": all %d places taken, the page never sees it\n", name, HOST_STATUS_MAX);
            return -1;
        }
        __atomic_add_fetch(&g_st.seq, 1, __ATOMIC_RELEASE);
        strncpy(g_st.item[i].name, name, HOST_STATUS_NAME);
        g_st.item[i].value = 0;
        __atomic_store_n(&g_st.count, (uint32_t)i + 1, __ATOMIC_RELAXED);
        __atomic_add_fetch(&g_st.seq, 1, __ATOMIC_RELEASE);
    }
    pthread_mutex_unlock(&g_mu);
    return i;
}

void host_status_set(int slot, double value){ host_status_set_n(&slot, &value, 1); }

/* several counters in one sequence-lock section, so the page never sees one
 * of them newer than another (frames and frames_t below) */
void host_status_set_n(const int *slot, const double *value, int n){
    pthread_mutex_lock(&g_mu);
    __atomic_add_fetch(&g_st.seq, 1, __ATOMIC_RELEASE);
    for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) if (slot[i] >= 0 && slot[i] < HOST_STATUS_MAX) g_st.item[slot[i]].value = value[i];
    __atomic_add_fetch(&g_st.seq, 1, __ATOMIC_RELEASE);
    pthread_mutex_unlock(&g_mu);
}

HostStatusRadio *host_status_radio(void){ return &g_st.radio; }

/* "frames_t" is the time "frames" was read, in ms on CLOCK_MONOTONIC (the
 * page's performance.timeOrigin + now(), the same clock).  The page divides
 * the change in frames by the change in frames_t: its own sampling times
 * (animation frames, about every 250 ms) do not line up with this thread's
 * updates, and dividing by them misread a steady 60 fps as 56 or 75 (phase-1
 * app review, finding 1). */
static void *status_main(void *unused){
    (void)unused;
    int slot[5] = { host_status_slot("frames"), host_status_slot("frames_t"), host_status_slot("frames_dropped"),
                    host_status_slot("tris"), host_status_slot("textures") };
    for (;;){
        struct timespec ts; clock_gettime(CLOCK_MONOTONIC, &ts);
        double v[5] = { (double)metal_frames(), ts.tv_sec * 1e3 + ts.tv_nsec * 1e-6, (double)metal_frames_dropped(),
                        (double)metal_tris(), (double)metal_tex_created() - (double)metal_tex_released() };
        host_status_set_n(slot, v, 5);
        usleep(g_st.period_ms * 1000u);
    }
    return 0;
}

/* "drive": what the page's touch controls (web/src/app/touch.ts) need of the
 * game, set at every Present (autotest.c): 1 while the player drives in a
 * race (the crib's test runs too: roam.c roam_exploring), 2 in free roam,
 * 0 elsewhere, plus 4 with a manual gearbox and 8
 * during a cutscene (the touch controls' level horizon waits).  Driving
 * is GameFlow 6 with a race HUD (HUD_*.fng) the top package; the pause menu
 * (UI_pause.fng), the results, the world's loading screen and the Engage
 * dialog over the HUD are not, nor is a cutscene in free roam (NIS, as
 * runtime/discord.c tells one).  A race's start is one too, the camera's
 * flight round the grid and the countdown until a moment after the start, so
 * a race drives during a cutscene: the player revs on the line and goes at
 * once (a player's report: the controls came seconds after the others left).
 * The gearbox is manual in a drag race (the game asks nothing there and sets
 * the car's gearbox to manual), else as the race's Transmission choice set
 * it: the player's setting 1 (0x4a7b30), kept at player 0 (0x8900ac) +0x20
 * and handed to the car's gearbox (0x407280: 0 and 2 shift by themselves, 1
 * and 3 keep the gear).  The gearbox itself is no good to read: in a drag
 * race the car's controls (+0x30) become the game's lane steering once it
 * rolls. */
#define G_PLAYER0    SPLIT_PLAYERS_INDEX
#define PL_GEARBOX   0x20u
#define G_RACE_DRAG  0x0089e7d8u      /* race parameters (discord.c G_RACE) + R_DRAG */
const char *autotest_top_fng(void);
int career_fe_active(const char *name);
int roam_exploring(void);
static int manual_gearbox(int race){
    if (race && MR8(G_RACE_DRAG)) return 1;
    uint32_t p = mem_is_committed(G_PLAYER0 + 3u) ? MR32(G_PLAYER0) : 0u;
    if (!p || !mem_is_committed(p + PL_GEARBOX)) return 0;
    uint8_t g = MR8(p + PL_GEARBOX);
    return g == 1u || g == 3u;
}
static int drive_state(void){
    unsigned flow = mem_is_committed(G_FLOW + 3u) ? MR32(G_FLOW) : 0u;
    const char *top = autotest_top_fng();
    int hud = top && !strncasecmp(top, "HUD_", 4) && strcasecmp(top, "HUD_World_Loading.fng");
    int nis = mem_is_committed(0x827ecbu) && (MR32(0x827e98u) | MR32(0x827eb0u) | MR32(0x827ec8u));
    int engage = career_fe_active("UI_EngageMessageDialog.fng");
    int roam = roam_exploring();
    int v = flow == 6u && hud && !engage && !(roam && nis) ? (roam ? 2 : 1) : 0;
    if (v && manual_gearbox(v == 1)) v |= 4;
    if (v && nis) v |= 8;
    /* a line at each change, for a player's log */
    static unsigned l_flow = ~0u; static int l_hud = -1, l_nis = -1, l_engage = -1, l_v = -1;
    if (flow != l_flow || hud != l_hud || nis != l_nis || engage != l_engage || v != l_v){
        l_flow = flow; l_hud = hud; l_nis = nis; l_engage = engage; l_v = v;
        fprintf(stderr, "[drive] f=%ld flow=%u top=%s nis=%d engage=%d -> %d\n", metal_frames(), flow, top ? top : "-", nis, engage, v);
    }
    return v;
}
/* "rate": the frame rate the game paces to now (framerate.c content_rate:
 * the mode's rate, 30 in a cutscene, at most 120 in a network race; 0 =
 * uncapped), so the page can tell whether the game keeps up with it
 * (web/src/app/rendercheck.ts) */
int hfr_rate_now(void);
/* "pause": 1 while the game's pause menu (UI_Pause.fng) is the top package,
 * not its options or a question over it, so the page can point to its own
 * menu under the panel (web/src/app/pausehint.ts) */
static int pause_state(void){
    const char *top = autotest_top_fng();
    return top && !strcasecmp(top, "UI_Pause.fng");
}
/* "roam_cars", "roam_friends": friends' cars the game holds and friends
 * connected in free roam (roam_game.c), for the page's copy of the log
 * (web/src/app/lastgame.ts): what a phone held when Safari stopped the page.
 * The friends take the session lock, so every 30th frame. */
int roam_game_cars(void); int roam_game_friends(void);
static void roam_state(void){
    static int slot[2] = { -2, -2 }, n;
    static double last[2] = { -1, -1 };
    if (slot[0] == -2){ slot[0] = host_status_slot("roam_cars"); slot[1] = host_status_slot("roam_friends"); }
    double v[2] = { (double)roam_game_cars(), n++ % 30 ? last[1] : (double)roam_game_friends() };
    if (v[0] != last[0] || v[1] != last[1]){ last[0] = v[0]; last[1] = v[1]; host_status_set_n(slot, v, 2); }
}
/* "engage", "roam_near": for the touch controls' free-roam buttons
 * (web/src/app/touch.ts).  "engage" is 1 while Engage (Enter, the pad's
 * D-pad Up) does something in free roam, so Start shows only then: the
 * player's car on an event's or a shop's marker (player +0x9AC, what Engage
 * would enter), the game's own outrun offer (the career's outrun state 2,
 * set with the HUD's outrun icon by 0x500D20 and tested by 0x500D80), or one
 * of ours (roam_game_engage: a friend's outrun, a multiplayer-only race spot,
 * a lobby to join or to start).  "roam_near": friends' cars within a horn's
 * reach (roam_game_near), so Horn and Quick chat show only then.
 * "hydraulics": while the player drives a car with hydraulics, so the
 * Pressurize and Bounce buttons show only then: the level its Hydraulics part
 * gives it (RideInfo +0x581), or the game's own for every car when that is
 * not -1, as the driver's hydraulics controls (0x4078A0) read it.  2 while
 * a press of H or J would set them going, 1 while not: they start 0.22 s
 * after the press (0x407400) if the car is then at 10 mph or less and the
 * race has them (0x407370 with 1; the press itself only counts under 30
 * mph), so a key held from faster never starts them.  The page presses its
 * key again when this goes to 2, and shows the buttons only then (or while
 * one is on).  "fast": 1 while the player's car goes over FAST_ON_KMH, 0 again
 * under FAST_OFF_KMH, so Reset shows only when the car is slow (stuck, after a
 * crash), not where a stray tap at speed would set it back on the road. */
#define PL_MARKER    0x9acu
#define PL_CAR       4u
#define G_OUTRUN_ST  0x00860a58u      /* Career4230 (0x85EF70) +0x1AE8 */
#define G_HYD_LEVEL  0x007e949cu      /* int: every car's hydraulics level, -1: each its own */
#define G_HYD_ON     0x007e94a0u      /* byte: the hydraulics at all */
#define FAST_ON_KMH  30.f
#define FAST_OFF_KMH 25.f
int roam_game_engage(void); int roam_game_near(void);
static uint32_t rd32_ok(uint32_t a){ return a && mem_is_committed(a) && mem_is_committed(a + 3u) ? MR32(a) : 0u; }
static int hydraulics(void){
    uint32_t car = rd32_ok(rd32_ok(G_PLAYER0) + PL_CAR), ride = rd32_ok(car + 0x10u);
    int32_t lv = ride && mem_is_committed(ride + 0x581u) ? (int8_t)MR8(ride + 0x581u) : 0, all = (int32_t)rd32_ok(G_HYD_LEVEL);
    if ((all > -1 ? all : lv) == 0) return 0;
    /* 0x407370 (1): races of the kinds without them (the race parameters' bytes, as it reads them), the speed */
    if (!MR8(G_HYD_ON) || MR8(0x0089e7d9u) || MR32(0x00890104u) || MR8(0x0089e7e3u) || MR32(0x0089010cu)) return 1;
    return mem_is_committed(car + CAR_SPEED + 3u) && MRF32(car + CAR_SPEED) * 2.237f <= 10.f ? 2 : 1;
}
static int fast(void){
    static int on;
    uint32_t car = rd32_ok(rd32_ok(G_PLAYER0) + PL_CAR);
    if (!car || !mem_is_committed(car + CAR_SPEED + 3u)) return on = 0;
    float kmh = MRF32(car + CAR_SPEED) * 3.6f;
    if (kmh < 0.f) kmh = -kmh;                    /* (backwards too) */
    return on = on ? kmh >= FAST_OFF_KMH : kmh > FAST_ON_KMH;
}
static void touch_state(int drive){
    static int slot[4] = { -2, -2, -2, -2 };
    static double last[4] = { -1, -1, -1, -1 };
    if (slot[0] == -2){ slot[0] = host_status_slot("engage"); slot[1] = host_status_slot("roam_near"); slot[2] = host_status_slot("hydraulics");
                        slot[3] = host_status_slot("fast"); }
    int roam = (drive & 3) == 2;
    uint32_t p = roam && mem_is_committed(G_PLAYER0 + 3u) ? MR32(G_PLAYER0) : 0u;
    int marker = p && mem_is_committed(p + PL_MARKER + 3u) && MR32(p + PL_MARKER);
    int outrun = roam && mem_is_committed(G_OUTRUN_ST + 3u) && MR32(G_OUTRUN_ST) == 2u;
    double v[4] = { roam && (marker || outrun || roam_game_engage()), roam ? (double)roam_game_near() : 0, (drive & 3) ? hydraulics() : 0,
                    (drive & 3) ? fast() : 0 };
    if (memcmp(v, last, sizeof v)){ memcpy(last, v, sizeof v); host_status_set_n(slot, v, 4); }
}
/* "sms": the text message of ours (sms.c) the game has in its inbox this
 * game, 0 none, so the page asks for it no more (web/src/app/playtime.ts) */
int sms_delivered(void);
/* "nocount": 1 while a countdown of the player's would not start where they
 * are in free roam (roam_game_nocount: a car meet, and they have not stayed),
 * so quick chat's picker dims it (web/src/app/quickchat.ts) */
int roam_game_nocount(void);
void status_web_frame(void){
    static int slot = -2, last = -1, rslot = -2, rlast = -1, pslot = -2, plast = -1, sslot = -2, slast = -1, cslot = -2, clast = -1;
    if (slot == -2){ slot = host_status_slot("drive"); rslot = host_status_slot("rate"); pslot = host_status_slot("pause"); sslot = host_status_slot("sms");
                     cslot = host_status_slot("nocount"); }
    int v = drive_state();
    if (v != last && slot >= 0){ last = v; host_status_set(slot, v); }
    int r = hfr_rate_now();
    if (r != rlast && rslot >= 0){ rlast = r; host_status_set(rslot, r); }
    int p = pause_state();
    if (p != plast && pslot >= 0){ plast = p; host_status_set(pslot, p); }
    int m = sms_delivered();
    if (m != slast && sslot >= 0){ slast = m; host_status_set(sslot, m); }
    int nc = (v & 3) == 2 && roam_game_nocount();
    if (nc != clast && cslot >= 0){ clast = nc; host_status_set(cslot, nc); }
    roam_state();
    touch_state(v);
}

/* main_web.c, before the guest starts */
void status_web_start(void){
    g_st.magic = HOST_STATUS_MAGIC;
    g_st.radio.radio_magic = RADIO_MAGIC;
    g_st.radio.radio_version = RADIO_VERSION;
    g_st.period_ms = 250;
    nfsu2_register(HOST_KIND_STATUS, &g_st, sizeof g_st);
    pthread_attr_t at; pthread_attr_init(&at);
    pthread_attr_setstacksize(&at, 64u * 1024u);
    pthread_t th;
    if (pthread_create(&th, &at, status_main, 0) == 0) pthread_detach(th);
}
