/* ---- HYBRID virtual clock ---------------------------------------------
 * Tried:
 *   (a) fixed increment per call -> irregular time, animations broken
 *   (b) real monotonic clock     -> the emulator is slow, so the game sees a
 *       huge "elapsed time" every frame and enters its catch-up loop (20->1 fps)
 *   (c) only 16.67 ms per frame -> frame pacing right BUT code that waits on
 *       time without presenting a frame (video player) goes into an ENDLESS
 *       LOOP: measured, timeGetTime was called 231 million times.
 *   (d) CHOSEN: 16.67 ms per frame + creep forward slowly when the clock is
 *       polled many times and no frame arrives.  That keeps the pacing right
 *       and guarantees progress for loops that wait on time.          */
static _Atomic uint64_t g_vclock_base  = 0;   /* virtual time at frame start */
static _Atomic uint64_t g_vclock_creep = 0;   /* busy-wait compensation     */
static _Atomic uint64_t g_real_base    = 0;   /* real time of that frame    */
static _Atomic uint32_t g_vclock_polls = 0;
static _Atomic int      g_vclock_fast  = 0;   /* NFSU2_FAST: track the highest reading */
static _Atomic uint64_t g_vclock_hw    = 0;   /* ... of this frame (vclock_tick)       */

#ifdef __wasm__
#include "web/host_abi.h"
#endif
static uint64_t real_us(void){
#ifdef __wasm__
    /* The guest's most frequent host call (QueryPerformanceCounter, timeGetTime:
     * ~1,000 a race frame).  The page's monotonic clock without WASI's
     * clock_time_get, whose i64 argument costs a BigInt on every call into JS. */
    return (uint64_t)(nfsu2_now_ms() * 1000.0);
#else
    struct timespec ts;
    clock_gettime(CLOCK_MONOTONIC, &ts);
    return (uint64_t)ts.tv_sec * 1000000ull + (uint64_t)ts.tv_nsec / 1000ull;
#endif
}

/* Virtual clock.
 * BETWEEN frames it advances exactly 16.667 ms: animation speed stays
 * independent of the emulator's speed.  WITHIN a frame it runs smoothly,
 * proportional to real time -- because the game measures the frame time by
 * sampling the clock TWICE within a frame and taking the difference
 * (0x005812d5).  The old clock, which jumped in one step, made it conclude
 * "the frame took zero", so the front-end tick [0x8651a8] never advanced
 * and every animation/timed transition froze. */
/* Measure the ratio of virtual time to real time: clock changes must not
 * speed the game up (it once ran at 2.01x). */
static _Atomic uint64_t g_vt_last = 0, g_rt_start = 0, g_vt_start = 0;
void vclock_report(void){
    uint64_t v0 = atomic_load(&g_vt_start), r0 = atomic_load(&g_rt_start);
    uint64_t v1 = atomic_load(&g_vt_last),  r1 = real_us();
    if (!r0 || r1 <= r0) return;
    fprintf(stderr, "  virtual clock     : %.3f x real time (%.1f s virtual / %.1f s real)\n",
            (double)(v1 - v0) / (double)(r1 - r0),
            (double)(v1 - v0)/1e6, (double)(r1 - r0)/1e6);
}
void vclock_tick(void){
    uint64_t cr = atomic_exchange(&g_vclock_creep, 0ull);
    uint64_t now = real_us();
    /* Per-frame advance.
     *   VCLOCK=fixed : exactly 16.667 ms per frame (old behaviour).  When the
     *                  emulator drops below 60 fps the GAME RUNS IN SLOW
     *                  MOTION -- and since the music is also played from
     *                  the game's clock, its pitch drops.  That was exactly
     *                  the user's "music slows down when fps drops"
     *                  (measured: at 50 fps virtual/real = 0.885, i.e. ~2
     *                  semitones flat).
     *   VCLOCK=real  : REAL elapsed time (default).  Game and music both
     *                  run in real time.  The per-frame step is capped at
     *                  50 ms so the game does not enter its catch-up loop.
     *   NFSU2_FAST   : (framerate.c, tests) the game time of the frame (one
     *                  slot; 33.3 ms in a 30 fps cutscene), whatever the wall
     *                  clock did, but never less than the frame's own
     *                  readings ran ahead (g_vclock_hw): no step back. */
    { static _Atomic int mode = -1;
      int m = atomic_load(&mode);
      if (m < 0){ const char *e = ENVC("VCLOCK"); int hfr_fast(void);
                  m = hfr_fast() ? 2 : (e && *e == 'f') ? 0 : 1; atomic_store(&mode, m);
                  if (m == 2) atomic_store(&g_vclock_fast, 1); }
      uint64_t rb = atomic_load(&g_real_base);
      uint64_t step = 16667ull;
      if (m == 2){
          uint64_t hfr_fast_frame_us(void); step = hfr_fast_frame_us();
          uint64_t hw = atomic_exchange(&g_vclock_hw, 0ull), b = atomic_load(&g_vclock_base);
          if (hw > b + cr && hw - b - cr >= step) step = hw - b - cr + 1ull;
      } else if (m && rb && now > rb){
          step = now - rb;
          /* above 250 fps: clamp.  The floor is 4 ms up to 120 fps content and
           * lower for 240 / uncapped (framerate.c), where frames routinely
           * come in under 4 ms. */
          { uint64_t hfr_vclock_floor_us(void); uint64_t fl = hfr_vclock_floor_us();
            if (step < fl) step = fl; }
          if (step > 50000ull) step = 50000ull;   /* huge dt -> catch-up loop */
      }
      atomic_fetch_add(&g_vclock_base, step + cr); }
    atomic_store(&g_real_base, now);
    atomic_store(&g_vclock_polls, 0);
    { uint64_t v = atomic_load(&g_vclock_base);
      if (!atomic_load(&g_rt_start)){ atomic_store(&g_rt_start, real_us());
                                      atomic_store(&g_vt_start, v); }
      atomic_store(&g_vt_last, v); }
}

/* oracle.c (cmp): the clock stands still while one guest function runs
 * twice (under the emulator, then lifted), so both see the same QPC/ms. */
_Atomic uint64_t g_vclock_freeze = 0;
uint64_t host_us(void){
    { uint64_t fz = atomic_load(&g_vclock_freeze); if (__builtin_expect(fz != 0, 0)) return fz; }
    uint64_t base = atomic_load(&g_vclock_base);
    uint64_t rb   = atomic_load(&g_real_base);
    uint64_t now  = real_us();
    uint64_t d    = (now > rb) ? (now - rb) : 0ull;
    /* Cap on the advance WITHIN a frame.  16 ms was FAR TOO TIGHT: code that
     * waits more than 16 ms of GAME time in one frame (the pre-race cut
     * scene) hit the cap and could only move on through the safety valve
     * below (after 200 ms) -> every frame was forced to take ~235 ms (4.6 fps,
     * measured).  Removing the cap entirely does not work either: the game
     * sees the real elapsed time and enters its catch-up loop.  A three-frame
     * budget is a good middle ground. */
    { static _Atomic uint64_t maxd = 0;
      uint64_t m = atomic_load(&maxd);
      if (!m){ const char *e = ENVC("VCLOCK_MAXD");
               m = (e && *e) ? (uint64_t)strtoull(e,0,0) : 50000ull;
               if (m < 16000ull) m = 16000ull;
               atomic_store(&maxd, m); }
      if (d > m) d = m; }

    /* Safety valve for loops that spin on the clock without producing a frame.
     *
     * NOTE: the criterion used to be the POLL COUNT (>2000 polls per frame ->
     * 400 us every 64 polls, 2 ms above 20000...).  More than 20 thousand
     * clock polls in a busy race frame is NORMAL; this added ~100 ms of fake
     * time per frame.  Measured: 2.04 s virtual in 1.01 s real (ratio 2.01)
     * -- cut scenes and the race ran twice as fast.  Now the criterion is
     * REAL TIME: it only kicks in when the frame has taken longer than
     * 200 ms (i.e. really stalled) and adds at most 100 ms per frame. */
    uint32_t n = atomic_fetch_add(&g_vclock_polls, 1);
    uint64_t stalled = (now > rb) ? (now - rb) : 0ull;      /* unclamped */
    /* Safety valve: threshold 200 ms -> 60 ms, step 2 ms -> 4 ms.  Since the
     * cap went up, this path now only runs on REAL stalls. */
    if (stalled > 60000ull){
        if (atomic_load(&g_vclock_creep) < 200000ull){
            if ((n & 15u) == 15u) atomic_fetch_add(&g_vclock_creep, 4000ull);
        } else
            /* Past the 200 ms the clock must still move, or a busy-wait in
             * the same long frame never sees its deadline: 0x45A630 waits
             * 20 ticks for each sound object it destroys on the way into a
             * race, and the career hung there for good when that frame had
             * already run long (career-46/seg08).  1 us per read keeps the
             * frame's extra game time small. */
            atomic_fetch_add(&g_vclock_creep, 1ull);
    }
    uint64_t v = base + d + atomic_load(&g_vclock_creep);
    if (__builtin_expect(atomic_load_explicit(&g_vclock_fast, memory_order_relaxed), 0)){
        uint64_t h = atomic_load(&g_vclock_hw);
        while (v > h && !atomic_compare_exchange_weak(&g_vclock_hw, &h, v)) {}
    }
    return v;
}
/* the virtual clock for another thread that only watches it (audio_web.c's
 * mixer under NFSU2_FAST): no poll counted, no safety valve; the base and the
 * frame's own real time, uncapped.  A frame that runs for seconds (a replay's
 * start, 11-04: 15 s in sub_005e6c10) waits on the DirectSound cursor, so the
 * mixer must keep moving in real time as it does without NFSU2_FAST; with the
 * time capped at one step it stood still and the game froze.  The reading
 * raises the high-water mark, so the next frame's base is never behind it. */
uint64_t vclock_peek_us(void){
    uint64_t base = atomic_load(&g_vclock_base), rb = atomic_load(&g_real_base), now = real_us();
    uint64_t d = (now > rb) ? (now - rb) : 0ull;
    uint64_t v = base + d + atomic_load(&g_vclock_creep);
    if (atomic_load(&g_vclock_fast)){
        uint64_t h = atomic_load(&g_vclock_hw);
        while (v > h && !atomic_compare_exchange_weak(&g_vclock_hw, &h, v)) {}
    }
    return v;
}
uint32_t host_ms(void){ return (uint32_t)(host_us() / 1000ull) + 1000u; }
uint64_t host_qpc(void){ return host_us(); }

uint32_t win32_block_size(uint32_t u){ return gheap_usize(u); }
/* guest address space the heap has reserved (the bump pointer with
 * NFSU2_HEAP=bump), and the bytes in live heap blocks (status line "heap=") */
uint32_t win32_heap_used(void){ uint64_t v = 0; heap_totals(0, 0, &v, 0); return (uint32_t)v; }
uint32_t win32_heap_live(void){ uint64_t l = 0; heap_totals(&l, 0, 0, 0); return (uint32_t)l; }

/* --- tracing --- */
typedef struct { uint32_t calls; uint32_t unimpl; } ImpStat;
static ImpStat *stat_;
static uint32_t trace_n = 0, trace_max = 0;
void win32_set_trace_max(uint32_t v){ trace_max = v; }
static uint32_t unimpl_first = 0xffffffffu;
static const char *unimpl_name = 0;
uint64_t g_win32_calls = 0, g_win32_unimpl = 0;

static uint32_t tls_slot[128]; static int tls_next = 0;
static uint32_t tls_free[128]; static int tls_nfree = 0;
int win32_tls_in_use(void){ return tls_next - tls_nfree; }
static uint32_t g_cmdline = 0;
static uint64_t tick0;

static uint32_t ARG(CPU*c,int i){ return MR32(c->esp + 4u*(uint32_t)i); }  /* after the return address has been POPped */

/* QPCWHO=1: who calls QueryPerformanceCounter (thread, return address, one
 * frame up).  At 120 fps ~21 thousand calls per frame were seen (~2
 * thousand at 60 fps PACE60): a time-based wait loop.  The call runs under
 * the GIL, the table is lock-free. */
typedef struct { uint32_t tid, ra, ra2; uint64_t n; } QpcWho;
static QpcWho g_qw[128];
static void qpc_report(void){
    fprintf(stderr, "\n=== QPCWHO: QueryPerformanceCounter callers ===\n");
    for (int k = 0; k < 128; k++){
        int b = -1;
        for (int i = 0; i < 128; i++) if (g_qw[i].n && (b < 0 || g_qw[i].n > g_qw[b].n)) b = i;
        if (b < 0 || k >= 24) break;
        fprintf(stderr, "  %12llu  thread %5u  return 0x%08x  parent 0x%08x\n",
                (unsigned long long)g_qw[b].n, g_qw[b].tid, g_qw[b].ra, g_qw[b].ra2);
        g_qw[b].n = 0;
    }
}
/* ---- The game's frame wait loop: sleep instead of spinning ----
 * sub_0057ead0 (0x57eb4e..0x57eb7e), when the frame time dt is below target:
 *     start = GetTicks(); target = (X - dt) * k;
 *     do { elapsed = Diff(start, GetTicks()); } while (elapsed < target);
 * GetTicks = sub_0043bdf0 = QPC >> [0x8284e4]; Diff = sub_0043be20 =
 * (now - start) * 2^S * [0x828028] seconds.  The loop only looks at the
 * clock; at 120 fps ~19 thousand QPCs per frame and ALL of the game
 * thread's idle time (8.2 ms of CPU per frame, 98%) burned here: every ms
 * saved in D3DX went here, the power draw did not change.
 * On a QPC from the loop (return 0x43bdfe, its caller 0x57eb69) the time
 * left is computed with the game's own formula and we sleep for (left -
 * margin); the final margin is still waited out spinning.  The exit
 * condition and the clock are the same, so the game's timing does not
 * change, only the CPU goes idle.  The sleep uses kevent NOTE_CRITICAL
 * (guest_sleep_ns): nanosleep woke 447 us late on average, kevent 41 us
 * (98% <= 200 us).
 * SPINSLEEP=<margin us> (default 200), SPINSLEEP=0 disables it.
 * Stack: after POP32 [esp+0xc] = 0x57eb69, E = esp+0x14 (0057ead0's local
 * base), target float [E+0xc] = [esp+0x20], start = EBX. */
static int g_spin_margin = -1;
static uint64_t g_spin_n, g_spin_us, g_spin_late[7];   /* late wake-up: <=25,50,100,200,400,800,>800 us */
static void spin_report(void){
    fprintf(stderr, "\n=== SPINSLEEP: the frame wait loop slept %llu times, %.2f s in total (margin %d us) ===\n",
            (unsigned long long)g_spin_n, g_spin_us / 1e6, g_spin_margin);
    fprintf(stderr, "  late wake-ups: <=25us %llu  <=50 %llu  <=100 %llu  <=200 %llu  <=400 %llu  <=800 %llu  >800 %llu\n",
            (unsigned long long)g_spin_late[0], (unsigned long long)g_spin_late[1], (unsigned long long)g_spin_late[2],
            (unsigned long long)g_spin_late[3], (unsigned long long)g_spin_late[4], (unsigned long long)g_spin_late[5],
            (unsigned long long)g_spin_late[6]);
    extern uint64_t g_sleep_late_ns, g_sleep_gil_ns, g_sleep_n;
    if (g_sleep_n) fprintf(stderr, "  average: nanosleep lateness %.0f us, lock wait on wake-up %.0f us\n",
                           g_sleep_late_ns / 1e3 / g_sleep_n, g_sleep_gil_ns / 1e3 / g_sleep_n);
}
uint64_t spin_slept_us(void){ return g_spin_us; }   /* perflog: frame limiter sleep */
static void qpc_spin_sleep(CPU *c){
    if (MR32(c->esp + 0xcu) != 0x57eb69u) return;
    if (g_spin_margin < 0){ const char *e = getenv("SPINSLEEP"); g_spin_margin = e ? atoi(e) : 200;
                            if (g_spin_margin && ENVC("QPCWHO")) atexit(spin_report); }
    if (!g_spin_margin) return;
    /* the game's units: F = [0x828028] per QPC tick (measured 0.001 = ms,
     * k = [0x784550] = 1000), X = [0x865558] = 1/120 s frame target */
    uint32_t S = MR32(0x8284e4u) & 31u;
    float F = MRF32(0x828028u), target = MRF32(c->esp + 0x20u);
    if (!(F > 0.0f) || !(target > 0.0f)) return;
    uint64_t now = host_qpc();
    int32_t d = (int32_t)((uint32_t)(now >> S) - c->ebx); if (d < 0) d = 0;
    double left = (double)target - (double)d * (double)(1u << S) * (double)F;
    double us = left / (double)F - (double)g_spin_margin;      /* QPC tick = us (QPF 1 MHz) */
    if (us < 50.0 || us > 100000.0) return;                  /* short: spin; >0.1 s: unexpected */
    void guest_sleep_ns(int64_t ns);
    guest_sleep_ns((int64_t)(us * 1000.0));
    g_spin_n++; g_spin_us += (uint64_t)us;
    { double late = (double)(host_qpc() - now) - us;         /* us slept beyond what was asked */
      int b = late <= 25 ? 0 : late <= 50 ? 1 : late <= 100 ? 2 : late <= 200 ? 3 : late <= 400 ? 4 : late <= 800 ? 5 : 6;
      g_spin_late[b]++; }
}
static void qpc_who(CPU *c){
    static int init = 0; static uint64_t tot = 0;
    if (!init){ init = 1; atexit(qpc_report); }
    if ((++tot & 0xFFFFFu) == 0){ long metal_frames(void);
        fprintf(stderr, "  [qpc] %llu M calls, frame %ld\n", (unsigned long long)(tot >> 20), metal_frames()); }
    uint32_t tid = (c->fs_base && mem_is_committed(c->fs_base+0x24u)) ? MR32(c->fs_base+0x24u) : 0u;
    uint32_t ra = c->eip;                       /* after POP32: return address */
    /* sub_0043bdf0 (the game's time wrapper): sub esp,8; push arg; call.
     * After POP32 [esp]=arg, [esp+4..0xb]=locals, [esp+0xc]=its caller. */
    uint32_t ra2 = ra == 0x43bdfeu ? MR32(c->esp+0xcu)
                 : (c->ebp && mem_is_committed(c->ebp+4u)) ? MR32(c->ebp+4u) : 0u;
    uint32_t h = (tid * 2654435761u ^ ra * 40503u ^ ra2) & 127u;
    for (int i = 0; i < 128; i++, h = (h + 1) & 127u){
        QpcWho *w = &g_qw[h];
        if (!w->n){ w->tid = tid; w->ra = ra; w->ra2 = ra2; w->n = 1; return; }
        if (w->tid == tid && w->ra == ra && w->ra2 == ra2){ w->n++; return; }
    }
}

/* Import index -> heap.c API kind (0 = not a heap call), filled in win32_init. */
static int8_t *g_hk; static int g_hk_heapalloc;
/* HeapAlloc debugging aids (unchanged from the bump allocator days). */
static void heapalloc_debug(CPU *c, uint32_t r){
    uint32_t sz = ARG(c,2);
    { const char *w = ENVC("TRACE_ALLOC");
      if (w){ uint32_t want = (uint32_t)strtoul(w,0,0);
        if (sz == want){ extern uint32_t g_watch_prev_ip;
          fprintf(stderr,"      [alloc] HeapAlloc(%u) -> 0x%08x   calling guest instruction: 0x%08x\n",
                  sz, r, g_watch_prev_ip);
          guest_backtrace(c, 12); } } }
    /* WATCHALLOC=<size>: set a watchpoint at +16 of the first allocation of
     * that size.  The constant block is written only once, so this is the
     * only way to catch the write. */
    /* WATCHAT=<address>: set a watchpoint on the allocation that returns exactly that address */
    { const char *wa = ENVC("WATCHAT");
      if (wa && r){ static int armed2 = 0;
        uint32_t want3 = (uint32_t)strtoul(wa,0,0);
        if (!armed2 && r == want3){ armed2 = 1;
          void watch_arm(uint32_t);
          const char *wo = ENVC("WATCHOFF");
          uint32_t off3 = wo ? (uint32_t)strtoul(wo,0,0) : 0u;
          fprintf(stderr,"      [alloc] target block 0x%08x (%u bytes) allocated, watching +%u\n",
                  r, sz, off3);
          watch_arm(r + off3);
          if (ENVC("MPROT")){ void mprot_arm(uint32_t); mprot_arm(r + off3); }
        } } }
    { const char *w2 = ENVC("WATCHALLOC");
      if (w2 && r){ static int armed = 0; static int seen = 0;
        uint32_t want2 = (uint32_t)strtoul(w2,0,0);
        const char *ws = ENVC("WATCHALLOC_N");
        int wantn = ws ? atoi(ws) : 1;
        if (!armed && sz == want2 && ++seen == wantn){ armed = 1;
          void watch_arm(uint32_t);
          fprintf(stderr,"      [alloc] %u-byte block 0x%08x allocated; watchpoint at +16\n", sz, r);
          watch_arm(r); } } }
    static int shown=0;
    if (ENVC("VERBOSE") && shown<2 && sz>0x100000u){ shown++;
        fprintf(stderr,"      [heap] HeapAlloc(size=0x%08x) SUSPICIOUS. ebp=0x%08x esp=0x%08x\n", sz, c->ebp, c->esp);
        fprintf(stderr,"        stack (from esp):");
        for(int k=0;k<14;k++) fprintf(stderr," %s%08x", k?"":"", MR32(c->esp+4u*k));
        fprintf(stderr,"\n        around ebp    :");
        for(int k=-4;k<=6;k++) fprintf(stderr," %s%08x", k==0?">":"", MR32(c->ebp+4u*(uint32_t)k));
        fprintf(stderr,"\n        esi=%08x edi=%08x ebx=%08x\n", c->esi,c->edi,c->ebx); }
}

/* Per-thread last error in the TEB (+0x34, the Windows layout): GetLastError /
 * SetLastError, the same slot WSAGetLastError / WSASetLastError use
 * (winsock.c); module.c (server.dll) calls win32_set_last_error too. */
void win32_set_last_error(CPU *c, uint32_t e){
    if (c && c->fs_base && mem_is_committed(c->fs_base + 0x34u)) MR32(c->fs_base + 0x34u) = e;
}
uint32_t win32_get_last_error(CPU *c){
    return (c && c->fs_base && mem_is_committed(c->fs_base + 0x34u)) ? MR32(c->fs_base + 0x34u) : 0u;
}
/* GetModuleHandleA: our exe and the DLLs it imports are "loaded" (they all
 * map to the image, as before, and GetProcAddress resolves by import name);
 * anything else (d3d9d.dll, mscoree.dll, ...) is not. */
static int module_known(uint32_t p){
    if (!mem_is_committed(p)) return 0;
    char nm[64]; snprintf(nm, sizeof nm, "%s", (const char *)(g_mem + p));
    const char *b = nm;
    for (const char *q = nm; *q; q++) if (*q == '\\' || *q == '/') b = q + 1;
    size_t l = strlen(b);
    if (!strcasecmp(b, "speed2.exe") || !strcasecmp(b, "speed2")) return 1;
    for (uint32_t i = 0; i < g_nimps; i++){            /* the exe's and server.dll's imports */
        const char *d = g_imps[i].dll; size_t dl = strlen(d);
        if (!strcasecmp(b, d)) return 1;
        if (!strchr(b, '.') && dl == l + 4 && !strncasecmp(b, d, l) && !strcasecmp(d + l, ".dll")) return 1;
    }
    return 0;
}
/* RaiseException(code, flags, nargs, args): log everything useful. */
static void raise_exception_report(CPU *c){
    uint32_t code = ARG(c,0), fl = ARG(c,1), na = ARG(c,2), pa = ARG(c,3);
    const char *what = code == 0xE06D7363u ? "C++ exception (throw)"
                     : code == 0xC000008Eu ? "float divide by zero" : code == 0xC000008Fu ? "float inexact result"
                     : code == 0xC0000090u ? "float invalid operation" : code == 0xC0000091u ? "float overflow"
                     : code == 0xC0000093u ? "float underflow" : code == 0xC000008Du ? "float denormal operand"
                     : code == 0xC0000092u ? "float stack check" : "?";
    fprintf(stderr, "\n*** GUEST RAISEEXCEPTION: code 0x%08x (%s), flags 0x%x, %u args, from 0x%08x (thread %u)\n",
            code, what, fl, na, c->eip,
            (c->fs_base && mem_is_committed(c->fs_base + 0x24u)) ? MR32(c->fs_base + 0x24u) : 0u);
    fprintf(stderr, "    x87 control word 0x%04x (exception mask 0x%02x%s, PC %u, RC %u), status 0x%04x\n",
            c->fcw, c->fcw & 0x3Fu, (c->fcw & 0x3Fu) == 0x3Fu ? " = all masked" : " -- UNMASKED exceptions",
            (c->fcw >> 8) & 3u, (c->fcw >> 10) & 3u, c->fsw);
    for (uint32_t i = 0; i < na && i < 8 && pa && mem_is_committed(pa + 4u * i + 3u); i++)
        fprintf(stderr, "    arg[%u] = 0x%08x\n", i, MR32(pa + 4u * i));
    /* MSVC C++ throw: args = { magic, object, ThrowInfo* }; name the type */
    if (code == 0xE06D7363u && na >= 3 && pa && mem_is_committed(pa + 11)){
        uint32_t ti = MR32(pa + 8);
        uint32_t cta = (ti && mem_is_committed(ti + 15)) ? MR32(ti + 12) : 0;
        uint32_t ct  = (cta && mem_is_committed(cta + 7)) ? MR32(cta + 4) : 0;
        uint32_t td  = (ct && mem_is_committed(ct + 7)) ? MR32(ct + 4) : 0;
        if (td && mem_is_committed(td + 8)) fprintf(stderr, "    thrown type %.80s\n", (const char *)(g_mem + td + 8));
        else if (!ti) fprintf(stderr, "    rethrow (throw;) of the current exception\n");
    }
    guest_backtrace(c, 16);
}
/* NFSU2_NETLOG=1: log every network-related import call (ws2_32, netapi32,
 * tapi32, plus LoadLibraryA/GetProcAddress/FreeLibrary) with its raw
 * arguments, a few decoded ones and the result.  Research aid for the LAN
 * track; off by default.  Must run before the stdcall stack cleanup. */
static void netlog(CPU *c, const ImpEnt *e, uint32_t r, int handled){
    static int on = -1;
    if (on < 0){ const char *v = getenv("NFSU2_NETLOG"); on = v && *v && *v != '0'; }
    if (!on) return;
    const char *d = e->dll, *n = e->name;
    int net = !strncasecmp(d, "ws2_32", 6) || !strncasecmp(d, "netapi32", 8) || !strncasecmp(d, "tapi32", 6);
    if (!net && strcmp(n, "LoadLibraryA") && strcmp(n, "GetProcAddress") && strcmp(n, "FreeLibrary")) return;
    char a[160]; int k = 0; a[0] = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < e->nargs && i < 9 && k < (int)sizeof a - 12; i++)
        k += snprintf(a + k, sizeof a - (size_t)k, "%s0x%x", i ? "," : "", ARG(c, i));
    char x[128]; x[0] = 0;
    int si = !strcmp(n, "LoadLibraryA") || !strcmp(n, "gethostbyname") ? 0 : !strcmp(n, "GetProcAddress") ? 1 : -1;
    int sa = !strcmp(n, "bind") || !strcmp(n, "connect") ? 1 : !strcmp(n, "sendto") ? 4 : -1;
    if (si >= 0){ uint32_t p = ARG(c, si);
        if (p > 0xffffu && mem_is_committed(p) && mem_is_committed(p + 95u))
            snprintf(x, sizeof x, " \"%.96s\"", (const char *)(g_mem + p)); }
    if (sa >= 0){ uint32_t p = ARG(c, sa);
        if (p && mem_is_committed(p) && mem_is_committed(p + 15u))
            snprintf(x, sizeof x, " {af %u %u.%u.%u.%u:%u}", MR16(p), MR8(p + 4), MR8(p + 5), MR8(p + 6), MR8(p + 7),
                     (unsigned)(MR8(p + 2) << 8 | MR8(p + 3))); }
    long metal_frames(void);
    uint32_t tid = (c->fs_base && mem_is_committed(c->fs_base + 0x24u)) ? MR32(c->fs_base + 0x24u) : 0u;
    fprintf(stderr, "[net] f=%ld tid=%u %s!%s(%s)%s -> 0x%x%s from 0x%08x\n",
            metal_frames(), tid, d, n, a, x, r, handled ? "" : " [stub]", c->eip);
    /* NFSU2_NETLOG=2: also the first 64 bytes of each outgoing payload */
    if (*getenv("NFSU2_NETLOG") == '2' && (!strcmp(n, "sendto") || !strcmp(n, "send"))){
        uint32_t p = ARG(c, 1), len = ARG(c, 2), m = len < 64u ? len : 64u;
        if (p && mem_is_committed(p) && mem_is_committed(p + m)){
            char h[200]; int hk = 0;
            for (uint32_t i = 0; i < m; i++) hk += snprintf(h + hk, sizeof h - (size_t)hk, "%02x", MR8(p + i));
            fprintf(stderr, "[net]   payload %u bytes: %s%s\n", len, h, len > m ? "..." : "");
        }
    }
}

/* Which module's import is being served on this thread: 0 = SPEED2.EXE,
 * 1 = server.dll (win32_ext.c gives the lifted DLL Windows' thread exit
 * semantics without changing what the exe has always been told). */
static _Thread_local int tl_imp_mod = 0;
int win32_caller_module(void){ return tl_imp_mod; }
/* Real monotonic milliseconds (server.dll's GetTickCount, see win32_call). */
static uint32_t real_ms(void){ return (uint32_t)(real_us() / 1000ull) + 1000u; }

int win32_call(CPU *c, uint32_t idx){
    if (idx >= g_nimps) return 0;
    const ImpEnt *e = &g_imps[idx];
    { void win32_thread_term_check(CPU*); win32_thread_term_check(c); }   /* TerminateThread */
    int prev_mod = tl_imp_mod; tl_imp_mod = idx >= g_imp_count;
    stat_[idx].calls++; g_win32_calls++;
    guest_fair_yield();          /* give the other guest threads a turn */
    POP32(c->eip);                      /* take the return address */
    int handled = 1;
    const char *n = e->name;
    uint32_t r = 0;

    /* QueryPerformanceCounter is the most frequent call (frame limiter); to
     * skip the name chain's ~20 strcmps the import index is cached on the
     * first match. */
    static uint32_t qpc_idx = 0xFFFFFFFFu;
    /* server.dll runs on real time.  The HLE's GetTickCount is the frame-paced
     * virtual clock, which nearly stops while the game does not present (loads,
     * hitches); the LAN server's ping/idle timeouts, its advert cadence and its
     * 33 ms service loop would stretch against Windows clients on real time.
     * Its time() comes from GetSystemTimeAsFileTime: real UTC as well (the
     * HLE's own is a counter that advances per call, which would end
     * StopServer's 10 s wait after 1,000 polls instead of 10 s). */
    if (idx >= g_imp_count && !strcmp(n,"GetTickCount")) r = real_ms();
    else if (idx >= g_imp_count && !strcmp(n,"GetSystemTimeAsFileTime")){
        uint32_t p = ARG(c,0);
        if (p){ struct timespec ts; clock_gettime(CLOCK_REALTIME, &ts);
            uint64_t ft = ((uint64_t)ts.tv_sec + 11644473600ull) * 10000000ull + (uint64_t)ts.tv_nsec / 100u;
            mem_commit(p, 8); MR32(p) = (uint32_t)ft; MR32(p+4) = (uint32_t)(ft >> 32); }
        r = 0; }
    else if (idx == qpc_idx || (qpc_idx == 0xFFFFFFFFu && !strcmp(n,"QueryPerformanceCounter") && (qpc_idx = idx, 1))
             || (idx >= g_imp_count && !strcmp(n,"QueryPerformanceCounter"))){
        if (ENVC("QPCWHO")) qpc_who(c);
        if (c->eip == 0x43bdfeu) qpc_spin_sleep(c);
        uint64_t v = host_qpc(); uint32_t p=ARG(c,0);
        if(p){ MR32(p)=(uint32_t)v; MR32(p+4)=(uint32_t)(v>>32); } r=1; }
    /* A lifted DLL's own heaps (server.dll's CRT: HeapCreate from that DLL)
     * are modheap.c's, in guest memory nothing else uses
     * (0x01000000-0x0F000000); every other heap call is heap.c's. */
    else if (g_hk[idx] > 0 && idx >= g_imp_count && !strcmp(n,"HeapCreate")) r = modheap_create();
    else if (g_hk[idx] > 0 && n[0] == 'H' && !strncmp(n,"Heap",4) && modheap_owns(ARG(c,0))){
        uint32_t h = ARG(c,0);
        if      (!strcmp(n,"HeapDestroy")) r = (uint32_t)modheap_destroy(h);
        else if (!strcmp(n,"HeapAlloc"))   r = modheap_alloc(h, ARG(c,2), ARG(c,1));
        else if (!strcmp(n,"HeapFree"))    r = (uint32_t)modheap_free(h, ARG(c,2));
        else if (!strcmp(n,"HeapReAlloc")) r = modheap_realloc(h, ARG(c,2), ARG(c,3), ARG(c,1));
        else if (!strcmp(n,"HeapSize"))    r = modheap_size(h, ARG(c,2));
        else handled = 0; }
    else if (g_hk[idx] > 0){
        r = heap_api(c, g_hk[idx]);
        if (g_hk[idx] == g_hk_heapalloc) heapalloc_debug(c, r); }
    else if (!strcmp(n,"GetVersion"))            r = 0x0A280105u;      /* 5.1.2600 */
    else if (!strcmp(n,"GetModuleHandleA")){
        /* NULL and the DLLs the exe or server.dll import: the exe's base, as
         * before (GetProcAddress resolves by import name); a lifted module
         * (server.dll): its base while loaded, NULL otherwise; anything else
         * (d3d9d.dll, mscoree.dll, ...) is not loaded */
        uint32_t p = ARG(c,0);
        const char *nm = p && mem_is_committed(p) ? (const char*)(g_mem + p) : 0;
        if (nm && module_known_name(nm)) r = module_by_name(nm);
        else r = (!p || module_known(p)) ? 0x00400000u : 0u;
        if (!r) win32_set_last_error(c, 126);            /* ERROR_MOD_NOT_FOUND */
        if (p && mem_is_committed(p)){ static char seen[16][40]; static int ns = 0; int k;
            for (k = 0; k < ns && strncasecmp(seen[k], (const char*)(g_mem+p), 39); k++) ;
            if (k == ns && ns < 16){ snprintf(seen[ns++], 40, "%s", (const char*)(g_mem+p));
                fprintf(stderr,"[hle] GetModuleHandleA(\"%s\") -> 0x%08x (from 0x%08x)\n", seen[ns-1], r, c->eip); } } }
    else if (!strcmp(n,"GetCommandLineA"))       r = g_cmdline;
    else if (!strcmp(n,"GetEnvironmentStrings")||!strcmp(n,"GetEnvironmentStringsW")){
        static uint32_t env = 0;               /* empty block; FreeEnvironmentStrings is a no-op */
        if (!env) env = gheap_alloc(1, 8, 1);
        r = env; }
    else if (!strcmp(n,"FreeEnvironmentStringsA")||!strcmp(n,"FreeEnvironmentStringsW")) r=1;
    else if (!strcmp(n,"GetStartupInfoA")){ uint32_t p=ARG(c,0); if(p){ mem_commit(p,68); memset(g_mem+p,0,68); MR32(p)=68; } r=0; }
    else if (!strcmp(n,"GetStdHandle"))          r = 0x10u + (ARG(c,0) & 3u);
    else if (!strcmp(n,"GetFileType")){
        /* The CRT's _open asks right after CreateFileA: files are DISK, the
         * std handles (GetStdHandle: 0x10..0x13) CHAR, anything else UNKNOWN. */
        uint32_t h = ARG(c,0); extern int fileio_is_handle(uint32_t);
        if (h >= 0x10u && h <= 0x13u) r = 2;
        else if (fileio_is_handle(h)) r = 1;
        else { r = 0; win32_set_last_error(c, 6); } }
    else if (!strcmp(n,"SetHandleCount"))        r = ARG(c,0);
    else if (!strcmp(n,"GetVersionExA")||!strcmp(n,"GetVersionExW")){
        uint32_t p=ARG(c,0);
        if(p){ MR32(p+4)=5; MR32(p+8)=1; MR32(p+12)=2600; MR32(p+16)=2; }
        r = 1; }
    else if (!strcmp(n,"GetACP"))                r = 1252;
    else if (!strcmp(n,"GetOEMCP"))              r = 437;
    else if (!strcmp(n,"GetCPInfo")){ uint32_t p=ARG(c,1); if(p){ mem_commit(p,20); memset(g_mem+p,0,20); MR32(p)=1; } r=1; }
    else if (!strcmp(n,"IsValidCodePage"))       r = 1;
    else if (!strcmp(n,"TlsAlloc")){
        /* freed indices first (server.dll's CRT takes one per load and frees
         * it on unload; with no reuse, hosting would stop working after
         * ~120 sessions) */
        if (tls_nfree) r = tls_free[--tls_nfree];
        else r = (tls_next<128)? (uint32_t)tls_next++ : 0xffffffffu; }
    else if (!strcmp(n,"TlsSetValue")){
        uint32_t i=ARG(c,0), v=ARG(c,1);
        uint32_t arr = (c->fs_base && mem_is_committed(c->fs_base+0x2cu)) ? MR32(c->fs_base+0x2cu) : 0;
        if (arr && i<256u && mem_is_committed(arr+4u*i)){ MR32(arr+4u*i)=v; r=1; }
        else { if(i<128) tls_slot[i]=v; r=1; } }
    else if (!strcmp(n,"TlsGetValue")){
        uint32_t i=ARG(c,0);
        uint32_t arr = (c->fs_base && mem_is_committed(c->fs_base+0x2cu)) ? MR32(c->fs_base+0x2cu) : 0;
        if (arr && i<256u && mem_is_committed(arr+4u*i)) r = MR32(arr+4u*i);
        else r = (i<128)?tls_slot[i]:0; }
    else if (!strcmp(n,"TlsFree")){
        /* Windows clears the slot in every thread, so the next TlsAlloc of
         * this index reads NULL everywhere: here the main TEB, the created
         * threads' TEBs (0x00C20000 + 0x2000 n) and the timer thread's. */
        uint32_t i = ARG(c,0); r = 0;
        if (i < (uint32_t)tls_next){
            int dup = 0; for (int k = 0; k < tls_nfree; k++) dup |= tls_free[k] == i;
            if (!dup && tls_nfree < 128){
                tls_slot[i] = 0;
                for (uint32_t teb = 0x00C00000u; teb < 0x00D00000u; teb += 0x2000u)
                    if (mem_is_committed(teb + 0x2Cu) && MR32(teb + 0x18u) == teb){
                        uint32_t arr = MR32(teb + 0x2Cu);
                        if (arr && mem_is_committed(arr + 4u*i + 3u)) MR32(arr + 4u*i) = 0;
                    }
                tls_free[tls_nfree++] = i; r = 1; } } }
    /* Critical sections are NOT handled here; win32_ext.c implements them
     * with REAL recursive locks (see cs_for).  With a no-op stub the GIL's
     * fair sharing would break mutual exclusion. */
    else if (!strcmp(n,"GetCurrentThreadId")){
        /* the real thread id from the TEB (fs:[0x24]); every thread must be unique */
        r = (c->fs_base && mem_is_committed(c->fs_base+0x24u)) ? MR32(c->fs_base+0x24u) : 1u;
        if (!r) r = 1u; }
    else if (!strcmp(n,"GetCurrentProcessId"))   r = 100;
    else if (!strcmp(n,"GetCurrentProcess"))     r = 0xffffffffu;
    else if (!strcmp(n,"GetLastError"))          r = win32_get_last_error(c);
    else if (!strcmp(n,"SetLastError")){         win32_set_last_error(c, ARG(c,0)); r = 0; }
    else if (!strcmp(n,"GetTickCount")) r = host_ms();
    else if (!strcmp(n,"QueryPerformanceFrequency")){ uint32_t p=ARG(c,0); if(p){MR32(p)=1000000;MR32(p+4)=0;} r=1; }
    else if (!strcmp(n,"SetUnhandledExceptionFilter")) r = 0;
    else if (!strcmp(n,"UnhandledExceptionFilter"))    r = 0;
    else if (!strcmp(n,"IsProcessorFeaturePresent")){
        /* Truthful for a Pentium 4 class CPU: PF_COMPARE_EXCHANGE_DOUBLE (2),
         * PF_MMX (3), PF_XMMI (6), PF_RDTSC (8), PF_XMMI64 (10).  It used to
         * be TRUE for everything, so D3DX's PSGP selector (0x641790, the only
         * caller) installed its 3DNow! kernels (PF 7), which the lifter cannot
         * run (pswapd/pfacc...). */
        uint32_t f = ARG(c,0);
        r = (f == 2u || f == 3u || f == 6u || f == 8u || f == 10u) ? 1u : 0u;
        if (ENVC("NFSU2_PF_ALL")) r = 1;                 /* test-only: the old answer */
        { static uint32_t seen = 0; if (f < 32u && !(seen & (1u << f))){ seen |= 1u << f;
            fprintf(stderr,"[hle] IsProcessorFeaturePresent(%u) -> %u (from 0x%08x)\n", f, r, c->eip); } } }
    else if (!strcmp(n,"GetModuleFileNameA")){ uint32_t p=ARG(c,1),sz=ARG(c,2);
        const char*s="C:\\\\NFSU2\\\\SPEED2.EXE"; char ms[300];
        if (module_file_name(ARG(c,0), ms, sizeof ms)) s = ms;   /* server.dll: C:\NFSU2\server.dll */
        uint32_t l=(uint32_t)strlen(s);
        if(p&&sz){ if(l>=sz) l=sz-1; memcpy(g_mem+p,s,l); MR8(p+l)=0; } r=l; }
    else if (!strcmp(n,"ExitProcess")){ g_exit_code=(int)ARG(c,0);
        fprintf(stderr,"\n*** guest ExitProcess(%u) - exiting\n",ARG(c,0));
        { extern void discord_shutdown(void); discord_shutdown(); }   /* the game quit: clear the Discord presence */
        if(g_exit_armed) longjmp(g_exit_jmp,1); return -1; }
    else if (!strcmp(n,"LoadLibraryA")||!strcmp(n,"LoadLibraryW")){
        /* A lifted module (server.dll) is really loaded (module.c); every
         * other DLL keeps the old placeholder handle. */
        char nm[260] = ""; uint32_t p0 = ARG(c,0), err = 0;
        if (p0 && mem_is_committed(p0)){
            if (n[11] == 'W'){ uint32_t k = 0; for (; k < sizeof nm - 1 && MR16(p0 + 2*k); k++) nm[k] = (char)MR16(p0 + 2*k); nm[k] = 0; }
            else snprintf(nm, sizeof nm, "%s", (const char*)(g_mem + p0)); }
        if (nm[0] && module_known_name(nm)){
            r = module_load(c, nm, &err);
            if (!r){ void win32_set_last_error(CPU*, uint32_t); win32_set_last_error(c, err); }
        } else r = 0x20000000u;
        { static int sh=0; uint32_t p2=ARG(c,0);
          if (ENVC("VERBOSE") && sh<12){ sh++; fprintf(stderr,"      [dll] LoadLibrary(ptr=0x%08x) \"%s\"\n", p2, p2?(char*)(g_mem+p2):"(NULL)"); } } }
    else if (!strcmp(n,"GetProcAddress")){
        uint32_t pname = ARG(c,1); r = 0;
        if (module_handle(ARG(c,0))){              /* lifted module: its export table */
            uint32_t err = 0; r = module_proc(ARG(c,0), pname, &err);
            if (!r){ void win32_set_last_error(CPU*, uint32_t); win32_set_last_error(c, err); }
        }
        else if (pname > 0xffff){                  /* by name (not ordinal) */
            const char *want = (const char*)(g_mem + pname);
            for (uint32_t i=0;i<g_nimps;i++)
                if (!strcmp(g_imps[i].name, want)){ r = IMP_MAGIC + i; break; }
            { static int sh=0;
              if (ENVC("VERBOSE") && !r && sh<12){ sh++; fprintf(stderr,"      [dll] GetProcAddress(\"%s\") NOT FOUND\n", want); } }
        } }
    else if (!strcmp(n,"FreeLibrary")){ module_free(c, ARG(c,0)); r = 1; }
    else if (!strcmp(n,"InterlockedIncrement")){ uint32_t p=ARG(c,0); r=++MR32(p); }
    else if (!strcmp(n,"InterlockedDecrement")){ uint32_t p=ARG(c,0); r=--MR32(p); }
    else if (!strcmp(n,"InterlockedExchange")){ uint32_t p=ARG(c,0); r=MR32(p); MR32(p)=ARG(c,1); }
    else if (!strcmp(n,"MultiByteToWideChar")){ uint32_t src=ARG(c,2); int sl=(int)ARG(c,3);
        uint32_t dst=ARG(c,4); int dl=(int)ARG(c,5);
        if(sl<0) sl=(int)strlen((char*)(g_mem+src))+1;
        if(dl==0){ r=(uint32_t)sl; } else { int k=0; for(;k<sl&&k<dl;k++) MR16(dst+2u*k)=MR8(src+k); r=(uint32_t)k; } }
    else if (!strcmp(n,"WideCharToMultiByte")){ uint32_t src=ARG(c,2); int sl=(int)ARG(c,3);
        uint32_t dst=ARG(c,4); int dl=(int)ARG(c,5);
        if(sl<0){ sl=0; while(MR16(src+2u*sl)) sl++; sl++; }
        if(dl==0){ r=(uint32_t)sl; } else { int k=0; for(;k<sl&&k<dl;k++) MR8(dst+k)=(uint8_t)MR16(src+2u*k); r=(uint32_t)k; } }
    else if (!strcmp(n,"GetStringTypeW")||!strcmp(n,"GetStringTypeA")){
        /* A: (LCID,dwInfoType,src,cch,out)  W: (dwInfoType,src,cch,out) */
        int aform = (n[13]=='A');
        uint32_t info = ARG(c, aform?1:0);
        uint32_t src  = ARG(c, aform?2:1);
        int      cch  = (int)ARG(c, aform?3:2);
        uint32_t out  = ARG(c, aform?4:3);
        int wide = !aform;
        if (cch < 0){ cch = 0; if(wide){ while(MR16(src+2u*cch)) cch++; } else { while(MR8(src+cch)) cch++; } cch++; }
        if (info == 1 && out){                       /* CT_CTYPE1 */
            for (int k=0;k<cch;k++){
                uint32_t ch = wide ? MR16(src+2u*k) : MR8(src+k);
                uint16_t f = 0x0200;                 /* C1_DEFINED */
                if (ch<128){
                    if (ch>='A'&&ch<='Z') f |= 0x0001|0x0100;
                    if (ch>='a'&&ch<='z') f |= 0x0002|0x0100;
                    if (ch>='0'&&ch<='9') f |= 0x0004|0x0080;
                    if ((ch>='a'&&ch<='f')||(ch>='A'&&ch<='F')) f |= 0x0080;
                    if (ch==' ') f |= 0x0008|0x0040;
                    if (ch=='\t'||ch=='\n'||ch=='\r'||ch==0x0b||ch==0x0c) f |= 0x0008;
                    if (ch<0x20||ch==0x7f) f |= 0x0020;
                    if (ch>0x20&&ch<0x7f&&!(f&(0x0100|0x0004))) f |= 0x0010;
                } else f |= 0x0100;
                MR16(out+2u*k) = f;
            }
        }
        r = 1; }
    else if (!strcmp(n,"LCMapStringW")||!strcmp(n,"LCMapStringA")){
        int wide = (n[11]=='W');
        uint32_t flags = ARG(c,1), src = ARG(c,2); int cch = (int)ARG(c,3);
        uint32_t dst = ARG(c,4); int cchd = (int)ARG(c,5);
        if (cch < 0){ cch = 0; if(wide){ while(MR16(src+2u*cch)) cch++; } else { while(MR8(src+cch)) cch++; } cch++; }
        if (cchd == 0){ r = (uint32_t)cch; }
        else {
            int k=0;
            for (;k<cch && k<cchd;k++){
                uint32_t ch = wide ? MR16(src+2u*k) : MR8(src+k);
                if ((flags & 0x00000100u) && ch<128 && ch>='A' && ch<='Z') ch += 32;   /* LOWERCASE */
                if ((flags & 0x00000200u) && ch<128 && ch>='a' && ch<='z') ch -= 32;   /* UPPERCASE */
                if (wide) MR16(dst+2u*k)=(uint16_t)ch; else MR8(dst+k)=(uint8_t)ch;
            }
            r = (uint32_t)k;
        } }
    else if (!strcmp(n,"GetLocaleInfoA")||!strcmp(n,"GetLocaleInfoW")){
        int wide = (n[13]=='W');
        uint32_t lct = ARG(c,1) & 0xffffu, p = ARG(c,2); int cch = (int)ARG(c,3);
        const char *v = 0; char num[16];
        switch (lct){
        case 0x0001: v="0409"; break;                 /* ILANGUAGE            */
        case 0x0002: v="English"; break;              /* SLANGUAGE            */
        case 0x1001: v="English"; break;              /* SENGLANGUAGE         */
        case 0x1002: v="United States"; break;        /* SENGCOUNTRY          */
        case 0x0003: v="ENU"; break;                  /* SABBREVLANGNAME      */
        case 0x0005: v="US"; break;                   /* SABBREVCTRYNAME      */
        case 0x000E: v="."; break;                    /* SDECIMAL             */
        case 0x000F: v=","; break;                    /* STHOUSAND            */
        case 0x0014: v="2"; break;                    /* IDIGITS              */
        case 0x000B: snprintf(num,sizeof num,"%d",437);  v=num; break; /* IDEFAULTCODEPAGE */
        case 0x1004: snprintf(num,sizeof num,"%d",1252); v=num; break; /* IDEFAULTANSICODEPAGE */
        case 0x0019: v="$"; break;                    /* SCURRENCY            */
        case 0x001D: v="/"; break;                    /* SDATE                */
        case 0x001E: v=":"; break;                    /* STIME                */
        default:     v="";  break;
        }
        uint32_t len = (uint32_t)strlen(v) + 1;
        if (cch == 0) r = wide ? len : len;
        else if (p){ uint32_t k=0; for(;k<len-1 && k<(uint32_t)cch-1;k++){ if(wide) MR16(p+2u*k)=v[k]; else MR8(p+k)=v[k]; }
                     if(wide) MR16(p+2u*k)=0; else MR8(p+k)=0; r=k+1; }
        else r = 0; }
    else if (!strcmp(n,"MessageBoxA")){
        uint32_t txt=ARG(c,1), cap=ARG(c,2);
        fprintf(stderr,"\n*** GUEST MESSAGEBOX ***\n  title: %s\n  text : %s\n***\n",
                cap?(char*)(g_mem+cap):"(none)", txt?(char*)(g_mem+txt):"(none)");
        r = 1; }
    else if (!strcmp(n,"Direct3DCreate9")) r = com_direct3dcreate9();
    else if (!strcmp(n,"DirectInput8Create")) r = com_directinput8create(ARG(c,3));
    else if (!strcmp(n,"DirectSoundCreate") || (!strcmp(n,"#1") && !strcasecmp(e->dll,"DSOUND.dll")))
        r = com_directsoundcreate(ARG(c,1));
    else if (!strcmp(n,"SetConsoleCtrlHandler")) r = 1;
    else if (!strcmp(n,"RtlUnwind"))             r = 0;
    else if (!strcmp(n,"RaiseException")){
        /* There is no guest SEH dispatch, so continuing after a raise is
         * undefined behaviour.  Stop loudly instead; NFSU2_RAISE=continue
         * (test-only) restores the old silent return. */
        raise_exception_report(c);
        if (!ENVC("NFSU2_RAISE") || strcmp(ENVC("NFSU2_RAISE"), "continue")){
            extern void (*g_report_fn)(void);
            if (g_report_fn) g_report_fn();
            fflush(stderr); _exit(5); }
        r = 0; }
    else if (!strcmp(n,"TerminateProcess")){ g_exit_code=(int)ARG(c,1);
        fprintf(stderr,"\n*** guest TerminateProcess(%u) - exiting\n",ARG(c,1));
        if(g_exit_armed) longjmp(g_exit_jmp,1); return -1; }
    else if (winsock_call(c, e->dll, n, &r)) { /* ws2_32, netapi32: winsock.c */ }
    else if (fileio_call(c, n, &r)) { /* file I/O */ }
    else if (win32_ext_call(c, n, &r)) { /* second-round layer */ }
    else { handled = 0; g_win32_unimpl++; stat_[idx].unimpl++;
           { extern void autotest_note_unimpl(const char*,const char*,uint32_t);
             autotest_note_unimpl(e->dll, n, c->eip); }
           if (unimpl_first==0xffffffffu){ unimpl_first=idx; unimpl_name=n; } }

    if (g_bt_on && (!strcmp(n,"GetModuleFileNameA")||!strcmp(n,"ExitProcess")||!strcmp(n,"RaiseException")))
        guest_backtrace(c, 14);
    if (trace_n < trace_max)
        fprintf(stderr, "  [%4u] %-14s %-32s (%d arg) %s-> 0x%08x\n",
                ++trace_n, e->dll, n, e->nargs, handled?"":"[STUB] ", r);
    else trace_n++;
    netlog(c, e, r, handled);
    if (idx >= g_imp_count && !strncasecmp(e->dll, "ws2_32", 6)){
        void module_note_socket_call(int, const char *, uint32_t, uint32_t);   /* module.c: unload report */
        module_note_socket_call(1, n, ARG(c,0), r);
    }

    c->eax = r;
    c->esp += 4u * (uint32_t)e->nargs;      /* stdcall: the callee cleans up the arguments */
    tl_imp_mod = prev_mod;
    return 1;
}

void win32_init(void){
    g_nimps = g_imp_count + g_srv_imp_count;
    g_imps = calloc(g_nimps ? g_nimps : 1, sizeof *g_imps);
    memcpy(g_imps, g_imp, g_imp_count * sizeof *g_imps);
    if (g_srv_imp_count) memcpy(g_imps + g_imp_count, g_srv_imp, g_srv_imp_count * sizeof *g_imps);
    stat_ = calloc(g_nimps ? g_nimps : 1, sizeof *stat_);
    heap_init();
    g_hk = calloc(g_nimps ? g_nimps : 1, 1);
    for (uint32_t i=0;i<g_nimps;i++) g_hk[i] = (int8_t)heap_api_kind(g_imps[i].name);
    g_hk_heapalloc = heap_api_kind("HeapAlloc");
    struct timespec ts; clock_gettime(CLOCK_MONOTONIC,&ts);
    tick0 = (uint64_t)ts.tv_sec*1000 + ts.tv_nsec/1000000;
    g_cmdline = gheap_alloc(1, 64, 1);
    strcpy((char*)(g_mem+g_cmdline), "SPEED2.EXE");
    /* fill the IAT with magic addresses */
    for (uint32_t i=0;i<g_imp_count;i++) MR32(g_imp[i].iat) = IMP_MAGIC + i;
    com_init();
    { void watchdog_start(void); watchdog_start(); }      /* NFSU2_WATCHDOG */
    /* addresses to read later for diagnosing the CRT heap mode */
    fprintf(stderr,"win32: %u imports bound to the IAT\n", g_imp_count);
    if (g_srv_imp_count) fprintf(stderr,"win32: server.dll lifted into this build (%u imports, bound when it is loaded)\n", g_srv_imp_count);
}

void win32_report(void){
    fprintf(stderr,"\n=== WIN32 LAYER ===\n");
    fprintf(stderr,"  import calls in total : %llu\n",(unsigned long long)g_win32_calls);
    fprintf(stderr,"  not implemented       : %llu\n",(unsigned long long)g_win32_unimpl);
    /* the most called unimplemented ones */
    fprintf(stderr,"  guest threads : %llu started, %llu exited\n",
            (unsigned long long)win32_ext_threads(),(unsigned long long)win32_ext_threads_exited());

            fprintf(stderr,"    %s%-14s %-32s %u times\n", i >= g_imp_count ? "server!" : "", g_imps[i].dll, g_imps[i].name, stat_[i].unimpl);
    fprintf(stderr,"  --- 15 MOST CALLED ---\n");
    for (int k=0;k<15;k++){
        uint32_t best=0, bi=0;
        for (uint32_t i=0;i<g_nimps;i++) if (stat_[i].calls>best){ best=stat_[i].calls; bi=i; }
        if(!best) break;
        fprintf(stderr,"    %-14s %-32s %u\n", g_imps[bi].dll, g_imps[bi].name, best);
        stat_[bi].calls = 0;
    }
    int shown=0;
    for (uint32_t i=0;i<g_nimps && shown<15;i++)
        if (stat_[i].calls){
            /* we do not know whether it was handled; just show the frequently called ones */
        }
    for (uint32_t i=0;i<g_nimps;i++)

#define H_BASE 0x00A00000u
typedef enum { OB_NONE=0, OB_EVENT, OB_MUTEX, OB_THREAD, OB_FILE, OB_KEY, OB_SEM } ObKind;
typedef struct {
    ObKind kind; int signaled; int manual;
    pthread_mutex_t mtx; pthread_cond_t cv;
    uint32_t guest_arg, guest_entry, tid;
    uint32_t owner_tid; int rec;      /* MUTEX: ownership + recursion */
    pthread_t th; int started; void *pending;

    int prim_ok;                      /* mtx/cv set up once (kept when the slot is reused) */
    /* OB_THREAD: how it ended (ExitThread argument or the entry's eax), and a
     * TerminateThread request it honours at its next import call */
    uint32_t exit_code; int ended; volatile int term_req;
    int closed;                       /* OB_THREAD: last handle closed while it still ran */
    uint32_t teb, stack_lo;           /* OB_THREAD: recycled when the thread ends */
    /* OB_THREAD: who started it (CreateThread's return address), its place in
     * the order threads ended, and how often an import looked its handle up
     * (waits, CloseHandle, GetExitCodeThread, DuplicateHandle, ...): obj_reclaim */
    uint32_t creator; uint64_t end_seq; uint32_t looked;
    uint32_t gen;                     /* handle generation (obj_reclaim); kept when the slot is reused */
} Obj;
/* v12na: 4096 (was 512).  The game never closes the handle of the thread it
 * starts for every race load, so one slot per load stays in use (measured:
 * +1 per load, heap-07); 512 would have run out after ~500 loads.  Since
 * then a full table takes such a thread's slot back (obj_reclaim). */
#define OBJ_MAX 4096
static Obj g_obj[OBJ_MAX];
static int g_obj_n = 1;
/* A handle is H_BASE + gen * OBJ_MAX + slot.  gen stays 0 until obj_reclaim
 * gives a slot to a new object: the reclaimed thread's handle then names
 * nothing (a late CloseHandle or wait on it is that of a closed handle and
 * cannot reach the slot's new object).  Handles stay below 0x00B00000. */
#define OBJ_GENS 256u
static int obj_slot(uint32_t h){                /* -1: not ours, or an older generation's */
    uint32_t d = h - H_BASE;                     /* below H_BASE wraps past the range */
    if (d >= OBJ_GENS * OBJ_MAX) return -1;
    uint32_t i = d % OBJ_MAX;
    return d / OBJ_MAX == g_obj[i].gen ? (int)i : -1;
}

static void ts_set(int what, uint32_t obj){

    g_tstate[tl_slot].what = what; g_tstate[tl_slot].obj = obj; g_tstate[tl_slot].since_us = gil_now_us();

static void reg_cpu(CPU *c){
    for (int i=0;i<g_all_n;i++) if (g_all_cpus[i]==c){ tl_slot = i; return; }
    for (int i=0;i<g_all_n;i++) if (!g_all_cpus[i]){             /* a slot an ended thread left */
        g_all_cpus[i] = c; g_all_tids[i] = c->fs_base ? MR32(c->fs_base+0x24) : 0; tl_slot = i; return; }
    if (g_all_n < MAXCPUS){
        g_all_cpus[g_all_n] = c;
        g_all_tids[g_all_n] = c->fs_base ? MR32(c->fs_base+0x24) : 0;
        tl_slot = g_all_n;
        g_all_n++;
    }
}
/* A guest thread ends: its CPU lived on its host stack. */
static void unreg_cpu(CPU *c){
    for (int i=0;i<g_all_n;i++) if (g_all_cpus[i]==c){ g_all_cpus[i] = 0; g_all_tids[i] = 0; g_tstate[i].what = TS_RUN; }
    tl_slot = -1;
}
/* --- measuring how long the big lock (GIL) is HELD ---------------------
 * A guest thread does not release the GIL until it makes a Win32 call; a
 * long computation (e.g. decoding an audio stream) starves the other threads.
 * The audio writes ~50 ms of silence every 30 s -- this measures whether
 * that is the culprit.  GILLOG=<ms> reports every hold above the threshold. */
#ifdef __wasm__
#include "web/host_abi.h"
#endif
static uint64_t gil_now_us(void){
#ifdef __wasm__
    /* the page's monotonic clock without WASI's clock_time_get (its i64 argument
     * costs a BigInt per call into JS): this runs on every guest lock hand-off */
    return (uint64_t)(nfsu2_now_ms() * 1000.0);
#else
    struct timespec ts; clock_gettime(CLOCK_MONOTONIC, &ts);
    return (uint64_t)ts.tv_sec*1000000ull + (uint64_t)ts.tv_nsec/1000ull;
#endif
}
static _Thread_local uint64_t tl_gil_t0 = 0;
uint64_t g_gil_max_us = 0, g_gil_long = 0;
static int gil_thr_us(void){
    static int v = -1;
    if (v < 0){ const char *e = getenv("GILLOG"); v = (e && *e) ? atoi(e)*1000 : 0; }
    return v;
}
static void gil_took(void){ tl_gil_t0 = gil_now_us(); }
#ifdef __wasm__
static double gil_host_wait_ms(void);   /* of the current hold: file I/O round trips, sleeps */
#endif
static void gil_gave(void){
    if (!tl_gil_t0) return;
    uint64_t d = gil_now_us() - tl_gil_t0;
    tl_gil_t0 = 0;
    if (d > g_gil_max_us) g_gil_max_us = d;
    int thr = gil_thr_us();
    if (thr && d > (uint64_t)thr){
        g_gil_long++;
        static int shown = 0;
        if (shown < 80){ shown++;
            double audio_time(void);
#ifdef __wasm__
            fprintf(stderr, "  [GIL] t=%.3f s  lock held %.1f ms  guest eip=%08x tid %u (host waits %.1f ms)\n",
                    audio_time(), d/1000.0, tl_cpu ? tl_cpu->eip : 0u,
                    (tl_cpu && tl_cpu->fs_base) ? MR32(tl_cpu->fs_base + 0x24u) : 0u, gil_host_wait_ms());
#else
            fprintf(stderr, "  [GIL] t=%.3f s  lock held %.1f ms  guest eip=%08x\n",
                    audio_time(), d/1000.0, tl_cpu ? tl_cpu->eip : 0u);
#endif
        }
    }

/* wasm: the guest lock is a FIFO ticket lock (web/ticketlock.h): browsers
 * schedule workers with no fairness promise, and an unordered futex mutex let
 * the main thread re-take the lock ahead of the DirectSound feeder, the
 * loader and the timer.  Every acquisition that had to queue is measured:
 * how long the thread waited (holder's time included) and the hand-off
 * latency (the previous owner's unlock to this thread running: the cost of
 * a wasm atomic wait/notify between two workers).  Reported at exit
 * (win32 report) and per [status] line. */
#include "web/ticketlock.h"
#include "web/host_abi.h"
static ticketlock g_gil = TICKETLOCK_INIT;
/* NFSU2_GIL=mutex (measurement only): the old unordered pthread mutex, with
 * the same statistics, to compare against the ticket lock */
static pthread_mutex_t g_gil_mx = PTHREAD_MUTEX_INITIALIZER;
static int g_gil_use_mx = -1;
typedef struct { uint32_t tid; uint64_t n, queued; double wait_ms, wait_max_ms, hand_ms, hand_max_ms;
                 uint32_t whist[24], hhist[24]; } GilStat;   /* hist: [2^k, 2^(k+1)) us, k=0 below 2 us */
static GilStat g_gs[64]; static int g_gs_n;
static GilStat g_gs_tot;                         /* all threads */
static GilStat g_gs_win;                         /* since the last [status] line */
static _Thread_local GilStat *tl_gs; static _Thread_local uint32_t tl_gs_tid = ~0u;
static double g_gil_rel_ms;                      /* last unlock (written by the owner) */
/* Busy time (there is no thread CPU clock in the browser): the time a thread
 * holds the guest lock, minus what it spent blocked in the host meanwhile
 * (file I/O round trips, sleeps; web/src/host/game-worker.ts).  Guest code
 * runs only under the lock, and every guest wait (pacer, Sleep, Wait*, the
 * present wait) releases it, so this is the guest thread's CPU time. */
static _Thread_local double tl_acq_ms, tl_acq_blk, tl_busy_ms; static _Thread_local int tl_holding;
static _Thread_local int tl_barged;              /* taken ahead of the queue (gil_acquire_frame) */
static double g_busy_all_ms;                     /* every guest thread (updated by the owner) */
static double held_busy(double now){ return (now - tl_acq_ms) - (nfsu2_blocked_ms() - tl_acq_blk); }
static double gil_host_wait_ms(void){ return tl_holding ? nfsu2_blocked_ms() - tl_acq_blk : 0.0; }
double win32_thread_busy_ms(void){ return tl_busy_ms + (tl_holding ? held_busy(nfsu2_now_ms()) : 0.0); }
double win32_busy_all_ms(void){ return g_busy_all_ms + (tl_holding ? held_busy(nfsu2_now_ms()) : 0.0); }
uint64_t g_gil_fair_yields;                      /* fair yields that handed the lock over */
static int gil_bucket(double ms){ double us = ms * 1000.0; int k = 0; while (us >= 2.0 && k < 23){ us *= 0.5; k++; } return k; }
static void gil_note(GilStat *s, double w, double h){
    if (!s) return;
    s->queued++; s->wait_ms += w; if (w > s->wait_max_ms) s->wait_max_ms = w; s->whist[gil_bucket(w)]++;
    s->hand_ms += h; if (h > s->hand_max_ms) s->hand_max_ms = h; s->hhist[gil_bucket(h)]++;
}
static GilStat *gil_stat_for(CPU *who){                /* GIL held */
    uint32_t tid = (who && who->fs_base) ? MR32(who->fs_base + 0x24u) : 0u;
    if (tl_gs && tl_gs_tid == tid) return tl_gs;
    GilStat *s = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < g_gs_n; i++) if (g_gs[i].tid == tid){ s = &g_gs[i]; break; }
    if (!s && g_gs_n < 64){ s = &g_gs[g_gs_n++]; s->tid = tid; }
    tl_gs = s; tl_gs_tid = tid;
    return s;
}
static void gil_acquire(CPU *who){
    if (g_gil_use_mx < 0){ const char *e = getenv("NFSU2_GIL"); g_gil_use_mx = e && !strcmp(e, "mutex"); }
    if (g_gil_use_mx){
        double t0 = 0;
        int queued = pthread_mutex_trylock(&g_gil_mx) != 0;
        if (queued){ t0 = nfsu2_now_ms(); pthread_mutex_lock(&g_gil_mx); }
        double t1 = nfsu2_now_ms(), h = t1 - g_gil_rel_ms;
        GilStat *s = gil_stat_for(who); if (s) s->n++; g_gs_tot.n++; g_gs_win.n++;
        if (queued){ if (h < 0) h = 0; gil_note(s, t1 - t0, h); gil_note(&g_gs_tot, t1 - t0, h); gil_note(&g_gs_win, t1 - t0, h); }
        tl_acq_ms = t1; tl_acq_blk = nfsu2_blocked_ms(); tl_holding = 1;
        return;
    }
    uint32_t me = ticket_take(&g_gil);
    if (ticket_try(&g_gil, me)){
        GilStat *s = gil_stat_for(who); if (s) s->n++; g_gs_tot.n++; g_gs_win.n++;
        tl_acq_ms = nfsu2_now_ms(); tl_acq_blk = nfsu2_blocked_ms(); tl_holding = 1;
        return; }
    double t0 = nfsu2_now_ms();
    ticket_wait(&g_gil, me);
    double t1 = nfsu2_now_ms(), h = t1 - g_gil_rel_ms;
    if (h < 0) h = 0;
    GilStat *s = gil_stat_for(who); if (s) s->n++; g_gs_tot.n++; g_gs_win.n++;
    gil_note(s, t1 - t0, h); gil_note(&g_gs_tot, t1 - t0, h); gil_note(&g_gs_win, t1 - t0, h);
    tl_acq_ms = t1; tl_acq_blk = nfsu2_blocked_ms(); tl_holding = 1;
}
/* The frame pacer's thread at its slot boundary (guest_sleep_frame_ns): it
 * takes a free lock ahead of the queue (ticketlock.h ticket_barge), and while
 * another thread holds it, it polls instead of sleeping, as it was spinning
 * on the clock anyway.  Before, it queued behind the threads that came during
 * its sleep, and one of them still waking up kept the lock idle for up to
 * 4.6 ms: a missed 120 Hz slot, ~4 times in a 35 s race (Ryzen 5900X,
 * Chrome 155).  Once per frame only, so the others still have the whole
 * pacer sleep; a holder still busy after 20 ms (a loading screen's long
 * call) is queued for as before. */
uint64_t g_gil_frame_takes, g_gil_frame_queued;
static void gil_acquire_frame(CPU *who){
    if (g_gil_use_mx < 0){ const char *e = getenv("NFSU2_GIL"); g_gil_use_mx = e && !strcmp(e, "mutex"); }
    if (g_gil_use_mx){ gil_acquire(who); return; }
    g_gil_frame_takes++;
    if (ticket_barge(&g_gil, 1)){
        GilStat *s = gil_stat_for(who); if (s) s->n++; g_gs_tot.n++; g_gs_win.n++;
        tl_acq_ms = nfsu2_now_ms(); tl_acq_blk = nfsu2_blocked_ms(); tl_holding = 1; tl_barged = 1;
        return; }
    double t0 = nfsu2_now_ms(), t1 = t0;
    while (t1 - t0 < 20.0){
        if (ticket_barge(&g_gil, 256)){
            t1 = nfsu2_now_ms();
            double h = t1 - g_gil_rel_ms; if (h < 0) h = 0;
            GilStat *s = gil_stat_for(who); if (s) s->n++; g_gs_tot.n++; g_gs_win.n++;
            gil_note(s, t1 - t0, h); gil_note(&g_gs_tot, t1 - t0, h); gil_note(&g_gs_win, t1 - t0, h);
            tl_acq_ms = t1; tl_acq_blk = nfsu2_blocked_ms(); tl_holding = 1; tl_barged = 1;
            return; }
        t1 = nfsu2_now_ms();
    }
    g_gil_frame_queued++;
    gil_acquire(who);
}
/* WaitForSingleObject on a free mutex (win32_ext_call): keep the GIL instead
 * of handing it over, unless another thread queues for it and this one has
 * held it for 2 ms.  The game thread handed it over at every take of the
 * sound library's mutex (~119,000 times in a 50 s race), and each hand-over
 * to a waiting worker risks a late wake-up (ticketlock.h).  Taking every
 * free mutex outright cut the late frames of a race's warm drive from ~8 to
 * ~6 a run, but in a heavy free-roam scene (32 friends' cars, 13.5 ms of
 * game work a frame) the other threads then waited 4 to 10 times longer
 * (the loader 0.7 -> 8.7 ms on average, p99 33 -> 262 ms): the game thread
 * let go only at its pacer sleep.  The 2 ms bound keeps their waits near
 * what the old hand-overs gave.  NFSU2_GIL_KEEP_MS sets it (0: hand over at
 * every take, as before). */
static double g_gil_keep_ms = -1;
static int gil_keep_for_mutex(void){
    if (g_gil_keep_ms < 0){ const char *e = getenv("NFSU2_GIL_KEEP_MS"); g_gil_keep_ms = e && *e ? atof(e) : 2.0; }
    if (g_gil_use_mx || !(g_gil_keep_ms > 0) || !tl_holding) return 0;
    return !ticket_queued(&g_gil) || nfsu2_now_ms() - tl_acq_ms < g_gil_keep_ms;
}
static void gil_release(void){
    double now = nfsu2_now_ms();
    if (tl_holding){
        double b = held_busy(now);
        if (b > 0){ tl_busy_ms += b; g_busy_all_ms += b; }
        tl_holding = 0;
    }
    g_gil_rel_ms = now;
    if (g_gil_use_mx) pthread_mutex_unlock(&g_gil_mx);
    else if (tl_barged){ tl_barged = 0; ticket_barge_unlock(&g_gil); }
    else ticket_unlock(&g_gil);
}
static double gil_pct(const uint32_t *hist, uint64_t n, double p){   /* upper edge of the bucket, ms */
    uint64_t want = (uint64_t)(p * (double)n + 0.5), acc = 0;
    for (int k = 0; k < 24; k++){ acc += hist[k]; if (acc >= want && want) return (double)(2u << k) / 1000.0; }
    return 0;
}
static void gil_print(const char *what, const GilStat *s){
    fprintf(stderr, "  %-12s %9llu taken, %8llu queued (%4.1f%%): wait avg %.3f p50<%.3f p99<%.3f max %.2f ms;"
                    " hand-off avg %.3f p50<%.3f p99<%.3f max %.2f ms\n", what,
            (unsigned long long)s->n, (unsigned long long)s->queued, s->n ? 100.0 * (double)s->queued / (double)s->n : 0.0,
            s->queued ? s->wait_ms / (double)s->queued : 0.0, gil_pct(s->whist, s->queued, 0.5), gil_pct(s->whist, s->queued, 0.99),
            s->wait_max_ms, s->queued ? s->hand_ms / (double)s->queued : 0.0, gil_pct(s->hhist, s->queued, 0.5),
            gil_pct(s->hhist, s->queued, 0.99), s->hand_max_ms);
}
void win32_gil_report(void){
    /* the mutex cannot tell whether anyone took it: there every fair yield
     * released it (and every 32nd napped 50 us) */
    fprintf(stderr, "  guest lock (%s), queued acquisitions; %llu fair yields %s; %llu frame-boundary takes, %llu queued after 20 ms:\n",
            g_gil_use_mx > 0 ? "pthread mutex, NFSU2_GIL=mutex" : "FIFO ticket lock", (unsigned long long)g_gil_fair_yields,
            g_gil_use_mx > 0 ? "released it" : "handed it over",
            (unsigned long long)g_gil_frame_takes, (unsigned long long)g_gil_frame_queued);
    gil_print("all", &g_gs_tot);
    for (int i = 0; i < g_gs_n; i++){ char nm[32]; snprintf(nm, sizeof nm, "tid %u", g_gs[i].tid); gil_print(nm, &g_gs[i]); }
}
/* [status] (autotest.c): the guest lock since the last status line, and the
 * worst wait of any one thread in that window */
int win32_gil_status(char *buf, size_t n){
    GilStat *w = &g_gs_win;
    int k = snprintf(buf, n, " gil=%llu/%llu wait<%.2f/%.2fms hand<%.3f/%.2fms",
                     (unsigned long long)w->queued, (unsigned long long)w->n, gil_pct(w->whist, w->queued, 0.99), w->wait_max_ms,
                     gil_pct(w->hhist, w->queued, 0.99), w->hand_max_ms);
    memset(w, 0, sizeof *w);
    return k;
}
#endif
void guest_lock(CPU *c){ ts_set(TS_GIL, 0); gil_acquire(c); tl_cpu=c; g_cur_cpu=c; reg_cpu(c); gil_took(); ts_set(TS_RUN, 0); }
void guest_unlock(void){ ts_set(TS_IDLE, 0); gil_gave(); gil_release(); }
/* Exit path (boot.c): take the lock for good, so no guest thread can start
 * another file or registry write while the process goes down.  A helper
 * thread queues on the mutex (a trylock loop would never win against the
 * guest, which re-locks right after each yield) and then keeps it; returns
 * 0 if that did not happen within max_ms (a guest thread stuck in a call). */
static pthread_mutex_t g_frz_mx = PTHREAD_MUTEX_INITIALIZER;
static pthread_cond_t  g_frz_cv = PTHREAD_COND_INITIALIZER;
static int g_frozen = 0;
static void *freeze_main(void *unused){
    (void)unused;
    gil_acquire(NULL);
    pthread_mutex_lock(&g_frz_mx); g_frozen = 1; pthread_cond_broadcast(&g_frz_cv);
    pthread_mutex_unlock(&g_frz_mx);
    for (;;) pause();
    return 0;
}
int win32_freeze_guest(int max_ms){
    pthread_t th;
    if (pthread_create(&th, 0, freeze_main, 0) != 0) return 0;
    pthread_detach(th);
    struct timespec ts; clock_gettime(CLOCK_REALTIME, &ts);
    ts.tv_sec += max_ms / 1000; ts.tv_nsec += (long)(max_ms % 1000) * 1000000L;
    if (ts.tv_nsec >= 1000000000L){ ts.tv_sec++; ts.tv_nsec -= 1000000000L; }
    pthread_mutex_lock(&g_frz_mx);
    while (!g_frozen && pthread_cond_timedwait(&g_frz_cv, &g_frz_mx, &ts) == 0) {}
    int ok = g_frozen;
    pthread_mutex_unlock(&g_frz_mx);
    return ok;
}
static void guest_yield_begin(void){ gil_gave(); gil_release(); }
static void guest_yield_end(void){
    ts_set(TS_GIL, 0);
    gil_acquire(tl_cpu); g_cur_cpu = tl_cpu; gil_took();
    ts_set(TS_RUN, 0);
}
static void guest_yield_end_frame(void){         /* the frame pacer's: gil_acquire_frame */
    ts_set(TS_GIL, 0);
    gil_acquire_frame(tl_cpu); g_cur_cpu = tl_cpu; gil_took();
    ts_set(TS_RUN, 0);
}
/* Host-side blocking waits inside an HLE call (metal_present) */
void guest_wait_begin(void){ ts_set(TS_IDLE, 0); guest_yield_begin(); }   /* watchdog: host side */
void guest_wait_end(void){ guest_yield_end(); }
/* Sleep with the big lock released (win32.c: the game's frame wait loop). */
uint64_t g_sleep_late_ns, g_sleep_gil_ns, g_sleep_n;    /* diagnostics: sleep lateness / lock wait */
#ifdef __wasm__
/* wasm: nanosleep is the worker's Atomics.wait with a timeout, which wakes on
 * the OS timer.  On Windows that timer ticks every 1 ms or every 15.6 ms,
 * depending on what else the browser is doing (Chrome 155, 2026-10-19: a
 * 1 ms wait took 15.5 ms at the median, a few came back after ~1 ms), and
 * every oversleep of the frame pacer cost a 120 Hz slot: a race ran at
 * 94 fps where the game thread's work alone allows 119.  So the wait ends a
 * margin before the deadline, the margin is waited in shorter waits as far
 * as the timer allows, and the rest is spun on the clock, with the guest
 * lock still released.  The margin is learned from the waits: it jumps to a
 * late wake-up and comes down slowly.  No spin while the page does not draw
 * (a hidden tab): nobody sees the frames then.
 *
 * Whether a wait can be tried at all comes from a probe thread, not from
 * the pacer's own waits.  Before, with the 15.6 ms timer the pacer spun its
 * whole sleep until its margin had come down below the sleep, every 1.5 to
 * 5 s, and the wait it then tried mostly overslept by up to 15 ms: one or two
 * slots lost, a hitch every few seconds.  The probe waits 1 ms right after a
 * wake-up, every ~10 ms, and keeps the lateness: up at once to a late one,
 * down in about a second to the fine timer's.  The pacer's margin is never
 * below what that lateness needs, so on the coarse timer it does not try.
 * The timer is the process's, so the probe's waits stand for the pacer's.
 * Without a probe (no thread to be had) the margin alone decides, as before. */
int hfr_display_live(void);              /* framerate.c */
static _Atomic int g_probe_late_us = -1;                    /* the probe's lateness, -1 = no probe (yet) */
static uint64_t g_probe_n, g_probe_coarse;                  /* diagnostics: probes, those > 4 ms late */
static uint64_t g_ps_n, g_ps_waits, g_ps_over;              /* pacer sleeps, waits tried, waits past the deadline */
static double g_ps_over_max;
/* diagnostics: ms spun on the clock (total, and since the last [status] line with its sleeps), and how late the
 * waits woke: < 0.25, 0.5, 1, 2, 4, 8 ms and later */
static double g_ps_spin_ms, g_ps_spin_win_ms, g_ps_margin; static uint64_t g_ps_win_n;
static uint64_t g_ps_halves, g_ps_hover; static double g_ps_hover_max;   /* the margin's waits, those past the deadline */
static uint64_t g_ps_late_h[7];
int pacer_spin_status(char *buf, size_t n){
    int k = g_ps_win_n ? snprintf(buf, n, " spin=%.2fms/f", g_ps_spin_win_ms / (double)g_ps_win_n) : 0;
    g_ps_spin_win_ms = 0; g_ps_win_n = 0;
    return k;
}
static void *timer_probe_main(void *unused){
    (void)unused;
    double est = -1.0;
    int run = 0, logged = 0;                                /* probes in a row > 4 ms late */
    for (;;){
        struct timespec one = { 0, 1000000L }, rest = { 0, 9000000L };
        double t0 = nfsu2_now_ms();
        nanosleep(&one, 0);
        double late = nfsu2_now_ms() - t0 - 1.0;
        if (late < 0.0) late = 0.0;
        est = est < 0.0 || late > est ? late : est + (late - est) * 0.03;
        atomic_store(&g_probe_late_us, (int)(est * 1000.0));
        g_probe_n++;
        if (!(late > 4.0)) run = 0;
        else {
            g_probe_coarse++;
            if (++run == 10 && !logged){                    /* once: a coarse timer, not a blip */
                logged = 1;
                fprintf(stderr, "[timer] 1 ms waits take %.1f ms: the frame pacer spins its sleeps while the browser's timer is this coarse\n",
                        late + 1.0);
            }
        }
        if (!hfr_display_live()) rest.tv_nsec = 250000000L;
        nanosleep(&rest, 0);
    }
    return 0;
}
static void timer_probe_start(void){
    pthread_t th;
    if (pthread_create(&th, 0, timer_probe_main, 0) == 0) pthread_detach(th);
}
/* exit report (main_web.c), under the frame-rate section */
void pacer_sleep_report(void){
    if (!g_ps_n) return;
    int pl = atomic_load(&g_probe_late_us);
    fprintf(stderr, "  pacer sleeps: %llu, an OS wait tried in %llu (%.1f %%), %llu of them woke past the deadline (worst %.2f ms)\n",
            (unsigned long long)g_ps_n, (unsigned long long)g_ps_waits, 100.0 * g_ps_waits / g_ps_n,
            (unsigned long long)g_ps_over, g_ps_over_max);
    if (pl >= 0)
        fprintf(stderr, "  timer probe: %llu waits of 1 ms, %.1f %% more than 4 ms late, lateness now %.2f ms\n",
                (unsigned long long)g_probe_n, g_probe_n ? 100.0 * g_probe_coarse / g_probe_n : 0.0, pl / 1000.0);
    else fprintf(stderr, "  timer probe: none (no thread)\n");
    uint64_t lw = 0; for (int i = 0; i < 7; i++) lw += g_ps_late_h[i];
    double q = lw ? 100.0 / (double)lw : 0.0;
    fprintf(stderr, "  pacer spin: %.2f ms per sleep, margin now %.2f ms; its waits woke late by < 0.25 ms %.1f %%, < 0.5 %.1f %%, "
            "< 1 %.1f %%, < 2 %.1f %%, < 4 %.1f %%, < 8 %.1f %%, more %.1f %%\n", g_ps_spin_ms / (double)g_ps_n, g_ps_margin,
            g_ps_late_h[0] * q, g_ps_late_h[1] * q, g_ps_late_h[2] * q, g_ps_late_h[3] * q, g_ps_late_h[4] * q, g_ps_late_h[5] * q,
            g_ps_late_h[6] * q);
    if (g_ps_halves)
        fprintf(stderr, "  pacer margin waits: %.2f per sleep, %llu woke past the deadline (worst %.2f ms)\n",
                (double)g_ps_halves / (double)g_ps_n, (unsigned long long)g_ps_hover, g_ps_hover_max);
}
static void ps_late(double ms){
    int i = ms < 0.25 ? 0 : ms < 0.5 ? 1 : ms < 1.0 ? 2 : ms < 2.0 ? 3 : ms < 4.0 ? 4 : ms < 8.0 ? 5 : 6;
    g_ps_late_h[i]++;
}
static void sleep_precise_ns(int64_t ns){
    static _Thread_local double margin = 2.0;               /* ms */
    static pthread_once_t probe_once = PTHREAD_ONCE_INIT;
    /* NFSU2_PACE_SPIN=0 (benchmarks): no spin, so the game thread's
     * instruction count is its work alone (web/tools/bench.mjs) */
    static int spin = -1;
    if (spin < 0){ const char *e = getenv("NFSU2_PACE_SPIN"); spin = !(e && *e == '0'); }
    if (!spin || !hfr_display_live()){
        struct timespec ts = { (time_t)(ns / 1000000000LL), (long)(ns % 1000000000LL) };
        double t0 = nfsu2_now_ms();
        nanosleep(&ts, 0);
        if (spin || !hfr_display_live()) return;            /* a hidden page: not counted */
        g_ps_n++; g_ps_win_n++; g_ps_waits++; ps_late(nfsu2_now_ms() - t0 - (double)ns / 1e6);
        return;
    }
    pthread_once(&probe_once, timer_probe_start);
    int pl = atomic_load(&g_probe_late_us);
    double need = pl < 0 ? 0.0 : pl / 1000.0 * 1.25 + 0.25;   /* what the probe's lateness needs */
    double t0 = nfsu2_now_ms(), until = t0 + (double)ns / 1e6, coarse = until - (margin > need ? margin : need) - t0;
    g_ps_n++; g_ps_win_n++;
    if (coarse >= 0.25){
        int64_t cns = (int64_t)(coarse * 1e6);
        struct timespec ts = { (time_t)(cns / 1000000000LL), (long)(cns % 1000000000LL) };
        nanosleep(&ts, 0);
        double t1 = nfsu2_now_ms(), want = (t1 - (t0 + coarse)) * 1.25 + 0.25;
        margin = want > margin ? want : margin - (margin - want) * 0.02;
        g_ps_waits++; ps_late(t1 - (t0 + coarse));
        if (t1 > until){ g_ps_over++; if (t1 - until > g_ps_over_max) g_ps_over_max = t1 - until; }
    } else margin *= 0.997;                                  /* no wait made */
    if (margin < 0.5) margin = 0.5;
    if (margin > 20.0) margin = 20.0;
    g_ps_margin = margin;
    /* The margin is mostly waited too, in waits of half what is left: a wait wakes late by a share of its
     * length (WebKit, Safari and every iPhone browser: a 10 ms wait 1-4 ms, a 1 ms wait 0.3 ms), so the
     * halves end close to the deadline, the last wait (as short as the probe's) ends what the probe's
     * lateness needs before it, and only that is spun.  Spinning the whole margin there was 2.7 ms a frame
     * at 60 fps, 0.7 ms with these waits, and the web content process took a quarter less CPU in free roam
     * with no more missed slots (Playwright WebKit, M4 Pro, 2026-10-24; a player's iPhone log has the
     * same 0.3 ms for the probe's 1 ms waits).  No such wait
     * is shorter than 0.25 ms or ends later than the probe's lateness allows, so a coarse timer (probe
     * lateness at the timer's tick) never tries one. */
    static int halve = -1;
    if (halve < 0){ const char *e = getenv("NFSU2_PACE_HALVE"); halve = !(e && *e == '0'); }
    double hneed = need > 0.4 ? need : 0.4;
    for (double rem; halve && pl >= 0 && (rem = until - nfsu2_now_ms()) >= hneed + 0.25;){
        int64_t hns = (int64_t)((rem >= 2.0 * hneed ? rem * 0.5 : rem - hneed) * 1e6);
        struct timespec ts = { (time_t)(hns / 1000000000LL), (long)(hns % 1000000000LL) };
        nanosleep(&ts, 0);
        g_ps_halves++;
        double t2 = nfsu2_now_ms();
        if (t2 > until){ g_ps_hover++; if (t2 - until > g_ps_hover_max) g_ps_hover_max = t2 - until; break; }
    }
    double s0 = nfsu2_now_ms(), s1 = s0;
    while (s1 < until) s1 = nfsu2_now_ms();
    g_ps_spin_ms += s1 - s0; g_ps_spin_win_ms += s1 - s0;
}
#else
/* On macOS nanosleep wakes up with the timer coalescing slack: in the game a
 * 3 ms request is 447 us late on average (separate measurement: median
 * ~770 us, QoS makes no difference).  A kevent timer with NOTE_CRITICAL is
 * not coalesced: median ~45 us. */
static void sleep_precise_ns(int64_t ns){
    static _Thread_local int kq = -1;
    if (kq < 0) kq = kqueue();
    if (kq >= 0){
        struct kevent ev, out;
        EV_SET(&ev, 1, EVFILT_TIMER, EV_ADD | EV_ONESHOT, NOTE_NSECONDS | NOTE_CRITICAL, ns, 0);
        if (kevent(kq, &ev, 1, &out, 1, NULL) == 1) return;
    }
    struct timespec ts = { (time_t)(ns / 1000000000LL), (long)(ns % 1000000000LL) };
    nanosleep(&ts, 0);
}
#endif
static void sleep_released(int64_t ns, int frame){
    struct timespec a, b, d;
    guest_yield_begin();
    clock_gettime(CLOCK_MONOTONIC, &a); sleep_precise_ns(ns); clock_gettime(CLOCK_MONOTONIC, &b);
    if (frame) guest_yield_end_frame(); else guest_yield_end();
    clock_gettime(CLOCK_MONOTONIC, &d);
    int64_t sl = (int64_t)(b.tv_sec - a.tv_sec) * 1000000000LL + (b.tv_nsec - a.tv_nsec) - ns;
    int64_t gl = (int64_t)(d.tv_sec - b.tv_sec) * 1000000000LL + (d.tv_nsec - b.tv_nsec);
    g_sleep_late_ns += sl > 0 ? (uint64_t)sl : 0; g_sleep_gil_ns += (uint64_t)gl; g_sleep_n++;
}
void guest_sleep_ns(int64_t ns){ sleep_released(ns, 0); }
/* The frame pacer's sleep to its slot boundary (framerate.c): the guest lock
 * is taken back ahead of the queue (gil_acquire_frame). */
void guest_sleep_frame_ns(int64_t ns){ sleep_released(ns, 1); }

/* --- frame rate lock (60 Hz) ---------------------------------------
 * The virtual clock advances EXACTLY 16.667 ms per frame, so the game's
 * speed = (real fps / 60).  At 117 fps from the emulator the game ran at
 * 195% speed.  Locking the frame to 60 Hz makes the speed independent of
 * the FPS.  The big lock is RELEASED while sleeping, or the worker threads
 * stall. */
/* TIMELOG=1: the virtual/real time ratio and frame count once a second.
 * To measure the "the game speeds up needlessly in cut scenes" complaint --
 * a ratio above 1.0 means the game really is running fast. */
static void timelog_tick(void){
    static int on = -1;
    if (on < 0){ const char *e = getenv("TIMELOG"); on = (e && *e && *e != '0'); }
    if (!on) return;
    uint64_t host_us(void);
    static uint64_t lr = 0, lv = 0; static long lf = 0;
    long metal_frames(void);
    uint64_t r = gil_now_us(), v = host_us();
    long f = metal_frames();
    if (!lr){ lr = r; lv = v; lf = f; return; }
    if (r - lr < 1000000ull) return;
    fprintf(stderr, "  [time] real %.2f s, virtual %.2f s, ratio %.3f, %ld frames (%.1f fps)\n",
            (r-lr)/1e6, (v-lv)/1e6, (double)(v-lv)/(double)(r-lr),
            f-lf, (f-lf)*1e6/(double)(r-lr));
    lr = r; lv = v; lf = f;
}

void frame_pace(void){
    timelog_tick();
    /* DEFAULT: NO BRAKE.  The 60 Hz rationale above NO LONGER HOLDS --
     * since the virtual clock moved to VCLOCK=real the game speed is
     * independent of the real fps (measured: virtual/real = 0.999 at both
     * 63.7 and 99 fps).  With the brake on, 61% of a race frame was
     * nanosleep; with it off the race went 63.7 -> 79.4 fps, the menus
     * 120 fps (the display refresh limit).  PACE60=1 restores the old
     * behaviour.  Vsync already cuts off runaway fps; the virtual clock's
     * per-frame step has a 4 ms (250 fps) floor. */
    static int off = -1;
    if (off < 0){ const char *e = getenv("PACE60");
                  int hfr_mode_off(void);
                  off = !(e && *e && *e != '0');
                  /* framerate.c paces every frame unless NFSU2_FPS=off: no second limiter */
                  if (!off && !hfr_mode_off()){
                      fprintf(stderr, "PACE60 ignored: the frame pacer is active (NFSU2_FPS=off restores the old timing)\n");
                      off = 1; } }
    if (off) return;
    static uint64_t deadline = 0;
    struct timespec ts;
    clock_gettime(CLOCK_MONOTONIC, &ts);
    uint64_t now = (uint64_t)ts.tv_sec*1000000ull + (uint64_t)ts.tv_nsec/1000ull;
    if (!deadline || now > deadline + 200000ull) deadline = now;   /* far behind: reset */
    deadline += 16667ull;
    if (now < deadline){
        uint64_t d = deadline - now;
        struct timespec sl = { (time_t)(d/1000000ull), (long)((d%1000000ull)*1000ull) };
        guest_yield_begin();
        nanosleep(&sl, 0);
        guest_yield_end();
    }
}

/* Fair GIL: guest code can also spin on non-blocking Win32 calls
 * (e.g. a wait loop spinning on EnterCriticalSection).  We periodically
 * release the lock and give the other guest threads a turn.           */
/* ---- REAL critical sections ------------------------------------------
 * EnterCriticalSection/LeaveCriticalSection used to be no-op stubs.  The
 * single big lock (GIL) covered for them most of the time BUT
 * guest_fair_yield releases the GIL every 1024 Win32 calls: a thread could
 * lose the lock while INSIDE a critical section and another thread could
 * enter the same section.  That silently corrupts the game's loader/audio/
 * video queues.
 *
 * The GIL MUST BE RELEASED while waiting for the lock, or it deadlocks.  */
#define MAXCS 512
